comments: Very close to the train, and he was such a fab host. Friendly, welcoming, always loved our chats.
Martin was a great and attentive host! Super responsive and maintains the space very well. Would definitely stay again.
We were a group of 6 and this was perfect for us. Henri was very responsive and gave clear instructions on how to check in.
Lovely place, great location. A lot of fun
Great property with easy access to the subways. Extra thoughtful amenities, everything you need for a nice stay. Great decor. Parking isn’t easy but it’s the real experience.
We loved it Sami’s place in NYC! Clean, conveniently located, lots of space, and everything needed to make our stay wonderful. Better than we expected! I would give 10 stars if I could!

Kamran’s place is definitely beautiful and welcoming! So many beautiful decorations and candles. It’s really clean and the scent of candles smells great! We all LOVED spending time here and really appreciate Kamran for his timely response!
Great stay! Especially staying for long stays. Convenient location and felt like home away from home 😊
Everything was perfect , easy and flexible check in. I would highly recommend!

We stayed here for 3 nights with 6 people. George was very responsive and let us check in early! If we needed anything that wasn’t available at the house he would be quick to respond and get whatever we needed! Roof top was awesome and beds were super comfy! It was a great place to come back to after a long day/night in the city, thanks so much George for the wonderful stay :)

Superhosts indeed! Carlos and Yvette are amazing, caring, loving people and super amazing hosts. As soon as you enter their home you can feel peace, warmth, coziness, and love. Cleanliness is wow! Kitchen, bathroom, bedroom just spotless. I love how the bedsheets and pillowcases smell soooo good and clean, makes you want to stay in bed all day. The bedroom is very cozy and private, good closet space with toiletries included, yay! I would have booked another week but the room was already reserved. Thankfully another room was available and right away I booked. Thank you Carlos and Yvette for your wonderful home! You are a great team!
Awesome area with a great of restaurants and breweries/bars to tour. And parks just a few steps away!
excellent experience. very clean and quiet with Gus being a great host.

Danette is very a kind and polite person.
Place is clean and relatively safe neighborhood. Quiet and comfortable.
Subway station is the best part about the stay. Its literally across the street and 30 minutes away from Time Square.
She is a great host. J definitely recommend it !!!

Liz ist sehr nett und hilft bei allen Problemen, die auftauchen. Selbst wenn sie es nicht direkt weiß, recherchiert sie es und man kann sie immer über ihr Handy erreichen. Da sie viel arbeitet, hat man die Wohnung meistens  für sich allein. Ihre Katze Allie ist sehr lieb und zutraulich. Das Zimmer ist sehr großzügig und geht nach hinten zum "Garten" raus, sodass man keinen Straßenlärm hört. Das eigene Bad ist ein zusätzlicher Pluspunkt und mit allem Benötigtem ausgestattet. Die U-Bahn ist in wenigen Minuten zu erreichen und bringt einen in 15-30 Minuten nach Manhattan (je nachdem wo man hin möchte). Wenn wir wieder nach New York kommen, werden wir auf jeden Fall wieder dort wohnen. Vielen dank Liz für deine Gastfreundschaft!

Der Raum an sich war sauber und nett hergerichtet und das Bett war frisch überzogen.
Leider war es für uns als zwei Männer mit 1,85m und 2,0m kaum möglich sich zu bewegen. Sobald ein Koffer geöffnet auf dem Boden lag, konnte der Raum nicht mehr verlassen werden.
Das Bett an sich war okay - etwas laut aber dennoch in Ordnung.
Das größte Manko lag leider im Bad. Hier konnten wir sowohl in der öffentlichen Toilette als auch in der Dusche massiven Schimmel finden. Das war sehr unangenehm und wir haben uns aus diesem Grund auch gegen einen weiteren Aufenthalt entschieden.
Gott sei Dank war Airbnb so frei und hat uns einen Teil unseres Geldes zurück überwiesen.
Trotz der Kommunikation mit Airbnb hat der Vermieter nicht verstanden, dass wir seine Wohnung nicht mehr bewohnen.
Zum Glück wurden wir schnell fündig und konnten in eine weitere Unterkunft umziehen.
Elena’s place is near everything and super convenient to walk to Times Square and Broadways shows. My Wife and I enjoyed our time there and would definitely recommend this location to our friends.

Very well decorated and full of amenities,  like toiletries, luxurious towels, and water and snacks. Having a private bathroom and a work desk is a huge plus. I did not have a chance to utilize these, but there is also a kitchen and a laundry unit in the apartment. The pictures of the bedroom are accurate, the bed sturdy, and the self check-in instructions were clear (just make sure to read them).
Great Communication. Great Location  Any problem we had were discussed and sorted.
This is a true hidden gem in park slope and has become our go to for all visiting family members. Exactly as pictured, great location, excellent hosts. No complaints!

We arrived to Sandra's place on Friday night and she was very nice and welcoming. I specifically asked her about Parking in her busy Brooklyn neighborhood and she reassured me that I could park anywhere on her street that didn't have fire hydrants. We parked as directed on her street Friday and Saturday night without any problems but on Sunday morning received a big fat ticket for $115.00. Needless to say we were upset but even more than that we were confused because we parked exactly as told. When we told sandra l, she said we should have parked in front of her house but there was a big black SUV in front her house that night and we just chose to park directly behind the SUV because we were told we could as long as there were no fire hydrants. Sandra was not  empathetic at all and when we asked if she could reimburse us she said she could not and none of this was her responsibility. It was a sour ending to an otherwise delightful trip To NY. I would not recommend anyone to stay here.

The service here was impeccable.  The check in was great.  There were plenty of people ready to help at anytime.  The food was excellent as was the restaurant service.  We would definitely stay again!

Jospeh was great. He was great in responding and the pictures are as advertised. The apartment was clean when I arrived and the kitchen was stocked as well. The neighborhood is good and close to the subway. I will definitely stay here again.
Amazing communication and was always attentive but not at all overbearing. We had a great stay at Michaels!

Staying at Mel's place was a very pleasant experience for my girlfriend and I. After some initial difficulty finding a mutually agreeable check-in time, our stay was comfortable, convenient (5-minute walk from Subway), and cheap compared to comparable AirBnB locations in the neighborhood.
Highly recommended!

Excelente ubicación para moverse en metro de forma rápida, aproximadamente a unos 25/30 minutos de muchos de los atractivos principales (Manhattan por ejemplo) y a 6 cuadras de la estación de subte. A 30 min aprox de JFK, también fácil de moverse con el AirTrain. Sheila muy amable, nos brindó privacidad y comodidad toda la estadía. Llegamos y teníamos productos como agua, refrescos y cosas dulces para disfrutar, además de artículos básicos de baño de cortesía, y compartimos todas nuestras mañanas con su mascota, una gatita muy amorosa!
Muy felices de la experiencia y sin duda volveremos a este alojamiento; gracias a Sheila y su amabilidad para con nosotros!
Tolle Unterkunft und sehr nette Gastgeberin!!

Incredibly close to the G train and only blocks away from various fantastic bars and restaurants. Rosa was incredibly communicative and hospitable! The place was clean and so charming. Every need was thought out for comfort in the room including a fan, A/C,  and a sound machine for troubled sleepers! Would definitely stay here again.

Very nice and cleane place. I suggest to personne who wanna trip in queens to reserve it.
The coffee was good and free.
Thx cando🤙🏾

I had a great time during my stay. Dusean is a great communicator and the accommodations were very nice. Beautiful home within a good proximity to the city. Overall enjoyed my stay and would recommend to others.
Perfect location in the middle of Manhattan. Pretty spacious, especially for the location. Eell equipped kitchenette was a nice bonus. Beds are spacious and comfortable. Not too much noise.

excellent location! minutes to the nearest subway station.
lots of food options in the area.
try the Mexican food in this area for sure.
$2.00 taco truck (El Bronco) around the corner from the house . 5th av
check out sunset park.
Skip is super nice and his two cats. =-)
we felt very comfortable and at home.
thanks for much Skip! we would stay here again when we come back to ny!
perfect for an overnight stay from JFK airport
Great Chelsea location! Easy walk to so many different neighborhoods in NYC - can’t beat it.

Esta fue nuestra primera experiencia en Airbnb y fue increíble. La casa está muy bien ubicada y tiene muy buena conexión con el resto de la ciudad (a media cuadra de la estación del metro). Steve siempre respondió rápidamente nuestros mensajes, la casa es preciosa y la habitación que nos tocó es muy grande y cómoda. 100% recomendado este alojamiento.

I was 7 nigths in this apartment, and i can say that is PERFECT. The place is very close to the subway. In 10 mins i was in Manhattan. I can hear the train noise, but finished so tired of walking that I did not care.
The building is a little old. The neighbors are very quiet. You could rest perfectly. The apartment is in a perfect place. I had all kinds of shops, fruit shop, restaurants, coffes and 2 supermarket 24H.
It was my first trip to New York and it was perfect.

Thank you very much Lilian.

Rebekah is a wonderful host, very attentive and always with quick answers.
The apartment was very clean and good located, just next to a local subway directly connected with Manhattan.

We stayed as a group of four in the Penthouse Apartment, and it was absolutely fantastic! The apartment itself is beautiful and well-maintained. The express train nearby made it super easy to get to the city (Manhatten) quickly, and there are plenty of shopping (Food-Markets) options in the area.
The host was incredibly responsive, thoughtful, and made our stay very comfortable with lots of helpful information and a welcoming attitude.
Special shoutout to the house manager – what an amazing person! He was incredibly kind, always ready to help, and his knowledge of the area made our trip even better. Truly a fantastic guy who added so much to our experience.
All in all, it was a wonderful trip, and we couldn’t have asked for a better place to stay. 10/10!

Space was conveniently located, clean, comfortable (A+ on sheet selection), and spacious. I did not personally meet Dylana, but she was very kind and reaponsive via message.  Would stay again! Thanks Dylana.
Very centrally located and easy to get in and out. It was certainly smaller than we anticipated but overall given the location it’s to be expected.

Rosie was a great host whilst we were over in NYC for Halloween. The apartment is super cool and cosy and Rosie was around to chat and recommend us places to go (she even lent me some things for my Halloween costume!)
Would definitely recommend / stay here again :)

Lejligheden ligger i et dejligt område i Brooklyn. Du finder masser af hyggelige cafeer og restauranter i nabolaget. Beliggenheden er faktisk en smule provinsiel, selvom vi er i New York. Du skal vide at det trådløse netværk er meget langsomt men værten har lovet at kigge på det.
Transport rundt i byen klart bedst med et kort til undergrundstoget. Kort til syv dage koster 33 $. Et andet rigtig godt alternativ er at leje cykler. Prøv city bike som har stationer over alt i New York. New York er en rigtig cykel by med cykelsti og cyklingveje mange steder i byen. Lejligheden har vor varmeste anbefaling.
Great Airbnb! Very clean and comfortable and in a good location.

Overall a great value! The host is so kind and helpful. The place is clean, comfortable, close to JFK with optional pick up\drop off service, and is just as pictured with a modern decor! I definitely recommend staying here, especially if travelling to or from JFK!
Very nice people, and good location.

I highly recommend Reka's place. She was so helpful and accommodating. The apartment is beautiful, clean and stylish, the bed extremely comfortable and the balcony has the best view... the location is in such a great part of NYC - I highly recommend to all. Thank you Reka!

Great place to stay at. Some good local shops and bars and only 20 mins away (if taking the underground) to grand central/ Times Square.
Room is very cosy and spacious and the place in general is very clean.
Only bad thing is the construction work going on next door but this is not a massive issue at all.
As I was a first timer coming to New York, I was worried about the area, but don't be. The neighbourhood is fine.
I would recommend this hotel to anyone who wants a lavish hotel, but not at Manhattan prices. Hotel was competitive and I won't hesitate in staying there again if I decide to visit NY.
After full days of sightseeing,  we were happy to relax here. Slept very well!! Easy walk to the subway from which you can get most anywhere.

Anibal’s place was a delightful retreat in the city! Check-in and arrival went very smoothly. The apartment is welcoming, cozy, and has everything we needed. With two beds and an air mattress it is great for three adults (or more if you don’t mind sharing). The little backyard is adorable as well!
Local restaurants were solidly excellent. Very easy public transit access to get to and from Manhattan and JFK airport; cross-town was easy enough towards Long Island City or the beach. Highly recommend!!
Great Location, spacious and bright Place.
Great place! Great location!
Craig is excellent host. His place is great and room was perfect. Craig was helpful with anything I needed. Highly recommend! 😊 excellent space and location. Really recommended! 😊

Out stay at Tasny’s place was great! The apartment has anything you need to make yourself comfortable, and the location is unbeatable.
Tasny is a great host too, always helpful and ready to answer any question.
If you are thinking on a place to stay for a short or long period in ny, and you see this place available don’t doubt it and book it!

I stayed at Marinela's place for 6 weeks during school. She is friendly, responsive, and caring. The apartment is clean, spacious, and comfy. The view of the verrazano bridge is nice and the parking space is a big plus
Great location, unique stay in a cool neighborhood! Blake was very responsive and flexible with our check in, which was very helpful.

We enjoyed our 4-night stay at Brady’s! If you’re familiar with hostel-style accommodations then this would likely be a good fit. Sound does carry throughout the house so might be helpful to bring earplugs if you’re sensitive to noise. 2 blocks from the J and walkable to the A/C lines so it was easy getting around. Would stay here again :)

Danny, the host, was amazing. He was super responsive and on top of any little issue we had. He made a lot of recommendations and made getting in super easy. The apartment is quaint but quite comfortable and super close to the park. We love staying on the upper east side and this was perfectly located with a gym across the street that does daily passes and a Whole Foods and target only a couple blocks away. Highly recommend Danny’s place to stay!

This space is just perfect; I loved everything about the apartment, and Savannah included so many extra thoughtful touches that made feeling at home almost instantaneous. The neighborhood was fantastic and every day we found delicious food and fun places within walking distance. I can't wait to stay here again!
Amazing find! This place was great. I consider myself lucky finding this stay labor day weekend. lourdes is a great host with A1 communication. I'll definitely be booking again, next time I'm in NY.
Great place to stay ! Will definitely stay again !
10/10 Recommend! Would stay again! Fantastic location and great host communication.
He’s very nice he’s very nice the house I like
Great everything. Staycation or traveling to nyc best spot best price. Clean comfy easy access

Michelle’s place is conveniently located near to the subway which allowed for easy access into Manhatten. The kitchen was well stocked for us to cook a meal during our stay. Both Michelle and her husband were easy to contact and responded immediately.
William was nice and always helpful! Very good host.

Nous sommes arrivés tard en soirée et nous avons apprécié l’accès facile notamment avec le digicode. Le logement était conforme à nos attentes, Kim est très agréable et sympathique.
De plus, le logement se trouve à 2 minutes à pied d’une station de métro (accès facile pour Manhattan).
On recommande.
Perfectly situated for a Manhattan experience,
The place is very nice and clean. I will stay there again.

Agnes was so kindness , she made me feel so special guest. My wife and I enjoyed a great time. I highly recommended Agnes Place to stay.
Thank you,
Tomas
The Lordon's were very responsive, great back yard seating. very accommodating for our need for early in. Good deal for price good

Un lugar muy bien ubicado, se puede ir andando hasta times square perfectamente. La habitación es pequeña pero acertada, no nos faltó de nada. Había aire acondicionado, papel higiénico, pañuelos y toallas. También un calefactor para el invierno. Los baños estaban siempre muy limpios. Ninguna queja de los vecinos,  la mayoría también extranjeros y solo se les veía alguna vez si coincidías al salir o entrar. Mi única queja sería una cucaracha que apareció en mi habitación,  un pequeño incidente. En general muy contento y repetiría sin ninguna duda.

This is a very clean and spacious one-bedroom space in Brooklyn. I booked this for my parents to stay while they visited so they could be within walkable distance. They loved the ease and walk-ability of the neighborhood itself. Check in was flexible and instructions were clear. The bedroom and backyard are extremely spacious and the entire apartment is very comfortable. A great stay!

Thanks Lee & Teri! Hosts were quite responsive and helpful (quickly addressing a small need when we had it, issue was resolved promptly); space was comfortable for the evenings and very well-located (short walk to Cortelyou Station, also to nearby small food places for breakfast), free parking was accessible nearby (especially with the host-provided advice); and we felt it was affordable considering the location's access to NYC more-broadly and the space/bathroom itself. The one note I would add is that there is a tight staircase leading up to the second floor.
Definitely read their instructions; we found the advice to be helpful & the guidance to be clear.
*TIP: Try and make sure that you are in your vehicle seeking out parking IMMEDIATELY after the street cleaning period closes in the area (Mondays 11:30AM-1PM) - the parking spots fill up and if you miss the window it may be tricky to find a spot without circling for a while/going further away. This worked successfully for us

L’ appartamento è molto grande (eravamo in otto persone) e fornito di tutto. La fermata della metropolitana 116 è vicina e comoda per spostarsi a New York. Non abbiamo avuto problemi con gli abitanti del quartiere anche rientrando tardi la sera. A cena abbiamo potuto sempre mangiare in casa risparmiando molti soldi (c’è un supermarket vicinissimo). Lo consiglierei a chiunque voglia visitare New York!

Beautiful place and location.
Amazing host, always nice and helpful.
Had an amazing time here.

Dan and Jarret's place was everything and more.    The place was incredibly clean and exactly like the photos and as described.  I used to live in Brooklyn previously and this is by far the nicest residence I've ever seen.  On my next trip, I'll definitely stay here again.

This is the best air bnb I’ve ever stayed at. Absolutely gorgeous block with an impressively decorated and designed interior. The space is huge with an awesome roof deck and each room comes equipped with luxurious robes, steamers and other amenities. Truly felt Like we were staying at a five star hotel. We can’t wait for an excuse to come back.

Nice stay in Williamsburg. They have many things going on within the hotel itself. If you have kids or need to get a good nights rest, I would recommend asking for a room furthest away from the club that they have because that kept us up until 4am. Other than that the place is good.

We spent a great week with 4 people in Adriannes apartment. Everything was very clean and working.
The location is located excellent to some metro stations and buslines nearby and the neighborhood is amazing. Many shops, a McDonald just opposite, very nice restaurants, all different kind of churches and lots of friedly people.
Adrianne is an excellent host was available at every time we needed her.
Really a good place to come back to again.

Micheline is a great host! Her place was so clean, well cared for and convenient to access the bus lines. Micheline was always proactive in reaching out to us, she checked in several times which was very appreciated. Micheline is very kind, I hope to stay at her place again!
Place was great and staff was super friendly/helpful
Fantastic host, great location. Very private even though it’s the same entrance for the flats upstairs easy to just shut the doors off

Really nice place with tasteful and considerate of minor touches that make you feel like the host cares about your overall stay.  Bedrooms are a plus with desk and space for getting comfortable. Communication with them host is really good and she is quick to respond. Easy access to the bus stop around the corner (subway transit station or other main bus lines off same route), laundromat, convenience store, and gas station if needed close by. Awesome host!

I really have loved my stay at Priya's. I immediately felt at home and the apartment went far beyond my expectations.
The space is filled with natural light and has been decorated tastefully. The bed is so comfortable, and the bedroom is extremely spacious. The kitchen was also fully stocked with anything I would need, which is essential for a long stay.
I really appreciated the amount of cleaning supplies, towels and bed linens that were provided for me. It made the lack of a washer and dryer much easier to manage, plus there is a laundromat only a 5 minute walk away.
The location felt safe and also provides plenty of restaurants and cafes. The 3 minute walk to the subway is also fantastic - allowing me to get to Manhattan in 25 minutes.
Priya made me feel really welcome in her home and I would recommend to anyone visiting NY. In particular, this space felt very safe as a solo female traveller.
Thanks Priya!

I warmly recommend the experience of staying with Rachael. Upon arrival I found the building older than I had expected, and I mistakenly thought the bathroom was private, while actually it is shared with her. But during a whole week none of this mattered. I never once had to wait to use the bathroom, and toilet, sink and shower were always perfectly clean. I found the room comfortable, and had plenty of pillows and clean bath towels. Rachael was extremely caring and welcoming, and I found the neigbourhood friendly and safe, as well as very convenient for the Subway. Totally worth the experience!

I booked Israel's apartment for my parents and my brother who were visiting from Germany. I live in the neighborhood, so I know how perfectly located the apartment is. It's directly at the Graham Stop, surrounded by cute restaurants, nice bars and supermarkets...It's also super easy to get into Manhattan. The apartment was clean and very nice decorated.

My Mom and I landed in the middle of a snowstorm in New York and got pretty late for check-in .Mike and his family were extremely helpful . It's a really clean place just like you see it in the picture and the subway is really convienent . It's slightly away from the hustle-bustle and we honestly preferred that . Thanks guys ! We'll surely be back soon :)
Wonderful stay for my birthday! Quiet and private street.
10/10 would do again!

Pasamos nuestras vacaciones en NYC en el apartamento de Zackery y lo encontramos bastante cómodo para descansar. Está cerca de la línea 6 del metro, lo que la hace muy conveniente para llegar a diferentes sitios de la ciudad

This is a really great place, excellent location, and exactly as represented. Check in was easy, beds were comfy. Freeway is noisy, but ear plugs are helpful, and supplied by host. Would absolutely book again!

We had a wonderful time at Angela’s. It is in a prime location with plenty of bars and restaurants nearby and subway stop right down the block. This place is perfect if you plan to be gone throughout the day and just need a simple, comfortable space to sleep. Everything was exactly as described, would definitely come back!
Nice & clean hotel. Staff was friendly!

Lisa's place was great! We had a great time there. The boathouse was lovely. It was clean, confortmable. Lisa prepared everything we need and made it feel like home. She also offered to drive us to the nearest station which was great. The neighbourhood was quiet and our neighbour Magen and her friends was so nice and welcoming and gave us lots of great suggestions about traveling in New York. Overall, I loved lisa and agnus' place and I would recommend them to my friends in the future

Sarah and her place are awesome.
It’s my first time to visit New york and my family and friends were very worried about me.
But I had such a great time thanks to her.
She’s very friendly, helped me and every time she saw me, she cared about me. It's really encouraging. Thank you very much!!
I wish I could stay longer.
Her neighbors also very nice btw.
A 5 star is not enough!! I highly recommended it.
Great clean place, awesome location (just a few minutes away from a subway that brings you to Manhattan), and really kind hosts. Definitely recommend.

Fantastic clean spacious apartment with everything we needed. Shedina was very responsive and helpful.
An easy walk to the local subway station and about 45 mimutes from there into times square.
We would recommend and would definitely stay here again.

Leon was very hospitable and responsive to the questions I had for my stay. The place was  really well decorated and clean with small notes to help everything work smoothly. Amenities were well thought out and I felt I had everything I needed for my stay. My only wish was that check out was a bit later, otherwise everything was a pleasure for my partner and I! Would return!

My partner and I absolutely loved our stay in NYC, and more importantly, Patty's apartment. It's a great location with loads of great cheap eats nearby and several subways, although my partner and I preferred to walk. The apartment is really great and has plenty of character and a cool view. Our stay was in December and the heating in the apartment was excellent, perfect for a pair of Australians not used to the cold. Patty is awesome and super kind! When we return to NYC we will definitely stay here again!
Really enjoyed the stay at this location. Very easy to get around with the perfect location.

Staying at Lianne's apartment was by far the best experience I've had in NY. I travel there often and for the first time I felt extremely safe, lucky and grateful.
The environment is extremely comfortable, clean and fragrant. Lianne herself is amazing and when you meet her you understand why the apartment is so wonderful.
Also, her place is extremely well located, close to the metro station and with restaurants all around.
I really wish I could have the privilege of returning to Lianne's house.
Thank you for everything and for your wonderful energy and welcome.

Great spot, absolutely divine bathtub. Amazing Caribbean food in the area and not too far from the beach by car. Even though we were technically still in NYC we felt so pleasantly removed from the big city.
Perfect for a city staycation or for someone visiting this area of bk from out of town!! Hope to be back soon
Great place! Would recommend.
Laura's place is amazing . She and her husband are very lovely and they even made us Dinner late in the night when we came. Hope to stay there again

We've staid at Tom's house plenty of times, it's become our home from home. And Tom has become a friend we love to visits. You'll have an amazing stay at this house and recommend it to all you who are looking for a place to stay and even my friends in Norway.
Thank you for being you Tom and we will definitely see you again in few months.

Kirikos place is in a great location. It was super clean, quiet, and they were phenomenal hosts! Their family was so nice to my dog as well. We loved staying here - it was spacious with a well stocked kitchen.

Skippy is a nice host. Always helpful and with some good recommendations during the stay. There is a subway station next to the apartment which makes it pretty comfortable to stay. Hope to see you again one day!

I loved staying in Silva’s place is was like a 6 minutes walk to Central Park and really close to the subway. Silvia was so helpful and she meet me outside to let me inside the room. The room itself is exactly like the pictures and I was able to sleep peacefully which is priceless if you are solo women traveler. There was regular city noise but it didn’t bother me which is weird because I usually don’t like noise. Would definitely stay here again!

You can't beat the location of Joe's apartment. Found street parking pretty quickly upon arrival. Quiet and spacious interior. Great kitchen set-up and huge couch to sink into after busy days in the city. Beds were super comfortable. We did have a couple of issues (check-in, loose faucets/handles, persistently lukewarm water in one of the showers), but Joe was quick to respond.

Great stay
Location perfect
There are a lot of extra taxes and add ons and I really have no idea how much I actually paid for our stay as they take but return some money so maybe try to work this out whilst you are there or before.
Our sofa bed was not that comfortable, But really was an excellent stay, great staff, excellent location!
easy check in and nice place !

Kelly is really nice and fast to respond. The room is very clean and the view is best!! Zion is so cute and is always around. The only thing is the apartment doesn’t have any elevator, kinda hectic to carry your suitcase up. The neighborhood is super chill. Definitely a recommendation for anyone watching gigs and going clubbing around. Will come again!

This was a great stay. Communication was very rapid with Alinca. We had a hard time finding parking, but Alinca was able to give us a parking spot which was great! The neighborhood is lovely. I would highly recommend staying here!
This was a nice Airbnb. If you don’t mind no air definitely I hood place to stay . Easy check in . Was able to find street packing easy . Can walk to pier from location

Good sized room in a historic building in Brooklyn. we found it perfect as a base to explore Manhattan and wider NYC.
Well connected to local subway and bus lines.
The room we had was at the back of the home, which suited a light sleeper like me as you don't get the noise from the street.
The entrance and bathroom are shared. it was never an issue for us but there was a bit of waiting every now and then.
Michelle was really friendly and gave us lots of tips about the local area, as well as answering our questions promptly.
I really enjoyed my stay there. You should take into account that you share the bathroom with 5 more rooms. The place was clean and the location is great.
Very clean and close to public transportation.
Un endroit parfait pour passer quelques jours à New York ! Merci à Edgar pour son accueil :)
I have had a good time working with them. They are responsive and provide clean housing. I am glad to work with them.

Avoid this unit. Found hairs on the sheets. Sheets also smelled unwashed. Bathroom door locked, but the door could be (and was) pushed open by another guest. Communication was poor. Would not stay here again.

Had the chance to spend the weekend at Chad’s place. The location was spotless, linens were clean, and Chad provided detailed instructions on everything. Location is great as well. There’s a bodega on the corner and you’re a 9 minute walk to the train station. I did see comments about the bathroom and I want to clarify it for future travelers. The bathroom is connected to one of the bedrooms. When you cross through the bathroom, you enter the LIVING ROOM. The bathroom has two doors. Just wanted to clarify that! If you get the chance to stay here, do it. 5 stars.
See my previous comment and feel free to make it public.

Diane is a lovely woman and the apartment is just as lovely. She has done a wonderful job with the brownstone. The apartment is well maintained with beautiful finishes. The block is quiet and looks like something out of the Cosby Show. We enjoyed our stay.

Stella’s house was my first airbnb experience.
She answered any questions I asked, and it was super quick.
Location was good to commute to the city. The only thing that’s not 100% was the room temperature. It was a bit cool for me during this late fall season. That’s all.
I would stay again here. :)
Excellent place. Everything was a promised. Great location. Would stay again in a heartbeat.

We had a wonderful stay at Ann and Allen’s. The house is beautiful with a very welcoming atmosphere and located in a very nice neighborhood. The queen bedroom is lovely and the bedding very comfortable, which is very appreciable after our intense days visiting the city. The shared bathroom is extremely clean and well maintained every day.
This experience gives all its meaning to the concept of Airbnb and has sublimated our trip to New York, thank you again for your kindness Ann and Allen, we hope to see you again!
Pleasant stay, very good location

Unfortunately, my stay at this property fell far below expectations. Upon arrival, the unit was not properly cleaned despite a cleaning fee being charged. The floors had visible debris, bedding was not prepared, and both the bathroom and kitchen required cleaning before we could comfortably use the space.
There were also privacy concerns during the stay. Maintenance attempted to enter without proper notice and began opening the door while we were inside, which was unsettling and inappropriate for a guest rental.
Additionally, after the booking had already been confirmed, we were informed that the property was on the market and could be shown to potential buyers during our stay. This was not disclosed in the listing beforehand and created additional inconvenience and uncertainty.
Overall, the lack of preparation, transparency, and respect for guest privacy made this a stressful experience rather than a relaxing stay. I would not recommend this property to future guests.
Everything good and as expected.
it was amazing all my trip, i highly recommend this place, Ive never felt so comfortable in a place, everything was perfect

The perfect place to see New York from. Located in a very cool and interesting area, easy to get anywhere you would want to. A lovely house and the hosts were friendly, made us feel at home and made our New York experience loads better with their tips and hospitality.
Thank you for our stay ☺️

Adoramos ficar hospedados na casa do Marco.
O quarto é completamente equipado e mesmo ficando próximo a rua não ouvi barulhos.
A simpatia é marca registrada dessa família linda e que provavelmente ira nos ver novamente. Amamos a cidade de New York. Ate mesmo meu namorado e eu que não falamos muito inglês conseguimos nos virar bem nessa cidade maravilhosa.
O Marco sempre nos respondeu prontamente as mensagens e foi muito flexível com nossos horários.
Agradecemos muito a toda família.
Um grande abraço Meghy e Bruno
Very helpful and quick with responses, I’m definitely booking them again when I come back
Everything was great except the central heating. It was too warm all the time and in such a tiny space, it was very challenging.

Clean and spacious living room, kitchen, bedroom, etc. Listing was accurate to description, pictures, and amenities. Jeremy & Angela’s communication was top notch and we took full advantage of their local dining recommendations! 很好 服务周到 房间很大 很贴心 很干净

Just perfect all around. Highly recommend. Watch your step at the corner house with the tree.
such good addresses should be kept secret !
Merlin was very nice and warm; and the place is cosy and clean!

Raj is such an amazing helpful host, I stayed overnight during a layover and they picked me up and dropped me off at prices comparable to Uber. He even offered me tea and helped me pack which he didn’t have to do at all but I appreciate it greatly.
I will definitely be staying and recommending to my friends aswell.
11/10 overall
A great place to stay. Everything is as it appears on the profile. Hamza is quick and helpful in his responses. Would return here in a heartbeat

Host was very accommodating and helpful. Replies very quick and provided a lot of information. Overall great place to stay. Quite street, bus is on the corner, although it has many delays. Heat could be better as well.

We enjoyed our stay in Lawrence's apt. Great location with easy access to everything including restaurants, bars, Whole Foods, the subway, plus a great view of the Hudson. To be fair, the reason I visited wasn’t for what I’d expect to be the reason most people book for, and even still, I had no real complaints and the folks running the place were very nice and amiable people. For my one night stay it was a nice place to drop my bags and rest my head.
Spacious. Clean. Accessible parking. Would recommend to anyone looking to stay in the suburbs of Queens.
Thank you for the spacious, immaculate unit! Lovely find in a great neighbourhood.

I was in New York, for the first time, with my family. There were 6 of us and Soraya's apartment was perfect. Soraya was very accommodating and helpful. The apartment was as described and has a lovely terrace out the back which would be even better in warmer weather and out front there is a terrific view of Manhattan in the distance. As for location the area is very quiet and friendly and is only a couple of minutes walk to public transport. I wholeheartedly recommend Soraya and her apartment. I'd definitely stay there again.

Rohan & Asha were great hosts, very generous throughout the whole time me & my roommates lived there. Always responsive. We are very grateful to them.
The space worked quite well for us, everything we needed was close by (grocery store, train station, laundry spot, etc.)
Clean easy and nice
Beto is an excellent host.  He was super responsive.  The apartment was cute and easy to get in and out of.    We enjoyed our stay and if we’re back in the area, would come back.
Located in a quiet residential area. Easy to get to buses which will take you to metro stations.
Joni and Carsten are fantastic hosts! The apartment is large and very well equipped. It is not too far from the subway station. We want to go back to NYC!

Quiet neighborhood with subway and restaurants within walking distance. Very clean and comfortable apartment.
I would definitely stay here again and hope to for my next visit to the city!
Very welcoming and inviting hosts. Always someone ready to help. Very responsive and inviting hosts a great location. No complaints!

Miriam’s brownstone was such a beautiful place to stay in Brooklyn. Very close to the subway and multiple good places to grab food or coffee. She was extremely friendly and easy to talk to. I would definitely stay here again!
The place was great and exactly as described and the directions to get there were spot on. It was very quiet and i would definitely recommend this spot to anybody staying in Brooklyn

A truly cozy place to stay while visiting family in NY.  Updated appliances and very clean. The AC was great during the hot weather and the backyard was a plus. The place is very clean and nice, the ubication is top because it is close to the subway and they are so many places to eat

Great pricing for the holiday season. The place was easy to find and walkable to the subway station. Great option for spending nights while venturing through the city during the day. It was clean, warm and cozy!
Grateful for clear instructions and responsive communication.
Perfect for our group of 6

Es un estudio, tamaño mini que resulta ser mas pequeño de lo que se ve en las fotos, recibes lo que pagas. Para 2 adultos y un menor de 4 años esta muy bien porque llegas prácticamente a dormir después de haber salido a las 9am a pasear. Al otro día te urge salir para no chocar unos con otros.

No conocí al anfitrión, contesta los mensajes y no me pareció muy amigable pero Lee es muy atento.
La ubicación es muy muy buena.

This is an amazing apartment with everything you need for an extremely comfortable stay in a really safe, friendly neighbourhood. Spotlessly clean and tidy, and very little street noise. Shereen place was amazing! Luxury status! The pictures is exactly how the place look if not better in person. The place was so clean and the beds; Oh my gosh, was to die for. So comfortable. I will definitely be making this location my number 1 place to stay when I visit Brooklyn. Thank you so much again Shereen. 😊 Definitely Recommend! ✨

1. Location was convenient to public transportation.

6. Overall I will not consider this location in the future.
I loved my stay here! The apartment is extremely well located and really comfortable, and all of the communications with the host were great. Would absolutely stay again!
nice place and great location
The room is clean, the bed is comfortable, the host is helpfull. I recommend this place.
I had a great stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was kind and responsive. Would stay here again!

Enjoyed my stay! Room was cozy and aesthetically pleasing! Hotel is a 3 minute walk away from the Subway and a quick Uber ride to and from LaGuardia Airport, so incredibly convenient location. Free breakfast was greatly appreciated. All around a pleasure—will be staying again.

Very quiet neighborhood, easy to find house and very CLEAN!
Bing was very quick to respond, very clear with instructions, and on top of things. We would definitely love to book again with Bing and suggest you do if you are considering to stay in Flushing!

Communication was very easy, and the host was extremely responsive at all times. I would highly recommend a stay here.
Very clean room, hosts were quick with every response to the questions I asked. Great stay.
The apartment was gorgeous! Spotlessly clean, super-comfy bed - wish I spent more thine there!!

I booked Danielle's home very last minute due to unfortunate events but lucky for me Danielle had great communication, and was very prompt. Also the home is very beautiful, the pictures don't do it justice.

Negra was the most kind, accommodating and responsive host!
Good place to stay!

El departamento es muy cómodo, limpio y tenía todo lo necesario. La comunicación siempre fue correcta y rápida. Lo único que no me gusto es que la ubicación era en una zona casi industrial, el metro estaba a 16 minutos y la zona no se veía muy segura.
Great location, clean, quiet. We had room with private bath but mattress needs to be replaced. Other than that it was very good!! Would book again!
Very helpful, friendly, responsive. Very kind to give credit for nights missed due to incoming blizzard!

Great location with excellent views!
beautiful building in a great location

Perfect place to stay:  nice and welcoming guest, good transportation connection to Manhattan and Brooklyn, nice appartment with a quite courtyard in the garden. Highly recommandable!
Good place, have a subway station  near that go to time square at 15 min. And the room is so nice.

Thankyou for making our stay a pleasant, hassle-free one!

Manuel was such a great host. Always responsive and polite. Apartment is clean, the room matches the pictures and description. I would definitely come back and would highly recommend to anyone who looks a place to stay near NYC.
This is an excellent place to stay that is secure, centrally located and quite comfortable.  We will definitely consider it when traveling to New York again.  Plenty of room for two couples.

We had a wonderful stay at Yellow Door, everything we needed, very clean & tidy, any issues we had, Wayne responded really quickly.  A very short walk to the subway, easy to find our way around, although didn’t explore the local area too much.

Very spacious, stylishly decorated loft in the heart of Williamsburg. Peter was was great to communicate with and super helpful. Wonderful host.

Great place for its cost! P.S. Beware of the shower spitting out too hot water from time to time;)

It was a very good experience! The apartment is located in a very calm street, near to good restaurants, supermarkets, drugstores, everything needed for day by day. Also, it is close to Astoria Boulevard station a direct subway line to Central Park, Manhattan, very useful.

Awesome location and a fun hotel.

Simply a great stay

Everything went well! very nice and convenient room with space and a comfortable bed. Melbourne is kind and easy to communicate with.

Vernette's place was everything I needed for my stay. It was conveniently located near the subway, which made my first time in NY very easy !! The apartment was clean and SECURE. Logement fidèle au descriptif. Chauffage électrique efficace. Possibilité d'ouvrir la fenêtre. great location with a lot of Chinese food in Chinatown. Responsive host. Got all my needs covered. The room is a bit small and dim.

We loved our visit and had everything we needed. Great location. Thank you!!
Great stay and very helpful and nice host. Clean and spacious for new york would definitely stay here again!

La casa de Diane estaba muy buena y la ubicación muy estratégica. Todo fue como estaba en el anuncio y la relaciòn precio/calidad es óptima.

A lovely space to relax in!
Outstanding apartment, very quiet, neighborhood so vibrant and Christophe is charming host.

Thanks RJ for being a great host!  The location is perfectly placed in Bedford-Stuyvesant near convenient transportation.  Most will feel safe being the 79th Precinct is across the street!  It is a nice comfy Airbnb

I had a great stay at Minetta’s. She was super nice and everything looked just like the pictures. Near subway/bus lines made it easy to get anywhere. No complaints !
We had a wonderful stay at Yuki's place - super clean, great location, and very quiet! It was really spacious for two people, and I'd definitely stay here again.
Very professional and clean set up. They keep in mind the special needs of Asian and muslim people.
Very clean in a peaceful area of this busy borough. Cheryl was very responsive.
A great booking for an even better price, amazing stay and more spacious than pictures show

Great and Spacious enough for two people. Loved taking advantage of the balcony and the view it had.

Lexia place was just as advertised. Bright, airy, and clean with the conveniences of home. Lexia  was very responsive to questions/ request and the parking was a big plus. I will book with her again and highly recommend her B&B.

Sara it’s a lovely person & a great host!
Her place it’s a heaven in NYC s chaotic atmosphere! Very central, clean & beautiful !!

The listing was accurate and the place felt clean and the neighborhood felt safe.

Convenient location

From accessing the apartment to checking-out, everything ran smoothly and ideally. We booked this place for my family as they were witnessing my graduation at NYU and I talk for them in saying their stay was perfect.

Thank you again for you’re amazing apartment, responsiveness and availability.
This was a quiet peaceful getaway in the middle of Brooklyn!
Perfect location to eat around the world. Rooms are small but perfect and comfortable. Lucas is a superstar!

Great location! Close to subway & bus lines. As a basement apartment it may have mosquitos, and they have Off spray available which was helpful at this time of year. Union market on 6th and Associated Market on 5th were close to get food supplies. Aaron was responsive with questions I had. I lived in the Park Slope area before and Prospect Park, Brooklyn Botanical Gardens, and Brooklyn Museum are within walking distance, and Prospect Park Zoo has reopened.
Home away from home fully supplied!

The location itself is ok, few nice little cafes and shops about, but it’s a hike to get anywhere. At least 40 mins on the subway to anywhere in Manhattan and 15 mins in Uber to wburg or areas like dumbo so if you’re new to or just exploring NY maybe not the best base.
Mike was very good at communicating, answered any questions straight away.

Greg‘s apartment looked just like it did in the pictures. I had access to the living room and kitchen and could use the laundry room downstairs. Greg had great recommendations and was very helpful overall. Would definitely stay again.
Wir hatten einen sehr schönen Aufenthalt in New York und waren froh, diese Unterkunft entdeckt zu haben

Gregory is a great and easy going host! He made us feel really welcome. We had a late flight, but thanks to the clear communication, we had no problem finding Gregory's place and getting into the apartment.

It's within walking distance of the L-Train (Lorimer Stop) and G-Train (Metropolitan Stop), which will get you to Manhattan within 10 minutes. Close to the train,  close to bus station close to convince stores.  Minutes aways (20 to 30 min walking) to prime Williamsburg locations .  Good coffee shops,  bars, restaurants and Pets friendly location..

This is experience was the best I’ve ever had. The location was easy and the apartment is BEAUTIFUL!  maribel is so friendly and kind. She shares her knowledge willingly to ensure you enjoy your stay. Her replies are quick and you can tell she cares about her guests. All the goodness and positivity from previous reviews are accurate 100 percent. Zero negativity for her. She is amazing If we ever come back we’ll definitely use her again!

This felt like a home away from home. It was near a subway stops and lots of food and grocery options. We explored the city and then could tuck away in this corner if New York. This place had everything we needed!

Great place to stay, as long as you don’t have a car. THIS IS A HOTEL ROOM. Ray’s place was very clean nice.
Really enjoyed my stay here, bed was very comfortable, subway was really close by and pettrina was very helpful.

Tony, who is Yves property manager, was welcoming and easily reachable to answer questions throughout our  5 week stay in Brooklyn. Very comfortable accommodations with full kitchen and washer/dryer and terraces to enjoy the outdoors.
worth what you pay for

Quiet, clean, cozy apartment in a great neighborhood. I had a fair amount of questions and the host responded quickly every time. It was easy to get downtown, to central park, or anywhere I wanted to go. Overall, I was very pleased with my stay.

Really a great place to stay at very close to the subway. The place is very nice and cozy and the host is super sweet and was available when I needed their help. Definitely would stay here again :)
Communication with Kim was quick and detailed. Her home was much larger in real than the photos represent - huge plus!  Great location in Astoria as well.
I had a nice stay! Perfect price vs quality match, wonderful food in the neighbourhood. Jianfeng was very kind to let me leave my suitcase in the apartment for a few hours after the checkout.
Very responsive host.  The place was very clean with great views. The check in was a breeze because the host was so communicative.   Perfect location right next to the theaters.
We had a wonderful stay at Jamie’s place! I loved the area and the house is really nice too. If you travel to ny sleep at Jamie’s place and enjoy Brooklyn:)

Great place! Very clean and had everything you need! The L is right now the street and you have all the amenities in the area you need right around.
Great value for what you get, I would recommend it in to anyone!

Great location! We really loved being so close to Central Park, and the ceilings in the space were high and it felt really open. Great host ; great back yard; great house. Will definitely visit again

Many thanks to Elissa for a wonderful stay at her place. Loved the in suite bathroom and air conditioning during the summer months of NYC! Elissa’s communication was much appreciated; I never felt uncertain about any detail; everything was crystal clear as far as communication. Im glad we had caught each other to have a lovely chat. The neighborhood had a great coffee shop and sushi spot bout two blocks away that I frequented too often :) I had a great stay and it was super clean. Thanks again!
Thanks so much for the lovely stay, Dina. You couldn't have been nicer!

The space was extremely clean. Great towels. Quiet. Walkable to many places if you want to and can walk. Coffee shops close by to grab a quick cuppa.
We would stay there again.

Merlberg was a great host! She accommodated my early check in as I was traveling from a nearby state and would be arriving early. She greeted me when I arrived and showed me around and how to use all the amenities. Space was just like the pictures and had way more amenities than I expected. Great experience! Will definitely book again!

I spent a month at NYC for work, and both the location and the appartment fit my needs really well. The UES neighborhood is really calm with bunch of nice restaurants, and within walking distance from midtown. If you've never been to NYC, and are looking to spend time at manhattan, I'd definitely recommend this location. The appartment offers nothing super luxurious, but good value with a clean kithcen and bathroom. Fast Wi-Fi and TV, as well as plenty of space for one. Laundry service at the ground floor, grocery store just around the block and only a few minutes away from central park as well as the closest subway stations (Q and 6 lines). The A/C was a bit loud, but did its job when it was 85 degrees and super humid outside.
The place was easy to find and the self-check-in with a key locker box was convenient, which was nice after a long flight from Europe. Overall communication with Kouroush worked very well.

Irie e la sua famiglia sono stati veramente gentile mi hanno fatto sentire come a casa. Harlem è anima, musica è fantastico, consiglio a chi vuole scoprire la città patendo da un punto di vista più originali. Irie a Jeremiah sono simpatici e molto gentili. Sono stato bene tornerò.

Location it’s great: safe, quiet and close to the subway. You’ll get what’s on the listing, very accurate. Communication with Li Rachel and Dewey was perfect, they replied very quick.
In summary, this is a great option to stay in New York, I will recommend it to anyone.

There were communication gaps/issues leading up to my stay and also during check in. However, the space itself is comfortable and quiet. It's a ~15 mins walk to the nearest trains (C, 3, 4) and they are great lines to take you wherever you need to go!

Cozy, comfortable, quiet,safe
Seth is very hospitable and quite the artist;)

Cute spot to go with your significant other.
Better in the summer because it was freezing and when I went there and had two small heaters ..it took about two hours for it to warm up. So if you go bring a blanket ! Besides that everything was just like the picture.
Best area in all of Brooklyn! I met Anthony and his group of friends around the neighborhood! So fun! Such a special place.

I loved our stay at M Social! This room was perfect for our girls trip and we had endless things to do on this end of the city. The staff were friendly and our room was cleaned so nicely each day. Thanks for a wonderful stay!

We had an amazing stay for a quick weekend in NYC! Loni was so accommodating and helpful, the place was perfect. Was comfortable the whole stay, not too much street noise at all, and super close to restaurants and stores. Very easy spot to Uber from as well. 5 stars!

Kevin's place is a gem and a rare find. The apartment is extremely well maintained, clean and comfortable. The location is as good as it gets in New York.

Kevin is a great host who was accessible and eager to answer any questions.

I had a wonderful experience.

Karen's place went beyond my expectations. It was exactly how it was described. The home was extremely clean, comfortable and peaceful. The neighborhood was quiet and parking was always avaliable. Everything we needed was avaliable to us. Im thankful to Karen for sharing her home with us.

hotel muy bien ubicado, con cama muy cómoda y todo lo que necesitas para terminar muy bien el día después de tanto caminar. El desayuno suma. El
personal es muy amable.
No es muy elegante ni nuevo.
Para mejorar que no tengan frigobar las habitaciones, la puerta del baño no cerraba, un ascensor estuvo roto 3 de los 4 dias (en un edificio de 36 pisos)… pero no fueron cosas que hayan opacado nuestro viaje. Por eso las 4 estrellas.

Danicas place was in a great location. Very safe and quiet neighborhood. Her place was super clean and was gorgeous. Plates, silverware, coffee, bottle opener, everything we needed for our short stay. Would stay here again.
Great hotel and location
Nice place to stay, super cute ♥️
Patrick is an excellent host.

Small space with a comfortable bed, a trundle bed couch and a redecorated kitchen and bath.  Large TV set, with an Apple TV for streaming.  Bring your own silverware, as none is provided, but there are a lot of cooking utensils.
Una experiencia única para ser la primera vez todo muy ordenado y limpio el anfitrión siempre estuvo en total disposición

This was a great location. Two blocks from the Empire State Building, 15 minute walk to Time Square, fantastic restaurants. You feel right in the action. The room is simple but it’s clean and has everything you need. There seems to be other hotel/short term rental operations out of the same location so just be aware of that when checking in but everything went smoothly otherwise.

Kamran is clearly very proud of his apartment and left long instructions to guests about keeping it  tidy. It is clean with lovely wooden floorboards. We were a family of 4 staying for 4 nights and there was plenty of room. The beds and sofa were really comfortable and the shower was good. There wasn't a lot of equipment in the kitchen, we shared 2 bowls for breakfast between us but it wasn't a big deal. A huge plus was that a suitcase of ours got lost and arrived at JFK airport late so Kam really kindly went to collect it for us to save us time, he didn't need to do that and it made a big difference to us.  Really my only criticism of the apartment is that it is far away from the main attractions of New York if you are on a sightseeing visit- my fault, I should have researched the location better. It's about 5 miles from the end of the Subway line 2 and it takes at least an hour to get in on the bus - Kam gave us transport advice. Just bear travel time in mind if you stay here.
good location..easy to access manhattan and near subway. good spots to eat nearby as well

Wir haben diese Unterkunft gebucht um eine günstige Möglichkeit zu haben Manhattan kennenzulernen.
Der Weg vom JFK zur Unterkunft war absolut okay (ca eine halbe Stunde) und der Check-In problemlos.
Die Unterkunft an sich war genauso schön wie auf den Fotos und super ausgestattet.

Als wir einmal ein Problem hatten konnten wir Madelyn innerhalb weniger Minuten erreichen und es lösen.
Auch wenn wir mit Bus und Subway knapp 1.5h bis nach Manhattan gebraucht haben, kam es uns gar nicht so weit weg vor und die Gegend war super schön und vor allem sicher.
Wir kommen gerne wieder!

We had a wonderful stay Hugo’s flat, the flat is beutiful, very spacious, very well laid out and equipped.  We loved the location, with very good amenities near by and great restaurants and cafes. Highly recommended.

My sister and I stayed at Casey's apartment in early June. It has everything you would need and is one block away from the G line. The neighborhood is definitely going thru some changes, as we came across some great new coffee shops and cafes within walking distance. It's located right between the lively Williamsburg and the more quiet Prospect Park neighborhoods. Casey was a great host and never more than a text message away. Thanks!!

Overall a great stay. The place was clean and as described, and the location was convenient. Communication with the host was smooth and responsive.
Everything matched the listing, and the check-in process was easy. Would recommend to others.

Bien placé, proche métro et Times Squares.

The place was great! Super clean, well designed and just what was needed for our stay. It’s a couple of blocks from the L and we walked back late several times and felt safe going from the L to this place. Would stay again next time that I’m in NYC.

This place is excellent for its location and price which is what appealed to us. It’s a no frills accommodation but fine for a week’s stay in New York. The shared bathroom facilities seemed to be rarely used….I only had to wait once for a shower. The shower temperature varied, one needed to run the tap for a while before hot water came through.
Most wonderful experience - such a beautiful place.
Amazing! We are coming back definitely!! Apartment is near subway, very clean and cozy! We have everything we needed! Perfect! Carlos is great host!

Great stay! Ryan was an amazing host.
Would highly recommend.

Will definitely be staying here again! To wake up and go across the street to get some exotic fruit from the street vendors was so cool. You’re kind of in between little Italy and Chinatown. So much to see in just a small walkable distance! Close to subway stations too. Fantastic place to stay in NY!
I enjoyed my stay. The apartment was the perfect place to hide and finish my book and was close to some great areas of the city.
Very decent..super host.. Very responsive to messages and inquires Thanks for the stay

We were a family of 5 (3 adult/2 children) and we were living comfortably.  Don't forget to enjoy also their large backyard to have a meal or just sit down to relax :-).
As always it was great to stay here. Clean, quiet, cozy.
Had an amazing time at this place and Cathy was super helpful with all my questions! Will def come again!!

This Airbnb was perfect - it's on a beautiful, quiet street not too far from a subway stop and close to several restaurants. The unit itself was clean and exactly as portrayed in photos. There is a dishwasher and laundry in the apartment, and several heating/AC units throughout. Everything worked well and Will was very communicative to see if we needed anything. We would definitely recommend staying here.
Great, clean apartment with many amenities around. The commute to Manhattan was a bit long - but Brooklyn is also great to explore!
Great host and perfect location.  The apartment and furnishings are pretty spare.
Henry was very helpful and respons very quick and clear communication. The room is as described. Good location for visiting NY
Boris was great. Communicative, flexible. The place was small but perfect for our needs and clean. He left drinks and candy for us and there was food too. All around great.

Chris was excellent! Welcoming and very helpful with any questions we had. The apartment was clean, comfortable and had absolutely everything you could need. We were there in steamy NYC summer, but the apartment wasn't too hot with air conditioning or opening the garden door. We loved the neighborhood. Tree lined streets but restaurants, cafes and shopping nearby. Plus it was just a few minutes walk to Bergen Station. So all of Manhattan and Brooklyn (and beyond) was just a subway ride away. We'd definitely stay again. Highly recommended!
Kiriko was quick to set me up with a same day rental. Place is clean and very convenient for a small group of friends. Thanks!

Super emplacement pour toutes les visites de Manhattan. Accueil impeccable et souriant. Café du matin sympa. Réactivité en cas de demande immédiate. Personnel souriant et disponible.

Merci 🙏
Mint House exceeded expectations. Will be staying there again on my next visit to NYC!
Great time at Gorans place. Perfect location and definitely big enough for 2 ppl

I loved this place ! The host checked up on us and that was so thoughtful ! Very understanding with my checkin situation. It was so clean and nice inside I loved every inch of this place if I go back to ny I want to stay again and again here

This is an ideal location -- close to public transit, in a lovely very walk-able neighborhood with lots of shops and wonderful restaurants.  We had the best bagels, the best pizza, the best ice cream, and even the best Thai food... all in Brooklyn!  Sylvia and Neil were wonderful hosts: their place is beautiful and clean, with kitchen and living room and eating area, and even a nice back enclosed sunny sitting room. It's a great place to stay, whether you're in town for a couple of days or longer.

Vigil was a wonderful host for my first stay in NYC. Super chill and friendly, very accommodating, and I instantly felt at ease when I arrived. She was nice to let me drop off my luggage since I arrived early. Her place was very clean, the room was comfortable, and the window ac helped with the heat and to also block out some of the street noise at night. Harlem is a neighborhood worth exploring with lots of culture and community events, and was a convenient location to the subway lines. I would definitely recommend Vigil’s place to anyone else who is solo traveling and looking to stay in Manhattan.
The apartment is just as you see in the pictures, perfect for a couple. We had comfortable stay and would recommend and stay here again in the future. 5*

This place is such a gem! Seriously one of the best locations in Brooklyn, on a quiet and peaceful street. The place itself has everything you need-- super comfortable and homey. It feels very private; in fact I never saw anyone else the whole time I was there! Agathe was super communicative, though, and had great local recommendations. It was so easy to stay here, and made my whole trip wonderful. I highly recommend!

Seth is a warm and accomodating host, no issues communicating!
His place is as shown in the pictures, close to subway and cafes make sure to ask Seth for recommendations on places to eat weren't disappointed!

We had a great stay at Yvette's place. Studio was clean, quiet, safe, and had everything we needed. The space is a big studio. Yvette met us upon arrival and gave us great information about NYC. We had enough street parking and had no issues coming or going. She is a short walk to the north start of central park and a easy walk to the subway. I would recommend her place to anyone looking for a unique stay and wanting to have the ability to experience a lot of NYC. Thanks Yvette for a great stay!
Great place to stay at! Very accommodating host!
Very nice experience. The place is very close to the metro station and you can find some restaurants and stores around. They were very kind to us at all times.
Friendly kind and accommodating

Ming’s retreat in Williamsburg was a fantastic place for my wife and I to ´feel like a local’ and enjoy the community of Williamsburg and also explore many aspects of New York.
The home had everything we needed such as a comfortable bed, a very quiet location, great amenities for home cooking and was a relaxing place after a day out and about.
It was a short walk to the subway that took us all over New York and we’d also recommend catching the ferry from North Williamsburg over to Wall Street and Manhattan. Ming was the perfect host and was available if we needed anything and it was so nice to arrive and find fresh flowers and cold drinks in the fridge. A great place to stay.
definitely decent for the price

Darren was a great host! Clean space and he was helpful/ flexible with early check in given our early morning arrival time. The flat is also quite close to the subway so was easy for us to get around.

We lived staying at Luis’s apartment in NYC. Amazing location, close to all of our activities. Modern, spotlessly cleaned, comfy couch and large TV to watch a few minutes of the playoffs. Kitchen has plenty of dishes, silverware and had the basics, salt, oil, tea bags, etc. We really enjoyed the latte/capuchino maker to start our mornings!
We’re definitely going back to this apartment on our next visit. Thank you Luis!!!

Ola flat is very nice and very confortable. We were 4 staying at the flat it's super central, and super convenient for 4 peoples. The roof top is very nice quiet and sunny. I clearly recommend this place and i will be happy to stay over there again for my next trip to NYC.

It took us only 5 min to walk to the ferry station and every day we had our views of the Statue of Liberty. I highly recommend Meghan’s place!

I had a great stay with my LO there —safe and convenient neighbourhood in a very clean house. Linda and Robert were friendly and very helpful, especially when they knew I was solo-parenting. Their devotion to Harry Potter is admirable !

We've had an excellent stay in this quiet neightbourhood. Subway station was quite close.

Marie & her daughter were very friendly hosts, I highly recommend her accommodation.
We had a very nice stay at the apartment. Kevin was very helpful and kind! Location is more uptown in Manhattan but has a good connection by metro. We would always choose the apartment again!

Joseph's apartment was very nice. He was very responsive and provided additional information for traveling in that area. He was such a great host for our group of friends. The apartment looked exactly like the pictures.

Had an excellent stay with my wife and two small dogs! Vika was extremely responsive as a host. I actually missed a check-in instruction (100% my fault) and he was prompt and our stay was seamless end-to-end!!
The location was great. Quiet, but super close to Court and Smith. Overall, would recommend to anyone looking for a pet friendly spot in Brooklyn. Would return again!

Yang was very friendly and responsive and supportive!The Airbnb is a two storey house in a quiet and safe area , walking to the nearest subway station in 7 minutes.While the host family is living on the first floor, the whole 2nd floor are 4 -bedroom guest rooms , with a separated single bedroom and a 3 -bedroom suite(with bathroom and kitchen). The 3 bedroom suite is spacious and very clean for our 4 person group.
We will come again next time !
la casa es perfecta y comoda

Elizabeth maintained regular contact, dealt quickly with queries, and provided useful guidance for our trip / eating out. Really good value for money for a large group in NYC.
Convenient to good restaurants in Queens and public transit. Could use a few more homey touches.
Very comfortable bed and warm place in winter.

This was my first time using Air BnB so I was a little hesitant at first . I was staying in Times Square but decided I wanted something more local. Michael is an amazing host , his studio is located right in the heart of Harlem . I would recommend this to anyone looking for a room in NYC . Make sure you tip the host , he goes above and beyond for his guest !

L'appartement est superbe avec beaucoup de cachet! Les photos et le descriptif sont fidèles en plus de plusieurs petites attentions. Jonathan est proactif et le contact est très cordial. Mariana was very nice! Check in was simple and quick, place was very clean and she regularly messaged us to check up. Definitely recommend!

Nicely furnished and super clean penthouse in a fun neighborhood in lower Manhattan. Beds were comfortable, the roof deck peaceful, no noise while sleeping and cool places to explore all around. Thumbs up!
Loved my stay here !!

A truly well deserved 5 stars to S&G's studio. It is exactly as advertised, the perfect location, with a bunch of complimentary touches that makes it extra special. I used their studio as a business traveller and it was perfect and I would highly recommend it and book it again for both my business and personal travel needs. Thank you for the extra touches!
Great value for the location.

Mariama is very sweet and thoughtful. The apartment is great and I can see Manhattan through the window in the room. She asked me to have lunch with, sharing her stories. The neighborhood is quiet and safe. 5 minutes walk to Subway, very convenient.

Alex was an amazing host! From the moment we arrived, he made us feel right at home. The place was spotless, and he provided great local tips that made our stay even better. Highly recommend staying with him!! 🙂
Very nice stay. The hotel is so fun many amenities
Exactly as described, very happy with the speed of communication and the ease of getting in and out.

this place was really great for the concert that i went to, easy access to the subway and the host was really helpful and responsive!! had a great stay thank you so much!

Great price for a great spot in Brooklyn. right by the J train to Manhattan as well.

The apartment has a great location, just a 1 block away from the subway station, theres a 24h deli just across the street which makes it great for buying food and drinks. The apartment is just a shown in the pictures, clean and with everything you could need to cook. The room it self is a little small but if you are organize you won´t have a problem with that. I would repeat any time.

We would definitely stay here again.

The place was amazing. I love the retro vintage feel to it all. I love how convenient it was. I will definitely come back.

Molto piacevole, per essere la mia prima volta a NY mi sono trovato davvero bene. Accogliente, spazioso e proprietari molto gentili. Sono contento.

The room and house is exactly as described, Henry is super nice, and the check in was flexible and easy. Mine was a very short stay but I would definitely recommend Henry’s place and I’d stay again :)

Lovely clean apartment located close to loads of good stuff in Williamsburg. Gala is an attentive and responsive host always a quick message away if you need something.

Hiokit et harold sont de supers hôtes. Le airbnb est très bien, très propre tout est très bien pensé. Nous vous recommandons vraiment ce logement.

Tricia’s place is 100% awesome and you should def stay here. it’s close to everything, an extremely walkable neighborhood. thank you, Tricia!!!

Douglas’s place is beautifully decorated. It is very close to many great restaurants. Would stay in Douglas’s apartment on our next visit.
Great place for the price!

It was a great experience staying at Anna’s place. Extremely clean apartment and exactly matching the photos.
