All the best

In one word Rodney was so nice and helpful, he welcomed me so nicely that, I even expected.. Not onley that he was very supporting and helpful....I m going back again and I will love to stay Rodney's place. Thanks u so much Rodney...

Ed's place is a lovely, cozy brownstone apartment that's a great launching pad to explore NYC or just to relax. It's fairly spacious. The only potential downside is that the living area is rather dark all the time, which made working during the day a bit tough. But overall it's a great place and Ed and Sarah are extremely responsive and friendly, while also giving you your space.
The room was very nice and enjoy every bit of it , I hope to come again , it’s 5 stars across the board to me , I would call people crazy for passing up this comfy room and amazing service
I loved my stay here. The hosts were incredibly welcoming and responsive. I never had any issues with the shared space and would absolutely stay here again.

Communication was quick. Easy check in. Location was beautiful. Beds were comfortable. Apartment was beautiful, and I clean and with a well stocked kitchen.
Would stay again!

Susan's place was perfect. It was very spacious, comfortable, and with everything you could possibly need. The location is also incredibly convenient. Communications were easy and stress-free. I would highly recommend staying here!

Sandra was such an amazing host. Very attentive & great hospitality! The room was very spacious/clean. As well as the bathroom. We absolutely loved that the room had its own entry so we didn’t have to worry about waking anybody up. Main st subway was literally 15 mins away & it made it easy to get around the city. :)

Kamil's apartment was very centrally located in North Williamsburg, anything you need is within a couple blocks walk. The apartment itself is very spacious, has everything you need, and was extremely clean. I would recommend to others.
We had a great stay in NYC.  Thanks, Alex!

Eric provides accurate descriptions and photos of his home. It's at a perfect location, and walkable to the train. The ride to Manhattan is easy and short enough. I was out till the a.m. most nights, and the neighborhood and it's surroundings are super safe. There are plenty of bars, restaurants, and coffee nearby. Most of all...Eric's home is clean and welcoming. I recommend!!

Great host, nice little space! Neighborhood is 50/50, but the grocery store is just a few blocks away and the Caribbean food is incredible. About a 45 minute commute into lower Manhattan, with a 15 minute walk to the subway stop included, but very easy. Book if you love cats, video games, or jerk chicken! Longer stays might be a bit difficult because you are living with the host and therefore may not have much space if you intend to do a lot of cooking for yourself, but there's plenty of solutions and shorter stays shouldn't be a problem at all. Enjoy!

Terry's apartment was wonderful. It was reasonably priced and had a very good location right next to a train station. No parking is provided but we were able to find nearby street parking. The set-up of the room is very nice. Terry was always responsive, even months before our trip. We did notice quite a bit of hair on the inside of the bedsheets upon our arrival. The room also is right below another apartment, and we could hear their every move. I understand this is typical of apartments and out of Terry's control, but we did have trouble sleeping at points. overall, this was a great Airbnb and it fit our needs for this trip!
Stanley Was A Great Host 5 Star In My Book!!!

As a native New Yorker transplanted to Maine, my expectations are complicated by the feeling of it still being home. So what matters to me is a homey atmosphere, books, artwork, old things, eclectic character and charm. All that was fulfilled here along with a large, bright, comfortable room and warm smells from the very active kitchen. The neighborhood is beautiful to walk in with many fine food choices (Miriam's on the corner for brunch, Olmsted's for dinner a few blocks away were our choices, along with Brooklyn Larder). As Ame noted in her description, she likes her privacy, so think twice about feeling TOO at home. Nearby Flatbush Avenue is a lesson in diversity, especially meaningful days after the election. All in all, more satisfactions than we could count.

We really enjoyed our stay. This was a weekend to remember. Your home was clean, beautiful and in a great location. There are only 3 beds, and checkin is essentially after 1:00. Other than those description errors, we really loved our stay. Guerline was wonderful and we would definitely say here again!

Sammy was an excellent host, friendly, accommodating and quick to respond to any of our needs or questions. Easy access to public transit, quick walk to convenience/grocery stores. Safe neighborhood to stroll through although a bit noisy from road traffic it wasn’t unexpected after all it’s New York!  The space itself is fantastic, and was very comfortable for the 6 of us. I would very much consider staying again. Thanks for a great stay Sammy.

We really appreciated the excellent location and the friendly, helpful staff, which made our stay convenient and welcoming right from check-in. The spot was perfectly situated for getting around easily.
That said, the actual rooms felt noticeably more outdated than the listing photos suggested. Our room had some maintenance issues including broken tiles, chipped walls, very old furniture, and a few other minor items that could use attention. It was still clean and functional for our needs, but it definitely has a more worn-in, vintage feel in person.
Overall it served its purpose well thanks to the great location and service. With a bit of refreshing and updates to better match the photos, this would be an even stronger choice. Thank you!

Jude was awesome and provided direct and accurate details. The place was beautiful and exactly like the pics showed.  Very clean, just like a hotel. I definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a nice and affordable ARBNB. Thank you for having us Jude!
Fab apartment in a lovely area. Very accessible

Excellent communication!  Kishorie is very caring with her tenants.  The apartment is very clean and everything works perfectly inside.  It is pretty easy to find parking in the streets around and to transit from there.  Thank you!

Kayan gave clear instructions and always responds fast. I have no complains at all. The apartment was perfect for me. Close to the subway, stores, parks, Yankee Stadium and more. It's a loudly neighborhood of course in the middle of the city, so bring som earplugs so is that problem solved. I felt like home both at Kayan's place and in the Bronx. I definitely recommend you to stay at Kayan's place, she's very friendly and helpful!

Ulises is super nice and responsive during our stay and came to the flat to solve our little problem with the shower. Definitely would recommend the place for everyone who comes to New York. Absolutely fantastic stay in this is awesome flat. It was spotlessly clean and had everything you could possibly need.
Good for a base and not far from the subway to get around. Only downside was the WiFi the security certificate had expired and the slow draining for the bath/shower

If you want to be close to the JFK, this is really nobrainer. I think that hosts are underselling this airbnb. I expected very barebones stay. Room was OK, but bathroom and the common area was very nice. Fridge is full of ice cold bottled water and milk. There are cereals and oatmeal mixes to eat. There is also coffee machine.
We arrived to NYC and had to dropoff the car at JFK Hertz. We flew out of JFK the next morning. There is bus connection, but we ended up ordering Uber. Cost from JFK Federal circle to this house is around 10 USD.
Checkin is via PIN code. We had no problem during our stay and i can recommend it to anyone.

Jennifer was a great host, she always responded to our needs and questions that we had. Everything was great , the unit was clean when we arrived . The photos of the apartment that are shown here are very accurate. Its very close to theaters and subway stations . Totally recommended.
Good place, near subway. Right on Canal by the bag vendors. Never felt unsafe walking outside.

Small but well appointed studio in Manhattan, which I’d recommend if you’re planning to be out and about most of the time. Koichi was a pro-active and communicative host, the apartment was easy to find and the check-in instructions were very clear. During my stay the building was quiet and peaceful and the bathroom were cleaned everyday; didn’t have to wait either which was great. The area is very convenient and walkable.

We had a great stay. Christine is just a sweetheart. The house is in Brooklyn near a bus and metro stop. several options for grocery shopping, coffee, and breakfast nearby. Our to go place: Cinnamon Girl (vegan options).
I would absolutely stay there again!

Hemos estado muy a gusto. Tony es un gran anfitrión. Fue una gran elección ya que la casa está en una zona super tranquila y en tan sólo 20 minutos en metro te plantas en el centro de la ciudad, aunque subir 5 pisos después de estar todo el día haciendo turismo era duro ;) muchas gracias Tony, si volvemos a Nueva York repetiremos seguro!
Wish is a great host and would definitely stay again. Very communicative and responsive.
Milan's home is exactly as advertised,. It was a pleasure to stay there and I feel as if I have a new friend.

Arrived 3 pm for the 3pm ck.-in time.
Ft. dsk said go up to apt. , door is open & keys inside.
I entered apt. & found cleaning supplies left all over the place & an uncleaned apt. It appeared that cleaning person started &then left b/f finishing the cleaning .
I immediately called Matt &he told me they should not have let me in & to leave the apt. Come bk. in 1 hr.
I came bk. 1 hr. later& still no one returned to finishing cleaning.
I called Matt again & he said : "Well you know we have over 40 units to clean!" Really!
I said we had a contract that apt. would be ready for 3pm ck-in & you broke the contract. I asked him what he was going to do about it , he said he would contact cleaning person.
I returned another hr later &still nothing had been done.
I called Matt again & it went toVM. I left msg. saying I was contacting Air BNB.
They said they would contact him & give me $52 refund.
3 hrs after ck-in time cleaning lady returned to "finish". When "done" I found hair in fridge!
Exactly what I needed!

This place is really well suited for solo travelers and people who want to enjoy and explore NYC. right in the middle of Manhattan, and near a lot of restaurants. the apartment was clean and had enough amenities to suit anyone's stay. Mine is clear and  responsive , roommates are nice and weren't a whole not of common interaction, felt like I did have privacy. Speaking from my own time there i only used the Airbnb to sleep and a place to keep my luggage while i would explore the city when I was awake. although I would wish the blind was a big bigger for more privacy I enjoyed my stay and would recommend

Great place to hang out with a cool view from the bedroom. It is above a hookah bar so be mindful of how light of a sleeper you are. Saturday night was noisy, people were partying outside until 6am. That is not the hosts fault.
Mary is very accommodating and helpful.  We had last minute issues and she saved the day!  Place is cozy and convenient and also safe! Everything  was as described.
We had a wonderful stay, and we would come back again.
This the best place to stay if you’re looking for cleanliness & feeling safe!!!
Alles war perfekt – saubere und ruhige Unterkunft, super Lage mit top Anbindung an Manhattan und eine sehr freundliche Kommunikation mit Julien. Jederzeit wieder!
Nice room, cheap and clean.
Shanda was super responsive and helpful in preparation for our trip. The apartment was cozy and clean. We had a wonderful time visiting family!

Alex was a great host. She was great at quickly communicating and was very receptive when needed. She greeted me at the check in and gave me recommendations, while also cooking me a meal when I first got there. The place itself was a quick Uber ride from West Village and Soho area which was nice. All and all I recommend this if your considering it.
The walk in shower was everything, the space was very clean, and it felt like home. Thanks for the stay❗️

I had a great stay at Pod 39 Hotel. The listing was completely accurate, the room was clean, and everything matched the description. Check-in was smooth, and the space was exactly what I expected. I felt safe and comfortable the entire time. I would definitely recommend booking here and would stay again.
Great location, and clean, well, appointed rooms.  Furniture and bathroom were alittle dated but was happy with the space.  Couldn’t have asked for a better staff!
This place was perfect. Close to everything!
c'était une fin de semaine agréable !
La mejor ubicación en Manhattan. Se puede ir caminando a cualquier dirección, una de las mejores zonas de la isla. Guillermo es amable y responde con rapidez a las solicitudes

absolutely loved my stay here. The cleanliness of the Airbnb was outstanding – it was spotless! The host was also fantastic, providing very clear and concise instructions which made everything easy. The overall atmosphere was so welcoming, it really felt like home. I highly recommend this place to anyone visiting the area.

Nice house, good location and very close to a subway station, but need to improve and do something about the cleanliness of the place.
It has a roach infestation!
The big ones.
Should help guest to be able to cook or just to enter the kitchen these bugs own it! And know they don’t pay rent!

Julia’s stay made our trip to the big city all the more enjoyable. Excellent location a handful of minutes to transit, fresh market grocery, and so much more. As a traveler, sleeping arrangements and shower pressure are super important to the quality of a stay so I was ecstatic at the comfort of everything. Truly a great experience.

Ron's place was just what I needed for my debut NYC Marathon experience (I had a personal best). The location was excellent – close enough to walk home from the finish in Central Park, close enough to walk to meet friends in Times Square, close enough to the subway stations, and there were plenty of restaurants and coffee shops nearby. And, if I had wanted to party late night – instead of wanting to rest up for the race – there were bars just below the room and in the alley below my windows.
Ron was an excellent host – easy and quick communication, he made it easy to check in and check out, and he recommended some great places to try for authentic NYC fare!
If you can book this place, it’s a great value – I recommend!

Great location and value for friends to stay at an Airbnb. 3 bedrooms + 2 couches in the living room so there is a lot of space for up to 8 people. Love having 2 bathrooms. Street parking is fairly easy to find in the area.

The perfect budget friendly spot in Brooklyn. Super convenient to get to local restaurants and bars on foot, as well as the subway. Very clean, and much more spacious than you’d think for a shipping container.
I would definitely stay here again it has everything you need for a stopover in NYC at the right price. You can tell the host cares a lot about providing a great stay.

Linda and her wonderful family were fantastic hosts and we felt right at home with them at their house. Immediately when we arrived, they treated us like family. The house is decorated with all of their artworks. They have two lovely cats, a 19yo and a recently rescued kitten. The bedroom was clean and spacious and comfortable. The bathroom was modern and clean. We highly recommend staying here and would do so again the next time we visit.

The basement apartment was exactly what I expected. It is a short walk to the subway and close to several 24 hr grocery/delis. The apartment was very clean and well worth the cost. The furniture seems brand new and there were no hint bugs or mildew anywhere in the apartment. It was a little warm but I opened a private hallway door to cool the whole space quickly. Overall,  I enjoyed it quite a bit. I was able to self check-in with no issues.  The only thing to be aware is there are a couple places the ceiling is low to accommodate pipes and venting for the apartment upstairs. I am 6'3" and I hit my head in one place in a corner. So if you are tall be aware before you go.
Very nice accommodations!  The host is very responsive and the apartment is very nice, clean and private. Great spot if visiting NYC.

Bobbi was a fantastic host and she gave many small touches to the place that made me feel at home! Her place is nearby restaurants and Astoria is a great neighborhood overall. I would definitely stay again when I visit new york again!

Grazie come sempre di tutto.
Camera Magnifica.
Host Magnifico.
Prossima volta staro piu giorni .
Perche da te è come essere a Casa.
Grazie.

Chan loft is a gem really very
nice it’s just like the pictures we stayed overnight for a birthday celebration it met all of our needs and expectations we loved the massage chair but we didn’t try out the sauna or check out the deck both were a nice feature Chan was very responsive when we needed it we would definitely stay there again and would recommend it to others
Polecamy! Apartament zgodny z opisem. Lokalizacja blisko stacji metra, bardzo dobra komunikacja z centrum. Wszystko bez problemu.

Ellen and Ann are wonderful hosts, they are professional and warm,let us feel esay.Their house is located at a nice and quiet neighbourhood,near to subway stations.The house is beautiful and clean, very comfortable,is a perfect place to stay in Brooklynn,highly recommend.
Love this hotel! Always great service.

A really cozy and comfortable stay in Manhattan’s beautiful Alphabet City. I agree with all the reviews that were already left here so I’ll just add one thing I didn’t see and that’s that the 122 Essex St Parking garage is so friendly and helpful. I reserved a prepaid space through the Best Parking app since I have parking anxiety. Upon walking the 5 mins to Emma’s place though, we realized there is AMPLE street parking.

Really great place to stay in the city.  We had plenty of space to lounge and relax.  It was great to have a full kitchen and washer/dryer to use.  If you are staying for an extended period of time, this is a comfortable, stylish and spacious apartment to stay at.   In walking distance of 2,3, 4,5, and 6 trains. Has all the amenities one needs when going out of town that sometimes hotels do not provide.

Regina is helpful and responsive. However, the unit is above 4/5 flights of stairs whcih is fine unless you have lots of heavy luggage. Also, the bedding seemed to be a bit dusty and the bathroom light was very, very dim. Other that that, the kithcen area was great and the studio was peaceful.

Wayne was de ideale host, zeer behulpzaam en vriendelijk. De kamer is groter dan ie lijkt op de foto en er zit zelfs een eigen badkamer bij. Zelfs met open raam is er weinig geluid van verkeer buiten.  Gemeenschappelijk keuken is ook clean en gezellig. Buurtje (Harlem) is heerlijk, op de hoek van de straat zit een soul food buffet waar je al vanaf 10 uur 's ochtends helemaal los kunt gaan.  Metro lijn 2/3 is 5-7 minuten lopen.

We enjoyed our stay! The staff was incredibly nice, the room was clean and comfortable, and we had everything we needed. The location was perfect and allowed us to explore and get to where we wanted to go around the city.
Loved walking by and checking out local businesses and restaurants and coming back to our room at the end of the day.
I would highly recommend staying here. Thanks so much for welcoming us!
It was nice. In the morning the pipes were frozen i believe and water was not running. a little noisy in the halls but hesides that it was a nice place for a night.

Although the room is simple, it's comfortable and clean. The place was for me since I was traveling alone and needed somewhere to crash for one night on my way from the airport.
Jaleh is very warm and helpful. I had no problems at all during my brief stay.

Michael’s place was perfect for my needs on a quick work trip! The studio is nicely decorated and larger than many comparable apartments, with nice places to sit by the windows, ample natural light and enough floor space to stretch out. The bed is very comfortable with a memory foam topper. Michael provides clean towels, washcloths and pretty much anything a traveler could need (although I didn’t see a corkscrew, so bring your own or opt for a bottle of screw top wine!). The location is pretty ideal- in my case I was 7 blocks from work and my favorite coffee shop (Rex!) and half a block from my favorite bar (As Is!)- please support these awesome small businesses and keep them open!! Hell’s Kitchen is one of the premier neighborhoods for a wealth of diverse restaurants, so many to choose from. You’re also mere blocks to all major trains and so close to the west side highway for a run on the greenway or a coffee stroll along the waterfront. Yes it’s a narrow walk up building, but only two flights, so pack efficiently and enjoy your stay :) 100% recommend and I look forward to staying there again myself.
fijn appartement om new york te verkennen. dicht bij veel metro haltes en leuke restaurantjes in de buurt
Adorable room and neighborhood. Thanks Jean!
All perfect! Really nice spot in a chill area of Brooklyn. 100% recommend.

Sara was very friendly and helpful without intruding in any way. Opal and Owen were a delight and we welcomed their intrusion, though they are very well behaved and won't bother you a bit if you don't invite them in. :)

The room was clean, snug (even in frigid weather) and well-appointed and the bathroom shower was a Godsend. I developed a cold during my stay and was gratified to have a comfy bed, supplies to make tea with honey and a hot, hot shower whenever I needed it.

It was also only 2 blocks from Prospect Park, which I'm certain is fantastic in the summer. Sara has internet cable available with a bunch of channels and it rarely "buffered" so I watched uninterrupted television while I recuperated. We also have a small projector and external speaker that made the Superbowl a fantastic event as the room has a nice, clean wall opposite the bed that is perfect for projection.

Thanks Sara, we look forward to seeing you in MV.

Me and my other half stayed at Cynthias from 28th Dec until 4th Jan 2011. The apartment is in a great location about a ten second walk from the subway, and then a quick route straight down to times square. The area is lovely with a great smoothie shop with cheap prices just round the corner which Cynthia kindly took us to. The apartment itself is AMAZING!! Me and my other half absolutely loved everything about her place it was very homely, clean and just stunning!! After a stressful 18 hour journey thanks to many delays, we arrived in the middle of the night and what a relief to arrive to such a nice welcoming apartment was fantastic. Cynthia is a lovely kind hearted, warm person and we are very grateful to have met her and stayed at her beautiful home. We look forward to visiting again hopefully in the summer :)

ps... We stayed in the Grand Room, the bed is extremely comfortable and you will get a great nights sleep!!

This airbnb was exactly as pictured and in a great location. It was easy to find as Nicoletta sent clear instructions before we arrived. Nicoletta was quick to respond to our messages and even sent a message part way through our stay to check that we had everything we needed. We would definitely stay here again.

El departamento corresponde a lo que dice en el anuncio. La zona se siente un poco insegura y el colchón no es muy cómodo porque tiene varios bultos. El baño está afuera de la habitación. Aunque las instrucciones de acceso son largas son bastante claras. La ventana de la habitación da a un jardín muy bonito lo que la hace silenciosa y tranquila. Si bien la zona no es la más linda, está relativamente cerca en metro de las zonas turísticas.

die kommunikation mit jeannie war perfekt. für eine nacht war das zimmer gut, gut gelegen für de ny marathon. wir fanden schade dass kein wirkliches interesse von jeannie kam. keine erklärung was dürfen wir was nicht zb in der küche. fanden wir komisch, wenn man bei jemandem privat wohnt...
Good location and exactly what we needed for a short stay. No complaints

I had a nice stay at Lolita’s place. The room was clean and there were very nice paintings that brightened up the room.  I had no trouble with communication as she responded fast and answered all my questions. The room was smaller than it looked in the pictures, but it was definitely spacious and comfortable enough for one person. There are four other rooms being rented on the same floor so you actually have to share the bathroom with five other guests, but in my case I didn’t have to wait so I didn’t really mind. I would suggest that Lolita take the time to greet her guests personally when they arrive or even after that - in my case I didn’t get the chance to meet her and it would’ve definitely improved my experience if I did. If you’re just looking for a clean and cozy place to sleep in during your stay in NYC, and you’re not expecting to interact extensively with your host, then I would definitely recommend Lolita’s place.

We had a fantastic stay at this Airbnb in Bed-Stuy, Brooklyn. The flat was clean, spacious, and very well maintained. The beds were extremely comfortable, which made it easy to relax after long days exploring New York.
The kitchen was well equipped with a coffee machine, fridge freezer, and plenty of crockery and glasses. We also appreciated the air conditioning and dimmable lighting, which made the space feel very comfortable and adaptable.
The area felt very safe and quiet, while still being conveniently located. There were great subway connections within walking distance, as well as plenty of shops and local corner stores nearby.
The apartment is accessed via one flight of wide stairs, and the beautifully sanded and varnished wooden floors added to its charm. The bathroom was bright and clean, with a shower over the bath, and the double-door entry to the flat provided an extra sense of privacy.
We would definitely choose to stay here again on our next trip to Brooklyn.
Cute and well-appointed spot in a perfect location.  Nelson was friendly and responsive.  Would recommend!

We stayed at Thomas and Gaby's for 5 nights at the beginning of a 6 week long stint around the states. Thomas greeted us when we arrived and was very helpful, later on in the week he gave us hints and tips about where to go for drinks in the city! The apartment was clean and tidy and had everything we needed including a hairdryer. The apartment was about 10 min walk to the nearest subway and took about 30/40 minutes to get into Manhattan. Overall we enjoyed our stay and was ideal for a trip on a budget!

Hudson Yards Hotel is the place to stay !! its my Second time staying there  and all I have to say is i will continue to stay in this hotel every time i visit NYC. close to Time Square and other attractions that makes your stay way more comfortable . Hotel room was very clean and staff is super nice. I recommend this Hotel to everyone.

We were delighted with the accommodation, and Marlyn was gracious and attentive. Upon check-in, Marlyn gave us a tour of the home, but equally as important were the additional amenities provided. There were breakfast food and beverages in the refrigerator for consumption. The location was suitable for our needs and easy to navigate around New York.
We recommend and would consider staying there in the future.
Great stay. Fantastic host. Lively NYC neighborhood close to transit.

Claudine was such a sweet and amazing host! Firstly, my guest and I had different arrival times and different airports. Claudine allowed for us both to arrive separately to the Airbnb which was great. She was also more than kind enough to pick me up upon my arrival, after my Uber driver dropped me off at the wrong location. The Airbnb itself was simply gorgeous!! The decor was lovely and the space was very clean, cozy and inviting! Claudine was also very helpful letting us know about things to do in the city, as well as how to get around. Even more helpful, she was available by phone if we ever needed anything. I really wish we could have stayed longer. If you're thinking about extending your stay, don't hesitate! Otherwise she'll be completely booked (once you arrive, you'll see exactly why!)  Overall we had a great stay here with a wonderful host, and I'd definitely book with Claudine again!

I was traveling for a work event and this was a great place to base out of for last minute travel! A lovely well lit space with common areas I wasn’t able to take advantage of during my stay unfortunately.

414A Waverley Avenue is a special place and conveniently located in Clinton Hill.
Vikki was helpful and courteous throughout our one week stay.
Richard

La habitación tiene muy buena comunicación en transporte publico y con Times Square, ademas los anfitriones son muy flexibles en cuanto a la llegada y a la salida lo que hizo que pudiésemos entrar antes a la habitación y salir más tarde. Además la habitación cuenta con grandes comodidades como calefacción, televisión para poder entretenerte y una terraza agradable. Si vuelvo a ir a Nueva York volveremos a contactar con ellos.

Logement spacieux propre et bien équipé.
Literie et linge de toilette très douillets !
Proche du métro épargné par la cohue new-yorkaise
Quelques commerces à proximité
Bien équipé.
Jenny est une hôtesse disponible et serviable avec le sourire.

We absolutely loved our stay at Jeffrey's place. He is amazing and helped us with everything we needed.
He taught us some history of the city places that we really appreciated!
He even had some pictures. Make sure to ask him about the "High line", Coney Island and other famous places, he surely will have some interesting stories about them.
As he state in his place description, he has a piano. If you are lucky enough, you can hear him play his piano during the night.
Don't misunderstand, the room is very quiet, comfortable and big.
We thank him once again for making our first visit to NYC an amazing one. If we come back we will definitely stay here again.
추워서 그랬는진 몰라도 엘레베이터가 수시로 고장나서 나이많은 부모님을 모시고 여행중이였는데 엘레베이터에 3번이나 갇히고 또 어떨때는 엘레베이터가 작동을하지않아 6층까지 걸어 올라가야했고 거실 히터가 작동하지않아 각자 방에만 있어야했습니다

Accurate listing for a nice stay. Cute little balcony overlooking the street, made for a lovely staycation in a great neighborhood. Side note would recommend getting a banh mi from the Vietnamese sandwich spot around the corner, those sandwiches made my day.
Very cozy and comfortable, my family was relocating and we needed to be close to our home , while the move was taking place .  We where very satisfied with our choice 😊

Norga's place is lovely and his mother, Linda, was an excellent host. The kitchen was exceptionally well stocked, the rooms were beautiful with very nice furniture, and we enjoyed the outside patio as well.
The bed is queen size and very comfortable.
Altogether, we were quite pleased with our stay.
The only thing that wasn't ideal is the neighborhood. Norga's street is lovely, lined with Brownstones and trees. Plenty of restaurants and markets are nearby as is the subway, however, quite a few of the streets in the rest of the neighborhood are rundown.
We were in Brooklyn because our daughter's school is there, so we weren't sightseeing. The location and home worked well for us, but tourists might want something in Manhattan.
That said, we certainly recommend Norga's Airbnb for anyone staying in Brooklyn.
Great location, easy access to subway and other parts of NYC. Awesome communication, check in process, and value for our stay! Thanks Yacine!
Great accommodations a lot of extras I loved it was adorable great location

Séjour formidable ! L’appartement était très propre, bien équipé et fonctionnel. Literie de bonne qualité. Emplacement central pour visiter New York à pied. Métro et bus à proximité.
À 2 pas de Hell’s Kitchen et sa diversité de restaurants.
Seul point négatif, emplacement très bruyant au carrefour de 2 grandes artères. Prévoir des bouchons d’oreilles ! 😀
Excellent stay! Cozy home! Awesome neighborhood and 8 min drive to train station! Super clean and lovely! Will come back!

Danica's place was fantastic for us while we were getting our heads around living in New York. The apartment is a short walking distance from the train and very convenient for different restaurants nearby. The room was spacious enough to accommodate our luggage (and we had a lot of luggage!)
Danica was a very welcoming host. The communication was efficient and clear and she made our stay very pleasant. We can warmly recommend this place for others as well.

This is a great little place with everything you need! The room feels like a small studio apartment, with a shower, toilet, sink, mini-fridge, microwave, and private entrance. The hosts also provided towels, shampoo/conditioner, soap, disposable cups/bowls/utensils, etc. The room was extremely clean and also very quiet, although it's only a short walk from Midtown/Times Square. Would definitely recommend!

The house and room are very nice and so is Christina! The room is very clean and comfortable! Christina was nice to give me a ride to the metro as she was going to the metro as well. I recommend this place.
Johnny is a amazing host.  What I liked the most is he was really sensitive to when I needed things quiet so I could rest properly. He really does share his space in a respectful way.
Jessica is Awesome and the Bronx was awesome!
Roxanne is a great host. The apartment was well equipped and everything was spot on. Would come back anytime!
This is one of the best airbnb I have ever been to. Parking is easy. Room is sparkly clean. About 10 min to the subway. Everything is perfect!!
excellent place and cozy.
Very hospitable host! Everything about my stay was great! Will highly recommend to anyone looking to stay in this area!

Good value for NYC. Great proximity to Central Park, Citi bike hire, galleries on upper east side, Harlem and subway. Aircon and air filter in room. Freshly painted. Warm welcome from host. Wifi is a bit slow and not suitable for downloading anything big. Very safe and adequate.

I had a good stay at Rose’s Fantastic Air BnB! The plan was for a month but I had to extended it and Rose was so helpful. The apartment space was so accommodating and lots of free-come and go without any interruptions of my flow of the day. I am forever grateful for the stay and use of the room and bathe! Winner!

This place is amazing, it is definitely on the smaller side, but there’s so much to do in the city you won’t want to be spending all your time in the room anyway. Leigh is very nice and approachable, and the cats are incredible!
My main warning: it is on the 5th floor of an apt building with no elevator, and the stairway is pretty narrow. So if you’re disabled or generally not up for a bit of a hike, this might not be the right place.
The location felt very safe, I walked around quite a bit pretty late at night and had no genuine concerns. I mean obviously it’s New York so caution is always advised, but still. There’s lots of food, bars, etc open late.
The apt itself is very clean, and feels very homey! You should stay here:)
One other thing: if you haven’t used a keycafe before, be prepared to go to a different location to pick up your keys when you first arrive. Leigh’s is on the other side of the block, which took me a little while to sort out because I’d never heard of key cafe before!

Safe neighborhood in Brooklyn, and perfect for if you need a place to just sleep, change your clothes and shower. My husband and I typically are gone all day while in the City, so a little place like this works well for us. They allowed us to drop our bags off before check-in which was helpful.
I would suggest bringing a new pair or two of cheap flip flops to wear for the shower/in the bathroom after the shower as the floor is concrete, and there’s no barrier for the water. And bring a pillow if you prefer a firmer/larger pillow.
Overall, a nice little place in a safe neighborhood with the red line a 6-8 min walk away!

Very nice for the area, very close to public transit and lots of good places you can walk to. You share common areas with others but your room has its own key and lock. It was very clean but too warm for my liking so time of year may be something you should think about.
Great location on a quiet street close to metro stations and stores, and the place was very clean! Would recommend/book again!
excellent night! I was able to successfully book at a short notice. The accommodations were perfect for my layover.
Todo salio perfecto, nos encanto el departamento y la pasamos genial en nuestra estadia, el barrio es hermoso y tiene el subte muy cerca, tambien mercados y restaurantes!!
Beautiful & very clean updated place just a little over priced..
The place is sparkling clean and easy to find. Good value for money.
no limpiaron un dia el cuarto, la habitación más pequeña de lo que parecia, los elevadores estan saturados siempre, tienes que esperar demasiado para subir o bajar.

Kimball's apartment was the perfect place to stay in NYC. I stayed for 2 months and was very happy to find this place so close to all the places in NYC I like most.
The apartment appeared as it is described. It is spacious and has enough room to accommodate 2 people. The kitchen and bathroom were well equipped, and the A/C, the heater, and the WiFi worked well.
Kimball was really helpful and always responded very quickly when I needed help.
The apartment is located in the middle of the Upper West Side. It is just a 5-minute walk to the subway as well as to Central Park. Columbus Ave, Amsterdam Ave, and Broadway are also just minutes away, which makes it the perfect place to go out and enjoy your NYC time.
It is located on a very busy street, though. So prepare yourself for some traffic noise. For me, it adds up to the whole big-city-experience :)
I can absolutely recommend the place and Kimball as a host.
We loved the space. It was perfect for our needs. Host was extremely responsive and kind!

Evan is professional, responsive, and has a great location. The apartment was clean and had everything I needed for a comfortable stay. It wasn't a problem for me but heads up that the apartment building has steep stairs. I would definitely recommend this place. Thanks Evan!
The location was very close to metro and affordable.
Great host higly recomend

You receive what you pay, spacious apartment and very clean. Kind and friendly host that can help you with every doubt. Yo need to walk around 8 minutes to arrive to the subway station. Bus stop very close in the corner.
We loved staying here.  As advertised and a great location.  Excellent views, bright, and clean!  Will stay here again on our next visit to NYC.  Steve was a great host.  Proactive and responsive.
Had a great stay
Apartment was just as pictured. Location was great. Perfect for families or groups who need some space. Mia was incredibly responsive!
Loved the location, lots of shops and restaurants nearby, Fort Green Park is a block away and perfect for walking and relaxing. Aaron is a great host!!

Noah the host was amazing at helping us check in!! He made us feel right at home, and the location of SoHoBlu was ideal as the subway was right outside the front door of the accommodation. I loved how ChinaTown and Little Italy were within walking distance and plenty of shopping options were available on the neighbouring streets.
Great and clean place with awesome views of Midtown Manhattan. Would definitely recommend.

Allison's place was perfect! Felt extremelyy safe in the neighborhood and everything was very walkable! Was also able to have a straight walk through to Central Park and loved that there was a Whole Foods, Pura Vida, and cvs very nearby!  I also appreciated that I was able to drop my luggage off in the early afternoon once I arrived to the city so I could explore the city during the day! Instructions were also made super clear and she was very responsive and made my trip such a breeze! 😊 also had such a sweet and adorable puppy! 🐶

We had a great stay at Chrys’s place. We were in the city most of the day but coming back every evening felt like coming home. Beds were good, shower great. Nothing to complain about. We will definitely come again.
The best good point is location. We can go anywhere by walk. But when we put our luggage before check in, we have to pay $7. I didn’t know that so I was surprised.
Great place, and Anna was extremely helpful throughout the process.

Excelentes Anfitriones, hermoso y muy bien iluminado departamento absolutamente privado con todas las comodidades. Acceso a Manhattan en 20', a 7' u 8' minutos a pie de 2 lineas de metro y a 1 cuadra de múltiples lineas de buses. El barrio es hermoso, arbolado y tranquilo, de edificios bajos, ideal para descansar bien por las noches, en el corazón de Brooklyn, a pocas cuadras de williamsburg y Bushwick. Nicole y Chacon estuvieron siempre predispuestos a ayudarnos en cualquier cosa que necesitáramos. Sin duda recomendaria este alojamiento. La pasamos de maravilla y ya extrañamos. Volveriamos a su departamento sin dudarlo.

We like the location a lot. Very close to subway entrance & Penn Station. Easy to take train from JFK airport to Penn station. Lots of great restaurants & deli in the area. Comfortable stay for our family of 5. We also like that we can drop off our luggages early before checking in since we arrived in the morning. Definitely would book again.
Great deal ‼️ enjoyed my stay I would book again 🤷🏽‍♂️

Mutale est un hôte très réactif et à l'écoute.
Nous avons passé une super semaine dans cet appartement qui est dans un quartier calme proche du métro et avec des commerces, restaurants et une laverie très proches.
Je recommande !!

We had an excellent stay at Andrew’s apartment. The space is at the second floor with two flairs of stairs (one to access the house, one for the rented space) it’s a spacious and private floor entirely for you which makes it a big perk in NYC!!! You have your own private kitchen, big room and spacious bathroom and you’re only 25 mins away from Manhattan! The neighbourhood is pretty peaceful that it didn’t even seem we were in the city, surroundings are well served and the host super kind and available. We highly recommend this listing and we’ll be happy to come back again if we’ll have occasions in the future!
Es un lugar con una expende ubicación para moverte , también sentí que la ubicación es segura , hay transporte cerca y el desayuno que te ofrecen creo que es un gran plus. Lo recomiendo mucho

Demetrio’s place was quiet, clean, and perfectly located. The hosts were very responsive and communicative and the place itself was comfortable and inviting. A lovely place to stay with easy access to the whole of the city.

Anita is very easy with checking in and out. She responded quickly if I needed anything and was very friendly.  The train stations are about a fifteen minute walk, but it's an easy and pretty route. The only downside was the internet was slower than I would've liked, but overall I would recommend.

Joseph & Teresa were helpful and great with responses. The house was amazing, extremely spacious and very comfortable. The bed and pillows were soooo soft, I couldn’t believe it lml. Would definitely come back very soon.

Very nice home close to public transportation.  It was everything we needed for the weekend.  The upstairs bedrooms as well as the main kitchen and living areas did get warm but the rooms have window AC units (which we instructed to only have on while at the residence) which helped to cool things down after a while as well as several fans.  Two and a half bathrooms was a big plus.
Easy check in to a great Brooklyn property
Barbi is very nice, friendly, and accessible.
The perfect place for solo travelers in NYC!! Clean, safe, efficient and in a perfect spot!

I would stay again but the first door was just left open lingering too much for my preference even though the second door locked too. & i had noise canceling headphones so the heater squeaking, animals, & workers didn’t really bother me. also bring a small towel w/ you too.

Great location in Brooklyn, close to coffee shops, restaurants and transit. There’s always something happening in the park across the street and in the neighborhood. We felt very welcome by the local residents.

Fernando and Jania were wonderful hosts! Communication was seamless. My family stayed here for my wedding and they felt right at home. They appreciated the  little details like the coffee, fully stocked bathroom and the cozy home decor. The best coffee and restaurants are all within walk as well!

Great place and great host. We had a car and honestly the parking wasn’t bad at all. Only spent 30mins looking one night, which is not bad for the area. The place was beautiful. I loved the extra supplies such as toilet and paper towels. The bathroom was filled with essentials one can appreciate.

The district of Astoria felt very safe. You have supermarkets with fresh food there. The subway station is not accessible. Fast connection to Manhattan with two lines! Main street is very busy, but the Airbnb is offside and quiet. My room on the first floor was very clean, but dark even in daylight. The kitchen had everything you need available. Bathroom was small but overall clean. Checking in and out was easy and well communicated.
Clean and great location!

Wir fühlten uns im Appartement von Vernon und seiner Familie sehr wohl.
Die Wohnung war sauber und es war alles vorhanden was man so für einen Urlaub braucht.
Sowohl die An-, als auch sie Abreise gestalteten sich unkompliziert und unser Gastgeber zeigte sich sehr flexible. Die Metrostation ist ist fußläufig in ca. 10 Minuten zu erreichen. Ein Lebensmittelgeschäft befindet sich um die Ecke. ( 2 Minuten)
Das Apartment können wir uneingeschränkt empfehlen.
Great value place with all the necessities! Highly recommend !
Lakshmee is such a lovely host!  The room is exactly as described and every space was perfectly clean. Very satisfied
Our stay was wonderful! I have a random charge for $37.94 from Hilton that I was told will eventually go away so I am waiting on that. Otherwise, everything was perfect.
Perfect place to stay, very clean, thoughtful touches, everything you need to cook. I look forward to coming back in future visits!

Lovely space in NYC in s bustling community. Close to the subway, which makes life a lot easier.
The apartment was clean and bed comfortable. Only stayed two nights but a comfortable stay nonetheless.

I was in town for a conference being hosted at Industry City and Andrada's place was the perfect location for it - roughly one block from the venue which is home to tons of restaurants, shops and a free coworking space. Andrada's place was also a quick walk to the DNR subway stop - so convenient! The apartment is a cozy oasis, super clean, friendly neighbors if you cross paths with them and a fully stocked bathroom. Andrada was very accommodating and flexible with check-in and very friendly/communicative. Wish I could've stayed long, I can't wait to come back!
Mich was very accommodating. Great apartment in a great location!

séjour parfait, le logement est proche des commodités de Brooklyn et de la bouche de métro qui amène a Manhattan.
Ellen est très réactive, nous avons eu un souci et il a été résolu dans la journée.
je recommande a 100%
this us the best airbnb I have stayed at in NYC .  location is great.  rooms are clean and you get a private bathroom.
Everything is good, one flaw is that I didn't see Michelle herself during the living at all, which is not a quite friendly living experience.

My stay at the Holiday Inn Express was great. Every aspect of the experience went smoothly, from check-in to check-out. My only complaint was the outdated TV, as I was hoping to connect and watch Netflix while in the room. Aside from that minor issue, I would definitely stay here again whenever I visit New York.!

Estuvimos una semana completa y muy bien, es tal y como lo describen. Es un formato más de hostal que de apartamento, te cambian las toallas y vacían papeleras todos los días (no limpian, tampoco hacia falta). La ubicación es lo mejor, a solo una cuadra de Time Square. Lo único que recomendaría ya es un cambio de colchón, por lo demás todo lo esperado. Muy recomendable.
Easy street parking , many restaurants nearby and easy to communicate.
The both Cristina and husband, prove to be excellent host, thank you!
Fantastic private cozy spot for a New York adventure. Place is clean with everything you need. Very affordable!  David was very welcoming! Close to subway and other cool areas!
I really enjoyed my stay at the art house hotel. Comfortable, clean, accurate to the photos.
The space was gorgeous and perfect for my trip!
No complaints and close to a subway
Great location, beautiful apartment, overall amazing experience!

Rob’s place was fantastic, and his communication was even better. After another property canceled on us last minute, Rob was incredibly accommodating and helped us get into his place same day. The apartment was great, the location was awesome, and the whole experience made a stressful situation so much easier. Would absolutely stay again!
My parents stayed here for a quick weekend in NY. They absolutely loved the convenience of a first floor apartment, and the space was just perfect for two people.

Greg and Adriane were fabulous hosts and their apartment was perfect for our trip (and the bed was so insanely comfortable that I wish I could've dragged it home with me). The whole space was filled with sweet touches (medicine cabinet full of travel toiletries, a white noise machine, personalized welcome sign on the door).
Both were very quick to respond to questions, and they gave us great information about the neighborhood and getting around.
This place was much larger than I expected and had everything we (myself and my two children) needed to travel comfortably. It was more private than I thought it would be.
looked just like the pictures, clean, kitchen well equipped and quiet. I recommend!

Christina is a wonderful, welcoming host and her apartment is brilliantly placed in Williamsburg. I stayed for 5 nights and for me, it was the perfect place to be – totally close to Manhatten and when I was done there to enjoy all the cafés, restaurants, shops and markets of Williamsburg. Christina knows all the cool places. And the bed is super comfortable too. I loved it.
Tracey’s place is great and well located!
Easy access to Metro, shopping center and restaurants.  Free parking on street except Friday morning. Have premium channels and wifi is stable.

Appartement très propre , très bien distribué et vraiment très bien équipé. Tout est neuf.
La petite terrasse partagée à l'arrière est un plus.
Les lignes de métro permettent de rejoindre Manhattan en 40mn à peine.
Le contact avec Lexia a été facile et elle a été très arrangeante.
Nous recommandons à 100%

Michele was a wonderful and responsive host. Any questions or issues that happened to come up were resolved immediately. The location of this space is safe and walkable, with plenty of great spots to eat nearby.
The beds were oh so comfy and everything was clean. Awesome amenities like laundry came in clutch for our group. If we find ourselves back in queens, I’ll be choosing Michele’s place again!
Tannise House was Perfect , definitely booking again !
This stay is classic and beautiful. I felt safe and comfortable, and a part of New York history. Julio is very kind and caring. The place is super easy to find and get into.

Most perfect apt. and we loved the location which is close to great restaurants, public transportation  and the West Side Highway which we used almost daily for our long exercise walks. Building is beautiful and staff was great both friendly and attentive. During Covid things are not as they should be and I felt comfortable and safe. Everyone followed protocol. I would highly recommend this building for a short stay or long stay -- we were there for a month. No complaints. I can only imagine that once all the restrictions are over this would be an even better place to stay.

Great hidden gem in a safe neighborhood! Especially if you have a car as it’s close to two major highways and tons of cool neighborhoods and restaurants. I’ve stayed here twice - would definitely stay again in the near future

Wonderful experience! Easy access to buses and trains that’d take you anywhere you’d like. Manuel was wonderful and communicative, helped to resolve any small questions I had! Would definitely stay here again and again.
Thank you! Perfect spot to explore bay ridge and brooklyn. Close to transit and very walkable area with good food.
Great location and very comfortable beds. Nice having a kitchenette, perfect for our trip. Would definitely stay here again next time we visit NYC.

My daughter and i loved our staten island cottage for our annual girls trip. Easy drive in from Newark and not far from the Staten Island Ferry to enjoy a day in NYC. Cottage was nice and a little bigger than what I expected. Quiet, close by resturants. The bunk is super cute esp for kiddos. The bread Kathleen made was aaaamazing, we ate the whole loaf lol. Kathleen herself is an absolute doll. If we go back to NY we are definitely going back to the cottage.

Great place to stay. Leesha was so accommodating and welcoming and gave us a handful of helpful information about the area and subway. The room that is offered is very confortable and is just like the description. Great people.

Jaleh's place is conveniently located only a couple of blocks from the subway and Central Park. Jaleh and her family were very friendly and made my brother and me feel welcome in their home. The place was clean and organized, contained all the essentials, and the neighborhood was nice and quiet at night.

We had a fantastic stay at Jeff’s house. The house was comfortable, and had everything we needed. The kitchen was well-equipped. The living room and the outdoor area were perfect for relaxing and spending time with family.

My partner and I spent a lovely week at Jennifer's, she is a very generous host and leaves you free to use her house whilst she is away, which means you can cook and relax in the living room after a busy day uptown.
Her living room is beautiful and stylish and a really nice space and there are loads of interesting books to browse. The bedroom is nice and spacious and it was great having a private bathroom, shower was fab, loads of towels and toiletries which is very considerate, so no need to bring your own and saves on your luggage if travelling light like we were.
House in a very quiet street, decking out back nice for breakfast and great for bird and squirrel watching. Plenty of good local restaurants and a nice patisserie and what we really liked was a bar called Barbes, literally 5 minutes walk, which had really amazing live music every night, well worth a trip out. Location wise we found this part of Brooklyn easy to get in and out of, couple of blocks to nearest subway and regular trains, although as it's about a half hour trip into manhattan we didn't go back in at night, too tired by then!
I would thoroughly recommend staying at Jennifer's if you can.
Love the location and it’s perfect for our 10 days stay!

Superbe logement très bien placé.
Spacieux, métro à 100 mètres.
Machine à laver et sèche linge fonctionnels et pratiques, cuisines permettant de se faire des repas.
Je recommande vivement et y retournerais sans problèmes si je reviens à NY.
Die Unterkunft war sehr sauber und nah an der U-Bahn. In der Umgebung gibt es sehr gute Restaurants.
Quiet & comfortable for a short stay. Nicely done.
Nice place to stay if you are catching a flight at JFK in the morning!
Jason was very responsive and went out of his way to help us out. His place met our expectations. Thank you Jason!
I had a great stay. Whenever I had a question Sanja responded quickly. The subway was really close. The room was cute decorated. Would definitely stay here again :)
Great location and easy check-in. Jane’s home was comfortable and spacious.

Stay here if you are in New York. This is an amazing AirBnB - extremely clean, modern building, great location for exploring both Brooklyn and Manhattan, friendly neighborhood-vibe and, most importantly, an absolutely excellent host. Thank you Chris for a wonderful experience and we hope to stay at your place again soon!

Roger's place was in a great location, easy access to 2 different subway stations.
the apartment was really clean and surprisingly quiet.
Supermarket and restaurants really close to the apmt.
Roger was a great communicator too.
easy check in and great location! would definitely recommend 😊

At the current prices this is the most affordable option with a decent sized room in east village. It’s a great neighborhood with lot’s of things to do and is very close to grocery stores, bars, the park, and the L train. Kirk was extremely nice and even had cleaning crews come. I highly recommend.
One of the best place to stay in Brooklyn.

Chris and Jenn are fantastic hosts! Made us feel very comfortable and at home. Chris gave us a lot of great tips on local restaurants and things to do. Neighborhood is safe and very convenient to the subway line into Manhattan. Room was nice, clean, and bed was comfortable. If you're craving Mexican food check out Xochtil Taqueria. For a local low-key bar check out Hudson dry. Great Atmosphere and friendly people. Overall a 10 out of 10 and a great location to check out Manhattan and Brooklyn! Don't be afraid to explore! New Yorkers are very friendly and helpful!
Great place! Close to ferry
Love the room and ariel is very friendly i definitely will stay again

The accommodation is three blocks from the subway station and with the J line in about 20 minutes you reach Manhattan. The common area of the house is very nice, it is possible to cook and store things in the refrigerator with comfort. The room has a good size, shelves and coat racks to accommodate some personal things, but as the roof is on the way down, the space to circulate is greatly reduced.
While we did not spend time with Brady during our stay he was always very attentive through messages of what we needed in order to help us.
Comfortable and clean, right by the J train
Excellent location! Very kind and helpful.
El apartamento esta superbien situado a una cuadra de times square, la habitación esta bien para dos personas tiene baño privado y la cocina esta disponible, la pasamos muy bien, muchas gracias
Exelente ubicacion despues de un dia ajetreado en la gran manzana, muy seguro estar caminando hasta las 5am y de rapido acceso al metro.

This is an amazing place to stay. It’s a hotel which is a bit unclear in the listing but feels like an apartment building as there’s no check in station or anything.
You are in the heart of China town here! Walk 2 blocks to little Italy, amazing Russian food, relaxing parks to people watch... and all while feeling safe!
Great location and would highly recommend it to anyone wanting to check out all of lower Manhattan.

Taylor is a great host, always friendly and responsive. The apartment is exactly like the pictures: well decorated with everything you need. Master bedroom very comfortable, plenty of space. The other rooms are smaller but can fit one person each or a couple sleeping together. Great experience overall!
Cuando me hospede en este lugar, el anfitrión fue muy atento y amable. El lugar es bonito.

We had a great stay at Lindsey's.
Cosy place, open view, charming flat.

Das Apartment war gut ausgestattet und groß genug für eine 4-köpfige Familie.
Vielen Dank!

This place was cozy and quiet. Loved having an apartment that felt like an oasis in the midst of a busy city. Neighborhood felt safe. Wonderful restaurants on every corner!  Would definitely stay there again!

Claudius was a great host! We spent our last two days in NYC in his basement suite and it was nice and relaxing. The place is not very accessible via subway but the Long Island rail road is a 5 minute walk away. If you're looking for an affordable getaway in a quiet part of New York, this is the place for you!
Thanks Claudius!

Very nice host, excellent space, easy access. I can’t think of bad to mention
Host is very accommodating

Absolutely loved my stay with Kate and Danny - they are super hospitable and helpful, and the flat, although old and creaky, is super charming. Location fab, bed comfy, cat super friendly. I’ll be back!

A fantastic 4-week stay! The space was clean, cozy, and well stocked. The building is on a quiet street, but is close to many shops and restaurants, as well as the Q and 6 trains to get around the city. Central Park is also just a few blocks away which was a great plus!
Kourosh was a wonderful host, communication was prompt and friendly, and he was available to answer any questions and give recommendations. I highly recommend this place.

Appreciated the home being close to subway, however, front room was a little noisy and bathroom amenities were a little run down and downstairs bathroom door didn’t close. Other than that, great place to stay!

we left NYC feeling like we stayed in the heart of Brooklyn, this air BNB was one of the best we've been to. Simone was extremely helpful and the place was loaded with everything we needed. everyone was very friendly and it felt like home. would highly recommend!
Very affordable, cozy and easy to check into. Would recommend 100% !!!

Alexandra’s spot was so peaceful and a great place to decompress from the business of the city each night. The neighborhood was quiet and safe feeling with lots of great food close by! Would definitely stay here again

The room is really great. It feels very private and is decorated nicely. The rest of the apartment is very nice and it was always clean. The apartment is close to the L train and Citi bike stations that make it easy to get into Manhattan. The host is great with communication and makes sure you have everything you need.

The house was very clean and very comfortable. I attribute this to the properly constructed rules, such as how to spend time in the common areas. I have been able to have private space and have never had any difficulty spending time in the house.
I have never felt unsafe in the surrounding area.
I highly recommend this place.

This is my second time staying at this location. Love it!  Thoughtful attention to details In the space -lots of towels, coffee, toiletries.  Clean and spacious.  Only 5 min away from JFK.   Don’t hesitate to book here!!

Was clean. Good value for the price. Friendly staff.
Walls are thin so it can be hard to sleep if ppl are noisy, but it wasn't a huge problem. The lock on the door felt loose and could easily be broken.
Parking is difficult. There's some parking in the front, but it's first come first served. Took a while to find on street parking.
We would def come back and really enjoyed our stay here :)
Thanks Michael for welcoming us to your beautiful place and for recommending local spots for coffee/brunch and dinner :) had a wonderful stay.
had a great time, the appartment is nice and super clean, everything you need! Carlos is very helpful and always reachable, if I needed somethimg.
Risha was felxible, communicative and welcoming.  The apartment was a nice place to come home to... thanks!

There’s no way you would be able to find me a better deal throughout the entire island than Rubem’s place. The value you receive from this listing far exceeds the price you pay. Easily walkable to several friendly neighborhood bars, pizza places and restaurants. Easily accessible public transit to go anywhere in the city. Big, spacious, extremely clean, felt right at home in the middle of the city. I would recommend this place to anyone and I highly recommend you book this listing.
Very welcoming and a great stay. fun neighborhood near Corona Park. Highly. recommened!

el apartamento es tal cual se ve en las fotos, el barrio está lejos del centro pero  nos ha encantado su ambiente, gente amable y bastante seguro. Our stay in Cara’s house felt like being home in New York city (and we’be never been to New York before!)

My retired parents and I stayed at Joanna's house in October. Joanna was warm and welcoming from her first email and this continued when she met us at the house to settle us in. The house is a home, filled with objects from Joanna's life there since the late 1970s and the style of the home reflects her interest in art and the environment and felt a little like you might be in one of Woody Allen's films from the 80s (think Hannah and her Sisters). Family photos, paintings and books lined the walls and the kitchen was equipped for serious cooking. The upstairs bedroom had a very comfortable bed, the second bedroom is a study with a pull out bed that would be fine for a short stay - that both rooms had their own bathrooms was very convenient and allowed us to feel quite self contained.
The weekend we stayed was a long weekend and there was a lot of noise in the street all night. Joanna has said she will provide ear plugs for her guests use in future and this will make a difference for anyone who hasn't adjusted to the hustle and bustle of NYC.

The check in process was super easy, as was check out. Boris was always reachable for everything from questions about the fan and TV, to logistical questions, etc. All of our interactions were friendly and helpful.
If I come back to New York again I would definitely stay at Boris’ again. Even if I needed to spend more time travelling to what I was doing in the city.

Beautiful and immaculate living quarters.  Four friends and I stayed for 1.5 days prior to flying out of the country. Sydney was great at responding to inquiries quickly and following up to make sure everything was going well with our stay.

Superb. I’ve travelled a decent bit on Airbnb, and this is one of the best places I’ve stayed. Bedroom is quite, spacious, and super comfortable. The home is spotlessly clean with all the provisions you could ask for. Barry is a friendly host who will have you well looked after. Very central location too.
This is amazing. was my first time in newyork the apartment was very clean and comfortable short walking distance from the train station. Would definitely stay here again.
Very nice place and very nice people. Treated me with respect and kindness. Highly recommend.

My sister and I had a great time at Mike’s. He was so helpful with things to do and see, helped us get great tickets. A perfect spot, really fun place to stay- seriously you’ll never find a place like it! We spent sometime hanging out, and I love that about airbnb. Meeting a new person and hearing their experience of the city. Would 10/10 go back and we made a new friend.

We really enjoyed Rick&Davids place for 4 nights. Even though they weren’t at home for most of our trip we got a virtual tour when we arrived which explained everything. The apartment itself is very nice and a perfect place to start your sightseeing through the city while still staying in a quiet neighborhood. The hosts are very friendly and the appartment has everything you could wish for. Would stay there again if in NYC!

Great place. Prime spot in the city. In the middle of everything. Within walking distance of so much and can take subway anywhere else. Only issue was the bathroom door. It was coming off the hinge. But we made it work.
Highly recommended.
Really nice and quit place! It is spacious for 3 people. Feels like home. We would definitely recommend this place.

This spot is great in Bedstuy.   Each bedroom has a bath room with a tub and shower and boy is that unusual in these parts!  Nice compact kitchen.  All you could want except, no microwave.  But there is a cooktop and an air frier/oven.  The back yard is such a great thing to have when you just want to retreat from the city.  And unlike other 'back yards' in the area, this one has real grass, and things growing.  Not just a patio and storage and a table or something.  It was enjoyable even in November.   Amy is a great and attentive host.  She checks in with you plenty to make sure everything is just so.
Great stay! Just as described, and Alfredo is very friendly.

I wanted to visit lower Manhattan and LES especially. I found the J train access convenient and good value. Very clean and comfortable space. Vika did a great job hosting, very interesting to talk to and responsive to my questions.
For other fitness enthusiasts like me I'll note that a Blink gym sits nearby.
Perfect place in every way. I would live here full time if I could. Pierce was kind and helpful with very thorough and punctual communication.
The apartment was spacious and neighborhood was fun to explore.

Rachael and Jeronimo are very kind people and try to make everything possible to give you the best comfort!❤️
Our stay was perfect and we felt save in that area!
There is a lot to do in the area and everything that I needed was close by. I enjoyed my visit.

I arrived to New York for 4 days and stayed at Candlewood Suites. The staff is friendly and the location is just 10 minutes away from Times Square by walking. The room was clean and comfy. I have nothing to complain about.

Hi, I stayed with Marjorie for 6 days. Her apartment and hospitality were exceptional. It was my first time using Airbnb and cannot say enough about how great it was. Her apartment is a great place to commute to Manhattan from and Redhook is a great neighborhood full of friendly people with great amenities. I particularly liked Baked, Fort Defiance, Hometown and The Good Fork these are all great places to eat and they make a single traveller exceptionally welcome.
Marjorie also provided me with great directions of the area and provided me with answers to any questions I may of had. I had a fantastic time in NY and credit Marjorie for providing me with a great place to stay. Tammy
Convenient location, clean, nice hotel overall!

Great spot near the subway and multiple parks and food spots. Worked well for our family of 5 and was a great size kitchen and bathrooms.
Checkin was great and it’s very clean and rooms were cozy. We loved the sky lights and and art through the building. We would definitely stay here again!

We had a really good experience in this apartament. The space is small, but there is everything you need to be comfortable, perfect for a couple like us visiting the city. The best feature of the apartament is by far its location. Minutes away from Union Square, we were able to go anywhere in the city with ease. The check-in and check-out went smoothly, there is a keycafe nearby where you will find your home keys. We recomend the place to anyone visiting and would definetely come back in the future.

There were pros and cons, but overall, it was a great place to stay in New York City!
As for the pros, the apartment has an excellent location, and I loved Chelsea. On the street, there are about four really cool vintage stores, cafes nearby, and places to eat. The High Line Park is very close, and I used to go for a run there in the mornings. The area felt safe, and when I came back at night, I didn’t feel in danger. Lacey is very friendly and responded to my questions. My room was spacious and had its own entrance. Overall, the apartment is even nicer than in the photos, and so is the room.
As for the cons, I would say the building is old, the elevator was out of service for a while, and the washing machine worked but leaked water, causing a mess. There were mice, so you couldn’t leave food out. Sometimes, the bathroom would run out of toilet paper (for a short time). You can hear everything inside the apartment, EVERYTHING. But if you always have your headphones on, it’s okay

Unfortunately, the hotel was overbooked and I didn't find this out until I was checking in. The hotel did a great job of moving me elsewhere to The Muse which is like a block away. It was frustrating in the moment, but my stay was still good. The space was clean and nice once I got in and checking out was an easy process.

The loft is really spacious and it has all the comforts. We only stayed one night but we wish we had more time to enjoy the wide selection of sport channels!
Eric is a very thoughtful host who cares a lot about the needs of his guests. The house is located on a quiet street. Can definitely recommend!
The host went above and beyond to ensure everything was perfect. We really enjoyed our stay.

Elissa's place was perfect for a long weekend in NYC for my fiance and I. The area is only OK but it's very close to a subway stop that gets you into Manhattan in ~20 mins, which is all we needed. Elissa was also incredibly helpful with allowing us to check in early after a red eye flight and even made my fiance tea when she was feeling a little under the weather!
Highly recommend for a good value option in NYC.
Very nice place, very comfortable. And Billy is very nice and considered

Keren was so kind to us for our whole stay. Apart from the place being exactly what was described, Keren was always helpful and responsive if we had any questions. It is also only a quick stroll from the subway to Manhattan, which was great. Would highly recommend staying here ❤️
Great place to stay!!

the place felt just like a home away from home. it was beautiful decor, very clean & had all amenities needed. the pictures didn't do it justice. it was a 15 minute walk from the train station, quiet area, very safe and check in was easy. definitely would return!

Our family loved staying here for the week! The 1 train is super convenient and right near the apartment. Fabulous surroundings and the artist loft was perfect for us. Spacious and lovely! Massive thank you for hosting us!
Love from New Zealand,

It was cozy and the location was so good. Great neighborhood. Host was also very kind and we had very pleasant conversations. Highly recommend.
Great place to stay, comfortable and quiet. Easy access to all the subway system to travel within NYC.

Wow is a home away from home, Grey was super friendly and quick to help .Our stay was heavenly and we felt like we are home. Upon everything we came to do in the city, we will always remember your hospitality and your spotless apartment.

We have stayed in 5 different places in the neighborhood in the past 3 months and this was by far the best! The location is perfect, the apartment spacious and well designed and James was the perfect host - - attentive when needed invisible when not.

A nice place to stay in NY central area. The staffs were very welcoming and the environment was good.

It is a spacious, clean room, it has a good desk and good internet connection, the bathroom is very clean, Qing responds very quickly and is very kind, a good place to stay even for several nights.

L’appartement est idéalement situé, à côté de Time Square, Briant Park… on est vraiment au milieu de Manhattan. L’appartement correspond tout à fait à la description ; assez spacieux, à l’aise pour manger ou se poser au salon. Thérèsa a été très réactive et arrangeante et nous l’en remercions.

Thank you for an excellent stay - the place was amazing and so much room and comfort. Loved the setup of the place and the back patio was so nice. Loved that it was so close to stores and the subway.

Apartment was as advertised. Closest subway was just 2 blocks away. So many restaurants within walking distance. Just a 10-minute walk to Central Park. The unit was clean. If I ever had a question, they always responded promptly. Couldn’t have asked for a better place to stay, hassle-free and smooth stay overall. Thank you for hosting us!

We're from NYC but this still felt more like a getaway than a staycation. Beautful house, easy to get to. We enjoyed the beach and boardwalk, even in the winter. Veronica was super prompt with her communications, and very accommodating. We'd definitely visit again.
Jenni’s place is so stylish, cozy and relaxing. Beautiful apt and neighborhood - would highly recommend!

This place was fantastic. Large bedroom and separate living room area with TV and netflix hookup. Full sized fridge and stove which came in very handy. The unit was clean and conveniently located. Great shower too -solid water pressure and it gets hot quick.

He was an excellent host. He responded to any questions we had really fast and made check-in and check-out super easy. He also set us up with good contacts for cabbing, local grocery & coffee shops, as well as sites to check out while we were visiting the city.

I would definitely recommend this unit, if you're visiting New York.

Our stay at this apartment was overall very good. The location was a bit far from things to do but the area was walkable and there was a subway stop close by so it wasn’t a big deal. The apartment was as described and was a good escape from the hectic nature of the city. However, there’s one thing that wasn’t that great about our stay: the apartment had a very large amount of ants in it. We killed a lot of ants throughout our stay - I think I killed around 25 during our two nights there and my partner killed more. I would suggest ant traps be put out to combat this. I know it’s in the city and it was the summer but it still was a little much. Overall, nice place and we had a great time but still, something to consider.

A little clutter, but super cute and clean with plenty of toiletries provided! AC in the room was amazing and the bed was comfortable. Great hotel and location.  Onsite amenities were great.

Great location, amenities are above and beyond. Super clean. Stay here!

Not a place I would recommend. The common area was messy, and looked lived in with many personal items lying around, as well as a messy kitchen area, trash overflowing and on countertops. I was happy with the space, the queen size bed (quite comfy) and the bathroom.  I was traveling by myself and not spending time there except to sleep and shower.  Isabel has a great spot, a great value, and it worked very well for me.

Will stay again, close to subway, nice place, nice host!

The last week I lived there, I was woken by their screaming at 3/4am which carried on till 6 am on multiple days.  On my last day, the police came and tried to get the woman out of the apartment but she wouldn’t move.  Once, someone slept in the corridor. It’s not the cleanest place, saw roaches but I guess that’s NYC (?). Also smelled really bad, maybe due to the pipes or the AC. The super was helpful when talking to in person and had good advice but definitely call him, that way he responds. If you’re staying there short term and only want a place to sleep it’s ok, otherwise find somewhere else.

The place itself was nice and located in a beautiful area, which we really appreciated. However, we encountered a few issues during our stay.
