New York was very hot during our visit, and returning to an uncooled apartment was especially difficult, particularly with a pregnant woman in our group. My sister had to stay elsewhere because she was not able to handle the heat.

good location, clean - had no issues with check-in. would stay again, thanks!

We had a wonderful time staying at Brian’s place! Great location, clean, and awesome AC to keep us cool during the summer. Would stay here again!

Firstly, our room was smaller than the photos and no natural light. We had no house keeping for an entire week, despite other rooms being cleaned. Awesome place and great value. Saved a lot of money

Logement tout équipé, très bien pour longue durée, grande chambre pour ma part et hôte très réactif ! Le logement contient 9 chambres mais vous ne serez pas embêté par vos colocataires . Prévoyez des plats rapide à réchauffer au micro-onde pour vos dîners.

Super séjour ;)

Danny's place was perfect for us in every way - it's large, clean, and flexible space in the middle of a great neighborhood. His team is friendly and accommodating! We'll definitely be back if they'll have us!

It was clear the owners had done their own renovations. The shower was gross. One of the towels was dirty. Michelle didn’t respond at all when I asked for a second set of keys, so I wasn’t able to keep the plans I’d made. It was ok but I wouldn’t want to stay there again.
Oscar is a great host and a very cool artist to talk to.
We would absolutely stay again!!! Erik is wonderful, and the place is very NYC.  Amazing time!  2 minutes from Central park north and the subway!

This place was perfect, clean and just as pictured. Host was very responsive and took great care of us during our stay, anything we needed they took care of. You can’t beat the location, right in the heart of everything. Will definitely book again!
Great spot. Very Central. Close to High st line. Would recommend for 3 couples.

Benjamin’s place was well appointed, clean, and as advertised.  He communicated well, was very responsive, and the few minor issues that came up during my stay were addressed immediately.  I’d gladly stay again, and highly recommend the apartment and management team.
Great and cosy crib. Subway are conveniently accessible. Antonio is a very helpful and informative host. Definitely a recommended place if you are in brooklyn.

Our stay at Caras place was fantastic, the communication was great and her hospitality was warm and genuine. The room was perfect for our stay the area was close to transport and many restaurants and bars. We had some reservations about sharing someone’s house but Cara was great , gave us our own space but very helpful when needed. We would happily recommend Caras place to anyone visiting NewYork . Cheers Brett and Andrea.
The location is very convenient and easily accessible. The hotel itself is a gallery, elegantly decorated. I especially like their coffee and pastries in the morning:)
great area great spot and jasmine was very helpful
Lovely place. Even though it was basement level, When you went inside it was real cozy. She was very helpful and assisted  in any way she could. A very great host indeed.

Great location - on the highway 95 in just a few minutes.... Shopping nearby ....
Appreciated the water and coffee you had for us at check in. The apartment was spotless! Plenty of towels !! The linens and beds were so comfortable I didn't want to leave.

This place convenient for just to sleep. Also, They provide a nice healthy breakfast and snacks.

Edgar was a great host! Super knowledgeable, kind, and very hospitable!!! had a wonderful stay! Had great recommendations too and was very flexible :)
Thank you! Red Hook and your place will stay on my NY list.
Great Airbnb! Renovated and very clean. Cam stocked with utilities such as toiletries and kitchen essentials. I never write reviews but this place I’d definitely return to.

We stayed two months at James & Lisa’s home and it’s a great launchpad for Brooklyn & Manhattan living. We felt totally comfortable, safe, and happy in the neighborhood and home. It was a refuge for hot summer days, and there’s great food and coffee nearby for remote workers (also good Wi-Fi). Highly recommend this home!

Travis has a very nice place in a great location. I only had a few questions and he was very responsive and helpful. The area is very pretty lots of restaurants within walking distance great place to walk doggies   we would love to come back sometime!
Excellent place to stay. Near two of NYC's most iconic landmarks, Central Park and Times Square at a reasonable price. I will DEFINITELY be staying here the next time I'm in NYC.
Kin’s flat is a good stay with nice updated finishes and good privacy. The neighborhood is amazing.

The bed is super comfortable, the apartment is a fun experience, the location has a really cool vibe, and Micheal is really accommodating, communicative, and tries to help you get the most out of your stay in NYC.  I wish I had more time.

Brenda is a very friendly and helpful person. We had a rather delayed flight which meant we checked in late in the evening, which was no problem at all.
The flat was not usually warm and safe, the area was also quiet and the neighbours were polite.
As for the flat itself, it is as pictured and even bigger, very comfortable beds in each bedroom, which is very important, a fully equipped kitchen, extra bedding, plus plenty of supplies if one wanted to cook in the kitchen. In the bathrooms you will find bath lotions, shampoos, air fresheners.
Our rating from 1 to 10 is 10+
We were also able to check out later and the flat was also very clean.
There are lots of shops in the area, the underground is 5 minutes from the house, if you want to exchange money you can do so safely at the shop next to the Ralph Avenue underground entrance, and you will find a great grocery shop between the underground and the church. THANK YOU Brenda !
Very understanding and helpful.
Great place to stay for a couple days in NYC. Family of 5 was able to comfortably fit in this space but we did not spend a lot of time in the room except to sleep. Thanks!

Great place! I would stay here again or recommend it to a friend for sure.  Everything was comfortable, the owners were very accommodating and just cool in general, and it's pretty close to the subway.

Quiet neighborhood and great host  communication, small room, Small bathroom, stairs to get into the Airbnb, no AC in the room but AC in the common area. Had a wonderful stay! Exactly the kind if place I want to stay in NY. Great location, the room was large and surprisingly quiet for NYC. Extra bonus was Zelda the cat:)

Staying in this apartment made my trip a better experience. It’s a very warm a comfortable place to stay in. Surrounded by great places to eat, the neighborhood is quiet and has an easy access. It’s really easy to travel other parts of the city by any transport means.

Perfekt für einen New York Trip. Subway in der Nähe mit super Anbindung nach Manhatten. Zimmer sauber, Küche super eingerichtet und es gibt auch die Möglichkeit für kleines Geld etwas zu erwerben. Bett sehr bequem, Klimatisierung funktioniert ohne Probleme. Die Kommunikation war spitze mit Zuleide, immer gerne wieder.

The place was perfect for 4 young ladies traveling.   Train was close and the hosts were perfect.  The hosts were perfect- quick communication, accommodating, and empathetic to our situation.   I would definitely stay again!

Great location to get around the city. Great amount of space for the city.
Anibal is a wonderful host, anticipates any accommodations and was very responsive. He was too kind! Would definitely visit with him again in the future.
Overall great pick for a weekend getaway. Loved the location!

Ruby's place was lovely, really well located, clean, safe, with all the amenities. In a quiet Hasidic neighborhood  just bordering more central Brooklyn spots. And Ruby and Daniel were extremely kind and attentive and cared for us from beginning to end; we had a great experience here and would definitely stay again!
Great communication and very nice space.
I had a great stay for a quick trip to NYC. Tammie was a great host and the room was lovely with an extremely comfortable bed which was perfect after a long day of walking around the city!

Joseph’s place was great for our family. The apartment is in a great location near greenpoint and Williamsburg, with tons of food and activity options nearby. The apartment had everything we needed. The G train is around the corner and the L train within walking distance. The apartment is a one bedroom, with another bed located in the living room. The living room door can be closed, to make that another private sleeping space. Most important to me, the apartment was clean!
Very easy check in/out, great place for the money!
It's great to stay in NYC.

Отличный вариант размещения в Бруклине, буквально в пяти шагах от станции метро Ave U (F), в трех остановках от Coney Island, можно дойти и пешком. you can look for it to having a peaceful and private stay. as well as a good location to relax yourself.
Cristine and her husband were great hosts. The house was in an ideal location for my trip to NYC, and the accomodations in the room were perfect.

Great location and plenty of room for a large group which is hard to accommodate in an area like NYC, Brooklyn.   Property manger was very responsive and available to answer questions.  Clean and we felt safe in the area, so close to Barclay center!

With delightful and caring hosts, this is the place to be for a couple staying in Cobble Hill, Brooklyn.  Spacious bedroom studio unit perfectly located near both Atlantic Avenue eateries, Columbia St. Waterfront and bike path in Brooklyn Bridge Park.
Great place to stay. Cozy and warm enough for the cold days! It is close to the 95th bay ridge train station and it has convenient stores nearby. Great host and very responsive.

Ale was an amazing host for my me and my partner! We spent three months at Ale’s place and if we needed anything Ale was right there to help us out. Not only is it a short walk to the subway but the area is diverse and accepting. I always felt safe and comfortable during my stay.
There is not a washer and dryer in the apartment but there are many affordable options for doing your laundry around, my favorite was the Clean Rite Center just a 20 min. walk away.
Not to mention there is the cutest neighborhood cat that hangs around outside. The cat was always there to welcome us when we came home and is a friendly girl owned by the neighbors.
I will definitely be booking with Ale when I make my way back to the Brooklyn/Queens area!
Great place and host!
Patrick was great he was thoughtful and I would def. Come back again.
Really nice stay, convenient location

Our stay was awesome! Herman was extremely attentive & accommodating. The apartment was beautifully decorated & has a cozy “home” like aura. Great over all experience. We would absolutely stay here again.

One our favorite stays ever ! Perfectly located and beautifully furnished with everything you need for a great stay. Sara and Fabien could not have been nicer - and communicated clearly and promptly throughout our stay. The huge space is bright and cheery and we hated to leave. We’d love to return. Very highly recommended!

I would have liked to inspect the area before requiring to pay and get the acceptance from the host.
The heating in the room was not working and took a while to fix.
The TV has no antenna for the network channels and thus, no reception. Antennas cost about $25 to install for free reception.
A water cooler in the apartment would be a nice feature freeing space in the refrigerator, even if the customer can pay for the water bottles instead of buying water every so often..
The Netflix program required updates every two weeks requiring connections and codes. The personnel came on time to fix it, but it was annoying nevertheless .
Overall there was a prompt and attentive service from the staff and hosts.
Thank you

My daughter and I are in between apartment moves, and our temporary housing with Liz was our first AirBNB experience. She and her daughter are wonderful hosts, the apartment is very nice, so we had a very positive experience. Now I feel a lot more comfortable staying with new people while in NYC or on future vacations. I'm even considering being an AirBNB host when we're settled in at our new place.

My husband and I had a wonderful 6 week stay at Perry’s apartment in the West Village. You couldn’t ask for a more central location and, although the apartment is quite small, it’s laid out very well. I especially appreciated the container store elf’s system in the closet that made it easy to store everything we brought with us.
One thing to note: the windows are thin and there’s definitely some street noise. This is to be expected for New York, but I’d recommend buying a cheap white noise machine if you’re a light sleeper. (We got especially unlucky with some intense construction for the duration of our stay. They were ripping up the streets right outside the unit.)
Still, the stay was lovely! Communication with Perry was easy and we had everything we needed to enjoy our time in New York. If you don’t mind a little noise and want to be in the absolute heart of the west village, this is a perfect option.

my partner is reluctant to share a home/bathroom with anyone.   sandra made us feel welcome and his reluctance was greatly reduced.   sandra was very responsive - even accommodating us allowing us to keep our window open for cooler temps.   her locating was very close to our kiddos house - all walkable.  we recommend sandra without hesitation!

Good base for exploring Williamsburg and Bushwick on foot, but also well connected to the subway. The traffic noise from the intersection, as transparently described by Sigfus in his ad, is actually immense, but as a big city guy it didn't bother me (and I didn't need earplugs). I had beautiful, eventful days. Thank you, Sigfus
Anderson was a very nice and helpful host. Although the room was small, it was functional and adequate. There's also a cute cat to cheer you up, Oscar.

The place was really comfortable, clean, and the host very responsive! It was just a shame that cars kept passing the whole night and early morning with very loud music making it hard to have a relaxing night despite wearing earplugs.

We have had a very good time in NY. The appartment is clean ans completely aligned with the description, its location is perfect to enjoy NY and Williamsburg at it’s best ! Cathy was very reactive when we had questions and found solutions to all of our requests.
It was a divine stay
From start to finish, everything was fine and exactly as described. Super friendly host and caring to make the visit as comfortable as possible! Thank you very much! Would recommend!
Terrific location and spotlessly clean. Cute hideaway with a very responsive host. And where else in NYC do you have a private patio?

This place is certainly a hostel but well maintained and in a great location. Staff on the check in desks and maintaining the hostel were very friendly. Location amazing, very close to Penn Station and Madison Square Garden and easy to find. Overall very good if you want a cheaper stay in NYC (still not that cheap but cheap for the area).
Quiet and super convenient spot for visiting Bed Stuy!

Super nice and cozy apartment! Very good location! Great host! Rented this place for my dad who came to visit me from overseas. Both me and my dad were very happy about this apartment.  No issues or concerns. Will definitely recommend. Thanks Alex.
Good location and very responsive host.

I will start with the positives. The hotel felt safe and there were lots of shops and stores within walking distance. That is where the positivity ends. This listing is false and misleading. Our room ended up having a queen bed instead of a king. As it states, the room is subject to availability which is understandable as it is a hotel. If a king was requested and there were none available that would be one thing. However, the host did not request a king bed and instead requested a queen bed from the beginning. This was verified by the hotel front desk. When trying to reach the co-host to clear up the confusion, there was no answer. Several calls were made over 2 days and we never heard from the co-host. If you enjoy being scammed, crammed in a smaller bed than listed, and paying more money to get less then this listing is for you!
Very close to Central Park and Times Square

My sister and I had a wonderful stay at Daniela’s place. Her place was easy to find and in a beautiful and quiet neighbourhood. The place was exactly as shown in the pictures, easy to check in, had all the amenities and was very clean. Daniela was very accommodating, approachable and friendly. We had really good conversations with her and would love to stay here again if we come back to the city.
I really enjoyed my stay here to the point that I extended it 3 times. The staff responds to any message under an hour. Very clean room and bath.
Fifi's place is very well located and comfy, it's better than expected and the location is perfect. We had a great stay. I recommend it. Thanks
If your looking for a nice and quplace to stay this is definitely the place to stay the host is welcoming and kind

Great location in Midtown, making it possible to walk to Downtown as well as Central Park and beyond. The hosts were great in communicating before our arrival, so we had no doubts and no questions. They are very organised and had thought of everything. The apartment is on 2 levels and feels like one's own townhouse. The apartment is actually lived in, so it does not come across like a specially established Airbnb apartment. We found that very inviting. We could find an interesting book to read, great selections of tools in the kitchen, so it felt like home. For NY, which is generally extremely noisy, the noise level in the apartment was acceptable, but if one is used to sleep in a very quite neighbourhood, the street noise could create a sleeping problem. Note that the mattress in the main bedroom seems to be of memory foam, and that is a hate or love relationship as far as I have heard. The heating system cannot be regulated, and it was too hot at times for us. We had a fantastic time

Great place for the price and location! Only a couple minor issues, the A/C was covered by the bed so it wasn't the most effective, and there were some excessive fees ($500 if you clog the toilet, which wasn't an issue for us but still excessive regardless). Other than that, I would recommend it if you're trying to stay in a prime location at a reasonable price.
Es un lugar limpio y bonito, igual a las fotos, no muy cerca de lo que normalmente se va a hacer a nueva york, no hay muchas cosas cerca, pero es un lugar lindo

This stay was perfect for me! I was a female solo traveler, so the accommodations were just what I needed. The bathroom is small but gets the job done! Bed was comfortable. Would stay again if my travels took me back to that area! Enjoyed it!
Clean house, close to the bus to get to Manhattan, looks like the photos.
I love the Airbnb everything was nice and clean the only thing is that it was very cold in the bathroom and the hallway. The communication with the host was exceptional
Small apartment, friendly and helpful host, convenient location.
Nice place. We reallly want to come back one day
The apartment was very close to JFK, super cozy, clean and we felt right at home. Dean was super responsive and a great host. We loved it and would be happy to come back
Nice place to stay, 45 minutes on subway to manhattan, 1 hr to coney island, around 40 minutes on uber or lift.Would recommend.

Carlos’ place was exactly what we needed, and is in a quaint area of Astoria. A little further from the hustle and bustle than we had expected but a quick Lyft or Uber away. The bus stop isn’t too far either, we just had the inconvenience of rain. Would stay again if I was in the area, and we loved seeing their four-legged pal Bruno!

We had a great stay at Mel's place. It was nice to find a place that wasnt an hour ride outside NYC proper. The neighborhood was fun and the food in the neighborhood was delicious (try Bodega City!). Communication was great and the instructions were very easy. Would definitely consider again and despite having 1 bathroom we were fine with a family of 7 (4 men, 3 women). I would def recommend, great place!

Host molto disponibile e sempre reperibile. Riceve personalmente al check-in. Posizione perfetta vicino al central park, al moma e a time Square. Metro all' angolo. Market sempre aperto accanto al portone.
It was okay. A little small.

We really enjoyed staying in Ivan's place. It's a great location on a quiet block but convenient to the park, subway and lot's of great Park Slope restaurants. It was very roomy and comfortable for a weekend getaway for two. I can't tell you too much about Ivan as a host - and that is meant as a compliment. The apartment was well furnished and equipped and instructions for entry, tv, etc. were clear and accurate so we never needed to contact him with questions during our stay. If you are looking for a place to stay in Brooklyn, you can't go wrong here.
Nice, clean space in a good location. No complaints!

My stay here was great! Easy to find and right by the metro.
Very clean and spacious! Would definitely stay again when I am back in NYC!
Great spot for the $$$ and location. Would recommend bringing a sleep mask/earbuds, a lot of light/noise gets into the sleeping area.

Hanchung's apartment is an elegant brownstone conveniently located near the subway. He was very hospitable, and I enjoyed our conversations. The apartment has a good amount of space for a New York apartment and is very clean. The bed was really comfortable. This is a good choice for a stay, especially if you're on a budget. Thanks, Hanchung!
John is really friendly and accommodating.  And his place is very nice, clean and comfortable.

I recently stayed at an Airbnb in Jose's apartment and it was an amazing experience! Jose was incredibly welcoming and made sure that I had everything I needed during my stay. The apartment itself had all the amenities I could ask for. The location was also perfect - it was in a quiet residential area but still very close to all the subway that I can travel to the central area.
Jose was very helpful in providing recommendations for things to do and see in New York. He was always available to answer any questions I had, and made me feel right at home.
Overall, I had a fantastic stay at this Airbnb and would highly recommend it to anyone visiting New York. The apartment was comfortable and well-equipped, the location was perfect, and the host was incredibly friendly and helpful. Thank you, Jose, for making my stay in New York such a memorable one!

Thank you Vibe for going above and beyond to make my stay as seem less and convenient as possible. I was very impressed by the responsiveness and timely updates on my requests. I loved the location of this property! It was safe, conveniently located next to major subway and bus lines and in a trendy neighborhood within walking distance to Central Park. The apartment was very large for a studio, with tons of storage! It is an old apartment with creaky floors, boilers and other fixtures inside but this is what adds character while staying in the heart of Manhattan. The updates done were nice, internet and TV with Roku were a plus and the bed was very comfortable. Overall this property is accurately described, with a great host, and great value for what you are getting. I will definitely stay with and recommend renting from Vibe again. Thank you!
The apartment was beautiful, private, and in a nice neighborhood. Spacious, beautiful historic feeling home. Loved the bathroom and tub. Wish I could have stayed for longer.

This place is amazing! The room and entire home are super clean and Esteban and his wife are so incredibly kind. They were super flexible with my last minute booking and went out of their way to accommodate me. Breakfast in the morning was homemade and delicious. Would definitely recommend this place to anyone!

Great host. Really helpful and friendly.
The room was clean and comfy.
I highly recommend.

The apartment is very cozy and furnishing is tasteful. It has everything you might need during your stay. The location of the apartment is also perfect. Edgar was a great host and I'd love to stay there again one day.

My girlfriend and I spent 4 night at this place and it was great! It is like a complete independent studio, very clean, very nice, great!
The host let us a lot of privacy but she was also really kind and open to share suggestions with us (by the way she also own a very nice cafe not too far from the place). The subway stop to go to Manhattan it is at a walkable distance. I am sure that if I will be back to NYC I will ask Dee if she can host me again!

This house is beautiful! The room was huge, everything was clean and the bed was comfortable. The bathroom is in the hallway and it is super pretty also! A lot of privacy since I think the whole level is guests and the owner is in another part of the house. This is probably the nicest Airbnb in the US I’ve stayed in!
Had a another great stay. Linda makes you feel very welcome and at home. Room is spacious and clean. Location close to public transport and in walking distance to CitiField. Top marks!

Great location; convenient to everything. And the place really does have an ocean view! Maybe 30 seconds from the beach. Very spacious, clean, easy to get in and out. Host is very available and helpful!

Great little apartment in New York, so close to everything near Times Square and only a walk away from a subway to other areas. Good value for the city. Safer area than some. Once you’re okay wearing earplugs to sleep, it’s a great spot for New York.
Ryan’s place is totally amazing and has a perfect location.  The home was very clean and Ryan was very responsive!  I would stay again!  Thanks!

Muy buen lugar donde hospedarse, es tal cual se muestra en los anuncios. Daniel es un excelente anfitrión. Cercana al metro, por lo que puedes movilizarte fácilmente. Estuvimos 6 días y realmente no tuvimos problemas.

Loved loved loved staying here! We needed a last minute place to stay and this was the perfect spot. Easy to check in, very clean, and I felt super safe here with my husband! Not worth 350 $ per night. Maybe 200$

Pearl's  place is at a perfect location, very easy to get around with public transportation.

I've stayed there for a month and I totally recommend it.

Très bon acceuil ! Adrianne pense à tout. Quartier avec quelques bars et restaurants. Malheureusement, comme dans de nombreuses grandes villes, un bloc plus loin et on change d'ambiance. Situé à 200m du station de métro (ligne 2 et 3 rouge) très safe (comme tout le metro de NYC).

It’s worth it

Being my first air bnb experience, this was easy and affordable. I did not actually speak to Eliza personally but the hotel lobby was friendly and helpful for the most part. The room was perfect - spacious, clean, and relatively quiet for Manhattan.
Parking was difficult, listing says the Lombardy has parking but it was hard to find. We looked at the Lombardy website and it just says self parking “off-site” but doesn’t have an address. We called the lobby to ask about it and they also said “off-site” but couldn’t give us an address. Don’t count on parking, we ended up having to find something else.

This apartment was fantastic during our stay in New York. It’s really close to plenty of subway stations, in a spot that feels safe even if you’re coming back late. The room itself was comfortable, and the private bathroom was a massive bonus - it was stocked with plenty of toiletries and fresh towels when we arrived.
I’d 100% recommend, thank you for the hospitality Kandi!

Vanessa’s place was great. It’s like 20 mins outside of the city center, but literally one block from the “1” train. Neighborhood is quite safe. The room is tiny, but importantly, it was immaculate. Bathroom was super clean too. Bed was very comfortable, Wi-Fi was reliable, and there’s a giant television in the room. The blanket was thin but surprisingly kept me super warm. And she’s quick to respond. I definitely recommend.
Super location and easy working with this host.  A good choice for small families.

We stayed here for 10 days. The B15 bus took us directly from JFK Terminal to the apartment (65 min ride), Metro to downtown is about 25 minutes. Bathroom, kitchen and living room very clean and cozy. TV with Netflix and great WiFi. The apartment fits 6 people, however we had enough privacy. You can see the NYC skyline from your bed. The area is not a typical tourist area but safe and calm. The neighborhood seems nice, but we haven't seen too much of it. Lots of churches, temples and schools. Worth to explore it a little more next time.
Jessica and Wesly do not live at the place but responded always very quickly and were caring hosts. We would definetly stay here again!

We had a lovely stay at Ryan’s home in Williamsburg. Ryan was excellent to communicate with and allowed us to drop our bags off before check-in when I requested it with rather short notice. The weather was chilly and his home was worm and comfortable. We were thankful to have the use of the stroller at the bnb for our 6 month old. The beds were comfortable and the whole apt has a pleasant aesthetic that makes you feel like you are in a home and not a hotel. The maps and the info pack provided were extremely helpful. The plumbing is a bit old and delicate but wife was fast.
Thanks Ryan!
Really nice old house. Tanya is a really nice person which is always there to help! Great experience!
Great host, great place. Would love staying there again

Quiet spot which can be very hard to come by in NYC. Doormen are very friendly and helpful. The  apartment is cozy with most everything you need for your stay. Convenient location to get to the train, restaurants, and anything else you might want to do in NYC
Very nice clean place.

The apt is comfortable and clean .  In the morning you will wake up with the sounds of the household. It did not bother us because we woke up at the same time but it might bother late sleepers. I recommend this place and would stay here again.
Great stay for my family of 5 - highly recommend!
They were great to work with.  We’d stay here again.
First time to NY and it was amazing.  This was centeally located for us to go everywhere we wanted.  The residence was clean and neighbors were friendly.
B's place was very nice, clean and cozy.. It's only a few blocks from the subway. Safe area. B was helpful and friendly. Would definitely stay there again.
Great stay. The apartment is very spacious and clean!
nice place and enjoyed the stay.  Steps were a bit much.
Brilliant stay and great hosts. Would stay again.
Great stay, easy to find and great communication! Thanks for everything.

Doris’ Apartment is a gem, beautifully decorated with attention paid to details. Located in historic Harlem within easy walking distance of bus and subway, M2 to 5th Ave museums and 125 st. Subway for the A train to lower Manhattan.
I want to give Doris a shout out for the wonderful library of books on NYC, Harlem, Boston, architecture, Beetles, Yankees and also poetry. There are 50 well selected books in this apartment. You don’t have to go anywhere!
Doris is extremely accommodating and gracious. Stay here and you will have the perfect place.

Wayne est un super hôte ! La chambre est confortable et correspond parfaitement avec l'annonce. Le petit déjeuner du samedi matin était très sympathique. Proche de toutes les commodités nécessaires à un bon séjour ! On recommande !

This is the second time we’ve stayed in the apartment - we were there at Christmas but this time there was five of us, a treat for my partner’s mum as it was her 80th birthday.
And she loved the apartment as much as us. She had a great old time looking over Alan’s fabulous and eclectic mix of art, and was totally wowed by the massive main living room / kitchen / dining area as we were.
Everything was super clean, lots of nice touches, perfect location and NY was as fabulous as always.
Trying to think of anything to add to my previous review - I should emphasise the audio visual setup is the best I’ve ever encountered - and I’m a bit of an AV nerd... the sound especially is stunning from the Bose system and the tv setup absolutely top notch.
Looking forward to staying there again soon!

Emilie's place is great! It's just two blocks from the subway stop. There are lots of local eateries and groceries stores close by. Emilie was very communicative and quickly answered our questions. The apartment is small but very stylish and beautifully furnished. Not to mention the amenities of a small kitchen, washer/dryer, and french press made for a stay that felt like home. If you're looking for a place on the upper west side, I highly recommend this place.
Great stay, awesome host and very welcoming.

We loved our month long stay! We would have extended if it wasn’t booked up. The beautiful brownstone is on a gorgeous bedstuy street, short walk to the subways for easy access to manhattan and other parts of BK. The apartment is spacious and clean and well kept. High ceilings and big windows made the main room lovely. Olivia and Ruthven were lovely and attentive hosts. Highly recommend for anyone interested in Brooklyn brownstone living <3

We had a fantastic time at Indo’s place- the location was great and the space was incredible. Indo had thought of everything- the “little touches” to make it really feel like a home away from home were wonderful. We will definitely be back!
Good value place to stay if you need somewhere with quick access to downtown!

Tanya communicated effectively and set expectations properly. It was a smooth stay and a fantastic weekend in this spacious spot.

I live in Brooklyn, but discovered 6+ amazing spots within 5 minutes of Tanya's loft over the course of 2 days.

The accommodation had everything we needed for our one week stay.
Delores was a great host. From the communication to the comfort of the house, we were more than pleased with our stay.
Great location, clean and convenient. Plus super responsive and friendly staff.
Great deal, Agnes was super helpful and responsive! Had very clear and easy-to-follow expectations for guests, which made it easy to meet them. Gave directions and local recs too, which was great!

Cozy place with great access to public transportation. Communication with Noelle was extremely easy and proactive, pleasant, and everything that we requested was provided right away. A very smooth and comfortable stay. Thank you.
Uniquely designed room with all the necessary conveniences. Great communication and easy to get around. Lots of shops and restaurants in the neighborhood. Street parking wasn’t a problem.
Very convenient location! This is such a great deal. Majority black neighborhood if you care about that. Right next to little Haiti. Lovely kitchen and new washing machines.

Had a fantastic stay at Tim and Sophie's apartment and would highly recommend. Location is perfect for those commuting to Columbia University and the subway is a short walking distance away. The apartment is fully appointed with everything you need, has tons of daylight throughout the day, and the hosts were very communicative throughout my stay. I look forward to a future visit!

This was new part of Brooklyn for us to explore, and the place was a lovely haven for eating, sleeping and relaxing. Wonderful artful decor and well equipped kitchen. Nice bed and bedding, good lighting. There are many restaurants nearby and some good corner stores for fruit and breakfast supplies. The subway well place for getting around. We will come back. It felt like a home away from home!

Exactly as pictured, raymond and janine thought of everything. The kitchen had ample equipment to prepare meals or just snack. The bathroom was large enough and with a few doors left open during the day it was easy to cool the place off. The backyard space was where we spent a lot of our free time in the evening.
We had a great time staying here, amazing location and Jerrod was super responsive! Will definitely be staying here again next time I visit Brooklyn!

A good apartment. Close to the subway.
Good pizza joint nearby.
A bit loud but not a big deal. We had a lovely stay.
Maggie was a good host.
Clean, Professional, and accommodating.

Me and my fam thoroughly enjoyed our NYC trip with such a good place to stay. The host was quick in communication and very accommodative. We liked that the place was pretty close to the subways. Well equipped with amenities and proper spacious.
Highly recommend!
Gary's two apartments were fantastic and he could not have been more hospitable and helpful!

We hebben echt genoten van ons verblijf. De buurt was perfect. Zalige restaurantjes op wandelafstand. Je bent op een wip van Manhattan maar vooral veel rustiger en cosy!
Tonderai & family zijn hele gezellige hosts, altijd in voor een babbeltje en met heel veel goeie tips.

Vintage New York apartment. Joesph is a friendly host and graciously invites he guests to enjoy his home. The accomodations are as listed, and the shared bath spotless. The neighborhood surprisingly quiet. The apartment convenient to subway stations. I enjoyed my stay.

Justin’s suite is in a great location. We would definitely stay again.The suite was very clean and Justin was accessible and very helpful. Shower had great water pressure and air conditioner was very helpful.

Vivian and Michael are outstanding hosts and apartment is so spacious and comfortable! It has everything that I needed. Even the umbrellas!
The kitchen is fully equipped, living room is so spacious! The bed is super comfortable. Location is great! 125th of 1 line is just 2 minutes away. Juice bar, restaurants, park, Riverside church - all is in 2 min walk distance.
Pisticci restaurant was my grandma’s kitchen away from home.
Also good for Columbia students - 10-15 min walk to campus.
Very clean apartment and super close to the bus stop. Overall a great place for a quick stay.

I loved staying at this beautiful Park Slope location. So much that I booked my next trip with Anna while I was still there!! I highly recommend Anna’s place for anyone looking for quiet, clean, and comfortable lodging!!
The apartment is very conveniently located, clean, and comfortable. Crystal is a wonderful host. Highly recommend staying here!
Thank you Iqbal and the female receptionist during checkin. You were amazing
Thank you so much, your place is very nice, your home and people are so kind. I had a great time. The location is wonderful.
Nice place at a good cost, and only 40 minutes to Manhattan, park a midsized car in the enclosed driveway. We really enjoyed our short stay.
Lovely room in a gorgeous home, Diana is a great, communicative host and the nearby transport links are really handy for exploring both Brooklyn and Manhattan.

I really enjoyed staying at Jason’s place, kinda felt sad leaving !! The room and rest of the house is very clean, there’s everything what you need and Jason is an amazing host. We didn’t see each other much but we had nice talks and he’s very open to give help and suggestions. I felt at home and very welcomed! Thank you Jason, I hope to come back one day!!
Beautiful spot in Brooklyn. Very easy access to subway, food, bars, & even a couple of grocery stores. Owner was kind, attentive, and responsive.
Spacious and well-equipped for a long stay — and a wonderful, gracious host.

I wish there were six stars for every category.  A really stylish, tranquil space with lots of attention to detail and to a guest's every need.  Sarah expressed her willingness to help in any way but there wasn't a thing I needed.  A beautiful part of Park Slope.

The apartment is located in an absolut in area. Bars, Restaurants, fashionable stores, Whole Foods Market are in walking distance. The entrance to the subway is next to you. So you can be everywhere in Manhatten within 15 minutes. The apartment is very lovely and comfortable. Bathroom, King size bed, fridge and cooker in the kitchen. Even it is on the 2nd avenue, you won't hear the traffic.
I have enjoyed my stay in this apartment. When I am back in NYC, I definitely apply for this apartment.
It was a good and affordable place to stay. Close to the subway, that was very convenient
Overall very satisfied with my stay.
Great apartment in a great location - thanks Carla!
Amy’s place was very clean and spacious.  She and her husband were very friendly and helpful and responded promptly to questions or if we needed anything like toilet paper.
Absolutely fantastic place to stay, communication from the hosts was great.
Amazing location, clean and very well decorated! Would definitely stay here again! Only bad part was hauling the luggage up the flight of stairs but wouldn't stop be from booking again!
The staff was incredibly friendly, the room looked just like the pictures & it was extremely comfy.

Dorian is a very pleasant, friendly, helpful host.
The location is convenient for the Subway A Train, just round the corner. 40 minutes from there to World Trade Centre, 20 mins or so to Central Park, 5th Ave area.
It's a noisy (traffic, horns, sirens) area, but friendly. Mostly Spanish spoken round there.
Plenty of shops. Not far from the lovely Fort Tryon Park and the Cloisters.
I went downtown every day - I had no difficulty getting back.
Decent sized room. Good value.

Great hosts, very responsive👍 The house is very clean and the hosts are cleaning it twice a day.
Neighbourhood is a bit sketchy, but overall I would say that this airbnb has a good price-value-ratio.
Great location! Short walk to shops and parks. It was very clean.

Esteban was a fantastic host for our one night stay in New York. Breakfast was fantastic, room was clean and cold thanks to the AC, and the bathroom was spotless. I would 100% stay here again if I'm in New York in the future.

Alejandro was very communicative and easy to work with. Hard to beat the location of his place - just a few blocks from a metro and just a few stops away from Time Square. We loved staying there and it made our trip very convenient!

Meital and her husband Tzvi were very nice and accommodating. The place is as advertised. Very good location and very quiet. The hosts were very responsive with everything. You can get to Manhattan and Long Island very conveniently from the place. Good food options around as well.

This apartment was the perfect place for my parents during a visit to their granddaughter. Kevin is an absolutely wonderful host. He goes out of his way to make sure the stay is going well. My parents would definitely want to stay here again and we could enthusiastically recommend it to anyone looking for a visit to the UWS of NYC. This place is great!

I recommend this place to any single person or couple to stay in the bx very cozy extremely clean neat tasteful decor big screen tv with cable and options to sign in to Netflix or amazon prime I will definitely be staying here again and spreading the word excellent host 👌🏾👍🏾👍🏾
the best place possible

I had a wonderful time, the place is great and very central.
Go with you eyes closed…
Great host. Good location. Clean place.
Nice and cozy place, near the subway and easy to access. If i go to New York again, i want to stay there again.
make sure to read everything before booking. I was mislead with the pictures that was provided other than that it was a great hotel

Milton hat uns vor der Tür empfangen und war super freundlich und von Anfang an hilfsbereit.Man ist in ein paar Minuten an der U-Bahn,die einen direkt zu den touristischen Hotspots bringt.Die Heizung ist öfter laut gewesen,was vor allem nachts etwas gestört hat aber mit Ohrstöpseln hat man davon nichts mehr mitbekommen.Die Wohnung ist klein aber sehr gemütlich und hat den NYC-Vibe und für 2 Personen reicht es vollkommen.Das Bett ist von der Größe her auch ausreichend und sehr bequem!
Wir haben öfter gekocht,die wichtigsten Kochutensilien waren vorhanden.Wir danken Milton sehr für den flexiblen Check in und Check out.
Small but cozy, we enjoyed our stay!

The apartment offers a truly relaxing stay. The decor is amazing and there were thoughtful touches throughout the entire place. It is a fully equipped apartment that had everything (and more) that I needed for my stay. There are many comfortable corners to relax or to work and D was responsive to my queries. Checking in and checking out was a breeze. Her husband was amazing and I suggest that when booking to take advantage of the pickup service offered from the airport.
One thing I really loved about the place was the balcony off the living room and the bedroom - it was very inviting and it’s the perfect place to enjoy a glass of wine at the end of the day.
I wholeheartedly recommend D’s place and am looking forward to returning.

So grateful to find Vida's place!
Maybe my favorite NYC stay yet! Beautiful quiet and cozy apartment in a great neighborhood near my friend's place. It was so rejuvenating to open the shades up and wake up slowly in the sunny bedroom but then step out on the quiet back patio in the mornings! Apartment was nice and warm while NYC itself was very very very cold during my stay. Super comfortable bed and great bathroom. Easiest walk over to the Subway ever on a calm residential street! Vida recommended a great coffee shop on the way to the A train just around the corner. (Rita & Maria's on Halsey).

Regina's place was just wonderful, just like Regina herself. The apartment is very clean and located in one of the best areas of NYC (my favorite). Regina is a very warm person who made us feel at home, served us coffee with chocolates in the morning and made sure we always had fresh water. I would not have wanted to stayed in another place in New York!
definitely a great place to stay

Great location with easy access to many subway lines, along with a farmers market in Union Square. The apartment was comfortable and spacious, exactly as described. And the balcony was perfect to sit out on after coming home from a long day of walking around. Communication was prompt and the videos were very helpful upon entering.  I will echo another review that the mattress on the pull out couch has seen better days; our son decided to just sleep on the couch itself and not use the pull out bed since the couch was far more comfy by itself. I do highly recommend staying here as it’s a 5 star stay for a couple.
Rory is a fantastic host!  He was always immediately responsive on text, and was flexible with our check out time.

I stayed at Kito’s place in Crown Heights for around a month, and had an amazing time. The place was spotless upon arrival and smelled nice. The bed was comfortable and I slept well throughout my entire stay. I absolutely fell in love with the neighborhood while I was there, Crown Heights is a gem. Food is affordable, there’s a laundromat on the same block, and TONS of bodegas that open late. And Kito is a great, responsive, and communicative host. I felt so safe and well taken care of staying there. I am going to miss “living” here so much. I would 100% book this place again without hesitation if I ever came back to NYC alone and it was available. Thank you for everything Kito!

Amelia’s place was of an exceptionally high standard. The place was kitted out with everything that a person would need on holiday and a lot more! She and Heze were very helpful and attentive to our requests. Amelia even contacted a cab service for us as one of the people in our group had to leave early. Nothing was too much trouble and we really felt at home.  I would be happy to recommend this Airbnb and would definitely stay there again.
Great place, great hosts, had a wonderfull time.

Lauren and Tim's Airbnb was one of the best Airbnbs we've stayed at to date! It's in a very nice location and is very close to the bus and train. Checking in was smooth and the hosts were always available to answer our questions and concerns. The place itself is very warm and cozy, sparkling clean, and has many impressive amenities (especially the entertainment options). Lauren and Tim are probably the kindest most generous hosts we've ever had. We really enjoyed our stay and highly recommend this Airbnb to everyone!

Buenas tardes... tratare de ser breve!!!
Ubicacion: impecable!!( 2 cuadras time square) no tiene precio!!!
Anfitrion: Claude, gran personal, servicial, trata de practicamente no estar en la casa para q uno no se sienta incomodo, te recomienda lugares para comer ytomar sin gastar tanto, sin obligacion te deja desayuno todos los dias para q te levantes con la mejor!!! Es un gran tipo!!!
Superrrrrrr recomendable!!!!! Ahh esta a 2 cuadras de subte.. ( te lleva a donde se te ocurra)
No lo duden, el lugar es lo de claude!!!
Great location and secure, clean room, i definitely  recommend this airbnb.

Appartement très bien placé pour se déplacer dans NYC. Équipement complet, nombreux accessoires de toilette, literie top, quartier calme. Hôte très réactif 🙏🙏🙏
Comme le mentionne un commentaire, il y a des travaux en face des fenêtres du fond, mais nous n’avons pas trouvé cela gênant.
Merci pour l’accueil !

Listing exceeded all of my expectations! Safe, quiet area and building. 4th floor walk up, which is not a problem for those who don’t physically need an elevator. Super close walk to many restaurants, shops, and train stations. Host is the most responsive host I’ve encountered with through Airbnb. Such great hospitality, willing to accommodate with any of your needs. We loved Sunnyside and will definitely be back to his place!
The space was very clean and conveniently located.

Nous avons passé un bon séjour!L'appartement est proche du métro pour rejoindre Manhattan facilement. Les hotes ont été super disponibles et aidant.
Le logement est parfait comme pied à terre pour visiter New York.
Quelques travaux de rafraîchissement seraient nécessaires mais ça reste un bon rapport qualité prix pour NYC.
Great location and host!

Objective evaluation: great location, very quiet and safe. Room as depicted, some nice perks from the host, Jefry. Pretty much as described. Got very useful insights and tips for the city, so useful for anybody unfamiliar with NYC.

Subjective evaluation: words alone cannot describe the incredible pleasure and connection I experienced during that stay. This experience was what makes Airbnb unique: the ability to connect with local people and become actual friends. Had some brilliant, fun and smart conversations that I enjoyed very much! As an overall experience I had nothing so far that could be compared to this unique stay.

For those who want to go beyond the functional stay this is definitely the place to be and get an extra dimension of the New York experience by meeting probably one of its kindest residents!
Great room in a nice apartment in a fantastic neighbourhood - recommend!
Max was a great host, always making sure I was satisfied
Olga was very nice to accommodate us on such short notice. Nice backyard. Close to the boats and very clean.

Wonderful stay at Michelle's private adjacent apartment. Very clean, airy, and homey. Everything one could ask for and more when staying at an Airbnb. All techy gadgets, air-conditioning, wonderful kitchen complete with dishwasher.
Very easy to use laundromat around the corner. Quiet street.
Highly recommended apartment.

My wife and three teenage kids found Nick’s place perfect for our stay in NYC.  Allan was also very helpful getting us checked in.  The place looks like the photos and is a good value.  It is very close to many restaurants and subway lines along with short walks to the Chelsea market and Highline.  The beds were very comfortable.  They had Shampoo, Conditioner and Body Wash which is nice because not all Airbnb’s have that available. Others mentioned it was up a few flights of stairs, but that wasn’t an issue for us.  Just got us our extra steps for the day.  Solid apartment, we would stay here again.
Great room with views of Manhattan. Kaitlyn's flat is very clean and super conveniently located. Communication was super. Really a gem! Thank you, Kaitlyn!

Awesome place. The window units in each bedroom could be a little bigger, but they worked. Quiet place. Easy in and out. Close to a lot, if not in walking distance, close to the subway. Easy check in, and out. Paid parking 2 blocks from the room. Great stay.

Their place was extremely spacious for the price, had all the amenities you will ever need to be comfortable. Conveniently located and only a 5-7 minute walk away from the Metro-North Railroad Marble Hill Stop and the NYC Subway 1 train stop at 225th Street. Also about a 10 minute walk from many restaurants, small strip mall, and walgreens.
The house is stocked with all essentials in the kitchen (fridge stocked with bottled water, toaster, coffee maker) and bathroom (extra towels, bedsheets, toiletries). If you ever need anything from the hosts, they are a text away and are more than accommodating. I would definitely stay here again!
They were the best! Super responsive, helpful and everything was as expected. The part that surprised me as a fellow nyc resident: the calm despite being in one of the best areas of Manhattan
Perfect spot for just one person you get your own room, in an apartment. Digi is a cool cat

Alicia's house is perfect if you need a place to sleep after a long day walking through the streets of New York city. The room is small but clean and the little bathroom gives you a lot of privacy. The house is in a safe neighborhood and is very close to the subway and the bus stop. Alicia and her husband are very kind people.

Honestly the BEST Airbnb I’ve stayed at. The location is the only issue, but you’re signing yourself up for that knowing it’s in Queens Village which is on the LIRR line so it is further out. It’s well worth the trip though, lots of goodies were included and her hospitality/communication was amazing. Definitely will be staying again!

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Roxanne’s  place. The pictures are accurate. We felt right at home and Roxanne added thoughtful welcome amenities. There is an excellent grocery store near by and some great places to eat on Tompkins Ave. we loved our stay at Roxanne’s and look forward to staying at her place the next time we are in NYC.
Really nice apartment in a quiet neighborhood. Well connected. Very easy to go to manhattan. I really enjoyed the garden.
Great location, beautiful loft, Mike was super helpful.
beautiful and trendy place in an awesome part of BK! perfect for a couple or a few friends!
Excelente lugar algo de ruido, pero lo Justo por la ubicación, la cama cómoda, faltaban algunas cosas destapa corchos! Dejamos uno nuevo. Muy bien todo. Gracias!
Great location, close to Prospect Park and transportation. Quite building, with doorman days and evenings.  Laurence is a very friendly host.

This is a hotel with a hostel vibe: there is a stack of toilet paper in the lobby in case you need it, and everything is well worn.  The view and light from the massive windows in the accessible bedroom are wonderful, and the 7th floor is high enough above the fray of Canal street to keep the noise reasonable. I found the bed comfortable but the towels are large rags.  Considering my options at the price point, I was very happy with the whole experience. Also there are so many subway lines nearby, and a quick walk to the fun of Chinatown, Tribeca, Soho and Nolita.
Benjamin’s place was fantastic! Great location. Super close to the subway stations, close to everything you need within walking distance! Also very clean and safe. Highly recommend!

Loved our stay here! This place is exactly how it is listed. The area is close to public transit, Whole Foods, and tons of restaurants in walking distance. This place was clean and had plenty of kitchen supplies for our use. Would 100% stay here again

Great apartment on the UWS! It was spacious (especially the bathroom for a NYC apartment), spotless, and updated. Not to mention, in a beautiful and safe area that’s a short walk from parks and the subway. It was peaceful – the perfect homebase for exploring the city!
Best apartment in NY I’ve stayed in for a while

Great host. Will definitely stay again. Quick responses and matched listing.
Great to have two bathrooms for 5 adults. Spacious for nyc apartment.
Lots of space. if you have bad knees - it’s a walk up 2 flights
STAY AWAY. MY CLOTHES ARE  STILL SMELLING OF SMIOKE. ITS BAD, STAYED ONE NIGHT, COULD BARELY BREATH AND STARTED COUGHING. COULDNT STAY FOR TWO NIGHTS. ITS BAD, REALLY BAD

We stayed at Joanna’s place after making last minute arrangements in the city for a funeral. Joanna was kind, respectful  and understanding of our situation. The property was very clean. Street parking was easy to find. Thank you Joanna.
This was a great stay. Well equipped apartment and in an ideal location!

Purtroppo è troppo rumorosa la stanza. L host non risponde . Ho iniziato a scriverle prima del mio viaggio e durante ma non ho mai ricevuto risposta . Credo se ne occupi un  agenzia e non un vero host . Davvero poco reattivi . Prezzo spropositato per il servizio
Yvonne's place was very nice and in a good neighborhood. It is less than 15 mins away from JFK which is perfect for people going to the airport at any time and the transit station is also close by.

Super hotel blízko JFK, čistý, vybavený, uschovali nám kufry po check outu.
Jen pozor na příjezd do 00:00, pokud máte plánovaný příjezd po půlnoci informujte hotel dopředu.

Very easy to communicate with and quickly solved any issues I had. The apartment is on the ground floor with no bars on the window which I didn’t find very safe, and the apartment is very noisy. Other than that the location is great and the studio is bigger than expected with everything you need.

It is a lovely place, you can get downtown manhattan easily although it does take sometime.  The shared bathroom does take  some getting used to if you are not used to having to share a bathroom but it is very clean.
Would definitely rent again !!!
Parking can be tricky but all in all a great place to stay.
Was great for a last minute trip.

Mari is great. It was easy to communicate. She is careful that everything is ok. Her apartment is my favorite, located I'm a very nice neighborhood, close to the park, close to restaurant, shops, and transport. Thanks Mari for hosting me
Beautiful affordable stay. Great for the parking deal!

Staying at Anna’s apartment was the dream Airbnb experience: looked exactly like the pictures, super close to the train/laundry/grocery/all the bars and restaurants & while the weather didn’t always cooperate, the back yard/garden was a huge perk as well. Thanks again Anna!

The apartment was perfect for a short stay for a family wedding in Brooklyn. It was well located and had everything we needed for our stay. The host was responsive leading up to and during our stay and was patient with our questions!

Great place. Clean and as advertised. Sonia is easy to communicate with and provided us with toiletries, clean towels, coffee and some snacks. The A/C is great and efficient (And so needed in August) Location is super close to the metro and 1 train gets you most places; it is a bit of a trek for sightseeing but we didn’t mind being on the train and it’s absolutely worth it at this price point.

Alicia's place is the perfect spot for an overnight stay if you're visiting Yankee Stadium! We were coming to town for the weekend/ 2 concerts and weren't sure where to stay, and I don't think I could've picked a better spot since it's just under a mile from the stadium. It was clean, stayed cool despite the Summer heat, and had everything and more than we could've needed for our weekend in the Bronx. Alicia was super responsive, incredibly friendly and helpful! She met us outside when we arrived and helped direct us to the free parking spot. She even had some menus in the kitchen drawer for local restaurants. I wish I had more reasons to come to NYC so we could stay here more, but we will definitely book Iris Place again if we come back!
Victoria was very responsive.  She was accommodating in our check in time. Apartment was clean and very close to everything. Would definitely recommend and stay here again.

We love location. We had 1 person coming with us unexpectedly, so Eduard helped us and we stayed in the same place. Place is very small,it says in description,  but very clean and has everything for cooking and having food. it is good to stay for sleeping, have breakfast and go explore NY. You can take train, 5 min walk, close to Times Square as well. Thank you so much, we loved it.
Super cute apartment with everything you need and an amazing location. Spotless, comfy and lots of natural light.  Absolutely recommend!

Great place to stay. Chito & Xavier were great hosts, any 'ask' was met with an expedient cheerful response.  The neighborhood is in walking distance to most major stores located on 125th St & subway stations. If they're available on my next trip to NYC, I'll definitely reach out.

I had a wonderful stay here! The apartment is right in the middle of everything – super central and walkable. You can easily reach supermarkets, shops, restaurants, and all the main spots in the city. The place looks exactly like the pictures, clean and comfortable. The hosts were very friendly, always reachable, and helped with everything I needed. Perfect choice if you want to explore the city – I’d definitely come back!

We spent a very enjoyable and comfortable Christmas week at Nicole’s lovely apartment. She had thoughtfully put up a tree and other decorations for us. We had lots of space and the apartment was well equipped. An easy walk to a local supermarket and Dunkin Donuts! Also easy to get subway into Manhattan.

My family and I stayed here to celebrate my 40th birthday and this spot is such a treat! Major plus is that it’s right next to the subway station so our trips into Manhattan were seamless. Great food spots around there as well as a great little grocery store. The kitchen was so nice that we did a substantial amount of cooking. Lots of natural light inside the house. Extremely comfortable beds, we got the best sleep! Hosts were responsive, kind and welcoming. I can’t wait to come back, loved this spot.
My brother got robbed in front of this air bnb please be very careful in this neighborhood. The lady told my brother he was going to get robbed the day before

Madison is an amazing host! She is sweet, helpful, and a very generous person. My friend and I had such a great time staying at her place. She made our visit very comforting, it felt like home. The location itself is perfect! It's a block away from the J-line, so commuting to and from the city is a breeze. I couldn't have asked for a better place to stay.
Madison is THE most helpful person ever! Any questions or concerns that you may have, she is more than willing to provide positive feedback and lend a helping hand when you need it. My friend's polaroid camera broke and Madison gave us glue and two different types of tape to fix it. She even suggested a camera store that repairs cameras and lends customers cameras to shoot for the day. Also, my last night in the city I forgot my glasses at a karaoke bar in Koreatown. I told her about it the next morning before I checked out and she offered to pick it up for me and mail it to me so I could enjoy my last hours in the city and not miss my flight. She is an excellent host and I highly recommend staying with her :)
We had a wonderful stay, she was at hand to welcome us and we felt at home.

Great stay, both the hosts were very attentive and communicated asap with me in regards to whatever I needed, space was very clean and super cute/comfortable, and I found that it was close to a ton of local spots, walking around and exploring was a breeze, would definitely recommend and stay again.
Amazing location. Clean, tidy, had everything you need to feel at home. Would definitely stay here time and again.
Tracey and Clevelands place was great! I found Cleveland always available. I'd strongly recommend this place

Excelente relação de custo X benefício.
Anfitrião bastante gentil e educado.

10/10, it is the place i feel comfortable when visiting new york. Val gave me clear instructions to the airbnb and very easy to find. Mel also hosted me well, very friendly :)
Overall airbnb is clean, and i slept very well during my stay
Amazing! Great location! Unit is exactly what is displayed no more no less!
Incredible stay in West Harlem! The place is incredibly spacious for a large group and a great deal. Host is super responsive and accommodating

I had a great stay at this Brooklyn BnB hosted by Derwin. The place is clean, modern, and exactly as pictured. Transportation is extremely convenient the bus stop is literally right in front of the house, and the train station is within easy walking distance. I drove into the city during my stay and had no issues finding street parking right next to the BnB, which is a huge plus for Brooklyn.
Safety-wise, this is hands down one of the safest BnBs I’ve stayed at, with the local precinct just about a minute away. Also, for anyone concerned by a previous review mentioning no microwave there is one; it’s just built into the kitchen island rather than being a traditional countertop unit.
Overall, a very comfortable, convenient, and secure stay. I’d definitely recommend it and would stay here again.

Great location, very close to Union Square. We felt really safe even at night. There are lots of subway lines but you can easily walk or bike.
The beds were comfy and the place was clean.
The only annoying part was the neighbour smoking. You can’t smell in the apartment but from the hallway it was really bad.
The host was friendly and quick to respond. Checkin instructions were really clear. Thank you!
Leecia war ein extrem freundlicher Vermieter. Die Wohnung war genau wie beschrieben und hat wirklich ein super Preis-Leistungsverhältnis! Ich würde gerne jederzeit wieder kommen.

Fantastic cozy space. Very walkable area to many great bars, and restaurants. The rooftop area was a total plus for me. Duery is always available to answer any questions. Very easy to communicate with.  Zero problems during my stay

Working with Annette was terrific.  She made the process very easy and effortless and helped us feel right at home.  The apartment was exactly as portrayed and in a fantastic neighborhood.  Highly recommended.
Wonderful location and perfect private garden apartment!
Happy with the accommodation, what you see is what you get.

the place is perfect about location.
the room was super clean and stylish. i really enjoyed the time there.

My daughter and I had a lovely week staying in Evelyn’s Airbnb.
We loved that it was so central to the Village and that just a few feet away were great coffee shops, deli’s and restaurants. Perfect space for the 2 of us. Evelyn was always around if we had a question. Cute Airbnb for sure. I would stay there again.

Definitely an awesome Airbnb that doesn’t break the bank but is well worth the money. Very clean and organized. You can definitely hear people upstairs but it’s not a problem, we weren’t in the apartment a lot anyway. Washer and dryer are great, within 10ish min walk to the subway. Close to downtown Brooklyn but not all the commotion. We had a wonderful stay! Definitely recommend!!

Great location. Right next to a main artery of Brooklyn, and the city is only a train ride away. The place was clean and spacious for a one bedroom apartment, and it had a fairly full dining&kitchen supplies. Bathroom was well maintained and clean which is always a big priority on my list. Overall, due to the nature of my stay, Vitaly's place made my time there very efficient and comfortable. I appreciate it, Vitaly!
Place was as descibed in the listing and host was very responsive to a question I had. Would likely stay again if I was in the area.

We had an excellent stay at Dominique's place. She and her husband were very responsive and made sure we had everything to be comfortable during our stay, their communication was excellent and they were very friendly while being completely respectful of our privacy.
The place is extremely clean and the location is great, very walkable, close to the subway and everything Park Slope has to offer. The kitchen was well equipped and allowed us to dine in with our child (please note if you have young kids: high counter chairs). I would recommend this place.

The best host !! The room is perfect for one person and Thaya is always kind and helpful with everything, she will give you lots of advice about the places to visit and also restaurants! Thanks again ❤️
Very nice appartment, great neighbourhood. We’ve really enjoyed our stay !
wonderful location, well-appointed studio, very kind staff, walkable neighborhood
Uma was a great host! We enjoyed our stay :)

Alles gut!
Nette, hilfsbereite hosts. Angenehme Gegend, viele Lokale in der Umgebung.
One of the best places i ever seen 💯

Nickolas is a wonderful, attentive, and very accommodating host. His apartment is located in the charming, vibrant East Harlem and is equipped with everything you need: a comfortable bed, a fully equipped kitchen, a private bathroom, and a cozy corner for watching TV.
From there, it's easy to get to Manhattan and Brooklyn by subway, as well as to Queens and the Bronx. I thoroughly enjoyed my stay with Nickolas and in East Harlem, and I will definitely be back!
Everything was perfect and as described, very quick to respond to our issues, highly recommend.
Everything as described, very close to the airport, the apartment is clean and cozy, the host provided timely and clear instructions and was friendly.

This place is amazing. Clean and well maintained.
Great area lots to do there.
Nice place. I would stay again

We really enjoyed our stay with Tucker and Steve. Clear communication from the start and friendly hosts. The apartment was clean and the bed was amazing! It's also very easy to go to Manhattan by metro.

This place is right in the heart of Manhattan. The oldest Macys is one block away. It is a quick walk to any of the subway lines. Lots of shopping and wonderful food right outside your building. In fact, the Korean corn dog place is just a few steps away (which was our fave). Since you are in Koreatown, you will be surrounded by awesome food and ALL of the bubble tea you can ask for. The staff at the front of the building were always polite. We had a wonderful time; be prepared to WALK A LOT and CLIMB tons of stairs. It was a wonderful place to crash at night after we were exhausted.
Great place to rest after a long day visiting. It was spacious and confortable.
James and Siobhan are lovely hosts! Super communicative and quick to respond to any questions or requests. The house is stunning and fit all 5 of us very comfortably. Thank you!!

Irina was an amazing host. The room looked exactly as the pictures. We got there super late and she woke up and moved her car for us to park and let us park in her driveway when needed. Best host ever is an understatement. We will definitely be revisiting here our next time in NY! Thanks for everything Irina!!❤️❤️

Absolutely recommended! Elma is a great host, very supportive and helpful and cool. she gave us great recommendations on a cool rooftop bar, helped organising transportation etc. Her house is nicely furnished, cozy and with her kids and friends around it has a lively atmosphere. Super comfortable bed!
Easy access from airport to here, or from here to Manhattan. At night, neighbors are quiet so easy to sleep.
Good place, clean and good communication.
Great stay in an historic building and old-vibe Brooklyn loft apartment!
Very hospitable staff and modest space. Recommend it for a short stay.

Worth every penny. One of the coolest apartments you’ll stay in. Very clean, good water pressure, and Nash was so sweet and kind w getting back to me.
His bed was incredibly comfy!!! A little bit of street noise, but pretty quiet in general for a NY apartment.
The roof was cool too, spent most days on the hammock enjoying views of the Hudson River. This apartment is def a gem, cool vibe, nice neighbors.
His roommate was barely ever home and when he was he was a pleasure to talk to, really sweet guy.
Honesty you can’t pick a better spot! Thank you Nash again!!
Perfect location & cutest little place. Super close to the train with walkable restaurants & bars nearby as well. We enjoyed the stay!

Evan was a great host. Both my daughter & I stayed for 9 nights and we were delighted with our decision to choose this apartment.
The apartment was well appointed, clean and in a great location.
Easily accessible to two subway options to transport to tourist areas. Don't forget to check out the local shops and restaurants in the area.
We highly recommend this property!
The room was really nice and it was easy to reach Manhatten by Metro. The communication with Liqin was good as well.
Very good response time to messages and good amount of space in the room

The room is clean and well furnished.  It is close to metro and rail. But the neighborhood is not that good. My family got scared of the streets. Furthermore checkin time is 4 pm.  My family had to idle around more than 2 hours in the dilapidated neighborhood with most shops closed on Christmas. And note that the apartment is on 3rd floor. You need to carry your luggages all along two stairs up.

I love Halley’s apartment. It’s a spacious bright apartment with creative details. I had everything I needed. This is a gem of a neighborhood, walkable and filled with charming local businesses. Highly recommend!

Mr. Mohammeds home was a great place to stay. It is clean, comfortable and near shopping and recreational places to visit. He is a great host along with his wife and daughters. I highly recommend staying here.
fairly friendly and helpful. would stay again

Nomad’s place was clean, neat and very central in location. The check in and check out process was also very simple..the only prob was the thin walls…if one uses the loo or the shower the walls are soo thin that the entire room becomes noisy…but the rest was fantastic…
Choi was a very amicable and communicative host who made sure we were comfortable in our stay. His space was also nice, spacious and quiet.
It was a cozy stay, really enjoyed the space. It felt well put together and comfortable.
great hosts and a great stay!
Thank you so much for everything Karen. Your home was clean and I felt like I was family. Thank you once again!

Sophia and Duda were great hosts.
I arrived to New York City a bit earlier than expected, but Duda was willing to accommodate my early arrival with no issue.
Location is close in proximity to 1 train and A, B, C, D trains. Also walking distance to M60 SBS if you’re commuting to/from LaGuardia. Around a 5ish minute walk to get to the Columbia University. I visited at a time when it was particularly hot in NYC so the AC in the room came in handy. Also very reliable WiFi that I used to do work throughout my entire stay.
It is pretty quiet and I had no issues sleeping at night. The bed was also very comfortable.
Very clean. Julio communicated thoroughly. Would stay here again. Generous to let us use washing machine and fridge.
We really enjoyed our stay here! Very cozy and great location. Walkable to west village  and all of Chelsea.
i loved this air bnb! i wish it came w parking it would be literally perfect! the inside of it is so freaking cute! so clean so homey i would definitely stay again soon !

sehr gute Unterkunft, blitzsauber, gute Ausstattung, keine 300 m zur Subway Linie 7 (69th Street) extrem freundlicher und hilfsbereiter Gastgeber. Kühlschrank war zu Beginn teilweise gefüllt mit frischen Lebensmitteln, Kaffee, Eiern, Milch. Gutes, nicht weiches Bett, Apple TV (das wir allerdings fast nicht genutzt haben, Manhatten war spannender als TV), viele Infobroschüren über New York, stabiles, schnelles Wlan.
Appartement ist ruhig trotz der nahen Schnellstraße und des La Guardia Flughafens, auch wenn es natürlich nicht vergleichbar ist mit der Ruhe in irgendeinem abgelegenen Dorf, aber hey, es ist New York, wer da völlige Ruhe sucht, ist falsch.
Lokale Einkaufsmöglichkeiten sind ausreichend vorhanden, vor allem in der Roosevelt Avenue sind mehrere mittelgroße Supermärkte, einer davon sogar 24 h geöffnet. Wir wollen in 2 Jahren wieder kommen, daher klare Empfehlung.
This place is sensational! It is in a great location within walking distance to everything! Check in was super easy and check out even easier! I look forward to staying again!

Great place to stay if you’re a single traveler exploring New York City! The room is small and minimalistic as all the other reviews have said, but that does not bother me because all I needed was a place to sleep and this place delivers that. Centrally located. Subway is three blocks away. I explored the city all day and felt safe coming home at night. Highly recommend.
Great place and great service, would highly recommend staying at this apartment.

I enjoyed my stay and Colin was one of the best host I have ever dealt with!
Highly recommend this place 5stars for me!
Nice cozy place. Great location and value !
Great stay! Very much hotel room vibes sans a front desk. Good price and good space. I felt safe. Maintenance staff was kind.

Pretty solid property. I had no cell service in the bathroom, but I could get a bar or two in the bedroom. There was an issue during my stay, but the host addressed it promptly and corrected most of it.  7/10

J'ai passé une très bonne semaine dans ce logement. Placé dans un quartier calme et sécurisé, il est situé à 100m du métro Q (7th Av), qui est direct pour Manhattan (moins de 20 minutes), et les lignes 2, 3, 4 et 5 (Bergen St) à 5 minutes à pieds. Il y a aussi de nombreux restaurants et commerces (Flatbush Av), le Barclays center n'est pas très loin non plus.
Le logement est en réalité une chambre située au rez-de-chaussée de la maison de Chris, la kitchenette est dans le couloir mais il y a très peu de passage.
La chambre est très spacieuse, bien aménagée, une grande commode pour ranger ses effets personnels.
La salle de bains est petite mais suffisante, avec accès direct depuis la chambre.
La chambre était très propre, la salle de bain aussi. Et le lit est incroyablement confortable, je n'ai jamais aussi bien dormi dans un b&b !
Chris et sa femme était très sympathiques et accueillants, et ils parlent français si vous n'êtes pas à l'aise en anglais.
Je recommande vivement à tous les visiteurs venant à New York !

Très bon séjour dans cette chambre. Les instructions pour rejoindre le logement étaient claires, tout était propre à l’arrivée.
La chambre dispose de tout le nécessaire : climatisation, serviettes, (gel douche et shampoing disponible dans la salle de bain)
Chambre individuelle avec serrure et clés personnelles 👍
Location was perfect for a tourist! Quite but around the corner lots to do and very central to all tours. Room was nice and spacious and grab and go breakfast had a good variety of options.
My favorite NYC hotel hands down!
