Un grand merci à Shemi et ses collaborateurs pour ce parfait accueil. C'était notre premier voyage aux États-Unis et nous étions une famille de 5 personnes. Le logement était très propre à notre arrivée. Beaucoup de linge à notre disposition et une literie très confortable. Shemi a offert des dosettes de bon café . Il y a tout l'équipement pour cuisiner et c'est pratique. La station de métro ligne 4 n'est pas loin. En cas de question, les hôtes répondent rapidement.
Nous recommandons fortement.
Cozy and close to restaurants! Awesome!

We have just returned home from a 6 day trip to NYC...Jamie was the perfect host.
Her beautiful apartment is perfectly situated and very well suited to families. The location is just minutes from Central Park and walking distance to most of the major attractions.
Jamie welcomed us like her own family. Thank you for making us feel right at home, we certainly would highly recommend staying and hope to return.
Fin og ren leilighet i rolig og sentralt nabolag. Kort avstand til undergrunn, whole foods og Central park. Kun en kort tur med undergrunnen til Midtown. Bor der gjerne igjen.

I enjoyed my stay at Michael's...mostly because of his dog, Churro (kidding! though Churro is great). Easy going, shared what was needed, helpful.  It's a bit outside the main part of the Lower East Side, but that's also kinda good. Some noise from neighbors, but not late and nothing like bar noise; and I really didn't hear Michael's comings and goings, so quiet inside as well. Has what you need and a friendly host to help if needed. Thanks, Michael!

Ivan made it so easy and peaceful staying in his private suite! I definitely see myself coming back to stay next time I’m back in Brooklyn. His kitchen amenities were updated and even had free laundry downstairs for guests. I’m definitely going to miss this airbnb!

William’s place is a beautiful historic brown stone on a quiet street in Harlem. It is very close to restaurants, bars, and two subway stops for easy access in and out of the city. It was a good accommodation for me and 2 friends with a clean private room and attached bathroom, 2 beds, and a kitchenette area. Since we had to pick up and hand off keys directly to William, it was a little difficult to coordinate but William was accommodating with our schedule. He has a few rules he is strict on, for good reason, so it’s worth reviewing rules and understanding before booking. The value for this place was good in comparison to other prices I was seeing, but I may look for other options before staying here again.
This is the third time we’ve booked this location — great, and an incredible location! Will be back!

We had a great stay at Paris' apartment, and even better that it felt lovely and private as Paris was away during our stay so that felt like a nice bonus. It is easily walkable to 2 subway lines. Close to Essex market which we went to every morning for breakfast bagels! But you are not short of other great recommendations either in Paris' amazing guide to the local area, which has everything you need to know in it including fantastically detailed info about appliances/amenities in the apartment. We also loved that Paris had thought of everything as well in all the little touches throughout the apartment such as filtered water, snacks and plenty of towels/linens etc. Paris was also very lovely to send us a message or 2 during our stay just to check in with us and make sure everything about our stay was going well and we were well looked after and comfortable. Would highly recommend to all our family and friends and anyone considering staying here, and we would definitely stay again!
Very quaint and cute !

We had a wonderful stay at Michelle's apartment! We were there for Christmas, and the location was perfect for taking in the sights, and exploring the city. It was great to come home to such a warm, quiet sanctuary at the end of each day.
Communication was fast and easy, and the apartment pictures are accurate. We'd recommend it to anyone who wants to be part of the action, but also likes a good night's sleep.
Very nice house and great communication
Everything was perfect! Great location!
Parfait pour visiter New York avec un petit budget. Le quartier est vivant et sympa, l’appartement est à côté du subway, et ressemble à la description. Trenton est très réactif et accommodant.

This was definitely a hidden gem. From the moment we walked in we knew picked a good choice. The apartment was very clean, organized, a great quality of furniture very comfortable. The basement Halal flexibility and was totally unexpected. We plan to stay again in the near picture.
If you want to feel like you’re at home but in New York definitely stay at Nias Airbnb it’s a nice quiet vibe close to the best parts of the city
Grateful to find affordable place in the middle of new york city :) Henry is approachable and helpful! Highly recommend.
It is really a Nice place.

Great stay! The room is in a beautiful old Brooklyn brownstone in a family friendly neighborhood that includes restaurants and coffee shops. Large bedroom and bath with TV and air. Thanks for the memories, Carol!
This place was amazing for our first time in the city. Great spot to get around near multiple subways and easy access to the ferry.

사람들이 정말 친절하고 룸 퀄리티가 좋습니다 다음에 다시 방문해도 이곳에 오고싶습니다. 복도에는 전자레인지와 여분의 수건, 휴지 등등 여러가지가 준비되어 있고 정수기도 있습니다. 근처에는 2에비뉴 역, 바워리 역, 그랜드 스트리트역, 라파예트 역 등 여러 역과 가깝습니다. 바로 옆에 홀푸드마켓도 있어서 먹을거를 사기도 유용합니다. 짐 보관 서비스도 하고있어서 마지막날 돌아다니기도 편했습니다.

Luz’ place was great! Really great value. Clean, adequate space, good location and best of all, great host! Luz was really nice to wait for me to check me in. I stayed there a few hours to freshen up in between flights and she was hospitable and friendly.

I and my husband had a great stay in this apartment.
It was amazing experience.
Mary is a great stylist.
I could feel how much she loves this space, and I could see that she cares so much about the place.
And the space is very private and cozy.
If you take the subway, Dumbo and Williamsburg go quickly.
There is a little away from tourist spots,
don't worry, it'll make you feel real Brooklyn closer!
There are a lot of good cafes, restaurants and grocery markets.
We felt a part of New Yorker at the moment.
It was one of my best experience in New York, absolutely!

Jessica & Sasha’s home was perfect for our family vacation. They offered all amenities we needed: clean rooms, toiletries, and a cozy setting. Aspects of communication were  easy and allowed checking in and checking out to be quick as possible. Highly recommend and looking forward to our next visit.
This was a great stay. We were close to everything. We we able to get to Manhattan to visit our kids in 30 minutes. Marlyn and Hollis were very friendly. Great experience all around.

Great location, comfortable, clean
Would recommend for a trip to New York
it was cozy and clean just a bit noisy up top

I had the joy of staying here with Celin for a month. He kept the apartment incredibly clean, vacuuming and cleaning the bathroom at least twice a week. It was quiet both at night and during the day, no street or neighbor noise at all. Celin was the perfect host, a true friend by the end of it. He will make you feel right at home and will help you with anything you could need. For what he charges he delivers twice the value. Thank you Celin.

Charles is an excellent host, his communication is always timely and clear. The home is amazing. It looks just like the pictures and was clean and ready when I arrived. I enjoyed my stay and I have no doubt you'll love it too.
Had a great time, the host had a printout of things to do in the city with great local spots! Everything was super clean, and a beautiful place!

I really enjoyed staying at Linda’s. She was very helpful and kind. I felt free to be able to come and go as I pleased. The bed is very comfortable for my back issues, it didn’t sag and it had great support. I would definitely stay here again.
Nice and quiet loft near to métro and to to little shops .we loved it very much.

We loved everything about our stay in Dumbo at Shahram’s place - we were so close to transport, great food and some great parks (for our toddler). The apartment was beautifully styled, spotless, we could cook meals at home when we wanted to, wash clothes - and Shahram was a wonderful, kind host. Thanks for having us!

Warm and clean space. A bit far out if you're in need for food delivery (pandemic), many places wouldn't delivery. The lighting is a bit harsh, 20 LED lights without a dimmer or ability to turn some off or on (all or nothing lighting). I ended up going out and getting a light bulb for the only lamp available. The bath tub works, the beds were comfortable, and the heating worked very well!

This place was very much as the pictures described. Lots of space and all the amenities that you would need. The location was also top notch, with plenty of restaurants nearby. We did have a problem with a blown fuse, due to the use of heaters that they provided, this meant being without internet for almost two days. Was kinda disappointed with the response and ended up having to take matter into our own hands until they could sort it out. And as others have said the street noise was pretty bad. I would also say that some renovation should be done soon, open hole in the wall and only the top floor heated properly without the plugin heaters. But overall our stay was pleasant.

This is an Airbnb but it’s just a hotel room. You could probably book direct with the hotel and get a better rate. The room with the sofa bed was very large by NY standards but the sofa bed was not comfortable, with springs jamming into my son’s back loudly all night. The queen beds were also old and not very comfortable. Reception was friendly and made it easy to drop off bags before check-in.
Can't get no place better..... clean low key near everything
Excellent communication and highly attentive.

The Nomad was great!  I was able to book & check in the same day.  It’s centrally located by all the trains and had everything you need within walking distance. The space is cute and stylish and I could smell that it was freshly cleaned when I walked in. The team quickly responded when I needed help with the stove and the space was very private. Yes you’ll hear construction during the day but it’s quiet at night. Check in & check out was easy. They provide everything you need for a quick and easy stay and I look forward to staying at the Nomad again.

I loved the location!  Right in the heart of upper east side where real people live.  I felt right at home in Francesco’s place. I never heard the neighbors, though when the firetruck drove by with the horn blowing, I did hear that.  On my next trip to NYC, I would definitely stay here again.
Great location and friendly front desk. Room was as it appears in photos
Recommend booking, at least from a solo adventurer experience.  Bus and ferry in walkable distance.  Generally quiet neighborhood, just keep to your self and move forward.  Hosts were accommodating.

Great place to say. Very nice host with good communication. Very understanding with our situation with our son being fussy some nights. Only problem was the listing was incorrect about the parking situation which he promptly messaged me about it with the option to cancel but still was a good deal regardless. Would definitely stay again!
Great place to stay !!
Ben is a great host ! Very responsive to messages. The apartment was immaculate ! Thank you Ben !
Very clean very spacious
It was cool close to everything would stay again loved the tub n shower but hate no microwave
We expected a great experience, and again our expectations were met and we appreciate and recommend this location to all guests
A good place to stay in a central area of the city. Very clean, but fairly basic accommodations and space. A good choice for a  short term visit to NYC.

Great space, exactly as it looks in the pictures. The location is nice, still nearby the busier parts of the city but it's the area is quieter and perfect to unwind in after a day of adventures.  Sasha was very accommodating and quick to respond. I brought my car in and while street parking is a bit tough to come by, there was a 24/7 garage just a block away.

Abbys place exceeded my expectations. For a New York apartment, it's huge, and so well laid out. It's close to the subway so easy to get in and out of the city but the local area is great too. Loved it!
Great location, incredibly quiet for where it is located.
A Nice house to stay with your family.
Very central to Manhattan, great stay!

Great location and price.
Comfortable 2 bedroom flat. Perfect for sharing with our friends to show them the city. Located right in Hell’s Kitchen with lots of shops and restaurants. Near Times Square, Broadway, Central Park, Subway stations and Circle Line Cruises. Communication was perfect and flat was comfortable and clean.

I almost feel bad writing this, but I feel it’s necessary to be transparent so no one else has to endure these issues. ROACHES were everywhere- inside the microwave, stove, and couch- the host's only solution was he “left a can of Raid”. There were exposed holes in the floor covered with tissue paper, poorly boarded-up walls, and a freezing cold bathroom with no insulation. The bathroom light was so dim we had to bring in a lamp from the living room. Strong, unpleasant smells from other guests made the stay even worse. Noise was constant, even outside quiet hours, and when I reported it, the host said he “doubts” they are being noisy. I contacted him at 5am while it was occurring and he then stated he will speak to them. Which it continued to occur. This is consistent with other guest reviews. Thankfully, Airbnb’s AirCover refunded me after I provided documentation. Airbnb has also recorded a violation against the host. Please consider this before booking; I regret not doing so myself
Great location! The place is cute and comfy. Perfect for a couple.
Great neighborhood, close to everything. Host very helpful. Apartment just like pictures.

Das Zimmer in Brooklyn ist sehr geräumig und verfügt auch über eine kleine Küchenzeile mit Kühlschrank, so dass man Vorort frühstücken kann. Die Nachbarschaft hat uns gut gefallen, da die Straße selbst sehr ruhig ist, sich in unmittelbarer Nähe aber auch viele nette Restaurants und Geschäfte befinden.
Insgesamt haben wir uns sehr wohl gefühlt und würden jederzeit wieder kommen.

Very spacious and would accommodate a lot of people. Check in was easy. Located not too far from the L train(about 10 minute walk). Liked everything about the apartment, only thing I could complain about would be it got a bit cold at night.  The blankets were a bit small(throws) and I would suggest they replace the throw blankets with bigger blankets. Other than that I’d book this place again if blanket problem is addressed.
Great place to stay for a couple nights. Good location, very walkable.

Judy harika bir ev sahibiydi. Dost canlısı gayet kibar ve nazikti.çocuklarımızla birlikte gayet konforlu ve güvenilir bir konumda olan evde harika bir deneyim oldu bizim için.en son çıkarken bize hediyeler almıştı bu jest gerçekten çok güzeldi kızlarım çok sevindi ☺️💐
Great value, enjoyed! thank you!

Staying with Neida & Samuel was wonderful. From the first moment on I totally felt at home. The atmosphere was very relaxed, I was free to use anything in the kitchen. The place was super clean and quiet. Not far from the subway stations. I slept very well and enjoyed the company of the hosts even though it mostly felt as if I had the entire place to myself. Strongly recommended!

This apartment is perfect if you are visiting the Park Slope area or if you want a nice location in Brooklyn. It is so near to Prospect Park, the subway station, and many businesses in the Park Slope area. It has everything you’d need and was very comfortable. Althea & Matt were very responsive and accommodating. We hope to stay there again when visiting!
Excelente, limpio, espacioso, el baño y la cocina full equipada y las recámaras acogedoras.

I truly enjoyed my stay and would definitely book here again. The pictures were very accurate and the unit is well designed. It has everything you need and then some. It's also the perfect location. There are so many walkable things, plus the train is close by. I also really appreciated how well the wifi worked since I had to work remotely during my stay. Best of all, the host, Lourdes, is very hospitable and kind. I'd recommend this Airbnb to anyone!

Very nice place, located near a train station which made it very easy to access. Joo Hee was very responsive and left some snacks and refreshments to help ease the tiredness from the trip. Highly recommend!
Good place. Did the job.
Room is perfect size for solo travelers also very easy to get to.

When I read the reviews I was blown away but didn’t understand all the hype. Now staying there its clear - Dusean is a great host very responsive and helpful and just a really nice guy , the place is stylish and homey at the same time , the location is perfect close to city  and Westchester but quite neighborhood. My family and I spent Christmas 2019 here and it felt like home. We will be back. You will be lucky if your able to reserve this place.

I really enjoyed staying here. The artwork everywhere was amazing. All the front desk people were super nice. I loved the room. I would stay here again & I would suggest other people stay here as well

the location was pretty good, the L is five blocks away. I really like that it's next to a dog park so you can get a quick burst of dopamine just by walking through the park every day. the bedroom was really bright, loved the storage ability. getting in was slightly difficult but she was wonderful at communication and exceptionally gracious. really easy to talk to. definitely worth the stay.
it was the perfect size for us! super nice host(s) :-)

This was a great place to stay easily accessible to the subway. Negra was incredibly accommodating and allowed us to drop off our belongings earlier than check-in so we could continue to explore the city. Thanks!

Very friendly, welcoming hosts! The team made me feel very well taken-care of, and always encouraged me to enjoy more of their delicious homemade muffins 🤩 The rooms are small, as described, but the common spaces were welcoming and never felt too full.

Just back from a week in Brooklyn at Dawn’s apartment. The apartment was great, really spacious and had everything we needed. We didn’t manage to meet Dawn but her Dad downstairs was friendly and helpful.
It was a good base for Manhattan and Brooklyn, a little bit further out than would have been ideal, about an hour to central Manhattan (but we knew that) there wasn’t really anywhere to go in the evening locally but it wasn’t too far in a taxi to find bars and restaurants. We were a little worried walking back from the subway at night but only really just around the subway station, the rest of the area was fine and we had no problems.
The weekly metro card for $33 dollars covering subway and buses was great value.
We had a fantastic time. Thank you Dawn

The place was spacious and clean, minimalist and fantastic. Adrianne was great and made us feel right at home. Only 2 blocks from the subway, this little Harlem apartment felt safe and we had a fantastic time. Easy to get to the sights downtown.

Great spot, super cozy apartment. Clean building. Excellent location, near to the train, the park and different kind of restaurants.
Highly recommended!
Beatrice is a great host. What an amazing stay we had in this beautiful rooms!
Place is cozy and clean, I really like :)
Don’t make plans to have friends or family coming over for a brief visit..u will be charged extra.
Small but nice. Would have gave 5 stars but the sound of the washer machine in the other apartment was very loud and disrupted my sleep.
Exactly as advertised! This place is in the middle of everything! The host was also extremely helpful. Highly recommended.
I stayed at Tash's place for 1 night because I needed to be in the area for an event. Everything was as described and as expected. Check-in was easy and hassle-free. Clean and quiet, 0 complaints.
J’ai passé un bon séjour ! L’appartement est bien situé, propre et conforme à la description. Adam est réactif et les instructions pour l’arrivée étaient claires. Je recommande !

Pleasant greeting and assistance with luggage. Accurate photos and description of place and what to expect.  Very, very comfortable bed. Patricia gave me a perfect amount of personal space during what was a very exciting/stressful transition into the New York acting world.  Use earplugs if you are mid to light sleeper.  Great proximity to public transpo, Greenpoint nightlife and C-Town around the corner (I was there for 10 days).  Book today!

Melanie was VERY responsive any time we reached out to her. Her directions and information ahead of time were great and very helpful. The apartment was spacious and well-lit. The light switches were not in the best locations, in our opinion, but she had nothing to do with that. They were there, it was just a matter of locating the desired switches. (I'm talking about the kitchen area and entering the bedroom from the entryway.) I'm sure we would have gotten used to the the switch locations if we had been there longer. (We were there 2 nights.) After we arrived by Uber we walked everywhere - church, the venue for the baby shower, and to our godson's school the next morning. It was dark when we walked the 0.7 mile home from the baby shower, and we had no concerns. I wouldn't hesitate to stay there again if we are ever staying in Brooklyn. The location was quite convenient for us. Thank you, Melanie, for a great place to stay.
Nice little studio. Quiet and walking distance to several great shops and cafés. Street parking was pretty easy, something you can't always say about Brooklyn.

Loved my stay with BP. They're so responsive and attentive. I stayed for a month initially and extended. I will definitely book with them in the future as well.
The location: Right next to a train station to take you into Manhattan, literally on the corner, so the commute was great everywhere. There are a few stragglers standing outside throughout the night so just be aware of your surroundings. I never felt unsafe but just be mindful who's around.
The unit: Entering the building, there are two doors to unlock, so it provides an extra sense of security. To enter the unit, and your room, its a touchpad door lock and I love that because some bnbs I've stayed at don't have locks on the doors.
The kitchen and dining area are cleaned a couple times a week by a cleaning company and they replenish the bathroom and coffee areas. The kitchen and bathrooms can get a little messy at times depending on the cleanliness of the other housemates, but I just brought extra cleaning wipes.
5/5!

Nice apartment with great access to the subway. Also walking distance to tons of shops and restaurants.
Apartment was comfortable. Beds were comfortable although the couch was marginal.
Appreciated the host’s responsiveness. Great experience overall.
Good location, very close to train station and supermarket. Nice apartment and very comfortable bed in loft. Had everything we needed for our stay.
Das Apartment ist sehr sauber und gut ausgestattet. Die Lage ist "optimal" - nur ca. 5 Minuten zur U-Bahn, zum Supermarkt, etc. Es hat uns sehr gut gefallen.
Beautiful host, clean and neat place with full privacy.
I enjoyed my stay!
Great place to stay, comfortable and near everything. A lot to do in the area.

Giana is very responsive, and helpful in time of need.
The room was very comfortable, full of sunlight and feels just like home.
Her dog is very friendly and welcoming if you have the chance to see him.
Very easy, and convenient assess to the train, across the street. Great for getting around Brooklyn to Manhattan and back.
Great stay.

We had a wonderful stay at Marco's place. We felt like home and had a lot of privacy, but when needed Marco was very helpful.
Public transport is nearby and we traveled al lot around the city.
We would like to recommend Marco's place to everyone.

Everything was good, me and my cousin had a good time, no issues, as long as you follow the rules you'llbe fine, everything was clean, the balcony was the best part of it lol Bobby and her roomie wer nice and attentive, we were delayed on the check out but they were nice with it even though it was our fault. It's Astoria so you can find everything around the area.

I had a great stay at Thomas's place. It's in a great location close to the L train and a bunch of restaurants, bars and shops. The home is in a secure building and is beautifully planned out and decorated. I had one of the best conversations with Thomas. He has such a kind and beautiful soul. Highly recommended.

Our group of 4 adults and 4 children (aged between 6 and 15) stayed between Boxing Day and early Jan 2016.
We all love New York and have visited previously but staying here was the icing on the cake and the cherry on top. An absolutely beautiful house, superbly equipped and in a perfect location.
The house is finished to exceptionally high standards, is extremely well equipped (everything you would expect from a family home) and actually feels much bigger than pictured. Enough full beds for 7 people and plenty of room for our little one on a very good aerobed in the master bedroom.
The ground floor open plan living space is huge and simply georgeous. Perfect for chilling between activities/trips out or for falling asleep infront of the TV in the evening. This is made much easier and possible because of the vast basement that is setup to fully occupy the kids.
We've visited NYC before but this was the first time outside of Manhattan. The location really is perfect. You are a few minutes walk away from 2 main streets of really good bars, restaurants, cafe's, shops etc. Then there is prospect park (great New Year's Eve fireworks) and the Barclays Center all within easy walking distance. To get elsewhere you are 10 minutes walk from 2 main metro stations that connect you with everything else very quickly.
We did loads of walking and you can walk (with a 6 year old) to Manhattan from the house via the Brooklyn bridge in less than 90 minutes. About half that time to somewhere like Times Square door to door on the Metro.
We loved staying in Brooklyn, we felt safe and actually part of the local community rather than just tourists.
So my advice to those thinking of a trip to NYC: Visit Manhattan, live in Brooklyn and absolutely stay at this georgeous property.
The location and room were good. The address that was originally posted wasn’t accurate which made the check in process confusing. But other than that it was a good stay.

Alie and Pat are very communicative, the check in is easy to do, the place was clean and very well equipped with all the necessary to feel at your own house, the subway stations are less than 10 minutes away!! the neighbor is really nice! I loved my stay there, I definitely will stay again! thanks Alie and Pat!!

Young made our one night stay in NYC very comfortable and stress-free. Given that our trip was so short, our goal was to stay out in the city for as long as possible, so our main concern was having to carry our luggage everywhere. Young was super helpful in allowing us to store our luggage before check-in and after check-out. We were also greeted to a clean, well kept room when we got back to the room at night, and had no issues with the amenities provided. I recommend this room and Young as a host to anyone visiting NYC.
Emily was very responsive and a great host. Very cozy even though my check-in was late. It was easy to get inside. Highly recommend!
Good experience, a bit pricey but overall gets the job done.
Very comfortable and convenient.  The apartment was quiet and a nice respite after spending the day in the city.  Close to restaurants and Central Park.  I highly recommend.

Absolutely loved my stay at Charlie’s Airbnb! The home is incredibly welcoming and felt like a true home away from home. The community is very safe, and the amenities were just what I needed. Having access to a gym and laundry facilities made my stay so convenient. Charlie was amazing—so helpful and just a phone call away. Highly recommend this place! Whenever I’m in NY, Charlie’s place is where I’ll be staying. Love it love it !! Well done ! Merry Christmas Charlie & Thanks for having me.
It was an amazing location, great space, and great hospitality!  I highly recommend Rosa’s place for a short or long stay!

A comfortable and beautiful home on a gorgeous street.  We had everything we needed and lots of space for our family!  It was a hot week and we were very comfortable with the central AC.  The back deck is lovely and my girls enjoyed the back garden.  Many lovely plants made the home feel even more homey.  Super location, close to everything; great food, coffee, parks and more.  Thanks for sharing your home!

Our stay at Fort Greene cottage was one of the easiest I've experienced through Airbnb. The neighbourhood is very central in Brooklyn and easy to find, just a ten minute walk from Atlantic Avenue metro station.  The cottage is small but clean and cozy – perfect for one or two people. Sarah has thought of everything so we called for nothing! I highly recommend. Thanks for having us Sarah.

Lara è una persona deliziosa.
Puntuale, precisa, disponibile.

Spero di poter ritornare!!
La casa è piccola ma ha tutti i confort che uno può desiderare. È calda ed accogliente. Pulitissima.
WHile the block may not be pretty, the apartment is great. And the service/support is instant and friendly and generous.
Fantastic location. Would definitely return!

Joyce is a lovely and sweet person! She was a great host and was extremely accommodating to the fact that my arrival time changed a few times. The apartment is on the ground floor of a beautiful old brown stone on a great street.

Very clean room, with lovely coffee place downstairs and awesome rooftop in the building. Located at the end of a little lane that can appear sketchy at first with all the graffiti’s but ends up being artsy, the area isn’t the best but just a few minutes away from the lively SoHo. The room is tiny but normal per New York standards, probably more suitable for a single person or a couple, especially with the almost non existent place to store your suitcase/clothes and the sliding bathroom door. The shower head is a rain shower which might not suit all. Bedding is comfortable. Overall amazing value for money, recommended!

We had a wonderful stay in Kirsten’s apartment. It is really well appointed with everything we could think of needing.
Kirsten was very flexible about our late arrival time. She met us at the door and helped carry our luggage in.
The apartment is on a quiet, tree-lined street just a few minutes walk from two different metro stops.
Views from the large rooftop patio were great.
We would love to stay again in the future.
we loved the place.The rooms were booth very nicely equipped, cleaned and the appartment was really charming

The apartment is exactly as described/pictured and exceeded our expectations.
The space is clean and quiet (apartment does not face the street) and in an ideal location for exploring Brooklyn or NYC.
Sandee is a great host!
Don’t hesitate in booking.
Quiet tidy space and had all the necessities required for a comfortable stay. I would recommend

Beautiful house that is well decorated. We loved our stay and the location. Tiffany was a great host and made us feel welcome. The check-in and check-out process were especially easy. Will definitely look to stay again when we come back to NY!

Mark is a fantastic host ! He was very attentive to the needs of my partner and I and had great hospitality. It was everything my partner and I needed to enjoy our stay which was very last minute. If you are a person that is very simple and appreciate an affordable price, this is definitely a place you can rely on.
Nice place. Comfortable rooms. Quiet neighborhood. Great communication with hosts.

Thera's place is a unique and very cozy stay for us women travellers. Every piece of furniture, every book and every object has its own personality. The bed is very comfortable too, and the room is quiet. The neighborhood and the other tenants that I met are very friendly too. It is a chance to feel at home in NYC!

A spacious studio,clean and very comfortable!
The bus to Woodside subway stops outside the door and takes about 15 minutes.The train to Manhattan takes about 25 minutes.
Plenty of shops,delis etc in the neighbourhood!
I would definitely return to this Air bnb!
Great people! And a great space with easy access to transportation and cool places in Brooklyn
Ian is the best.
Cute and in a good location

Kind, attentive and hospitable. Clean and cozy room. I felt at home here, and Pamela is a kind and attentive host.
We loved our stay in Harlem – highly recommend!
agradable lugar descrito igual que el anuncio con lo necesario para la estancia y cerca de supermercados y paradas de autobuses para movilizarse a New York city, anfitrión atento y amable

When we booked our vacation, this place was advertised as a “Serviced Apartment” and Airbnb’s search engine showed it to me after I had selected the “entire place” filter. However, this place is a private room, with shared bathrooms and kitchen. When we contacted BP Host, they did not recognize that their post title was misleading and told us we should contact Airbnb (but changed the title afterwards). Airbnb said that they include “recommendations” in user searches, even if those recommendations don’t meet the user’s search criteria, so this is how this place showed up in my search. Airbnb’s customer service told me that I should have known that a “serviced apartment” is not an entire place. Neither BP Host, nor Airbnb, did anything to help us, not even allowing early checkout and reimbursing unused nights.
Shared bathrooms had cloth hand towels used by people in 5 rooms! therefore, always had hairs on them. Carpet was filthy. Coffee cups were dusty. Not a luxurious stay at all.

Wir haben in Devoras Apartment einen einwöchigen Familienurlaub (mit 4 Erwachsenen) in Brooklyn verbracht und hatten eine wunderbare Zeit. Das Apartment entsprach den Bildern und war sehr sauber. Es ist in einer ruhigen Wohngegend gelegen und sehr gut mit U-Bahn sowie Bus angebunden. Das Haus ist etwas hellhörig, was allerdings, nach unserer Erfahrung, normal ist für amerikanische Wohnungen. Uns hat dies nicht weiter gestört, weil wir viel unterwegs waren.
Devora ist eine sehr hilfreiche Gastgeberin und stets zu erreichen. Wir sagen vielen Dank!

Blair and Briken are very hard working and kind people who are very responsive to the needs of their guests. This location is perfect if you’re looking for something walkable to NYU which we were for graduation. Enough beds for a small group, nice details and unique layout.

Gute Unterkunft für Besichtigungen, bequeme Betten, nette und schnelle Kommunikation, wir konnten das Gepäck noch am Abreisetag länger dort aufbewahren, was uns sehr geholfen hat. Um vorhandene Küche zu nutzen, bitte Besteck, Teller etc.mitbringen

Gem!! Ken was so nice and accommodating of all our needs. Great recommendations around the area especially the beef patties. The room is only a block away from the subway entrance so a great home base for peeps looking to explore NY. Thanks Ken!

Helen's apartment is ideally located in the lower East Side, the metro is at a walking distance and there's plenty of bar, restaurants and markets in the vicinity. The apartment is spacious and bright, recently renovated, the bed extremely comfortable. Helen greeted us upon our arrival, she is extremely kind and precise. We had 5 wonderful days even if the weather was freezing. Will definitely come back!
Thank you!
This is a really comfortable stay in a great location. Definitely a great price-quality relationship. Amal was an attentive and truly responsive host. Highly recommended.
Kamil was very communicative and accommodating
goede locatie, goede metro en busverbindingen! ruimte zat met 7 personen

Rena’s place was just what I needed. My boyfriend and I were able to find easy parking, and check-in efficiently. The area is quiet and residential - perfect after a day of beating the streets of Downtown Brooklyn. Thanks Rena for opening your home to us!

We were all disappointed by the place being a bit dirty. The floor was super sticky, the towels didn't seem so clean. Also the place feels smaller than on the pictures. On the plus side, Abraham is very reactive.
Best stay in Brooklyn, I would advise this as your first choice!! Clean, central, charming and hosted by amazing people! Thank you Paul
Comfortable bed and clean room.
לקחתי חדר סמוך לשדה התעופה קיבלתי חדר סביר אבל באו אורחים ב11 בלילה ועשו רעש עד שתיים בלילה והלכה השינה לפני טיסה מוקדם בבוקר. פעם אחרונה שלוקח מקום כזה עדיף לשלם יותר על מלון נורמלי
Hidden gem in Brooklyn! Spacious, spotless interior with comfy bed & big screen TV. Safe, quiet neighborhood with easy subway access. Perfect for exploring!  Easy digital check-in. Highly recommend!

Grace is an excellent person, she is very good at communicating, she is very polite.  The location of the house is great and helped a lot in the tours.  Grace prepared the house very well especially in the details ... Thanks! 😊

El departamento es hermoso... Justo como se mira en las fotos. Todos los espacios estaban muy limpios y ordenados. Me encantó el recibimiento que Pierce nos dio: fruta, agua y sodas en el refrigerador. Chocolates en la mesita de centro. Además Pierce fue muy amable...
This was an awesome Airbnb. I look forward to booking with her again in the fall.

We had a great stay at Marina's apartment. Ms Marina and her husband, the owners of the apartment, were very accommodating and generous. The apartment was as described, was clean and had everything we needed. The s51 is a 5 minute walk, and takes you directly to the SI ferry in about 15 minutes. That was my first AirBnB experience and I think I was lucky to find such a lovely host. I highly recommend the place for tourists who are planning to enjoy their trip to new york city.
good stay, no issues
Mr. Ulises place was absolutely beautiful. Very clean. Updated electronics. I would highly recommend his place.
Alfred and team were very professional and great customer service.
Loved it! Thank you
Quiet, comfortable space in a great location. Friendly and welcoming hosts.
A great family stay in the East Village of Manhattan. This listing was central to everything in the Big Apple. I highly recommend this space. Definitely coming back.

My overall stay wasn’t the best as the host did not make it clear that there was no lock on the door. I did not feel comfortable with that with only having the option to lock it when I was in the room. There is also very strict no eating in the room rules which made me feel like I was living with a parent as the other guest occupied the kitchen very often.
Pretty much what I expected for the price point. Very dependable at an unprecedented time. Hosts were great too.
Thanks again for your kind welcome. We enjoyed very much our stay in your beautiful house, very relaxing and we appreciated the space, cleanliness and quietness.
Roni’s place was great and he was quick to respond to any questions. We’d definitely stay there again.
Will definitely stay here again! Hotel staff was lovely and location was safe and quiet.

We loved our stay here! The whole space had good energy–a perfect tranquil reprieve from the chaos of the city. The bathrooms & kitchens were clean, ACs were able to keep up with a heatwave, & every fridge had a Brita. :) Would totally stay here again.

I had a couple issues with this place during my stay and ended up leaving 2 weeks early to stay with a friend instead.
There’s no self check in.
Host gets very agitated if you use the A/C, I’ve accidentally overheard him cursing me out for having it on, not knowing I was actually in the apartment. The room is like a greenhouse during the day with all the windows. They turn the A/C off at random times. This situation is way worse considering I had a Long haired cat that would pant and vomit from how hot it was in there, and I let them know this. This was taking place during a 104° august NYC heatwave btw.
Wi-Fi is very dysfunctional and may kick you off when more than two devices go online.
Many nights, there were people coming over to chat, play video games and/or smoke which I would not have a problem with but they’d talk for hours and yell til 2 AM. It’s extremely easy to hear everything through the door.
Host was reasonably friendly but I started avoiding him not too long after arriving.
I also overheard him talking about “getting rid” of some drugs to someone else who visited the apartment and that was my last straw.
The Private bathroom and Location were my main reasons for staying here. Beware who you book with on this app.
Vale muito pela localização, próximo a estação de metrô, quarto limpo. Não tem frigobar, e o anúncio falava cama de casal mas na hora foi beliche.

What a gem in the middle of Manhattan. It's like a grown up dorm room, everyone has their own wee private space with a very comfortable twin size bed with a towel provided. The shared gender specific bathroom was spotless and easy to take a shower. Then on top of all that a vegetarian breakfast bar is provided with an impressive variety of food on offer. Honestly the best value I've  ever seen anywhere let alone Manhattan. It'll be my go to spot for future trips to NYC .

Joseph's apartment was very cosy , the location was serene, quiet and very safe. One major positive was the privacy the residence availed me and my family --as there was a private entrance for the guests; and the bath and kitchen were also not shared.
Joseph's residence was really a home away from home, and he helped us to source for phone cards and arrange for taxis.
Will definitely stay in Joseph's apartment anytime l need to be in Queens NY. The apartment is highly recommended! Thank you Mr Joseph!!
The apartment is very clean, close to stores and restaurants, and easy to get in using code. .Would  definitely stay again.
A wonderful place to stay during a business trip! My favorite Airbnb thus far in NY. Looking forward to booking for all future work trips!
Five Star Stay, With A Superhost..Always Amazing & Amy Is An Amazing Person Authentically. Home Away From Home, Thanks Again .
kind and helpful hosts who did everything they could to make sure my stay there was smooth! the place was really nice and clean as well with a well equipped kitchen, laundry machine etc
Me and my wife really enjoyed our stay.

Jaleh is an amazing person. I had definitely not expected anything close to the hospitality that I got. Room was very clean and comfortable. The house is situated in a very convenient location. Made great friends too. Will come back here every time I am in NY!

Great place to stay, house was clean, everything was labeled and the instructions on the counter were very detailed making the stay extremely easy to figure out everything. Only thing that caught us off guard was finding the right door when inside, but it didnt take  long to figure out which one. People upstairs were almost silent you can’t ask for a better neighbors.

If you want to imagine yourself living like a New Yorker, without the Manhattan price tag, this is the place.  The location is the best...shops, restaurants, cool neighborhoods, easy access to other nearby NY areas.  The walkup apartment has so much character with a modern style.  The main living are is open and bright.  Yes, there is some noise on the street below, but don't go to NYC if you want solitude.  I liked the big windows for people watching below.  The bedrooms were in the back of the apt and were quiet like a cocoon.  Best of all was the quick and personal attention of Jana and Nikolas!  If I'm back in Brooklyn, this will be my home away from home again.

Excellent location. New and updated units however can tell the building needs just a little more love. Updated keypad to enter the building would be nice and sometimes the hot water would be lacking but overall a nice place for 1 person or a couple.

Never communicated with Ismene but with the building manager Evangelo via phone during my stay. He was always available to address my concerns; very welcoming and patient. The studio apartment was renovated beautifully and the neighborhood is safe and quiet. I loved the fireplace and the bay window brings in tons of natural light :)  My only issues were:  1. Cleaning lady - poor job on properly cleaning and sanitizing; with stricter COVID-19 health regulations I highly recommend hiring a professional service. 2. Missing Items (especially for long stay residents) -  My initial booking was for two months. The apartment did not come with any toilet paper, trash cans, or cleanings supplies like dish detergent/sponge to wash dishes. Overall AMAZING stay just needed some last minute touches and  hiring of professionals.

Conforme au descriptif, hormis l’usage de la douche est complexe, le logement répond parfaitement aux attentes d’un voyageur qui cherche un endroit correct où se poser à bon prix pour visiter New York. Le bruit du local dessous ne nous a pas empêché de dormir car nous ne sommes pas sensibles.

Il nostro soggiorno a casa di Marie è stato semplicemente meraviglioso, a partire dalla simpatia della famiglia e dall’estrema comodità e bellezza della casa. La stanza è enorme (ottimo rapporto qualità prezzo) e insieme al bagno privato forma quasi un appartamento indipendente al 3* piano; viene fornito tutto il necessario e anche di più: frigorifero, microonde, ferro e asse da stiro, moltissimi asciugamani e lenzuola pulitissimi. Il letto morbidissimo ci mancherà! La zona è comodissima, ben collegata a tutta la città da bus e diverse linee metro, e si trova nella parte centrale di Harlem, dove sono ubicati tutti i più famosi ristoranti di Soul Food. Marie e la sua famiglia sono stati gentili e sempre pronti nel rispondere, torneremo sicuramente!

Excellent value for money: a comfortable bedroom with a clean en suite bathroom (very good shower).

Courteous and helpful host.

So I picked this listing because of the 177 5-star reviews and superhost. I had many, many problems. I want to honest, but not mean. I saw several cockroaches coming from the small table opposite the sofa bed and crawling under the door. There is another room rented sometimes a few inches from the sofa bed. This apartment was not very clean especially the bathroom and shower with hair and stuff on wall. I kept sneezing so lots of dust. Sofa bed very uncomfortable compared to the couches I have been sleeping on this year and is just a futton. I had extreme trouble opening front door and would get locked out with the keys to the apartment.I had trouble canceling this listing and Min did not want to give a refund and I had to contact customer service all night and got no sleep the night before important work. Good location, but would not recommend sofa. There was no A/C at all in the apartment when I rented the sofa bed and I had headaches from the heat. Min was good at communicating , but also asked for opening of door and accused me of taking key I waited extra time to return and missed my bus.
I also noticed several bed bug bites all over my body and had that confirmed at the doctors appointment. This is a very unclean accommodation with high traffic.

What can I say? Celina’s apartment is outstanding! A real gem of a find. The online description of this property, in my opinion undersells it.
It’s bright, well light, with a spacious feel. Your guest space is excellent. The bedroom has a good, firm double bed, a bedside drawer unit and a writing desk and chair. There is also a good sized built in wardrobe area, with about 30 clothes hangers, shelf space above that and ample storage below for baggage etc.
The bathroom is larger than mine at home. It is spotless with a great walk-in shower, a large basin and lovely soft towels are provided.
The shared living space of a lounge/dining area is very informal and it runs into the adjoining kitchen. This has a large refrigerator, coffee machine, hob, microwave and dishwasher.
Then the big bonus feature. There is an outdoor terrace which is about 15 yards wide and 8 yards across. This has a table, soft seating and at night superb city views.
Celina is the hostess with the mostest!!

David’s home is absolutely beautiful. We were looking for a modern, yet inspired NYC home and found exactly that here!
Also extremely close to public transit so getting around NYC was a breeze. David is also an extremely attentive, respectful host!
Great communication , house is nice great for small gatherings nothing too crazy tenants live downstairs so you can’t make much noise but host was very respectful and patient

Kady was awesome host, easy to communicate and helpful.
We enjoyed every second. Everything was perfect. House is absolutely awesome, clean, stunning designed and everything we need is in it for long trips. House shape is so good for 2 family trips.
~10 mins to subway. Lots of nice place nearby for eat and shopping.
Highly recommended!

I had a great stay at Pedro's. The room was clean and comfortable with easy in-and-out through the front door and bathroom nearby. Pedro was a wonderful host. He accommodated my request for a very early check-in after arriving on a red-eye flight, and helped me through a challenging situation when I pulled a muscle in my back. I would definitely stay at Pedro's again.

Very comfortable beds. Simple and clean. No noise in neighborhood.
10-12 minute walk to subway.
Would recommend if staying with family.

The stay was good
The place was clean
Great experience

We had a great stay at Nazleen's & Daniel's place! The view is nice, and the terrace is a wonderful escape from bustling NYC. We loved watching the sunset while sipping on a glass of wine after an eventful day in the city.
The apartment is in an developing area, but buses make it very easy to go around. Also, we had no trouble catching a Lyft or Uber, regular yellow cabs were a bit difficult to find.
Nazleen even went out of her way and purchased some dog food for us, so my dog wouldn't have to go to bed hungry when we arrived late. Thank you!!
The apartment is on the 5th Floor, so it is a bit of a hike, but the terrace totally made up for it. At our arrival Daniel was so friendly to help us get into the apartment at later hours, and even helped us with our bags.
Very cute and charming place
Great stay! Thanks for the quick response times and other help here and there
The place was beautiful, I had an awesome stay, and Michelle was extremely nice and helpful! This was my first Air BnB experience and I am definitely using it again thanks to Michelle

This AirBnB was great. It was in a very cozy and peaceful neighborhood. The place is kept very clean. The pictures matched perfectly to what you saw when you walked in.  The space was enough for my family of 10 including an infant, a toddler and three adolescent aged children.  The host was very responsive. The only downside to my stay was that we had a 10pm quiet time curfew. Being that I am originally from New York. That is somewhat impossible. We are coined the city that never sleeps. It was a little hard for us to actually enjoy leisure time having to always hush the kids and be mindful of not being too loud. Other than that the stay was great. I would stay again and I would recommend it to anyone; friend, family or stranger looking for a great place to stay.

Stayed here for several months as I moved to the city to start a new job. The apartment is remarkably spacious on maybe the most quaint street in the neighborhood, with easy access to great restaurants and the subway on Franklin.
Wish I could have been here during summer and fall and taken advantage of the back patio outdoor space! Proximity to Prospect Park and Brooklyn Museum is wonderful.
New addition of a washer/dryer to the unit just before I arrived was a game changer.
Becky and Andrew are very kind and responsive, and have plenty of recs for local spots.
Ideal place for a longer term stay
This is my 4 time staying at Stellamari place. I really enjoyed my stay. Her and her daughters  were very good host. They only one text away. Place in very clean and quiet.
Excellent stay. Perfect location! Ed was a great host.

Karen è un ospite colto, discreto e disponibile a dare suggerimenti su come muoversi e cosa visitare. Si vede che ama la città in cui vive.
Affitta una stanza nell'appartamento in cui vive col compagno a sud di Arlem a due passi da Central Park e dalla stazione metropolitana Cathedral Pkwy (110 St). La zona mi ha dato l'idea di essere molto sicura con molti locali dove poter mangiare anche di sera.
L'appartamento si trova al piano terra di un caseggiato tipico, non grande, con bagno e cucina in condivisione. Noi usavamo la casa solo per dormire per cui non ci siamo neanche accorti della la promiscuità. Tutto era pulitissimo.
La stanza che affitta è molto piccola con un letto matrimoniale alla francese, comodo ma non adatto a taglie forti o a persone alte.
Per noi è stato tutto perfetto.
Grazie Karen, è stato un vero piacere soggiornare da te.

Très bon rapport qualité-prix, logement idéalement situé près du métro. L’accès est simple, les explications claires, la communication efficace et le bien correspond parfaitement à l’annonce. Quelques équipements mériteraient cependant d’être rafraîchis.
Wanda’s home is so lovely. Enjoy!

Marta's place was great! Awesome location especially after a long day in the city (right off the metro stop) and near everything you need on the Upper West Side. We really enjoyed our stay and highly recommend this place.

I stayed for a month and a half and already miss it!  This was my first time staying at an airbnb and I really enjoyed such a spacious room with two huge windows, 2 leather couches, a small coffee table, a nice vanity/work desk and queen bed. I felt like I had the whole apartment to myself. I loved all the little details that made the room so chic yet cozy. Strong wifi was great for work. AC and fan were nice to have for the summer. The flowers by the window were my favorite to wake up to with the sunrise. Oh the summer moons were beautiful to see! The way the light shown down on the opposite backyard with the clothes lines were such a nice vibe. I also enjoyed being able to workout with the Nordic strider, a giant hoola hoop, and a yoga mat. The area is great for walks and nice sunsets.
I give the room and the area being close to Target, banks, and things one might need  a 5/5. It's a short ride into the city with a couple train options nearby. I didn't really use the kitchen but did enjoy ordering from the neighborhood eats. The hosts were very accommodating and the kind you might want to go for brunch with. I would definitely stay at this Bensonhurst apartment again!

This was a beautiful room in a great house and great neighborhood. Clinton Hill is a nice, safe neighborhood close by areas like Fort Greene, Prospect Heights, Barclays Center, etc. The place is within walking distance to multiple subway stops which makes it accessible to tons of areas in Brooklyn. The room itself was spacious, clean, and comfortable, and private. Waldemar was a great host - really accommodating, communicative, and great to talk to. Next time I'm in New York I'll definitely be staying here again.

Host was not at home during our stay. I had to email and text to get information on how to get keys and WiFi info. We did not use the pullout bed in the living room, only the 2 single beds, which were ok. Apartment was quiet and location was convenient to restaurants and shops.
Marie’s place is a great place to relax and enjoy the Marina. The balcony was one of my favorite parts about her boat house and also her kayak. Great place!

My stay was absolutely perfect. The space was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and thoughtfully put together. It truly felt like a home away from home after long days out exploring the city.
Elena was incredibly responsive and made the entire experience smooth from start to finish. One of my favorite touches was the library of books, it created such a peaceful atmosphere and was perfect for unwinding in the evenings.
I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting the city!
this was a great Bnb and was perfect for a weekend getaway!  Great host and Great place!
cozy little airbnb, near to the subway

Really appreciate their flexibility - I arrived early for a show starting shortly after check-in and they were willing to let me check in as soon as a room was available.  The room was great, clean, and quiet.  Check out was easy.  Very smooth stay.

Devora was friendly and communicative, plus the space was perfectly clean. I don’t know if something happened to the original mattress, because I didn’t see any other complaints, but it was a very thin sofa bed type mattress on a regular bed frame.
Great Stay with friendly staff.  Close to everything we needed and the subway stations.  Super comfy firm bed which is a must!

Our stay with Michael and Bethany was wonderful. Michael was always available to answer any questions or address any concern we might have had. As for the apartment itself, what a fresh of breath air for New York.  Nice sized one bedroom studio. In cleanliness it was beyond our expectations which are pretty high already. The towels and bedding were excellent and the bed itself had my husband and I sleeping in each morning, which we normally don't do. I would recommend this to any one looking for peace and quiet or just visiting while in the city.
I enjoyed my stay at Rory’s place, she was clean and helpful when I did get a chance to meet her. I enjoyed the room and the location was ideal.
Katrina is a wonderful host. So kind and helpful. Made my trip such a pleasant experience.

Chris' apartment is a great way to experience NYC life with some extra breathing room compared to Manhattan. It's a one-bedroom with a large, open living room and a decently sized bathroom and is very spacious, with lots of natural light throughout the day and great use of space that makes for plenty of storage options. Everything was clean and just as the pictures showed. There's AC, Wi-Fi, towels, sheets, everything that covers your basic needs. Great energy, too!
The building is nice and welcoming, with plenty of amenities such as a laundry room and a gym on the ground floor. It's located in a great, vibrant neighborhood, with a well-stocked deli just steps away from the entrance and lots of other stores, food options, green spaces and other great spots within walking distance. The building is just off the Cross Bronx, so there is some traffic noise, but if you're not the type of person who's sensitive to that, it's not an issue at all.
There's a train station down the street served by the 2 and 5 trains, so Manhattan is only about a half hour away.
Chris was a kind and accomodating host every step of the way, flexible regarding checking in and checking out, and also responsive and easy to talk to.
We stayed there for 3 weeks and had a very pleasant experience from beginning to end. Would definitely recommend it and will happily consider it again in the future!
James and Laureta's place was great! Comfortable and peaceful for our stay in the city!
This was a fantastic place to stay! Great location and very clean and comfortable. would definetly stay here again!

Bright’s place was amazing, the apartment was very spacious and comfortable which is very important to me. The house is located at a dead end which is clutch because you don’t get that NY traffic noise. Bright was professional and respectful. When we needed an iron Bright called his house manager and provided us with a brand new iron. Next time im in NYC you will definitely catch me at Bright’s spot.
In a great area to get supplies quick by or quick bite! Close to subways and was a great stay for my group!
Kay was super awesome. He responded asap, helped me with everything i asked for and provided me with whatever i needed. Great stay
Great place for the price. Close to subways and a lot of other things if you don’t mind a 20-30 min walk. Host was very helpful.
It is a nice place in a great neighborhood. Communication was perfect and quick.
Great place to stay and good rooms and service +++
Very nice host enjoyed the stay thoroughly
Great spot.  The house was perfect.
Thank you for making my stay Amazing, I’ll be back most definitely. Clean, quiet, and Amazing once again.

Please book here! Wonderful home and host. Kara communicated promptly and helped make our stay comfortable. Loved the location because we were 2.5 blocks from the subway and half a block from a deli. This is a great home to stay.

The apartment is in a great location for exploring the Upper East Side, including the major art museums, Central Park, and the East River walkway.  It's also close to the Q subway line, which goes to many of the important locations in the city.  The apartment itself has all the basics and is very comfortable for one or two people.
je vous le conseille
Loved Mariana and her place. It was clean and beautiful. Easily accessible via subway. She was always very quick to respond to my questions ! Would go back there again.
Location is great. J train is about 5 minutes away. Pretty clean apartment too. You should definitely consider this as an option for your stay.
Great host, safe location and very clean
Great place to stay if your no trying to stay in the city. Easy access to subways.

This house is very good, cleaner than most of hotel in new york( around 200 bucks a night). The house keeper is a kind madam, she provides me two cups of hot coffee after I wake up! Conclusions, it is a clean comfortable private great house, really surprise me!

Great views from the balcony, clean, and with every essential, including a speaker. The front desk were very nice, super easy check in. It has a great location with a rooftop bar in the building. I recommend.
Super cute place and looked like the photos. I wish we could stay longer!

Gerard is an excellent host and person! Really went the extra mile to ensure everything was clean and Rona-free. HOWEVER as far as location goes, I am a solo female traveler that relies on public transportation and the area is rough to say the least. The actual street seemed safe, but it was a harrowing experience waiting for the bus in club wear at midnight. In terms of hospitality, I would 100% book with Gerard again but the location is something to really consider.

An incredible location for the money, plus a kind, friendly, and approachable host. Roosevelt island is a wonderfully peaceful retreat from the intense crowds of Manhattan, while still being very close by subway and cable car. The room has plenty of space for three people and a very nice view, plus it's warm, quiet, and overall super cozy. The host was very helpful in making sure that we had everything we needed, while also giving us plenty of privacy. Next time we visit New York we will 100% be booking here again.

Our expectations were beyond exceeded. Lots of room, beautiful spot, nicely decorated and very clean. The host was very accommodating and helpful and answered all our questions/concerns. I would recommend this place to anyone, especially if you have a bit of a larger party and prefer to stay together. The host made this trip and experience very memorable!!

Amazing place for a big group. Spacious common areas, outdoor patio with a grill, numerous bathrooms with showers. Our host, Alex, was very communicative and easy to work with. She let us know ahead of time that the dishwasher had broken the week of our arrival, but made up for it by offering us her stash of paper paper plates and plastic cups and utensils and gave us a bottle of wine to apologize! Overall a great experience.

Joslin was a fantastic host and made sure we felt welcome. The place is in a really great neighborhood with tons of restaurants, groceries, and shops. (I unfortunately didn’t get to spend much time around since I was here for work, but regardless it was really nice!) It is also conveniently located near a subway stop so it was really easy getting to, eg, Manhattan. Highly recommend this place (esp for the price!!) and for Joslin’s welcoming hosting.

This was the worst experience I’ve had with Airbnb. Handful of issues: the host, Daljit, was not responsive, I was stranded for an hour before gaining access to my room, which was not even properly cleaned, and, finally, the space was not as described in the ad.
1) Once the booking was confirmed, I received a set of instructions in an Airbnb message -- that was the very last time I heard from the host. I arrived the day of at check-in time and followed the instructions to get in the front door of the house. Once I got to the second floor, however, I found another locked door with no instructions as to how to get in. I texted and left voice and Airbnb messages for the host but got no response. As I was calling Airbnb to resolve this, I bumped into another visitor who stayed at the place and he showed me a part of the instructions that was missing from mine – we had to download an app for the smart lock. Even after I did so I was still not able to get in because the host have failed to authorize / invite me in the first place. This only get resolved when the Airbnb agent was able to contact Daljit (who perplexingly still never answered my call). There was no acknowledgement nor apology from the host for his mistake, nor for the one hour I wasted calling Airbnb and waiting for them to find him.
2) Once I got into the room, it was apparent that cleaning was not done properly. There were used towels hanging on the wall, and it was apparent that the bed was hastily made without replacing with clean sheet. Someone did come in to fix this later when I was gone, otherwise I would’ve given this zero star. But again, no acknowledgement / apologies from the host. Everything had to go through an Airbnb agent.
3) Instead of the host being the only other person staying in the apartment as stated in the ad, this house is an Airbnb farm with 8 double rooms split between two levels and only 1 bathroom for each floor. At full occupancy this would’ve been a disaster with noise and poor bathroom access. Furthermore, the room did not match the picture (there was no skylight, e.g.). I have no problem with Airbnb farms per se, but I cannot tolerate misrepresentation.
I’ve never given a negative Airbnb review but this one warrants it. All in all, I do not recommend anyone staying here or anywhere operated by the same host / group of hosts.
Always a great place to stay for the weekend when I come to the city ! Wayne is always very respectful and responsive when you need him ! Definitely would book again .
My in-laws enjoyed their stay. Though brief, they felt welcome and comfortable!

Super nice area, the room was very clean overall and the staff was lovely. Breakfast was also a super nice perk.
Keep in mind this particular room is a true studio.

Overall, this place was really great. It was a large space, in a safe and nice building, and in a fantastic location. I would definitely stay here again, especially because the space is about double or triple the size of decent hotel rooms at that price in that area. I wish there was more accommodation for our long 16-day stay, such as more/better cleaning materials. But it definitely would exceed expectations for short stays.
I enjoyed my stay. Kara was very attentive when I needed assistance responded back very quickly. The apartment looks just like the pictures, it was very clean.

This space was clean and bright, exactly as pictured.  Was not entirely prepared for a 3 story walk up, especially with a partner who was on weight lifting restrictions and two small kids.  The walls are extremely thin and we could hear everything going on in the neighboring apartments.  The noise made it difficult to sleep.  The living room furniture was extremely uncomfortable, I’m not sure how anyone would sleep on it, let alone sit on it.  The kitchen was very modern and clean as was the bathroom.  Not being as familiar with Brooklyn, I found the neighborhood to be a little bit sketchier than I had hoped.
Little flat in the East Village centrally located to everything. Small but comfortable. Great launch pad for a couple to check out the most beautiful city in the world
My wife and I had a great stay! Awesome location! Great value for the price, even free breakfast! Host was very responsive.

Marjorie was an amazing host with a wonderful gem of an apartment. We were welcomed by Marjorie who made us feel very safe. The apartment was quiet, cute, and peaceful. The location was perfect - a 5 min walk to buses, subway, and plenty of restaurants. Marjorie was accommodating with our check in and check out times and made our stay lovely. Would definitely recommend her apartment!

Very spacious and Eric was a great host. Located very close to food, malls, subways and Yankee Stadium. Very, very quiet at night. Our visit to NY started off great staying here, would definitely recommend. Bathroom looks great and more renovations to go we are told.

The place was beautiful. Everything you will need for your stay he has it available (exp.a lint brush)I came with my coffee I do not drink any coffee to my surprise he had my favorite coffee .Thats 100%.I will definitely come back.
Thank you,
Shemi.

Sam is indeed a superhost. His warm welcoming made us feel right at home and he was always available to help us out with anything, big or small. Travelling with a baby can be stressful and challenging but Sam made sure to adress all our concerns and to make sure we have a pleasant stay. The apartment is spacious, bed comfortable, nice big bathroom and a cute backporch. The area is overflowing with nice restaurants and cafés and a big plus was the easy access to the ferries - Manhattan is only a quick ferry ride away!

My boyfriend and I loved this space!! It felt safe, close to the city, and there were tons of little shops and restaurants around to try. Any and all communication with the hosts went smoothly. We had the best time here and would definitely stay again!!
Great stay, would recommend!!
Fantastic family friendly place that is easy to get to, accessible parking, and super clean and stylish. Was great for us with young kids and would also be great for couples or singles.
Great host and great spot to stay for a show at ubs arena. We were only there at night, but Nicole was helpful every step of the way.
Marsha is a gracious and pleasant host, I loved staying here and would highly recommend.

Meela’s place was perfect for a couple of night’s stay in NYC. Subway was just around the corner and only 3 stops into Manhattan so was perfect for what I needed. Room is nice and very quiet, and did have an in window AC unit which is a prerequisite for NYC in summer. The nightly rate was extremely reasonable, however the $100 cleaning fee felt like a little bit of a stealth charge for a private bedroom. That being said the room, bathroom and common areas were the cleanest I have ever seen in an NYC Airbnb, so atleast the money is being spent  well.The ability to lock my bedroom door with a key would have been nice, it didn’t bother me as I packed very light and left no valuables in the room, but this may be a concern to others. Would definitely stay again.
Perfecta anfitriona Dawn estuvo en contacto en todo momento. La ubicación es inmejorable y la estancia fue muy agradable.
Our second time at this location, all as expected and very pleased with all aspects!  excellent

We loved Sumitra’s place! Checking in and out was very easy. The location is convenient, quiet and on a very pretty street. The space is clean, well equipped and comfortable. The back garden is an especially nice addition that is hard to come by for staying in New York! Sumitra is also very hospitable, quick to respond and accommodating. Highly recommend!
Great place to stay with a wonderful host
Great place to stay!
Mark’s place is two thumbs up! Loved it. Very spacious and comfortable. And Aesthetic is beautiful! Met all my solo traveler needs

Grâce à Ismael vous aurez un logement chaud et accueillant, avec une bonne literie, idéal pour se reposer après avoir parcouru tout New York! C'est un hôte très prévenant et qui se préoccupe des gens qu'il reçoit. C'était très bien!
Really amazing, huge place in a very walkable neighborhood. Would love to stay again
Good location to travel in Manhattan. A bit noisy by surround. I will reccommend to my friend and will be back here for sure!
Check in and out was easy. Great space! Easy to communicate. Highly recommend!!

Flat was very cosy, well looked after and in a very good location. Michael has been ind and attentive to our messages, checked in on us a few times and provided us with all the help that we needed.
Very good stay! Would totally recommend the place!
קרוב לתחנת הרכבת ובית הרב 770, השכונה קצת רועשת אבל אני מניח שזו ניו יורק... מתאים למשפחות, פחות לנשים שבאות לבד.

The room was unfortunately very dirty. The host did not communicate before hand that they only allow bookings by over 21 year Olds. Luckily this didn't affect us but needs to be made clearer. The stay was okay for the price.
exactly what I need. mini pumas the best! thanks for the welcoming stay
Great location and great space. We loved the place, and it was a great deal.

I absolutely loved staying at Michael’s AirBnB - it was clean, easy to access, and he was so communicative, and response. Honestly it’s a great layout - had really nice touches (like toiletries and bath towels folded creatively in room) - felt more like a hotel suite than anything else.
5 stars all around - and I loved the location too - just a really great place to stay. Thank you Michael!!
Amazing location, just a few minutes away from Penn station but on a quieter street that isn’t too loud or busy. Room was spotless, couldn’t recommend it enough!

Had a wonderful stay at Lori and John’s place. The apt is lovely with a genuine New York feels but quiet and private. Much appreciated was Lori’s gesture in making sure I am well settled and gave me a quick tour on the neighbourhood as well as making sure I have a ready breakfast of bagel, cream cheese and orange juice. The place is near the subway, groceries, restaurants etc and is safe to walk during the night especially for a solo traveler like me. I will definitely go back and stay in this apt on my next visit to NY.
Great location, clean and neat place. Matthew was a very responsive and friendly host. We will definitely stay here again when we come back to Brooklyn!

You can't find a better place in Brooklyn for the price!! Stores just a block away and really quiet neighbors and house and safe neighborhood too. Highly recommend it. I liked it so much, I extended my stay. She does a great job keeping the steps and walkway shoveled.

Very nice and homey place, they made us feel as if we were going to see family by waiting up for us until super late and the place was really nice. They are a very sweet couple. Absolutely recommend their place!

Appartement fonctionnel et bien équipé, idéalement situé dans le quartier vivant d Harlem. Nous n y sommes restés que pour dormir.
Literie confortable (canapé-lit), bien isolé du bruit.
Petit bémol : leger probleme d humidité dans la salle de bains que nous avons remonté à Charles.
Charles a toujours ete tres réactif dans ses reponses, et nous a donné des infos completes pour faciliter notre arrivee dans l appartement.

March 8, 2022
Jae’s place is a pretty safe choice for a monthly stay. The apartment has all the utensils you need, for cooking, cleaning, bathroom and sleeping. The lighting you get inside is a highlight, the floors are new and the table is big and foldable.
I stayed there for 2 months with my colleague, so we took turns on the bed and couch. As for most NY apartments, the sofa-bed is not optimal and actually sleeps better folded.
A few points to notice:
Wifi sometimes suffers some variations, but nothing more than for a period of the day somedays. The smart tv controls did not work very well, so you better install a device to mirror your smartphone.
The sealing of the windows are not exactly optimal, so you can expect some wind and noise entering. When cooking, it is better to leave them open, as the vent fans don’t handle all the job in removing the smells.
These are the only points that need attention, the rest is good.
Jae is a busy man so communication sometimes may suffer a few delays, but overall he will be there for any main issue.
Williamsburg is also a highlight, because it offers a more tranquil environment than Manhattan, still with everything you need and 5 stops away/20 minutes from the city by train (Montrose Station). We moved to a Manhattan place with the same budget and got ourselves a 2 bedroom but with no windows, tight living room and uncomfortable smells.
If you are staying here I recommend the Win Son Bakery right in front and the Sternberg park.

Chris was very kind and gave a very detailed explanation of how to get to and enter the apartment, which was excellent.
The place is exactly as he described, and the location is excellent. I highly recommend it
It was an amazing Airbnb! Mark it was an excellent host! I recommend it if you are visiting NYC! It’s pretty close to the subway, great area and amazing vibes in the apt

Solo podemos decir cosas buenas de Carlos. Desde la distancia nos ayudo mucho con información de NY y cuando llegamos nos coordinamos muy bien para la entrega de llaves. El apartamento es pequeñito pero "precioso". La habitación y la casa en general limpísima. La cama perfecta para los días que estuvimos andando sin parar por NY. El aire acondicionado de la habitación se agradecía en algunos días de calor. Todo funcionaba estupendamente, incluido el Wi-fi. Muchísimas gracias por todo Carlos, sin duda recomendable 100% !!!

Emil was a friendly and responsive host. He lives in the unit directly below, and he met us in person for check-in to explain how the locks worked. This was nice, but also in the age of Covid a fully contactless check-in option would have been preferred.
