The location was good, an easy ~10 minute or so walk to the metro. The neighborhood felt safe and easy to walk around. Overall I think this place needs some TLC but could do in a pinch if you need a simple spot in the area.
Great place to stay for a large group! The moderate walk to downtown is pleasant but is conveniently connected by bus. Ivanna was responsive and helpful during our stay.
Comfortable and stylish apartment! The only disadvantage is the noise from the subway and from the upper apartment.

Greg's place is awesome! Super clean, spacious and comfy. Has everything you need for an extended stay. The locationis perfect with a 2 minute walk to the train station and restaurants surrounded the place. Easy check in and Greg is super helpful. Will definitely stay here again!
Great location and good space for the value, train is literally 3min walk from Patrick’s place - would stay again
Super Lage, alles zu Fuß erreichbar. Waren begeistert

This is the second time I’ve stayed at Marek & Grace’s place; they are wonderful hosts. I love the apartment and the location. I live in Manhattan and come out all the time on day trips but being able to bring my dog; stay so close to the beach and be in the Rockaways for a week is heaven for me. We zijn goed ontvangen. Er waren duidelijke instructies om de woning binnen te komen. Foto’s komen overeen met werkelijkheid. We konden gemakkelijk communiceren bij vragen. Vanuit de woning waren we snel bij het openbaar vervoer.

Christopher's and Maya's place is a wonderful 3 story brownstone adorned with beautiful pictures taken by Maya's father. They were really easy to accommodate all 7 guests. The kitchen is well equipped and had all the necessities for making coffee or tea in the morning. The place is within a 5 to 10 minutes walk to the nearest train station. Strongly suggest to grab the crosstown bus to grab the express train just a few blocks away. Neighborhood is quite safe and irradiates authentic harlem environment. Place is clean, just as seen in pictures and great for parties of 5 or more. We had an excellent stay during our week in NYC.

Brett’s place was simply amazing. Super convenient, stylish, clean, comfy, and centrally located. Brett was an amazing host. He was very welcoming, extremely accommodating and quick to respond when needed. He really did make me feel right at home. He even left water, juice and beer to ensure my stay was pleasant. Brett’s place is exactly what I need and I truly enjoyed my stay. I would definitely stay here again.

The hotel is a very nice hotel and in a great location at 8 Ave and between 48th and 49th St. the Subway was across the street. The staff at the door and their housekeeping staff were very friendly and helpful. The whole hotel is clean. Enjoyed the complimentary coffee in the morning in the lobby and the complimentary wine and bites between 5-6pm.
I did find out that our IHG membership number could not be added since it was booked through AirBnB.
I loved staying here and will consider staying again in the near future.  The host was great, very nice and attentive.
Our stay at the Lexington was enjoyable. Check in was simple and easy. The location is also very nice as it’s close to many great places.

We travelled with our twin daugthers to visit New York. We had a wonderfull time in the charming house of Michael. Great location in Broockyng not far from several metro stations. Close to good restaurants and supermarkets. Michael was of great anphitrion during our stay in his house.

This cute English basement studio is a charming spot to be able to stay in Greenwich Village. It's tin ceiling is very pretty (although seems to block wifi and cell service a tiny bit where video calls are not always clear). The quaint wallpaper and wood floors make for nice interior design that feels historic New York. It's perfect for a short/medium stay, but being underground for a longer period may prove claustrophobic. Overall, though, it's a better price point than finding a hotel in West Village / Greenwich Village! A good stay, indeed.

What a beautiful home in a neat part of Brooklyn - a vintage house with contemporary design.  We had 3 couples stay over a long weekend while visiting New York, and while we were playing tourists in Manhattan, we loved that we could come back to this place for winding-down and much-needed rest. The house is spotless and well-appointed & maintained. Great living room to sit and gab about our adventures, and all 3 beds/bedrooms were comfortable and clean. It’s very close to the subway (took us about 35 minutes to get to midtown), and some neat neighborhood restaurants (we especially liked Zaca Cafe & Cloud 9 Crepes).  Our hosts were very attentive - even while they were traveling out of the country - quick responses and no issues.

I enjoyed my stay in Kyle's Airbnb a lot. The studio was clean and perfect for my purposes. It had a small but well equipped kitchen and a comfortable big bed as well as a clean bathroom. The location of the studio was good but to get to Manhattan it takes 50+ minutes by subway. However, Kyle is a really nice host. He always answered immediately when I needed something and resolved every problem within 10 minutes.
We had a good stay at Kasa in New York. It was conveniently located, nice to explore the neighbourhood.

I was so comfortable as Jazmin’s place. The apartment had everything I needed - coffee in the morning, a comfortable bedroom, and a peaceful outdoor space. Jazmine wasn’t home very much, so I often had the apartment all to myself. I would absolutely stay again.
Great place to stay. It is nice, clean, and close to everything. You will not be dissapointed.

Lesa is my angel!!! She helped me a lot for my first time trip to NYC. When I couldn’t find the place she picked me up and saved me from danger! She is such a nice lady with kind and care! My bedroom is clean and comfortable. I slept very good like home. The bathroom is nice with hot water. I feel 200% safe in Lesa’s home.  It was a lovely stay there! Thank you Lesa for everything!!!

One of the best experience in my life. Lovely house really close to subway, in a suggestive neighborhood. Everything was great, I definitely recommend this place. Many thanks to Pettrina and Mrs Monica, hope to see you soon!!!

Let me start with the obvious: Laurence provides a clean, spacious room with a private bathroom in a great neighborhood that is located near not one but two subway stations. Whether it was great food and bar recommendations or things to do, I loved all his suggestions. I started each day of my visit while sharing stories with Laurence, and flipping through his various photobooks. I could give you recommendations, but let Laurence give you his picks when you book your stay here. The bed was comfy, the building is great, the windows to the courtyard add a little ✨, and I’d stay here again and again.

Wonderful host and lovely place! Great outdoor space and very comfortable all around. Will definitely come back!

Place is as per listed

My family and I had a great stay here. The staff were very friendly.  We were greeted each day and asked how our stay was going and how they could help. The room is just as described and the room for 3 people was fine for two adults and one child. It would have felt cramped for three adults. We had a lovely stay. It was easy to get to the subway and was very walkable. Great stay.

Beautiful and spacious loft. I was lucky to have the whole space to myself during my stay but was unlucky not to be able to compliment Deborah on her beautiful flat in person. Would definitely recommend.

Troy's place was exactly as advertised. It was one bedroom in an apartment that had plenty of privacy for our trip, and allowed us to be about as close as we possibly could to Times Square. The room was clean, and spacious enough to fit all of our bags from our travels also. It was up multiple flights of stairs so if that is not your thing, just be aware of that. Troy was great! He was very detailed in the check-in, showing us how to access both the apartment and the room we would be staying in. He was also able to provide us with a few tips on things to do around town, which was helpful since we were just visiting the city for a few days and needed some ideas. Overall it was a great place and we would recommend Troy's place to anyone looking to stay in the area!

Space is rather good when other guests are not there.
I could hear my housemates and the kids downstairs. Walls are just a bit thin.
House was warm for the season.
Room had everything as it showed.
No complaints from me.

Spartan set-up with an extremely comfortable bed and impeccably clean bathroom! I read a review that mentioned the bedroom door not having a lock, however I can confirm it DOES have a lock now. Malik is as kind and lovely as it gets. Will stay again!!

Christian was an excellent host and provided very clear check-in instructions with photos that I appreciated. The space is comfortable with a nice large living room area. The neighborhood is really nice and quiet, which is great after coming back from visiting all of the bustling sights around the city. The place was really clean and overall very comfortable.
A few things I wish I would've known:
Strict no guest policy - not the fault of the host and totally understandable, but Airbnb's website makes the rules hard to find, and it wasn't apparent in the description. I misinterpreted the "guest access" section of the description. I was visiting friends and it would've been nice to have them be able to drop by.
Noise - This is in the host's basement and there doesn't seem to be any insulation in the ceiling, so conversations and footsteps are very audible.
Overall great place and excellent host though!

Location was good & check in was so easy! But the room itself was dirty. Bathroom had a used washcloth in the shower & a large amount of long hair in the shower drain. As for bedding… there was legit a hard booger on a pillow case which makes me think they didn’t change the bed sheets in between guests.
We love Marjorie's space and are repeat guests. It just gets better and better !!!

Our stay was awesome! This neighborhood is the perfect mix of having plenty to do/see/eat while being much calmer than Times Square. The place was clean and safe. We needed somewhere to sleep and shower and for the price this was perfect. The host also sent a million emails/texts before check-in and check-out so the instructions and codes were readily available. Would definitely stay here again!

Seth and his boyfriend Sam were super friendly and the apartment is close to very hot spot and great blocks in downtown. Seth has recommended me all the cool places to go around the city and was super cool letting me joined them watching Project Runway and The good wife together. They are the coolest hosts I could get!Would love to go to the city and visit them again.

Loved staying here while our apartment is being remodeled due to a burst pipe. Tarebs place was close our restaurant/work and made us feel very comfortable during a difficult time. Everything was perfect! The apartment was beautiful and very clean and we Ioved that there were multiple doors/cameras for added security. They even had a super cool heated fan in the bathroom to warm you when you get out of the shower.  All in all a wonderful stay, we didn't want to leave and would definitely book again!

Lieber Mory, wir haben uns in der Wohnung sehr wohl gefühlt. Der Check-in war etwas schwierig, das liegt nur an dem Schloss. Deine Nachbarin war sehr hilfsbereit und die Lage des Apartments ist toll. vielen Dank Susanne
Great place for a group of friends nice and central if a little noisy but couldn’t have chosen better

I'm thrilled I selected this room for my 5-day trip to NYC with my friend. The communication was very easy because Luosong was very quick to reply to my questions before and during the trip. The house and the room were very clean. Luosong allows us to drop our bags at the house before the check-in time (to enjoy the city when we get to NY). We were able to use the kitchen, the TV, and the wifi. Moreover, the metro station is only 10 minutes walk. You can get to Times Square in 20-25min from the metro! We can't complain...
Good place. Joseph is very friendly and will assist you.
The room view was incredible! Our stay went smooth, easy check-in, walking distance to subway, restaurants, mall, and much more. Host was kind and responsive. Definitely recommend this place.
I really enjoyed my stay and will happily book again! Looked like the pictures and was very clean! Hosts were super nice and responsive

Mari is the perfect host! She was responsive and helpful.
The apartment is exactly as described. We loved the Upper West Side neighbourhood. It's nice, quiet and very close to Central Park and the metro. We highly recommend!
It's a good price and it is convenient to get to the city. It's a noisy neighborhood, but quiet from about 12 midnight till 7 am. It's a good place to stay.
todo perfecto. buen precio comparado con otros. funciona para dormir. la ubicación es cómoda ya que podés caminar a todos lados. hay lugares para comer cerca.

Walker was a great host.
What really meant to me was that the option that i could leave my luggage before check in and after check out instead of carrying it with me in all the time.
His place was clean and everything was as described.
Swann est très gentil et toujours de bons conseils. L’appartement est spacieux et propre. Nous le conseillons.

Easily walkable from bus or subway stations. Convenience stores on 2 nearby corners.
Fluffy towels for bath/shower. Well stocked kitchen for most cooking needs. Easy checkin with precise directions. Air conditioners in each bedroom and in the living space made each space comfortable to your own temperature and added white noise to tune out street noise or conversations in other parts of the house. Well cared for accommodation that easily slept 6 adults. Would stay here again!
Great place just as advertised and super comfy.

My favorite block in all of New York City. This is a beautiful neighborhood, lined with big trees and stately brownstones. Great restaurants, coffee shops, cool bars, and great parks. The house is beautiful, the rooms are large and just as photographed. Most importantly, George is a really special man and phenomenal host. He welcomed me heartily and made me feel right at home. The hospitality, location, and price are unbeatable. I’ll be staying here on all future trips to NYC. Thank you!!
El señor Freddy es muy amable y cordial, está presto a tus necesidades y ayudarte. La habitación cómoda, tal como se ve en fotos, fácil acceso

Si tuviera aire acondicionado la experiencia hubiera sido más agradable. La habitación es muy pequeña, el parqueo fue un poco difícil, entra mucha claridad por las ventanas, precio muy alto para lo que ofrecen.

Me hospedei no apartamento por 2 meses . Foi incrível. A localização é boa , perto da Times Square e sem barulho ! O espaço é confortável , chuveiro quente , aquecedor funcionando . Obrigada pela hospitalidade . Foi incrível . Pretendo voltar .
Great location, close to train. There is a lot of stuff in the apartment making it feel more like someone’s apt vs Airbnb.
Thanks for having us. The place was exactly as described. Host was super responsive when needed. Easy access. Very spacious!

We were attending a show a UBS arena, and this location was ideal for us! It was raining, so we didn't walk, but it was just a quick ten minute uber. Madelyn was helpful and responsive when I had a question about the parking situation (we easily found a spot across from the place). This space was pristine, quiet, spacious, and lovely. We'd stay again!
Doug is a great host! Super responsive. The place is in a really phenomenal location as well.

La chambre était petite mais le lit super confortable, pas de vis à vis. L'appartement lui-même propre et confortable, très bien desservi par les lignes de métro.
Nia a été une très belle rencontre également. Elle ne vit pas à l'appartement mais y passe régulièrement pour assurer le nettoyage. Elle a été une hôte parfaite.
Je recommande vivement cette adresse et les 2 chambres à l arrière de l a''appartement qui sont moins exposés au bruit du métro.
Nice and quiet are the words best described about this place. I had an enjoyable experience and I'd highly recommend this room to anyone looking
Cute place. Clean and convenient to everything.

It’s a beautiful, clean, peaceful wonderful place to be. I really liked everything about the place I would recommend for anyone to book. Surely I will be booking again thank you for the stay in the hospitality. The host was a great person and easy to get in contact with.

Yotlaire is an amazing host! Amazing to say the least. He is responsive, helpful and so kind. The place was extremely clean.
You can tell that they clean the apartment with so much care not just to get the job done. It is the best of the best and I so appreciated it.
I loved my stay at this apartment. It has everything you would need, an ac, nice kitchen, comfortable bed, couch, tv, table to do work and dine and nice bathroom and with all that I did not feel smushed in a small space. I felt like I had plenty of room to move around and live.
As you can tell, I loved this place. I didn’t want to leave and I have lived in a lot of places in the city as well as tons of airbnbs. This is by far one of my favorites.
Thank you, Yotlaire! You rock and your care for your guests and the home are much appreciated! Hope to return again.
Great stay clean place would recommend for others
Great location in Brooklyn and the apartment has everything you could need.

Chrissy's place was great to stay in--clean, well-stocked, and private. Plenty of room and a huge kitchen and backyard area that could be fun to take advantage of in warmer months. Despite being near a hospital the street was very quiet. For light sleepers--you will hear walking and some talking from overhead, but that is to be expected in NYC.
Overall a very cute, clean place to stay, and the murphy bed was very comfortable!

La habitación es espaciosa, con ventana a la calle. La ubicación es muy buena, tiene metro para todos lados y además negocios abiertos hasta tarde. El ambiente en general es tranquilo. El apartamento está impecable y las mascotas son encantadoras, un precioso sitio para quedarse en Manhattan.

Erica's place was absolutely perfect for our weekend trip. We loved the neighborhood and Erica was the nicest person and gave us local recommendations. Check-in was so easy and Luna is the sweetest little pooch! Would definitely stay again! Thanks Erica!!
Great place to stay at !!
Lovely neighborhood, lovely stay, lovely host. Absolutely fascinating history to the place. Thank you, Alaric!
Location was excellent.  Walking distance to Central Park, Museums, and delicious restaurants.

Overall our stay was good.  The room is small but it was clean and enough for a 1 or 2 night stay.   The heat was on very high in the room and we had to open the window to cool it down.  A technician can up and shared with us the issue with the heat and was very friendly and even found my wife a few extra pillows.      .
Great host. responsiv, clean place and overall a great experience
Tash had great communication and the room was good for a couple nights. Just what I needed.

Seamless flexible check-in/ out. Scott was super fast at responding, it was a little cold when we got to NYC and Scott was being super fast at responding to our request and raised the heating temperature for us. Only 5 min walk to subway which takes you to downtown Manhattan in 30min and only 5 stops to Williamsburg hipster capital! The place is clean, spacious and comfortable. We really liked it there.
Thank you Scott!

The location of Angelika’s apartment is more than perfect. ( a brisk walk to our favourite coffee shop La Cabra every morning, two beautiful, 2 charming parks just five minutes away, and some other great restaurants all within walking distance)
The apartment ( more like a duplex) is huge and beautifully furnished. It also easily hold 4 guests comfortably. The balcony is a bonus! And the fully equipped kitchen has everything one needs for cooking including spices, flours, dried beans etc.. My wife loves the kitchen! Our host Angelika appears whenever we need her help/instructions then she disappears. My wife adores her and Ares, her puppy!
This is the best Airbnb apartment we have discovered and stayed in NYC since 2012! And we really look forward to staying at her place in the future!

Great value for money if you drive. New clean space with many thoughtful touches. You will not escape noise. It is building with possibly 4/6 apartments and there is always some noise. Someone was watching TV till 4 am and either walls are not insulated or thin but good luck trying to have quite time.
There is TV in the room that was loud and I could not adjust volume so rather than annoying others I did not watch.
Good AC so on a very hot day, I was comfortable.
Overall good value.

Lovely, comfortable place to stay just half a block from the Rockaway Beach and boardwalk. Everything we needed was there--very thoughtful touches, such as a bottle of wine and chocolates on the coffee table, water bottles in the fridge, all the kitchen equipment you could want or need, Keurig coffeemaker with creamer and sugar supplied, bathroom equipped with nice toiletries--plus the use of a very pretty enclosed garden in the back of the house. Marek was very attentive and available to help with anything you need. We can't wait to visit again.
Perfect location for a first week in NYC. Place is small but good
We had a really nice time staying at Mo's place.  The effort put into the living space is evident throughout. Would definitely recommend. Thanks again.

Dawn and Mike were brilliant hosts. Great home, easily accessible to buses to get to the subway and around New York. Good communicators. Close to the airport, lovely park to walk around just around the corner. Had a great stay with our family.

Hemos pasado unos días fantásticos junto a Allen y Ann en su preciosa casa!! El lugar es idílico y sus desayunos con café recién hecho al levantarse eran increíbles, acompañados de su siempre acogedora  compañía. La ubicación es muy buena para conocer Brooklyn y estar bien comunicado con Manhattan. Volveremos a visitarles!!
We had a super stay at Laura's guest house!
Die Wohnung ist super schön und sehr sauber, die Innenstadt ist auch super zu erreichen. Wir fühlten uns sehr wohl in der Wohnung Top Empfehlung!!!

Had an amazing stay at Stephen’s home - couldn’t have asked for anything better in an apartment or a host!
He even shared freshly baked cookies one night - the best!

Regina's place is an absolute gem 💎
The place is advertised as a room in an apartment but in reality it's more like a studio! The place is very spacious and private and it was packed with all the essentials. Regina was very nice and accommodating. I'm sure I'll come back in the future!

This was my first airbnb experience, and it couldn't have been more perfect! The place is amazing and extremely well stocked, and only min walk from the subway as well. It had every possible thing we could have needed during our stay, including a fully stocked kitchen and bathroom, and even food and supplies we were welcome to use. Chuck greeted us in person on arrival and was always prompt with answering any questions throughout the stay. He was extremely kind, friendly, and went above and beyond to help us with any questions we had regarding directions and transportation or anything else. This was by far the best experience I’ve had renting an apartment. Highly recommend!

Beau logement bien placé
Super pour découvrir manathan

If I could rate a 10 star I definitely would. My husband and I enjoyed ourselves and felt right at home. They were very respectful, responsive, and  organized to all of our needs. We are looking forward to booking with Daniela again in the near future. Thank you for your hospitality!!!!!
Listing is accurate. The location by the highway is surprisingly quiet, and the neighborhood is pleasant. I enjoyed my stay.

This was our first time in New York City and Richard’s place made it feel like home! Very central right next to public transport, felt very safe and the space itself was so clean and cozy. Lots of space heaters around that we were so happy to have as we stayed in the winter time! we even said we will most likely stay again for a future trip and would recommend to our friends as well. Thank you Richard!

Al llegar al lugar nos encontramos con el apartamento sucio basura en los zafacon, el inodoro sucio, la bañera llena de pelos. No tenía detergente para la limpieza tuvimos que comprarla nosotros y limpiar el lugar.
La ubicación es aceptable y el lugar tranquilo.
Very nice overall experience. Jozef was a very kind and reasonable host

This apartment is exactly as stated. Clean, spacious and most of all convenient for tourist attractions in Times Square. Ariana is very polite and attentive. Her husband was also very kind and showed great hospitality. 5 stars all around!
Thomas is a really nice guy and it was great to be with him. If I ever come back to New York I will stay here again. Thank you Thomas.
Great location and value. My favorite stay since using Airbnb.
Clean and comfortable accommodations.  Would stay again!
Great space with South facing windows for lots of light.

Andrea & Sebastian were very good hosts, way much better than we expected.. very nice and easygoing. Gave really good recommendations about where to do candy and medicine shopping, and very helpful about the luggage situation. We appreciated everything in the airbnb for the days we had it, thank you for everything and looking forward to see you someday again :)
Louann’s place was amazingly clean.  She was extremely polite and hospitable.    The amenities offered by Louann were amazing too.  All around great stay.  Thank you!

This was a great place to stay for our weekend trip to NYC.   Patio in back was awesome with great views of planes landing at LGA airport.   Very close to bus stop and restaurants nearby within walking distance. Very nice place to chill after a day in the city.
Loved it - very comfy bed, in the heart of Manhattan. Super useful for a last-minute stay.
Great Place to stay.
Tutto ok. Lou è un ottimo host disponibile e attento. C'era tutto quello che avevo bisogno. Mi ha fatto piacere soggiornare qui.
Great little studio! Super clean, has everything you need, close to the subway, and the bed was so comfy! I checked in late and it was super easy with the door codes. I’ll be staying here again!

Hope and Raj's apartment was the perfect place for us to stay for a couple of weeks. It was so spacious and cozy that we would have happily stayed longer.
There is everything you need in the kitchen, enough furniture in the bedroom to hang or fold your clothes in, a washer&dryer, good Wi-Fi, two bathrooms and even an access to the rooftop from where you can see the Empire State Building and the Chrysler building!
Hope is very helpful and reacted quickly to our messages.
Everything was clean and as shown in the pictures, plus the location was great. We highly recommend Hope & Raj's apartment!
Very disappointed that I was not allowed to check in at 3pm. There was no phone service whatsoever. Calls to front desk went unanswered and I gave up .

This was a great place for its price. If you’re like me and you don’t mind taking public transit (subways & busses) then this is a great place. It’s a little bit of a ride into the city, but I tend to stay out all day so this is was okay with me. The check in instructions literally were so great especially because I had never been to New York before. If those instructions with pictures hadn’t been there I would’ve been so lost. I like the private entrance and privacy. It was nice.

Emilia and Michael were wonderful hosts. In addition to having a beautiful home, they left coffee yogurt and granola there for me so I didn't have to go food shopping as soon as I landed.
The home itself is beyond gorgeous. It was absolutely pristine, having only been renovated a month prior.
The tidy and uncluttered space help me clear my head at the end of each day and relax in an environment that felt nothing like the city right outside. The back deck was also such a rare treat for an apartment in Brooklyn.
The apartment is located right at the nexus of the few amazing neighborhoods. Fort Greene itself has so much amazing food and great shops and is one of the few spots in Brooklyn that still feels like it has a beating heart. There's plenty open late and open early.
I'm grateful that Emilia and Michael went above and beyond to make sure I was comfortable and checked in on me a few times to see if there was anything that I needed. It reminded me of my first Airbnb experiences five or six years ago where the hosts took care of you and tried to make you feel at home when you were away from yours.
The place is so beautiful and very clean! There is a bathroom in the bedroom which is awesome. Will come back again!
We had a lovely stay here. G was very friendly and helped us when needed. Would definitely recommend staying here :-)

Our stay in Annabel's house was very pleasant. It was very spacious and clean with all necessary amenities nearby. The ferry to Manhattan is just 50 minutes and costs $4! The beach is only a kilometer away and we enjoyed it, very much recommended!

nice location、
its very convenience to everywhere
my english is not good enough.
thx for Cynthia have more paitience to me
And she gave me more space in the apt
even if i always take a bath very early in the morning.
have a nice trip to stay here.
Nice clean well appointed place.  The location was great for walking to restaurants and other sites.  We enjoyed our stay!

Robert has a charming historic railroad style apartment that is actually bigger than the pictures suggest. He is very prompt with responses to questions, even when we emailed questions at 10:30 at night. He has a very helpful set of notes about the neighborhood - it's a largely Caribbean neighborhood. It's a few blocks from the subway, so well connected. Our toddler did find the neighborhood a bit uncomfortable whenever we came back late at night - seeming to be nervous of the infrequent cars and people passing by. But maybe she's just used to more of a bustling neighborhood, coming from India.

My hubby and I recently spent 3 nights at Jazz's place. We were pleasantly surprised with the long layout of the space,  and how private it seems when you walk in. We chose his place for the central Willamsburg location, as we went on a foodie vacay with the majority of the Willamsburg restos we visited within a 7-20 minute walk of his place. Getting around by transit was also easy to pick up, and nearby. The apt is on a relatively quiet part of the street but close to main roads with lots of shops, cafes etc. Overall it was great! My only suggestion is more for travellers who will be doing a lot of walking: pack some indoor slippers! My feet were hurting units after each day and I regretted not packing slippers since the apartment is hardwood and tiled floor. Enjoy your travels!

The room was exactly as described and a perfect location to be able to get anywhere in NYC while maintaining a quiet atmosphere. Everything was clean and the ensuite bathroom was clean and convenient! The folks who helped us check in were very friendly as well, definitely recommend!
Tako is a friendly and responsive host. I enjoyed the conversation with her and the music!
This was an excellent place! Our host Olenka lived up to and surpassed all expectations! Next time I travel to NY I’m making sure I book her place again! 5 stars!
Stunning rooftop Terrance, large space with lots of storage available and fantastic location!

maria is a great hostess :) the apartment smells good and is very cozy, when there was a problem with the wifi, she quickly took care of it. Unfortunately there is no washing machine BUT there is a laundromat near the nearest metro station. In itself it is well connected, at night I didn't feel particularly comfortable in the area as a woman - but that's not Maria's fault, I would like to say - don't be too stingy for an uber from the station to the air bnb!
Maria is really sweet, would recommend her anytime :)
Lovely spot by the park that's quiet at night. Anna is a friendly and warm host, the stay was very comfortable.
Beyond happy with my stay. Nothing but positive reviews!
Safe, clean, excellent location just off Times Square. This was an excellent place to stay!

It was my first time in the AIRBNB experience as guest. I was travelling with another one and spent 4 nights in NYC.  Yaniv’s flat was amazing: safe and central area, very close to Times Square and Broadway, few blocks from Central Park, with a clean and comfortble bedroom and totally good privacy.  Yaniv is a cool and open-mind guy and helped us in all I needed about my touristic doubts... suggesting and giving tips to better enjoy the city. We felt as we were at our own home.  Next time in NYC I am quite sure that I will stay in Yaniv’s place.
Stayed here beforeAnd will be back to stay here again

Amazing stay! Location is great (recommend the restaurant right down the street, Lola Taverna). Highlights: great towels, quiet residential street, clean, quick communication from the host, easy check in. For anyone who wants a good night sleep and walkable location to the surrounding areas, this is your place.

The check-in should’ve been done at 3pm, we reached there at 3pm and the room was still unclean so we had to wait for 40min to get our room. We have also communicated that we are 3 guests and we haves confirmed with Brooklyn before booking if the room has enough space for 3 people and whether an extra bed and mattress will be provided, unfortunately that wasn’t the case. The room was prepared for only 1 person and even the extra bed that has been provided later wasn’t appropriate. Very unformtable and very thin basic mattress that caused me back pain. I have communicated this with the host but she wasn’t cooperative.Also, I do no recommend it during the winter, the small heating machine wasn’t enough to warm out the wind.
Great price for NYC! Good location with ample parking which was important to me. Basic hotel but very much worth the price and the hotel breakfast was good too. I’d stay here again.

Shully is an amazing host. Her attention to detail is phenomenal. The apartment was very nice and perfect for our stay. Also the bed is the most comfortable bed I've ever slept on. Shully also provided us with a stocked fridge which was kind. I would definitely stay her again and again.

Our family had a wonderful stay at Negra's Airbnb in Astoria/Queens. The two-bedroom apartment was clean, well-maintained, and was spacious enough to comfortably accommodate our group of four. The location was perfect—just a short walk to the subway station, which gave us easy access to all the places we wanted to visit in Manhattan.
We loved coming back to this quiet, cozy apartment to cook dinner and unwind after our adventures. The proximity to the Food Bazaar grocery store was a bonus, making it easy to pick up fresh ingredients for meals. Negra, our host, was incredibly responsive and provided excellent local recommendations, adding even more value to our stay.
Plus, the convenience of being only a few miles from LaGuardia airport made our travel days much smoother. We highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone visiting Manhattan or the surrounding boroughs. It truly made our trip memorable!

this is a beautiful juliet  where our family  has everything we needed we were so grateful it was available! Great communication from the host and a very thorough handbook would like to family  come back again someday

(This review is for the 1st floor where we stayed). Lucy was an exceptional host. She was responsive almost immediately, and was very accomodating to our requests.  She is a kind and caring person and goes above and beyond to make sure everything is fine.  The space had been recently remodeled and everything was done beautifully as you will see in the photos. The space was exceptionally clean.  The wifi was good. Would highly recommend and would definitely stay again!

We very much enjoyed our stay at the Airbnb. Quiet and uninterrupted. At the age of 80 we found the stairs very steep to access our room. Would preferrd to have more than a stool and portable, minature table for eating. The kitchen area was recently remodeled and was done nicely. Washer and dryer seemed out of place in the kitchen but nice to have available. Would loved to have had a toaster available. Bed and bedroom were very comfortable but closet had things already hanging up. Plenty of security cameras.
Lisa went out of her way to send us a forgotten device that we left. That kind of response left a great impression upon us both..
Great location and accommodation
Eva was amazing! She let me know places to attend in the area. The place was as advertised and the pictures are exactly what you get. Shower was the highlight for me! Appreciate the hospitality!
Regiane's place was a great base for visiting NYC, located in a pleasant neighbourhood and close to the Union Square metro. Regiane was very efficient with communication and check in.

Well located, this boutique hotel is so well placed, within a 10 minute walk of Central Park and a similar walk to Riverside Park. 89th St is only 2 blocks away for your subway connection. Lots of cool restaurants in an authentic New York neighbourhood.

Gabriel’s space was in a great location, though we unfortunately did not get to stay at the space due to a last minute illness. Gabriel was very responsive and respectful of our last minute cancellation.

I can't express highly enough my experience. Marta is absolutely amazing and a gentle host. Her lovely home is warm and welcoming, I was extremely impressed. Just a serene atmosphere and well decorated. I personally shared with her, she should update her pictures on the website because her home in person shows better.  OMG I slept like a newborn after taking a bath in her roman size tub and the mattress was just right. The neighborhood is quite delightful, quiet and and safe.  Marta allowed me and my friend to remain in the home until our evening flight due to scheduling changes. Outstanding host, best ever with a splendid home. I would highly recommend her place to anyone looking to stay in NYC even though her home is in Queens.
This place was great! Loved the decor and all the plants, beds were very comfy, Benjamin was helpful and communicative!

The stay was great the place was great I love it here went on the balcony a few times access to transportation was good supermarket was in walking distance and most of all the hose deserves six stars. I recommend this place and host.
Notre séjour chez Layland était paisible nous avons passé de très bonnes vacances !

This place was awesome. Enjoyed the quietness of the neighborhood. Conveniently located to family and friends while visiting. Will most definitely rent again if stay is minimum days or longer. Host response were quick and good hospitality. Only suggestion, would had been nice  to have TV in bedroom too.
I just needed a place to take a rest between two long flights. So I just spent for a few hours during the day. It was fine for that purpose. It was a bit cold though.
Alex was really nice and helpful. It was very relaxing to stay at his really nice apartment close to beach.

Had a great stay at Anmarie's place! The space was clean and the fridge was filled with soda, juice, and eggs. It was a delight to stay at Anmarie's and I would recommend anyone who's looking to stay in BK/NYC to stay here.
This place was great! Loved the accommodations and the location.

Travis' flat is great, beautiful and perfectly represents the spirit of Brooklyn's Park Slope. He is a perfect host, extremely kind and helpful, very quick and efficient when a question comes up.
We had a wonderful family holiday in NY in his perfectly located home, close to the subway, to Prospect Park and to the heart of Park Slope. We strongly recommend his home !
Would definitely stay here again. Everything was as described.

Darin was great. She'll give you a set of keys so you can lock your individual room if that's a worry. The apartment is in Gramercy which is a good neighborhood, and I always felt safe. Would recommend for a friend

Location was really convenient, a 2 mins walk from the subway, 15 mins subway ride to the main areas of time square and Central Park and very accessible to most general tourist attractions. Pleasant area with food conveniently available too.
Jolly was very accommodating for check in and communication was great. A nice space in a nice area, happy with the stay and the value. Thanks!

A wonderful and home-y stay! “Cozy Nest” is the perfect description for it. Definitely a hidden gem; it felt better than some hotels. Nicole has it set up very nicely, and she was very helpful and friendly. I couldn’t recommend this more, and I will be staying here again :)

Nick and I are neighbors but we hadn't met, and my parents were coming to town so I wanted to rent an apt near by for them to stay and decided to go with his. I live in the area so I can honestly say this is a fantastic location. From Nick's front door you're one block away from the amazing prospect park, and one block away from the F&G subway stop (20min to SoHo, and under 30min to Flatiron).

Checking in was easy and hassle free. The apartment is spacious and accurately represented in the photos.

Bottom line, this was a great find and will provide you a unique NYC experience at a really fair price.

Easy walk from the subway. Quite spacious by the New York standards. Lots of natural light/sun.
Older building but the bathroom and Kitchen is remodeled so things work well.

We truly enjoyed our stay at Marisa and Colin's apt. We appreciated that they have kept the rate accessible, it is more than reasonable for the space offered, especially when compared with hotel rates in Brooklyn, never mind Manhattan! We found it to be conveniently located at about a 10-minute walk to several subway lines, and others were easily access by a longer walk or cab ride. Getting into Manhattan, esp Lower East Side was a breeze. We also enjoyed walking around the surrounding neighborhoods. Marisa and Colin's apt is probably best suited for no more than two people traveling together as the second bedroom is small with a pullout sofa bed. We traveled as a couple and found it to be comfortable and perfect for our needs. They have decorated it with a wonderfully curated minimal collection of flea market finds, art and books. A wonderful hybrid between hotel and home stay.

Tahirou was a great host and the place was exactly what I needed. He helped me everytime that I asked him for something. I didn't have any problems at all and that made my first time visiting NY, even more enjoyable. Highly recommended.

Our stay at Elizabeth's was wonderful. Her location's easy access (within a
block's distance) to all shops, restaurants and subway made our trip easy and
fun! The bedroom, kitchen and LR space was great for relaxing and recharging.
Couldn't find a more gracious landlady. Will definitely be staying with Elizabeth
again. (A+ rental opportunity)

Spacious 3 bedroom. Plenty of towels were provided. Sheets felt nice. Each bedroom has a tv. There’s a mirror in the living room in addition to the bathroom (FYI for the ladies who need to do make up). The family downstairs was nice. The only recommendation I would say is to add a full length mirror somewhere.
The place was spotless and clean. Walkable to the public transit. Great location. Would definitely recommend it and stay there again.

A great find for sure...Brian was so clear with directions via email. He sent me step by step directions on the location of his door with visuals, the location of where to pick up my keys, since he had to work when I arrived. Then step by step instructions on how to key into his building, his apartment door.
The location is easy to find and easy to access. Just as he described it on the site. No surprises and perfect for my visit. The apartment was perfect. When I arrived, he has pages of instructions on house rules, how to handle the heat, the tv and the kitchen waiting for you in the bedroom. Brian covers it all. Emergency contacts and list of special sites, eateries and all.
Brian’s apartment is a simple walk from Time Square and the subway. Of course, Hell’s Kitchen is the best place to stay when you visit the city. Can’t go wrong and you can’t go wrong with Brian as a host. He is available by text and emails and truly opens his apartment to his guest.
The bedroom as big enough for me and would be for two. There is a window for light, but not much of a view. But that is not important. There is great storage. Dresser, cupboards and a closet with hangers. There is also space for your luggage, which is nice.
The rest of the apartment is nicely decorated and gives you space to relax to read or watch TV.
Brian helped me out when I thought I lost my phone and needed access the web. He happened to show up while I was in the apartment and let me use his phone to find my phone, which was with friend in their car. I found it and got it, thanks to Brian taking the time.
There are so many local stores, coffee shops, drug stores, and restaurants within minutes from this location. He mentioned a bar located downstairs, and you can hear the music, but it really just becomes white noise and I slept like a baby.
It is what it is, an apartment in Hell’s Kitchen...no frills, but perfect to visit the city. A great deal and great host.
Thank you Brian.
Perfect for traveling alone, nice little room, really close to Underground and Central Park

If you want a quiet tucked away stay in Brooklyn, this is where you’d go. Close to restaurants, coffee shops, and more, it is well worth it. I look forward to booking with Chris again! He was super responsive, hospitable, and recommended a fabulous local florist. 10/10! 🤩
The nicest host I have ever met.

I highly recommend staying at Gloceridas!  She is the best host I've ever met in my life. The accommodation is perfect – everything is clean, functional, and well-equipped. You feel at home there. The surroundings are truly amazing, it's a very quiet neighborhood with a beautiful and, above all, safe community. If I return to the Bronx, I would be delighted to stay here again :)
Awesome time staying at John and Trang's! Sweet 3-story setup. Two spacious bedrooms and an awesome upstairs kitchen and dining/lounge areas. Close to subway and TONS of dining and activities.

We loved staying at Richard's place. Loved the location,
the proximity to everything we needed including groceries,
restaurants and coffee shops, and subway stations. The place
was comfortable and clean.
We would definitely choose to stay here again!

Sarah and her husband stayed up late into the night to welcome us to their home. The brownstone was fantastic with lots of space and charm. We felt privileged to be able to stay in such a wonderful environment.   The three rooms offered ample space, much better than squeezing our family of four into one hotel room. The owners were gracious hosts and offered suggestions and recommendations for places to visit. Highly recommended- wonderful couple and property.
She is a gracious and hospitable hostess
Good location but it’s not worth the price paid

Minha estadia no apartamento do Léo foi sensacional, estava tudo muito lindo, organizado e limpo, exatamente como nas fotos. Sua hospitalidade me fez sentir em casa desde o primeiro momento.

It was great for my family of 5. Woke up and could look at the empire state building. Within walking distance of all of the Manhattan sites.
Fantastic apartment with a real wow factor! Fantastic location, lots of restaurants shops and galleries nearby. Subway really close. Loved it!

Had a great stay in a great neighborhood. So close to the subway, both the L and the J. Communication was clear and fast, the room and common areas were clean, cozy, and welcoming. The place had a great vibe. A great place to rest in between our ventures into the city.
We had an excellent time, as good as advertised. Yulia was very helpful, Cafe Colonial was an excellent suggestion:)
Great stay and great location. very comfortable. Would stay here again.
Jacqueline’s place is amazing!

I can't heap enough praise onto Doug and his place for such a great stay in Brooklyn. The location is suburb given its proximity to transit to Manhattan, but the neighborhood is also fantastic (Fort Greene Park, Center for Fiction, bars, restaurants, coffee, Greenlight Books). Despite its central location, the street is also quiet, peaceful, and picturesque (brownstones galore). The mattress and linens were high quality and comfy, and the house was silent for sleeping. Doug is the most communicative and friendly host I've yet to encounter. He's readily available and willing to help. Can't wait to go back and take advantage of the backyard!
Shavanne made it easy for us to stay here and took great care of us💙.
Great location, large room, great host but shared bathroom not for everyone

Alles in Allem hatten wir einen angenehmen Aufenthalt bei Jessica. Der erste Eindruck war sehr positiv und man hat sich gleich wohlgefühlt.

Unterkunft ist weiterzuempfehlen, wenn man kein Problem damit hat einen etwas längeren Weg auf sich zu nehmen, um nach Manhattan zu kommen.

The place was so awesome and cozy. Barb was amazing and was very responsive, understanding, and helpful. Lots of nice restaurants nearby and good shops. Great area! And lovely home…
Great experience and fantastic view of World Trade Center!!

Nice and clean apartment, perfect for a large group of people. Safe neighborhood even at night.  Recommended!
Nice, clean place for vacation!

Room was OK. Clean. Bathroom clean. Easy access to the room. Although bedding was different color. Other guests were loud at night and early in the morning in the kitchen. Never met Lolita.

everything was good we enjoyed but the thing is when you pay for cleaning fee its supposed to be cleaning while you stay

We had a group of friends visiting NYC and we stayed at Danny’s loft for three days this July. The place was perfect; a giant common room to hang out, eat, and relax a little after walking all around the city. Open kitchen floor plan with multiple sitting areas in the large common space.
The bedrooms and bathrooms were clean and comfortable, divided out in two sections on either side of the big living room. There is also a separate, smaller living room by the back bedrooms. The art work on the walls was cool too.
Location was exactly as stated, steps away from all the great restaurants in Chinatown and Little Italy and the Canal Street subway line is a two minute walk. Communication experience throughout was great. We recommend this loft, it’s just what we were looking for to accommodate our big group.
Great location - very walkable. But their AC seriously needs deep cleaning! Besides that AC, everything was pretty okay.
Convenient location to ferry, all uphill though. Unit was clean but ceiling fan light was broken and hanging quite low. Neighborhood is not well lit. Unit has a lot of space for NY.
Decent place in flower market
A very convenient location in the heart of Greenwich Village.  A cute little noodle shop on the first floor.
I loved it! But expected a bugger kitchen! Thank you! Everything was perfect!

I loved my stay at Masoud's stuido. It is the best equipped AirBnB I've ever stayed at. It is also charming and very well located. I felt right at home and so comfortable immediately. I liked being on the upper floor above the bakery. The heater worked very well. the bathroom is small but the kitchen provides plenty of space for your things. The kitchen is amazing! I think since they run a restaurant they really know how to equip and stock things. The bed is VERY comfortable and there is also place to eat and work (separately). The only thing is to make sure you have ear plugs and an eye pillow bc the bed is right by the window out to the street and there are only light drapes - no shades so it isn't very dark at night with all the outdoor light and it is loud with the street noise.

We stayed with my family at R.J.'s for 5 nights. The stay was perfect: the apartment was very clean, well equiped, with a mini mart right at the corner and a bus stop one block away. The communication with our host was seamless and we really enjoyed our stay! Thanks for having us R.J.!
Would highly recommend Craig’s place!Wonderful host, beautiful home and a nice location. This was our first stay in nyc and we can’t wait to come back

Great location. Nice, well maintained space. Request higher floors to avoid city noise. Black out shades, ok water pressure & good hot water.

Walker is an amazing host! Extremely helpful and easy-going. His place is nice and comfy. So don’t hesitate and book with Walker. You won’t regret it!
Henri was an excellent host! Extremely convenient location, comfortable, great value!

Amazing location, extremely clean and place looks just like the pictures. Chris was an amazing host that was extremely attentive throughout the entire stay. Will definitely recommend this location to others and will come back soon!
This is a prime location for an Airbnb. The place offers a lot of cozy beds and was very clean! Also, as a woman I can confidently say that I felt safe where I was. :)

Had a really great stay, spacious, clean and well located apartment within a 10 minute walkable distance to subway station. Lots of little deli’s in the area and felt safe at all times. Very friendly neighbourhood.
Loved the fact that I could wash and dry clothes before packing to return home.
The amenities in the apartment met every need and was a perfect home from home experience.
The host was not intrusive in any way but on hand with advice and recommendations when needed.
Would highly recommend as an alternative to Manhattan.

La famille d’hôtes a été disponible, attentionnée, discrète.

Si on devait retourner à NY, on relogerait sans hésitation dans cette location.

Nicole was an amazing host.  We arrived early and were able to enter the home a bit before check in time. We needed some extra bath towels and Nicole promptly responded  and brought some up!  Thanks Nicole!

An absolutely beautiful AirBnB! Bedroom was very comfortable and the apartment had all the amenities you would need - including extra bedding & plenty of pillows. A completely accurate description and would gladly stay there again!

Amazing experience. The place is clean, hosts are friendly, beautiful art, flowers, cats. The location is great as well - a lot of restaurants, a nice park is near, subway is like 5 minutes walk. I really enjoyed my stay and would definitely recommend. Thank you very much. It was amazing. 🙏

Amzingly gorgeous apt. I would stay here every time i come to NYC if i can . It is beyond lovely, and the host is so accomadating and kind. Great place! Neighborhood has lots of charm and I felt safe the whole time I was around which included walking very late in the night.

We had a great stay.  Jennifer was still there when we arrived and she was very friendly and gracious and said is everything we needed to know. It would definitely stay there again and the only thing I can say that was not ideal was that it was really hot and we could not control the heat.
The house was perfect. Cozy, clean and so close to the train. Couldn’t have asked for a better stay.
Room was clean and hotel was in a great location, check in was easy. Helpful staff
Great location and a beautiful space. This is our go to cobble hill Airbnb ! Thank you so much !
It is small but good apartment .. they are very cooperative and the location is good there is supermarket near from the building

beautiful home and amazing hosts that opened their home to us. gave brilliant advice on tourist places and directions.
The Hotel is very nice, the room, not as pictured, was small & dark. The bathroom & sink were way too small. The Hotel’s location is great for NY.

Very nice location, very clean place, close to subway. Nice bed, very cozy, soft carpet. You have all you need to spend quiet time after running around in Manhattan. Ming is so nice, happy, kind and humane ... we have been like in our house and in the heart of Park Slope. Highly recommended if you want to know the culture and the neighborhood of Brooklyn and near the subway to visit Manhatan. The house was very clean and we appreciate the hospitality of Ming.

Jan's place is amazing - it's cozy but it was actually perfectly sized for two people (plus our overflowing bags of stuff), and quite spacious by New York standards. From check-in to check-out Jan was a consummate hostess - easy to communicate with and very welcoming. When we arrived there was delicious babka waiting for us, along with fresh fruits, coffee, milk in the fridge, and other treats for us to enjoy during our stay. Other lovely touches included umbrellas in case of rain, organic bath products, power strips and outlets in lots of locations for all the various devices we all cart around these days... the list goes on and on!
The location was perfect - situated conveniently close to the subway and easy to get cars or find parking if needed. It's in a quiet neighborhood, which was great after busy days, but is right off the main streets so there is plenty to eat/drink very close by.
We used to live in the area and were in town for a wedding so we didn't need too many suggestions but there was a very helpful guestbook with recommendations if we ever needed one.
We can't say enough good things about our stay and are looking forward to returning to Jan's place when we're in Brooklyn next!

Nos quedamos 5 dias, el hospedaje coincide con las fotos, estaba ordenado, limpio, olor agradable. La anfitriona respondía rápido, muy accesible, sin duda alguna excelente hospedaje, totalmente recomendado.

Win was great! She offered us umbrellas when it was raining. And the room was homey and cute.

No estuve 4 noches, muy buen lugar para disfrutar de Manhattan. Lo recomiendo.
