Sono stata in questo appartamento per due mesi e ha tanti pregi: la posizione ottima, 15 minuti a piedi da metro C ed E; Bagno privato con cambio asciugamani, cucina con gli utensili e letto con i ricambi per le lenzuola. Quando ho avuto bisogno Micheal mi ha risposto. Il problema però sono gli scarafaggi in bagno e in cucina (davvero troppi per quanto mi riguarda) e il rumore. Ci sta che a Ny non ci sia silenzio, ci mancherebbe, ma i vicini di questo palazzo sono davvero rumorosi: corse sul pianerottolo di notte, suonano al citofono, vengono a bussare ubriachi. Questo ultimo aspetto per me è stato molto fastidioso viaggiando da sola come ragazza. L'appartamento è però molto bello e ha tutto ciò che serve. Consiglierei al'host di riparare le finestre, in quanto fanno davvero fatica ad aprirsi e a occuparsi della questione scarafaggi.
This was a great position, close to subway good coffee and shops around the corner. Had everything ai needed and felt completely safe.

Where to start ?
Carl's appartment is luminous, incredibly clean and confortable, beautifully decorated with a great taste in art. You'll find everything you need and more.
The giant sunny terrasse is the perfect spot to enjoy breakfast and start the day in New york.
But above all, the main asset to the place is Carl himself. Best host EVER ! He made us feel at home, made sure we had everything we needed and felt comfortable. It was so nice to share a glass of wine together and to chat about New York, travels and life.
As we say in french, it's a "pépite", a place not to be missed !
Hope to see you again in Paris Carl !
Clean and neat. Good place to stay . Linda is very friendly.
Nick's place was great.  Exactly as described, clean and easy to get to.  We had just a very short stay but Nick was super communicative.  Thanks!

We stayed at Ryan's place for a week and really enjoyed our time. The house is in a great location near the L train, a short Subway trip into Manhattan while also having lots to do locally. As first time visitors to New York it made things very easy to get around.
Ryan also gave us plenty of helpful local tips and was very friendly to deal with. Thanks for having us, we had a great time.
Great place and Doug was a good hoast

Really fun neighborhood that is very walkable and close to Public transit. Relatively easy to find walkable street parking if you have a vehicle. Neighborhood is pretty busy due to college and public transit, but the noise doesn’t carry into the space.
Great staff. Clean rooms.

Alojamiento ubicado estratégicamente a una cuadra del bus a New York, Los servicios en la estadía fueron buenos, la información fue muy clara para el ingreso y el anfitrión responde rápidamente. Lo recomendaría y volvería a hospedarme en mi próximo viaje a New York.
Enjoyed my time at Sarah’s apartment. Very cute decor and an amazing location in the heart of Alphabet City. The brand new A/C unit kept the whole place quite cool in July.

Ismael’s apartment was perfect for our trip to NY! It was always warm and cozy when we arrived after a long and very cold day! Everything we needed was available in the house and Ismael was a great host.
We absolutely recommend Ismael’s home! Thank you so much for everything!
Enjoyed the experience! Worth coming back. So many great places to eat and do nearby.
It is a sweet and quiet little place from where you can reach Manhattan easily.

Es un buen lugar para  hospedarse, lejos del ruido,  se duerme muy bien pues no hay bullicio. Si vas de Turismo, te recomiendo  salir muy temprano para que te de tiempo de hacer tus actividades,  yo regresaba antes de las 20:00 hrs, ya que me quedaba a 1.30 horas de regreso,  maravillosamente la parada del bus esta en la esquina, y pasa muy seguido, no tienes que esperar tanto tiempo, solo tarda 20 minutos en llegar a Jamaica Center.   por la noche la calle es algo oscura y  solitaria,  recomiendo no llegar tan tarde, afortunadamente  todo bien, no sufrí algún incidente.  El  perrito de Don & Modupe es adorable.  No platique mucho con los anfitriones,  pero me parecieron muy buenas  personas, Don, siempre estuvo muy al pendiente y atento. es un barrio muy tranquilo y  me pareció limpio y bonito.
Great host, spacious & nice room! All was very smooth! Can fully recommend

Wir waren zu zweit für 4 Nächte bei Véronique und wirklich rundum zufrieden. Das Zimmer ist groß genug für zwei Personen und in einem guten Zustand. Alles andere ist ebenfalls wie auf den Fotos bzw. wie beschrieben.
Das Bad ist klein aber absolut ausreichend. Die Wohnung liegt im 5. OG, das sollte einem bewusst sein, wenn man mit schwerem Gepäck reist. Die U-Bahn ist keine 5 min zu Fuß entfernt und auch "Little Italy" kann fußläufig erreicht werden. Die "Lower Eastside" ist ein buntes und lebendiges Viertel mit vielen Kneipen, Läden und Cafés.
Véronique ist eine sehr nette sowie auskunftsfreudige Gastgeberin und hatte einige hilfreiche Tipps parat. Zudem lief die Kommunikation sowie Checkin und Checkout reibungslos.

This apartment was great! It was very clean and up-to-date. Yngrid was very fast with communication and accommodating. It is far from Manhattan so plan your trips accordingly, but the local train is in walking distance and for the most part it's a straight shot to all of the major attractions.
great space for the price, private room on top floor. Thanks for the hospitality

The apartment is very well located, between 5th Avenue and Broadway, we were able to quickly reach several points in New York (5th Avenue, Empire State, Times Square, Madison Square, etc).  The apartment is small, but it is well equiped to rest when you intend to spend the day walking around New York. Lee and his team were very supportive and helpful during our stay, the flexible check-in helped us a lot due to the time our flight arrived.
Great place and Sophia is a great host!

Perris place was perfect for our stay. Very clean, easy to find and get into. Perri was super responsive and even let us check in early when some plans fell through.
Easy to find and few blocks from the local 4/5 trains.
Perri even had snacks for us, pantry had plenty of spices.
Excellent stay 10/10. Would book with him again.

This place is JUST as pictured, if not better than the pictures! Its a basement apartment with a private entrance from the driveway. The parking spot is the driveway leading to the front door of the apartment. The spot is VERY tight especially for new drivers (like myself lol). Luckily, every time I arrived to the home, someone was outside and would direct me into the parking spot without scratching my car. I appreciated that the spot was literally right outside of the door because it made it easy for me to make sure my car was safe and also to run back and forth to my car as needed. It also ensured a parking spot, which could be a big issue in Brooklyn. There is an air conditioner in the living room and in the bedroom. They both work to the max, which was great during those hot summer nights. The backyard was cute, simple and cozy. Its a cement closed in yard so you could let your little ones run outside in the backyard without worries. The bed was comfortable for my daughter and I. The shower was amazing. It got nice and hot, was very clean and  relaxing. Overall, I highly recommend staying at this apartment. The host was extremely nice, check-in was simple, the neighborhood is quiet, the place was clean and the complimentary bottle of wine was a nice touch although it was alcohol-free. Hopefully this place will be available when I travel to Brooklyn in the future.
Stephen was very pleasant, the apartment was clean and comfortable, and the location is excellent.

We appreciated having a calm and private space to stay during a work trip to Brooklyn. The apartment was clean, matched the description, and was very easy to get to via several subway lines. The host was very responsive and helpful, too. Thanks for a great stay!

We loved Eric’s place! The check in was really easy and the location is great! The bed is really comfy and the Netflix was a great addition. Surprisingly quiet so had a great nights sleep too! Thanks Eric!

Illtyd is a very open and welcoming host! We had nice conversations and got really great advises for restaurants and activities.  The apartment is spacious and well located, close to the subway and with a lot of things in walking distance. We enjoyed our stay and definately recommend it!

This is our 2nd time staying at Carlo's and Yuvette place. They were very nice and always available to communicate through text.
Its very convinent for us to go to places from here.. Highly recommended.!
Thank you for hosting us ...

Apartment was clean and very convenient for groups if you don’t want to stay in Manhattan. Uber and lyfts very easy and affordable for journeys in and out of tourist areas. Very simple walk to and from the subway also. Hosts had great communication and answers any of my questions. Would recommend to anyone thinking about staying here!

Rick and Mary's place was perfect. Clean, spacious and all amenities included. Linen was generous and beds were comfortable. I also appreciated the fact that they were happy for me to stay an hour after check-out time, as I had an important online meeting to attend to. Thank you Rick and Mary!

I had an amazing experience at Ms. Sherryl's place. I found a parking spot right in front of the apartment but Ms. Sherryl also offered her driveway for me to use as well. The apartment looked exactly as the photos. It was clean, had modern appliances and was very spacious. The neighborhood was nice as well. It's a short distance from many restaurants in the Little Carribean area and about 20-30 minutes from downtown Brooklyn. Lastly, the hospitality from Ms. Sherryl is unmatched. She beyond kind, accomadating and made me feel like I was at home. I will definitely be back.

This Brooklyn apt is completely spotless and roomy. The beds were very comfortable and it was appointed with many niceties such as coffee, tea, and water. The hosts were extremely flexible with requests and help. Everything was easy. It was a bit of a far walk to the subway and a long ride to midtown. If it wasn’t raining the whole weekend it would have helped! The distance wasn’t bad when you consider the amount of space you get at a reasonable costs (in nyc).
Amazing place and well located! Super clean and confy! We truly recommend it!

Michelle was a great host. She was super responsive whenever we had questions or issues and always found a solution. The space was clean? Well organized, and had everything we needed. I would recommend this location to anyone!
My boyfriend and I enjoyed our stay very much. The location was great but our room was a bit smaller than expected.

Miriam is a gracious host and her house is charming and comfortable.  It is located near the subway,  parks and many fine restaurants.   The room is spacious and air conditioned, a feature that was welcomed during heat wave.   It also has an incredible library for those who like to browse books.

Our stay at Ming and Matt's place was an absolute joy. The appertment was well-designed, very clean, light and had showed a personal touch and style we really liked.  Ming and Matt are very nice  people who make you feel at home immediately and took the time for a chat and left some very delicious goodies as a welcome gift. As many others said before, we would definitely recommend this place and would like to come back soon!

Clean, comfortable accommodation. Near Subway, shops where you can buy groceries and cook in the kitchen. Wayne is very good, kind, hospitable hosts. He can be done so that you will want to live again in his apartment. Thanks a lot for the hospitality!!!
centrico, seguro y confiable
Gut gelegene und saubere Untekunft wie bescheieben, hat alles was nötig ist. Kommunikation mit den Inhabern war reibungslos, sehr angenehmer Aufenthalt!
I thoroughly enjoyed my stay at Jennifer’s! She took care of ensuring a pleasant experience since the initial contact. I highly recommend this unique gem. I surely will come back!

I enjoyed the lodging, especially the quiet, since my primary reason was to sleep and shower after running all day. I found that the premises was clean and well cared for and comfortable. Enjoyed the "guest refreshments" provided.
Area was for me very Convenient to transportation and travel to and from the airport.

I had a wonderful time while staying at Ms Sandra place. Its a very nice home with a lot of space and it's well kept,clean and comfortable. I also got the chance to meet and chat with Ms Sandra and she is a very pleasant and nice person. It was a pleasure staying at her place and I am definetly going back.

Great place, very nice studio
I have nothing negative to say, Tony is fair, nice guy, for the travelers you will not be disappointed at all. Shower head is so dope and the patio is nice too!! As me being a smoker the patio accommodation was a plus for me!!

The room is just like the pictures—small, but with everything you need. For a shared apartment, there's a lot of privacy. I stayed for a month, and only ran into Mica maybe twice. Can't beat the location, which is just steps from the subway and a short walk to Penn Station. Good value and convenient location!
The place was awesome. Great location. Nicholas was very nice. I would stay here again

This is a great place to stay, right next to Times Square and surprisingly cheap for the location! Claude is an amazing host, he is very quick with responding, generous and a great guide to the city. He added thoughtful touches like face masks and gloves, teas and other beverages, and had a hassle free checkin/checkout process. Great hospitality overall, I would definitely book again for my next visit to NY!

This was a last minute booking that required immediate correspondence. The host was punctual , communicative …Inspite of being in another country at the time of booking.  Unfortunately due to  a change with my out of state work , I had to cancel early. Otherwise Great location minutes away from the New york action. Definitely worth the money.

Das Wort „Superhost“ trifft auf Alex zu 100% zu - er war immer zur Stelle falls man Hilfe oder Ratschläge gebraucht hat. Er hat uns absolut herzlich empfangen, gab Tipps für gute Restaurants und Unternehmungen. Gerne würden wir ihn mehr als 5* geben!
Die Wohnung ist wie beschrieben super schick eingerichtet und ausreichend groß für 2 Paare bzw. 4 Personen. Es mangelt an nichts und lässt keine Wünsche offen (vom O-Saft über Milch bis hin zu Müsli, frischem Obst und Wasser). Auch frische Handtücher lagen bereit. Neben der voll ausgestatteten, typisch amerikanischen großen Küche gab es auch eine Waschmaschine nebst Trockner.
Die Lage der Wohnung lässt ebenfalls keine Wünsche offen und ist wirklich perfekt für ein Trip nach New York. Brooklyn ist ein toller Stadtteil und mit der Subway ist man binnen 15-20 Minuten in Manhattan (meist Union Square zum aus-/umsteigen). Nach dem turbulenten Manhattan freut man sich abends in eine gemütliche Wohnung und in ein etwas ruhigeres Brooklyn zu kommen.
Alles in allem ein super Aufenthalt bei Alex! 100% Weiterempfehlung 👍🏼

Chi is a fantastic host, very communicative and friendly before check-in and during my 2 months' stay. He was very respectful and keeps the apartment clean and organized. He was always there for questions, advice, a chat, or a meal.
The place is exactly like described and pictured and has everything you could need during your stay, and more! The location is close to public transport, supermarkets, and lots of cafes and restaurants - it's easy to get around.
I had a great stay and would definitely come back on future trips to NYC.
Jamila is a great person to communicate with, and was always able to help.
Very clean place. Great host.

We felt like home for the entire 2 weeks stay . The place equip everything you need plus the owner is so nice & responsive that we felt like being taking care of. We will definitely come back when we visit Brooklyn again.

Sol and Carmen were great hosts! I didn't get a chance to meet Sol. However, he answered all of my questions very quickly. The place was in a quiet location and close to restaurants and markets. The place was exactly as pictured and was very clean, modern and updated. This honestly looks like a fake home it's so perfect. I would definitely stay here again if they would have me.

The Seaside Nest made for a perfect girls weekend getaway! The space was clean and stylish and had excellent location near the beach! Thank you Bobby and Holly for your hospitality!! We would love to come back for longer next time :)
Fantastic apartment in a great location in Williamsburg. Was perfect for our family of four. Host was amazing, so helpful and responded quickly to any questions.
An amazing cozy place!

Based upon location, we hit the jackpot with this Air BnB. There are not a lot of amenities and you should be prepared to walk up three flights of stairs,  but it was absolutely perfect for us. Claudia is lovely and we felt comfortable and safe. Lots of cute coffee shops and restaurants nearby and we were just a few blocks from our son.  We were so glad we found it.

This place was amazingly great! My man enjoyed the Happy Birthday greeting note..this stay had everything I needed and the host reposted in 2 point 3 seconds. Communicate in details on any questions I had. Which is great! I do plan on rebooking again.
Great host friendly service and very interactive

Quite good.
Pros:
+ good location
+ fast check in
+ nice, clean room
+ top tier shower
Cons:
- not many staff available
- fees make take this from a good deal to an ok deal for New York
Really good stay !
Russell was very communicative and very effective while I was staying here. Great host.

Excellent séjour chez Hind! Appartement très propre et bien organisé.
Emplacement proche du bus et métro au top pour aller en centre ville!
Je recommande vivement ce logement!!
I had a very good stay, I liked how walkable it was and close to the main station line 7 so easily able to get to Manhattan as well. Host was very responsive and answered all my queries.

Great place to stay, (however please make sure you are stair savvy, they are steep, thin and there are 48 of them!) a great workout at the end of a long day and a bugger hauling up the luggage and then a workout at the end of everyday.
That aside..... the place is on 5th Ave and is central to public transport located uptown Manhattan in Harlem.
We felt safe the whole time and the locals were very helpful with directions. The apartment is clean, great shower, kitchen and lounge room.
Thank you Miouly for a great stay.
Mon séjour s'est très bien passé et j'ai bien dormi. Le quartier est vivant et les transports ne sont pas loin

We have had a very good time in Blanca and Teddy's apartment. They have been a very helpfull couple abd they offered lots of facilities to enjoy New York. The apartment was perfectly communicated with the subway and the bus and it was 2 minutes walking from Central Park so the location was perfect. I strongly recommend this appartment. Thank you Blanca and Teddy.

I loved absolutely everything about staying here! George was incredibly thoughtful in making sure I had everything I could possibly need. The area you step out into the next morning is equally as beautiful. Definitely will stay here again in future trips to New York!

My boyfriend and I stayed in Conor's place for a month and we absolutely loved it!! I would recommend this Airbnb to anyone visiting New York. The location is A+ as it’s on a nice street, nestled amongst all the great coffee, restaurants, and shops in the area. The space is comfortable and welcoming, and perfect for two people who were working from home and exploring the area. We felt absolutely at home in the space, which is decked out with all you could need for a stay - high quality appliances, comfortable bed and nice linens, beautifully furnished. And Conor himself is lovely - friendly, quick to respond, and helpful.

Absolutely love this place! From the location, to the atmosphere in the room, to the employees this place was perfection! Everyone that I interacted with was very helpful and accommodating. This will be the only place I stay when visiting New York! The location is perfect for a walk to pretty much anywhere! Very clean hotel and comfy bedding! The Mint House deserves 10 stars!
Very clean and pleasant experience :) The area is super cute!

The location is pretty nice!  Close to the 7 train that takes you straight to Times Square. There were lots of food options and grocery stores very close by as well. The apartment is clean and it's a pretty quiet neighborhood. Thanks for the stay!

Val’s place was exactly as I expected. The true New York experience. Located right next to Time’s Square and plenty of restaurants, it’s the perfect place to stay if you’re looking to shop while you stay in Manhattan. I loved the place and can’t wait to go back!
They are very nice. They can give you good advice to experience NYC. They also provide a warm welcome. Just feel like at home.

Perfect location and great hospitality! Less than a block away from Central Park, across the street from subway station, and blocks from 5th avenue. I would definitely recommend it and plan to stay here again next time we are in the city. The comfort and proximity of the apartment made our stay in New York better than ever before!

A small today place in a good location for trips into NYC via subway, which is 5 min away. Neighbourhood felt safe. There is a nice forested park about 1 km away. Host was very polite, responsive and helpful. Good value for money in this area.
Nice apt, good location - 110th line 1 is a minute walk. Had a slight mishap with a leak that was dealt with promptly.

Kai was a great host and we loved the apartment! Its location was central to everything and the building felt safe and easy to access with an elevator. It was awesome to have a good space and access to outdoors in the heart of the flatiron district.

Great host, great room, great value. Under 10 minute walk to Times Square yet I could sleep fine with the window open at night. A little quieter and down the road from all the action but close enough to all the downtown Manhattan sightseeing. Host's check-in instructions were easily understood with pictures and backup telephone numbers in case anything went wrong.
Highly recommended. I have stayed at Frederick's three times now. It's in a beautiful location and masterly styled by the lovely host.
It was great and the price pint was good. Easy to find and close to the subway.

Great price for the location and quality. It's right by quite a few subway stations and bus lines, with easy access to Manhattan, Queens, etc. The hosts/managers are also super friendly. Couldn't recommend more!
Clean apartment in a nice residential area, kind and very communicative host
I plan my work schedule around as a flight attendant and book for the days I am in NYC
Vielen Dank für den angenehmen Aufenthalt.
I enjoyed my stay, no complaints at all
Always an amazing stay with Sharon. AC was great in these dog days of summer too.
Beautiful home with a gracious, knowledgeable host. Ideal location, great value, and the most amazing shower you'll ever use! Plus a cute dog. What more could you ask for?
Our stay was extremely short and really just a place to catch some quick sleep before a flight. It worked out perfectly!

We had a really good time here. The room was as pictured. The place was clean and tidy. As two women, we felt safe in this location. Yemi was very accomodating and helpful. Due to unforseen circumstances i had to check in a few hours earlier and he assisted..he met me at the train stop helped with my things.. he took time to "take care"  and we are greatful. Thank you so much Yemi!

We loved this place. The 4 bunk beds were super sturdy and comfortable. Lots of light when we opened the shades. The overhead light wasn't very bright, but there were bright lights by each bunk. Bathroom was clean and nice, although yes, no fan (as some other reviews noted). All our outlets seemed to work! The room was slightly smaller than the one in the picture, but plenty of space for us. Really cute building,  amazing bar on the roof (delicious food, I loved my mocktail). We are definitely going to stay here again.
Definitely a sure comfortable place to stay and the hospital was the best. 5 stars
The apartment was just as described, and the pictures gave a good idea of what the apartment was like. It was clean, in a great area, and we walked down the block for coffee at the bakery every day.

For someone not from the country - easy to find!
Good room, comfy bed, didn’t use the kitchen but it looked well equipped.
Stayed one night after flying in, perfect!
Nice clean (huge bathroom!) and would stay again.

Place was exactly as described in the listing. Great location, well equipped for a family or small group of friends and the host is extremely responsive.
The only downside is the noise from the heating pipes which, to be fair, the host explicitly noted in the listing…

Daryl’s place was a great space for the week while visiting family near by! Place was clean, private, and had a nice outdoor area to sit if you’d like. I would stay here again when visiting and recommend to anyone visiting the area. Daryl was friendly and always responsive, if needed.
Nice and clean hotel, conveniently located near Times Square and several subway stations.

Bardzo ładne, duże i wygodne mieszkanie. Bardzo blisko do metra. Dojazd na Manhattan około 45 minut. Blisko sklepy i pralnia. Okolica spokojna. Żadnych problemów z bezpieczeństwem. Z Amalią dobry kontakt przez Airbnb. Polecam to mieszkanie.
I’m renting again this week 😊

Christopher was the ideal host.  He was very responsive and attentive to our needs.  His place is exactly as described.  I would recommend it to anyone who is looking for a reasonably priced place to stay in the city.
Very nice place, nicely renovated and decorated, and very well equipped. It was great to have 2 bathrooms for the 4 of us!

Katherine and Jeff are very friendly, and Jeff is always helpful and kind. My family is on their first visit to NY, and they have had wonderful experiences because of this amazing house.
The house is very clear and has almost everything that we need, the location is good very close to the subway and supermarket.
The only small regret is that it is not easy to find a parking space.
Highly recommend this house to whoever has a big family! Will visit this house next time.

Dirk is an amazing host and did all he could to make our stay easy and comfortable! His apartment is very nice, spacious, great kitchen and nice neighborhood!  Half a block from the park so great for a morning wall to the Reservoir. First time using Airbnb and if I need to use it again in NY will certainly look for his place or any other location he manages in the future

We enjoyed the stay in this unit.  Originally our grandchildren were scheduled to come with us and we wanted a place with more space and a kitchen.  This would have fit quite nicely if they had come too.  The outdoor space was an extra bonus we were able to enjoy.   There are two flights of stairs to access the unit.  I don't recall that being mentioned in the description.   It was okay for us but might be a problem for others especially with heavy luggage.   We found the neighborhood to be walkable and tried a few of the local restaurants which were good.   The subway station was close as is the bus to/from LaGuardia airport.
Excelente lugar, Robson es muy amable, y tienes todos los que precisas.
Hale was a wonderful host! Very quick responses and very helpful when it came to transportation in the area. Would stay here again!!!

We stayed at Al's apartment for a week. When we arrived at night my husband was not that impressed with the neighbourhood (large group of young people over the road playing very loud music) but after a few days the people in the street were saying hello to us as we left every morning and everything was fine.
The apartment was very big compared to the space you would get in a hotel in Manhattan, which was great for my daughter and a baby that just wanted to crawl.
The place was good but I probably wouldn't stay there again as it is a decent trip to get into Manhattan with 2 kids and more than once at night when we had lots of bags and tired children, the cab drivers refused to take us back there. One driver said he didn't have a clue where it was and had no GPS or map so we had to get everything out of the cab and get in the subway. The place is really close to the subway entry though which was a big positive.
Al was accessible via email while we were there and we had no problems. Loved the authentic NY experience rather than staying in a hotel.
Quiet, neat place with easy access to public transportation...Great stay
A home away from home.

Local exatamente como no anúncio. Para duas pessoas dá para ficar bem instalado. A Jan oferece agrados de boas vindas que são muito convenientes e deliciosos. Há espaço para as malas, cabides e gaveteiro que complementam o conforto. O metrô é muito próximo. Muito conveniente para ir a toda parte. Só lamentei não tê-la conhecido pessoalmente, mas ela foi rápida nas respostas em todos os contatos e guardou as malas até na hora do nossa partida, que era bem mais tarde que o horário final da estadia. Espero voltar um dia.

This is a great place to stay! The host - Selena is super kind and helpful. It has a private parking so it’s great for people traveling with cars. The kitchen utilities are super new and nice and this apt is spacious.
Wonderful, stylish place in a perfect location
Patricia's place is wonderful! I had such a lovely stay it was wonderful. Perfect location and Patricia was so easy to communicate with :) Thanks!

The place is exactly the same as the picture. The direction to go into the room is very clear. The place is cozy and it’s not small. However, I still can hear people from upstairs walking at 4 am. But it’s not Estefania’s fault. The neighborhood is safe. I walk to a supermarket in 10 minutes.
Great place exactly as advertised and the host was very responsive and easy to work with. Will stay with The Local Stay again.

Firstly, let me say that was a fantastic experience.
(The room was pretty cozy and clean and convenient location.)
I arrived bit of earlier, but he took me into the room earlier than Check-in time because of his flexibility.
And he is an instructor, so knows how to communicate with us.
When he has a time, he may invited to work out.
I could learn not only different culture also improve the way of communication.
I appreciate what you did for me. Thank you.
What I want to say is that I can highly recommend staying with him. You'll be able to feel many things more than usual.

Lovely apartment to stay in, nicely furnished and had all the amenities that made it feel like home. The apartment is really close to the subway so getting into the city was really easy. The hosts were really helpful and made us feel very welcome!

Edmund è un ottimo host, molto gentile e attento alle esigenze dei suoi ospiti anche grazie ad una pratica guida cartacea che mette a disposizione in appartamento! Quest'ultimo è proprio a fianco a quello di Edmund ed accessibile attraverso un tastierino numerico, il ché lo rende perfetto per un self check-in a qualsiasi ora del giorno o della notte. Per entrare è neccessario salire solamente una decina di scalini.
L'appartamento è decisamente spazioso e più che adatto per la convivenza di 4 persone, o potenzialmente 5 qualora venga utilizzato anche il divano. La cucina è dotata di qualsiasi accessorio si possa immaginare, mentre in bagno è possibile trovare un po' di sapone, molta carta igienica e anche l'asciugacapelli; la doccia è davvero spaziosa e sebbene il bagno non sia dotato di finestre, la ventola d'aspirazione funziona a dovere. I letti sono abbastanza comodi e sono disponibili alcuni appendini negli appositi guardaroba.
I tre climatizzatori (due nelle camere, uno in soggiorno) permettono di regolare a proprio piacimento la temperatura dell'intera casa. Nonostante il pavimento sia coperto da una specie di moquette morbida, l'ambiente appare comunque molto pulito, anche più di altri Airbnb con pavimentazione classica nei quali mi è capitato di soggiornare.
L'edificio si trova all'interno di un quartiere particolarmente residenziale, nel quale non è solito trovare molti turisti. Posto a 15 minuti dalla metro e solamente 3 dalla fermata del bus, che si si è rivelata una migliore soluzione per raggiungere qualsiasi zona di Manhattan in poco meno di un'ora. Il pullman si è rivelato particolarmente utile soprattutto di sera per arrivare molto vicino all'appartamento e quindi evitare possibili situazioni indesiderate con il vicinato. In generale la zona è molto silenziosa e durante la notte non si sente fiatare una mosca, se non per una sola volta nella quale è successo che vi fosse della musica fino alle 3 di notte (non sappiamo se fosse un normale sabato sera oppure causato da una parata hip hop indetta per la medesima giornata).
In conclusione, la gestione dell'appartamento è davvero ottima ma la posizione potrebbe essere migliore, specie per quanto riguarda i tempi di percorrenza e l'evidenza di trovarsi in una zona non particolarmente frequentata da turisti.
Great place, great neighborhood
Bon rapport qualité prix. Propre et très bien situé.

The place is at a great location and is walkable from the subway station and bus stop.
The house felt like a home and had everything mentioned. It was a very comfortable stay and Kenneth is a great host always responding to queries and helping us feel at ease. I love that the house has its own washing machine and dryer which made our stay even more convenient.

Foi excelente. Desde o check in (cheguei mais cedo, guardaram minhas malas até dar o horário do check in enquanto eu andei pela cidade). O quarto e o espaço foram maravilhosos. A localização é perfeita (entre o Central Park e a Times Square). Checkout tudo ótimo também. Retornarei em breve. Adorei e recomendo.

Minetta is a very kind and welcoming host, with a beautiful and very tastefully decorated home, and the room is exactly as the pictures. I would definitely recommend it. The neighborhood is great, with lots and lots of food options, and walking distance to both Central Park and Columbia University.
A very well-decorated apartment with great amenities! I don’t cook much but was still mind blown by all the kitchenware they provided. Beautiful living room with beautiful garden as well.
Well appointed apartment with great character and location. Highly recommended

El departamento estaba bien equipado, nos sorprendio gratamente algunos elementos de cortesia como shampu, jabones, papel higienico, cafe, té, etc.
Departamento amplio con camas comodas, bien calefaccionado.
Fácil acceso al subte con el cual llegamos a todos lados.
도로 소음은 괜찮았는데 옆방 방음이 정말 안 됨... 그리고 사진보다 실제 방 크기는 작음... 그치만 맨해튼 내 숙소 가격치곤 훌륭하고 역세권인 게 가장 좋았음. 세븐일레븐도 가까워서 좋음.
Had a great time! Super convenient and spacious.

Alles war bestens; ich kann nur wiederholen, was andere vor mir schon geschrieben haben. Wir würden auf jeden Fall noch Mal das Haus von Christopher buchen, wenn wir mit einer größeren Gruppe nach New York fahren!

We had a wonderful stay at Norman's place. It was prettier than pictured: a large room with high ceilings, super comfy bed, and exceptionally clean. Also enjoyed the snacks provided and the thoughtfulness of providing extra toothbrushes & toothpaste if needed.  We had no trouble finding parking and enjoyed wonderful coffee & crepes a block away at La Paris Dakar. It was also great to find a space that did not require a certain number of nights.  Would recommend Norman's Airbnb and look forward to returning.
Great place for the price!

We enjoyed our amazing view overlooking Central Park from this well appointed apartment (although the view was compromised due to the record-breaking smoke/haze  from the Canadian forest fires - Oh Canada!). This spacious apartment was a good option for our family of three although they could use a bit more furniture in the main living space. The kitchen and bathrooms are modern and up-to-date and had everything we needed. The location is exceptional - walking distance to so many of NYC's highlights. We will return!

Great place to stay with a lot of space. The photos are accurate. Getting to the City was less than an hour by train and a little shorter by Uber. The subway station is about a 10-minute walk. My girlfriend didn't feel safe walking it at night so we Ubered it instead. There are grocery stores and restaurants in walking distance. Plan a little bit if you're going into the city. The apartment is close to Manhattan but not close enough that you'd want to travel back and forth during the day.
Jenny's place is well situated in between two metro stops. The place is spacious, nicely renovated and had everything we needed. The garden was really nice and check-in was easy.
Very nice hotel and staff, a perfect place to unwind in the chaos of the city.

A estadia está localizada extremamente próxima do norte do Central Park e da estação de metrô, o que é bastante conveniente para explorar Manhattan. O bairro parece um pouco esquisito durante a noite, e não é dos mais limpos de NYC, mas não sentimos insegurança ao andar por ele. O quarto estava limpo, assim como os banheiros compartilhados. Nosso quarto era no quarto andar e tivemos que subir escadas íngremes com as malas, mas já sabíamos da possibilidade. Além disso, ficaram com nossas malas após o check-out até dar a hora da nossa ida ao aeroporto. Apenas tive um pouco de dificuldade na comunicação com o host, pois várias vezes fiz uma pergunta que foi respondida apenas com a mesma mensagem automática, que não respondia o que eu havia questionado.

Alberto was great and accommodated us with short notice (less than 24 hrs).   No issues with check in or with accessing the apartment during our stay.  When Wi-Fi password didn't work, Alberto responded in an hour with correct code.  Apartment was on a quieter side street in Queens that allowed for less noise away from the main boulevard.  Subway stop was in easy walking distance  as were a variety of great restaurants and stores.  I was worried for parking, but on both weeknights I stayed, I found parking only a block away.  Fridge in the room was a nice touch and very convenient.  Accessible power strips made charging phones very easy.  Linens and room were clean.  Bathroom was also clean but definitely a shared space as described in the listing - a rather full laundry bag took up  unnecessary space in the small bathroom, and toiletries were laid out on the sink.  It made us feel awkward to use the bathroom.  Again, it is advertised as a shared bathroom, but usually people don't leave items out when strangers are using the facility, so this was a bit of a surprise, but not a deal breaker.   I appreciated the privacy of the room away from the rest of the apartment.  I also liked the security of locking the room from the outside when we left the apartment and locking it from the inside when we were sleeping.  I would surely recommend this listing to others!
Attentive to any needs which there were few as this place was ready to be home for my stay. Great kitchen with everything you need and comfy bedroom. Easy check in and check out process.

Hosts were experienced and accommodating. Perfect place to rest your head. Nisha, was attentive and responsive, through out my NYC journeys.
The entire apartment was fully equipped.
Highly recommend this cozy space.
Tivemos uma ótima estadia, espaço próximo de estações de metrô. Javier sempre respondeu rapidamente e a Pam também nos recebeu super bem.

Très court mais bon moment passé dans l’appartement

Communication fluide avec l’hote.
Accès facile
Au top merci

Awesome location! Great restaurants close by and the market was right around the block. Very easy to get to the subway and once inside it was quite and peaceful. The place was super clean and we had plenty of towels and things like that for the week. Will definitely stay again! Thanks Ruben!

A very comfortable, clean and conveniently located apartment in a very colourful and dynamic neighbourhood. Kitchen well stocked. Short driving distance to JFK airport. Subway very close - train J (Crescent St.) 5 mins walking, and express train A (Grant St.) about 12-15 mins walking distance. Train A is a real time-saver to get to and from Manhattan, especially in the evenings. Kevin and his team are excellent hosts, very responsive, reachable and willing to accommodate and to make your stay as comfortable as it could possibly be. We had a great trip to New York and were very happy with our accommodations.
A classic hotel in a great location. The staff delivers superb customer service, and the hotel is unique and quite funky. A true New York staple

First off, Shayara is extremely responsive! Any issue or questions I had was addressed in a timely manner. Her home is clean and about 4 minutes walk to the subway station. There are many restaurants, groceries and food trucks around even for a late bite. At midnight you can still get food on the streets.  Her home also has chargers on the bedside for your phones which I found to be a practical touch. The only downside I would say is that the building itself is old and the elevator can only hold 4 persons at a time. In terms of the apartment, the beds are on the harder side and the king size bed in the main bedroom makes a lot of noises with any slight movement.  All in all, it’s good value for the location, and it had enough sleeping space for everyone to be comfortable. Would definitely stay again!

Alloggio corrispondente alla descrizione. Consiglio di non alloggiare in più di quattro perché molto piccolo. Il letto sotto del letto a castello un po’ troppo rumoroso e molto mollo, ma i letti dell’altra stanza comodissimi. Alloggio caldo e con i servizi necessari. Per gli standard di New York era pulito. Zona comoda e super in centro.
O local é bem legal, espaçoso. O atendimento foi bem legal também.

Xavier was a wonderful host - charming, gracious, welcoming and courteous.  We enjoyed chatting with him and getting to know him a little, but also appreciated that he was non-intrusive and gave us our space (not always my experience with b&bs!).  The room was great - a winterized porch area but we had no problems being warm enough.  Location is very convenient to the train and it's an easy ride to manhattan.    The room is small, might be more ideal for one than for two, but since we were out and about so much it really didn't affect our trip.  Kitty is an added bonus.  Definitely recommended.

This is a great 2 bedroom apartment on a quiet street! It has everything you need for a short stay and longer one if you wanted. It’s short walk to the nearest metro station and convenient for flights into LGA. Definitely recommend for anyone visiting NYC or Brooklyn!

Great location!
Apartment is just as described and it is easy to locate. Bathroom had all the necessary needs : shampoo, conditioner and body wash. It ended up snowing when I was there and host gave us an extra hour to leave - thank you!

Nyoh is a great Host, he answers fast the chat and its very helpful. I Don’t recommend this space for a long stay, the kitchen and the batroom need a good cleaning but if the final goal of your trip is Tourism I think this can work for you as you just need to go for sleep in the place.
Merci beaucoup pour le logement. Impeccable. Il a fait un peu froid la nuit et le bruit peut déranger certain mais sinon c'était impeccable.

We stayed with Rick (David was away) for 6 days in December 2011 and it has been a great experience. Only thing that I disliked was how expensive the Lyfts were to and from the Airbnb it was $74 to leave Times Square so I took the subway instead and that took 2 hours.. even though NYC has lots of traffic I think it’s still worth it to get a rental car, that’s what I’ll do the next time I visit.

Excellent stay with our family.
Beautiful location and enjoyed the property.

Shemi was a great host! Always responsive and attentive to all our needs. He’s went above and beyond to make sure all our requests were met and that we were comfortable. Thank you!!

We were able to walk to so many great restaurants, catch a Broadway show, and visit Times Square. The place was comfortable, clean, and everything we were looking for in our trip to NYC. We would easily choose this place to stay at again next time we plan on visiting. Thank you Mario!

Valentina is really a great host!
The room was really big and private.

The place is spotless and would highly recommend if you are looking to stay away from it all and need peace and quiet at the end of the day. Grateful for the hospitality I received.
It was a blessing to have a space close to my venue.

L'appartement est vraiment beau et bien placé, à quelques pas de Central Park dans un quartier calme et familial de Harlem. J'ai vraiment hâte de retourner à New York et de pouvoir retourner chez Saint, qui est une des meilleures personnes que j'ai rencontré à New York.

Our stay at Collen‘s apartment was wonderful! The check in and check out was super easy. The apartment is just a few minutes away from the subway and a beautiful park. There are also many restaurants and bars around. The apartment was clean and had everything you need for a comfortable stay.

I had a great stay at Casey´s place, that is cozy and with a quiet neighbourhood.I diddn´t meet with Casey but he was easy to reach and very fast in responding to my qustions.

Geri's place is absolutely what I was looking for, great amenities,  super nice and clean without forgetting the location. I enjoyed my stay and I will definitely book her place again,  if you're fancy think of Geri's place. You won't be disappointed.

This AirBnB has such an excellent location in Brooklyn- we ended up using the ferry often which we highly recommend. Hally’s airbnb was great! I used to live in NYC and as a New Yorker, the location was awesome. Just a few blocks from the train into the city. Her space was spacious, private, clean and cozy. The bedding/ bed was super comfortable too. YES just YES, book it!
Very clean flat. Exactly like the pictures. Lovely stay. Would recommend

Very clean and tidy space. Thank you for the comfortable stay! :)

Location: Amazing! At the intersection of Nolita and LES. Soho and Little Italy as well as subway stations serving to many lines are within 3-5 minutes walking distance. Wholefoods is just a couple of buildings away.

Building: Mid-rise condo building with elevators, hard to come by in Lower Manhattan. 24/7 security and front desk receiving your packages on your behalf. They are very polite and helpful, offering help to carry your luggage or bags if you are coming from grocery for instance. A well equipped gym and laundry facilities are available in the basement floor.

Apartment: Quite spacious and hard to come by in Lower Manhattan. In my opinion it can easily accomodate 4 people as there are two sofas in the living room. The apartment receives ample sunshine. The queen size bed is sturdy yet extremely comfy. TV is small but has lots of channels. Internet is pretty fast. Lots of storage is available. Abundant kitchenware is available. The oven, stovetop, microwave and fridge are all large size. The rear side of the large mirrors in the bathroom has quite a lot of shelves which would easily accomodate your personal grooming supplies like comb, razor, shaver, toothbrush etc. The water pressure of the shower was great and got hot instantly. The toilet flushing power/pressure was amazing. It won't get blocked unlike many old apartments in Lower Manhattan. I did not personally meet any of the neighbors but the people I saw when entering/existing the building or the elevators were quite well-dressed and neat. The radiators generate a great deal of heat so I am sure you won't get cold even in the coldest days of winter. I assume the A/C would work great in the summer because the panels serve as both radiators and A/C with different settings. Last, we received the apartment in a very clean condition. Therefore the additional payment Ted charges guests for "professional cleaning" is well justified as his cleaners are professional indeed.

Host: I did not personally meet Ted as he had left the keys to the front desk and I left the keys to them when I moved out. This allows for very convenient 24/7 check-in and -out. Nonetheless, he was very prompt and helpful when I contacted him via email, SMS or his mobile. Before our check-in when I had asked him about whether towels are available in the apartment, he noticed there were none and arranged that brand new sets for two people to be available in the apartment prior to our check-in.

Negatives: None, if you don't consider the absence of hair dryer as such.

Final words: I cannot recommend this apartment and host highly enough.

Rodney’s place has been great - have to highlight the fact that they’ve let us stay in the flat way after check out time (our flight was at 10 PM) and we could stay there for the rest of the day! Appreciated very much, thank you! The apartment is clean, quiet, equipped with all the necessities, hot shower, proper kitchen etc. Overall, a perfect choice for a business trip.
Kimberly was a great host! Very kind + accommodating. Clean + spacious room and having a private bathroom was a plus!!! Will definitely book again in the future! :)
Excellent host. Very attentive and helpful. Highly recommended and would stay there again.
this little studio is the perfect price & the perfect location... very clean... & has lots of thoughtful things you may need... & right smack in the midst of all things nyc...

Bel appartement bien situé à 15min de marche des lignes R, E et 7 du Métro. Confortable pour coucher 3 adultes et un adolescent. Un peu serré pour manger à 4 dans la cuisine mais elle offrait tout de même toutes les commodités nécessaires pour cuisiner. Des stationnements sont disponibles dans les rues avoisinantes mais ils ne sont pas toujours faciles à trouver.
Merci pour le beau séjour!
Stairs leading to the entrance could be a challenge for older travelers, especially with heavier luggage.  There seemed to be no other exit except the front door.

Dwain’s place was so clean and it smelled sooooo good. The pictures does it no justice. He came and introduced himself and was very nice. Omg he had coffee cakes that were on the counter they were so good. The shower was wonderful and clean (MAJOR PLUS). The linen was so clean, the curtains made my rest so peaceful. Everything was just simply amazing. Easy check in and out. I will definitely come back and stay at the “Spot”.
Clean place, nice location, near the metro.

Spacious, beautiful home where we felt comfortable and welcome. Chris was a great host who made the whole process simple from booking to checking in and out and  answering any questions we had. We would love to stay there again.
Cosy place in the center of Brooklyn in between subway station. So good 'basecamp'  for exploring NY. Andrew is a very gentle and helpfull man who lives in the 19th century wooden house as well.

Very unique and cool place to stay, it is very walkable to everything you would want to see for your first time in NYC, Coffee and food are readily available for you, close to parking garages and great price !
Great location with a lot to do. Perfect place to experience Williamsburg. Comfortable bed and great shower. Enjoyed our stay and will do so again when in the area.

Cozy, comfortable, great location. I stayed for one night and it was perfect for what I needed. Jane was accommodating, easy to communicate with and allowed me a late check out which was great. Thank you Jane!
Would highly recommend staying here if your heading to New York.
ubicacion excelente por el precio, el dueño siempre al pendiente

Wir waren zu zweit 3 Nächte bei Alonso und konnten die Zeit sehr genießen. Das Zimmer ist klein aber fein. Alles ist sehr sauber und geschmackvoll und praktisch eingerichtet. Das gleiche gilt für die gemeinsam genutzte Küche und Bad. Alonso und Rachel waren selten gleichzeitig mit uns zuhause und so war die gemeinsame Nutzung überhaupt kein Problem. Die Unterkunft liegt wenige Minuten von der U-Bahn sowie einem Anleger der NYC-Ferries entfernt, das jüdische Viertel und das Zentrum von Williamsburg sind gut zu Fuß erreichbar. Wir können die Unterkunft sehr empfehlen! Vielen Dank!
Perfect private stay here ! Location is absolutely the best! The host is a lovely person and very helpful and the house is probably one of the best Airbnbs I’ve ever stayed at!

Cozy brownstone in the heart of Bed Stuy. Quiet neighborhood. Comfy beds. Everything we needed was right there.
Convenient to where our family lives as well as subways to anywhere we wanted to go. Loved walking around and eating locally.
Hermoso lugar para compartir en familia y amigos , buena ubicación , limpio, y muy bien organizado
The place was just how it was described. Highly recommend
Place was new, clean and comfortable. Highly recommend!

Linda's home is very pleasant and she is a thoughtful host.  The upstairs guest room is comfortable and right near the bathroom, which was convenient for me because I use it during the night.  She was not home when I arrived, but I had been told how to get inside.  When I got to the room, I was greeted by a guest basket with some helpful items and instructions.  I later met Linda and we had some pleasant conversations, though I hope I did not take her away from her infant daughter for too long; she understandably spends less time talking with guests than she did before the baby came.  The part of Flushing where she lives is quite busy, with narrow streets.  I had to circle around some to find a parking spot that would be good for my 2 night stay, but it was not very difficult to find one in late afternoon and that is typical in many NYC neighborhoods.  I did not find it overly noisy at night, though I slept with the windows open.  (The second floor guest room is in the back of the house.)  When I was there, jets were flying low overhead during the day, so it's not a good place to sleep in the daytime.

Accommodation is very much as Saya & Diego described: cozy, clean, functional and close to subway, sights and other services in Brooklyn. Booking and other communication with hosts went smoothly. I can definitely recommend this location for NYC visitors, who spend some laid-back time and have a good night sleep in Brooklyn!
Super convenient Williamsburg location. Walk anywhere within minutes. Clean/organized bedroom with plenty of room to hang/store our clothes...  Private bath was a wonderful plus.
The room was clean, the beds were comfortable, the staff was helpful! Good price for the location.

Janet is a thoughtful and accommodating host. I was here for more than a month and had a great experience. The house is clean, Janet is very communicative and the kitchen is great for a longer stay! Would recommend!
In a word, exceptional! Jon’s apartment was spacious and well-appointed, comfortable and surprisingly quiet. I will look for it next time I’m planning travel to NYC.
Great place to stay. Really clean with a great host!

Camilas Unterkunft ist schön groß, sauber - wie beschrieben. Man läuft nur einen kurzen Weg zum Strand, der toll ist. Die Subway Station nach Manhattan ist nur ein paar Meter entfernt. Zum JFK benötigt man auch nicht viel Zeit. Camila ist super nett und hilfsbereit. Unsere Erwartungen wurden erfüllt und der Preis ist top. Wir werden gerne wiederkommen.

Thanks again.

Comfortable apartment on one of the most convenient locations in Brooklyn. Tons of options for taking almost every subway line around town. All in all had a great time at Alex' place, and would definitely stay at her apartment again.
Natalia was really friendly and helpful, the room was clean and comfortable, definitely recommend!

Spent two months (October-November) at Benjamin & Don’s brooklyn apartment and let’s just say— what an incredible experience! The place is actually bigger than it seems in photos, I was surprised when I checked in. The front bedroom’s walk-in closet was a game changer, internet was fast (I worked from home during my stay and ran into zero wifi issues), the washer/dryer unit was truly a lifesaver for my extended stay— and the skylights: both in the living/dining room as well as the stairway weee magical on both rainy days and clear skies. The neighborhood is quiet, safe, and SO convenient. It’s literally a 30 second walk away from a huge grocery store and a couple (short) blocks away from the L & M trains. Ben & Don we’re truly the best hosts— from communication to any random questions I had. Don brought me cheesecake from Junior’s for Thanksgiving!!! If you’re looking for a CONVENIENT, CLEAN, and SAFE stay in Brooklyn, this is the spot for you. I couldn’t recommend this listing more!!!
Great experience. Great location.
Rahul and his wife were very kind and hospitable hosts. The area is fantastic, the house is old and beautiful, and the apartment was decorated with wonderful carpets and animal skins. Thanks.

Very basic, but clean. AirBnb listing gives impression it's a personal apt/unit. But because of NYC short term rental rules (30 day min stay) it's classified and called a hotel. multiple units/apts are all rentals. Not a problem.. and not uncomfortable.. Just had expected it to look and feel like previous Airbnb stays.. and it was more akin to a hotel. But fine nonetheless.
Leandro ist ein sehr netter Gastgeber. Die Unterkunft war sehr sauber. Für einen kurzen New York Aufenthalt aufjedenfall empfehlenswert.

Great shared-room in east Flatbush, Jackie was an extraordinary and caring host. The space was spacious, clean and Jackie made it feel like home. For my first Airbnb stay it was better than I expected. I stayed with my boyfriend for 5 days and had no issues and no complaints at all. If you are looking for something really private I wouldn't recommend because we did share a bathroom and everything else. However, if you don't mind sharing space this is a great DEAL! Jackie will definitely make your share as comfy as possible and accommodated us as well.
The apartment is well appointed, handily located, very clean and bigger than expected. The hospitality of the hosts was exceptional, very friendly and helpful.

Everything about this place was great, from the check-in procedure until the fully equipped kitchen. Our whole family loved and enjoyed the stay at Michael's place. The subway is not even a 5 min walk, there's a Burger King next to the apartment and there's supermarkets, restaurants and gas stations all in a radius of a 7 min walk. If I ever decide to come to NY again with a big group, I'll definitely book here again :)
We enjoyed our stay at the apartment and would recommend it. It is well located close to the subway and a variety of grocery stores and restaurants/cafes. We would stay here again.
Very happy with the apartment - clean, nicely furnished, natural lighting, well stocked, conveniently located. Hosts were very accommodating. Would stay again.
Séjour très agréable. Le logement est très propre et proche du métro.
Great spot close to the subway. Big kitchen and comfortable beds!

ONE OF THE BEST AIRBNBS I'VE STAYED IN.  What a remarkable place.  The photos don't do it enough justice.  My family and I were very impressed with the quality of the appliances in the kitchen, and the furnishings.  The front bedroom was quite large with an open feel yet cozy due to the marble fireplace.  Denise was very thoughtful in meeting us when we arrived, and I loved the fresh cut flowers that awaited us in our bedroom.  And not only was the apartment super clean, but the kitchen was one of the best supplied kitchen's I've ever seen in all of the Airbnb's that I've stayed in.  And the quality of the small kitchen supplies such as dishes, pots and pan, flatware, etc. were beautiful.  My husband is a hard one to please when it comes to cooking at Airbnb's, and this time he had no complaints.  We would love to return one day.  Thank you Denise.
limpio, cómodo, cerca del metro, volvería.

We enjoyed our staying in this place. The host was very nice and answered in messages quickly. The place itself was very clean and nice. We were provided with everything we needed and nobody bothered our staying.
Great spot and great host! With only a short walk to the subway you can be in the middle of Times Square in 15 minutes. Would definitely return again 😄

Chrys really provides the ultimate short stay experience. The pictures are %100 accurate and the level of comfort, communication and privacy is top notch. Wish i could keep the listing to myself but if your fortunate enough to be hosted by Chyrs, I promise you wont be disappointed.
A wonderful place for our large family group. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay in Brooklyn at Hong’s.
Nastya’s place was as described. Small, no frills room, in an apartment. There is a dog and there was dog hair but that is in the description.

A really cosy place to stay. We never met Rod, but his family was very helpful and kind. The place is really close to subway and there are shops, supermarkets and places to eat all around it. We'll stay there again for sure.
Great place, enjoyed our stay!
This was a great Airbnb. The place was clean but a bit smaller than expected. This is based on the pictures. But overall it’s in a great location and was a good for my situation.

맨해튼에 바로 붙어있는 숙소는 아니지만 숙소에서 바로 걸어서 3분 거리에 전철역이 있고, 이 전철을 타면 타임스퀘어까지 3-40분에 직행할 수 있어서 시내 접근성은 좋습니다. 집이 고풍스러워서 미국 가정집의 분위기를 잘 느낄 수 있습니다. 호스트분이 친절해서 의사소통이 잘 되며, 얼리체크인도 가능했습니다. 욕실을 공유하고 있지만, 제가 머무를 땐 같은 층에 사람이 많지 않아서 욕실도 자유롭게 사용할 수 있었습니다. 숙소 근처에 코인빨래방이 있어 세탁을 하기 편리했고, 슈퍼도 옆에 있어서 먹거리 사오기에 좋습니다. 이곳에 묵는 것을 추천하며, 저도 뉴욕에 다시 온다면 재방문할 의사가 있습니다.
I stayed here with my two kids to visit family in NYC. It was perfect. Clean, nice neighborhood, free parking, great space. Perfect for our trip.
Everything was super, thank you!

This place was right next to a venue we needed to be near for a conference, and it was only a block and a half from one of my favorite places...Chelsea Market (you gotta eat at Very Fresh Noodles...SO delicious)! Check-in was easy enough and flexible. It is a 5th floor walkup, so be aware of that. We had a baby and a stroller and hauling that up and down wasn't the easiest, but we knew what we were getting into. The only qualm I had was I had asked the night before we were to depart if there was a possibility of a late check-out, but didn't get a response. I asked again the morning of, and didn't get a response. The host never responded to that request, so we planned accordingly and left before the posted check-out time. Not the biggest deal as it worked out better that we left when we did, but it would've been nice to have been communicated to about it. Small thing, but worth noting. Other than that, excellent place! Would stay here again!

I had a great stay in Brooklyn. The location was super convenient and easily walkable to the train, which made getting around the city simple. The place was very clean and surprisingly quiet, which I really appreciated after long days out. I also liked having two bathrooms and a comfortable shared space, it made the stay feel much more relaxed and functional. I would definitely stay here again if I’m in town.

Everything was as described, we didn’t find any inconvenience with the place, we felt very comfortable, everything was spotless, the beds are comfortable. It is perfect. The only thing to consider is that the commute to Manhattan is long, it is easy to take the subway but it will still take an hour, but it is clear from the beginning. One of the best Airbnb’s I have stayed in.

My friend and I absolutely enjoyed our stay. The communication was TOP TIER! The home was beautiful. We have already decided to come back sometime in the future. We had a very short trip, so we didn't have time to enjoy it as much as we'd liked but we definitely will the next time. We didn't expect the stairs but we had an adventure of laughter of our own going up and down them. 🤣 Check-in was smooth, the home was stocked with everything we needed for the kitchen and bedrooms and the skylight was a special touch. The rooms were spacious and the beds were so comfortable.
Boa opção para quem está viajando em trio ou casais que possuem criança. O local acomoda muito bem ate 3 pessoas

Varias estaciones del metro quedan a solo 5 minutos, el tiempo es de una hora de la ciudad. Muy buena la tecnologia del los TV. Varios restaurantes en la zona.
Ivan was very respectful,  and was quick to respond. very understanding and respectful.

Unfortunately we had issues with check in but after that it was a breeze! Amazing location with endless options for food and stuff to do. Plenty of space in the apartment as well. A perfect spot for a first time visit to New York. Would suggest bringing flip flops for the funny shower :)

Nous avons passé 10 jours très agréables dans le logement de Ruby et Daniel. Le logement est situé dans un quartier calme du sud de Williamsburg. Il est très propre et bien équipé. Ruby et Daniel sont des hôtes charmants et très conciliants. Encore merci à eux !
Freddy’s place was extremely close to the subway. He was responsive and kind and the place was well kept.

Jeff's place is great - the location is convenient to the G train, bars, shops, and bodegas. Lots to see within walking distance, as well. It's a great value for the space, and the bathroom is awesome. Jeff communicated so quickly and really made sure all of our needs were met and questions answered. The rooms were set up very comfortably, and we loved having the ability to make coffee and tea in our bedroom!

The location is really great! - particularly for getting into lower Manhattan. The place was really clean, and the room was a good size and had lots of storage space.
Check in and check out were very simple, and the hosts were easily accessible and responded promptly to any queries I had.
It was my first time ever in NYC, and the place suited my purpose perfectly!
Very nice place to stay. Thanks for being helpful and communicative Andrada!
Kind, response host. Good deal, especially if you need an Airbnb with 2-bed 2-bath.

Mark was a great host - he responded quickly to my last-minute reservation when another airbnb reservation fell through. He made sure we were comfortable and he was easy to communicate with. The apartment is lovely and well-located, just steps from Central Park. Clean and has everything you need, including linens, towels, kitchen items, coffee, etc. There were even fresh flowers on our arrival! Thank you for an excellent stay.

I really enjoyed this place! Safe area, friendly hosts, very cute place! It was pretty worth it. I totally recommend this place.
When I come back to NYC, I’d like to stay here again.
I appreciate you’ve done for me Tommie and Chris! :)

Win’s place was great! It had all the amenities you need to feel right at home and was super close to bus and subway routes. Win had very clear directions for entry and exit and was always very responsive to questions.  I would stay again!
Great spot with quick access to the city! Light filled and lots of plants. Oscar was quick to respond to anything I needed.
Amazing stay right in the middle of NYC !!!
A frequent visitor, I always stay here. Love it.
Johny is a very efficient host who made sure he was thorough and available if needed. I would definitely stay again when I’m back!
Arnol was an amazing host, felt like we were a part of the family!

Great place, easy to find and would definitely stay there again.

Stay in Patrick's place was great. He is very kind and funny . I really would love come back.

I enjoyed my stay very much. Nice little apartment with everything I needed. Close distance to everything, like subway, little supermarkets etc. Norman is a great host. All together: I would come back anytime.

Great location, room was very clean, spacious, and comfy. Felt safe at all times and super easy public transit options nearby to anywhere. Highly recommend!

Overall, we had an okay stay.
Nasir was extremely helpful, understanding and responsive.

Great place to stay in Brooklyn/New York! Spotless clean, perfectly located in a quiet and safe neighborhood and only a short metro trip away from Manhatten. Can only recommend to stay at Polina's and can't wait to return.

Erma's place was better than how it's advertised. Home is very quaint and cozy, very very clean, close to public transportation and stores. I will definitely recommend this place and I will for sure stay there again.
This was a great location in a safe neighborhood. Accommodations matched the pictures. And the Doorman Ronald was super helpful.
It was a really nice stay even though pretty short. Ibrahim is a very good host and his apartment is clean and nice. I recommend staying with him. Thank you!
Lovely historic home, fantastic host.

This place is a gem in Manhattan. It’s clear that a lot of thought has been put into everything, including the layout of the facility, the amenities, and support from staff. It was always very peaceful and quiet inside the hostel, which was a nice contrast from the hustle and bustle of the city, and I would not hesitate to stay here again if I’m ever back in the area.

Ben's place is awesome. Incredibly hip and fashionable, centrally located, and more. Not only does Ben own two awesome tortoises (who pretty much stay to themselves), he is a gracious host and all around interesting person with plenty of insight on the city. Best AirBnb experience thus far - thanks Ben!
Great place and location, would a 100% recommend the host. Always responsive and any issues were dealt with in a prompt and professional manner. 5 stars
Excelente departamento el de Tristán, tiene todo lo que se describe. Zona muy tranquila y de buena actividad comercial en cercanías. Buen acceso a Manhattan en varias opciones de metro y autobús.

Super convenient location to everything you want to do. The neighborhood has so many cute shops, food, close to China town. The Airbnb has everything you need for a good time in NY.  Also Melisa was one of the most responsive hosts I’ve worked with. Always responded and super proactive with the few questions we had

The Airbnb was perfect.  Modern and new, but with comfortable welcoming touches such as a lovely otter poem, cool lighting, huge tv, convection oven, Buddha garden and amazing outdoor patio.  We hope to be back soon!

Ich war mit meiner Tochter in New York. Wir haben uns in der Unterkunft von Paul sofort sehr wohl gefühlt, weil alles wunderbar liebevoll hergerichtet war. Für Fragen war Paul jederzeit ansprechbar. Vielen Dank für diese tolle Zeit!

Don’t hesitate to book, had a great stay. Hosts went out of their way to make sure we had a lovely weekend and offered plenty of amenities as well as flowers for a birthday present. Everything close by with nice food options. Thanks for everything.
Joe is very nice. My flight was delayed and He kindly waited and offered to carry my luggage up.
Great stay. Everything was described accurately and host was very responsive.
Nice apartment, pictures are real...it is far from the city, train station near the apt was closed during the weekend but free shuttles will take one to the next train station.

Such a lovely place to stay in an awesome location!  Lory and Cindy are great!  We'd love to come back and stay again!

This was a great home base for our trip to New York! Really convenient for the subway and some great food in the immediate area. Dawn was a fantastic host - always responsive and helpful. Check-in was very easy because of the clear instructions, and we appreciated being able to leave our luggage for a few hours after checkout.
Casey’s place is in a great location. Communication before check-in was fast and Casey was flexible and accommodating. The place is large, and looks as pictured.

We stayed there with 9 people (3 generations) for 9 nights. Everyone was fine with the appartment and the location. Near to subway, bus, supermarket and a super Foodtruck. Near to everything you need.
Tanya is a super host! Always answers fast, gave us super tips and very obliging.

Pamela is a gracious and friendly host. Her kitchen has everything I needed and the location is in a nice neighborhood.

Great host and great stay! Very clean place, safe, and felt private despite being in someone else's house. Having a private bathroom was very nice too.
Only drawback was the full size bed, a little small for a taller guy, but overall still a great experience.

This is a gem of NYC apartments.
Unlike your usual NYC airbnb, this apartment is:
- clean
- spacious
- with a well-working appliances
- has good internet
- has hot water in the shower
- very quiet: no noisy neighbors, the street is pretty quiet too
We liked the location as well:
- good quality grocery store nearby (Lincoln)
- huge variety of coffee shops around (we liked Coffee Uplifts People for work)
- There's also a convenient wash & fold laundry nearby with $1/lb price. Drop it in the morning, come pick it up in the evening.
- Just 5 minutes from an A and C subway lines - very easy access to all the best places on Manhattan.
I would like to also note that Ruthven did a great job as an airbnb host. The communication was very clear, and we were even provided with a fresh towels & bedding once a week - very nice of them!
Overall, great place to stay!

The location is perfect. It's close to several subway stations that go all over the city. But I did a lot of things on foot. The room was very comfortable, exactly as described in the ad. The bed was comfortable, there was space to put my bags and hang my clothes. There was a kettle to heat water, a microwave, a fridge with a freezer and a Nespresso machine with capsules. The bathroom was very spacious, the shower was very hot (it was very cold) and was very comforting. The heating was great, I didn't need to wrap up warm inside the room despite the low temperature outside. Although I've read other people talking about the noise, I didn't find it noisy at all. I fell asleep as soon as I lay down in bed (it could be due to tiredness), but I found it to be very quiet. I stayed on the third floor facing the front. It might be noisier on lower floors, but I found it to be very quiet. There are many clubs nearby, cafes, restaurants, shops. It's a great place!

Delores's place was great, we walked or rode our bikes to the beach each day. It is very close to Rockaway Brewery, grocery store, and shops on Rockaway Beach Blvd. This was a great place for us to have a family vacation at the beach. Our kid loved the porch and watching the neighbors  and planes come and go. The apartment was nice and clean, with plenty of pots and pans for cooking. Having the bedrooms upstairs was great so we could put our little one to sleep and still be able to hangout in the living room and porch without worry about waking him up. We had a great time, Thanks Delores!

I stayed here for a week and overall had a good experience!
PROS: It’s about a 10 minute walk from Midtown where I was spending most of my time. It’s also a very quick walk to the 34 Street-Herald Square subway station, so getting around is very easy. The place was clean and looked just like the pictures. There’s lots of shops and restaurants in the area. The hosts are very quick to respond.
CONS: If you’re not used to street noise, it can be a little loud at night, as can the heater, but I found that I got used to it after a few days. I did see a mouse running down the hallway once.
If you have a busy schedule and are basically looking for a place to sleep in a convenient area, I would recommend this place!

Well located in Lower Manhattan.

So Jung, Karl, and Heri are the best hosts I have ever met!! We arrived late at night and they welcomed us like we were coming home. So Jung and Karl give amazing recs for restaurants to try, and events around the area. They are very responsive and super quick to reply to any questions. Our favorite part of our stay is taking evening walks in the Gantry State Park, the view is STUNNING along the river. It's only a 3 min walk from their place to the park where you can enjoy the relaxing breeze, epic night view of Manhattan, and sometimes free live performances! The neighborhood is safe, lovely, and close to the subway, markets, and restaurants. We def fell in love with LIC because of our stay!

We had a marvelous visit to the East Village made all the more enjoyable by staying at Ed's apartment.  It was a fantastically clean and organized space. Enjoyed my stay wanted the room to be a little bit more spacious.
Just as described, simple and cozy. A great place to stay a night or two!

What a great stay at the beautiful neat house and big sunny room from Charlie and Sam, a hidden gem in nice Williamsburg, and with such nice hosts, Sam helped out with all very quickly and made me feel so at home! We enjoyed our time in Guerlines home very much. We also loved to get an impression of normal life in Brooklyn. The people were friendly and helpful. If you plan to stay in NY for a week or even longer, this is a place, that ist affordable, nice and interesting. Guerline ist our favourite host!
Exceeded my expectation! Will def come back to this awesome place. Haffro and other guests were super friendly and warm. I highly recommend for those who are solo travelers!
This apartment space is comfortable, with great amenities, and is located in a quiet neighborhood near good restaurants, shops and walks.  Althea is a wonderful host!

We had a great time in New York! Lots of privacy in the apartment, but you should know it’s about a 15 minute walk to the subway each day.
We felt comfortable and even though we didn’t get to meet Elsa the communication was great and quick.
This was a great stay, the host was very responsive. The pictures looked just like the room very nice !! I would definitely book here again next time I’m in New York.

Staying at Azeez's apartment was an absolute pleasure! Throughout my stay, he went out of his way several times to ensure my time at his apartment was comfortable. Azeez maintained great communication throughout the stay. The apartment is well-equipped in a great location, with many great restaurants, bars, and grocery stores within walking distance. The apartment is more spacious than I expected and is a rarity for apartments in the area within a similar price range.
If you are looking to spend some time in Brooklyn, I'd highly recommend Azeez as a host and his apartment as your temporary home.

Great studio apartment. The bed is memory foam and very comfortable. The couch and tv are nice to have and the tv is easy to use. Also, cable!! The bathroom is super nice and clean! Tomer is friendly and is incredibly quick to respond to any questions!

La habitación está excelente, grande, cómoda, con baño y regadera privados.

Manhattan Brownstone located on a quiet street close to the river. All that is needed is within walking distance. place is comforting and safe, met all expectactions. Leslie is lovely to work with, booking and communication went smoothly.
