Maggie’s place is perfect for a long term stay, the decor is beautiful and location is great right next to the subway. She was a great host and was super quick to reply to our messages. I would definitely recommend!!
Cozy home and host were great and friendly

La experiencia en el check-in no fue muy buena. La persona encargada del turno de la mañana fue bastante tosca al tratar a los huéspedes. Cuando uno llega a un lugar espera un trato amable y una bienvenida cordial, y lamentablemente no fue así.
Sería importante que el personal de recepción tenga una actitud más amable con los visitantes. Si alguien no está de buen humor o no tiene disposición para atender al público, quizá no debería estar en esa posición. Una mejor atención haría una gran diferencia en la experiencia de los huéspedes.

Ame was very welcoming, kind and arranging. Her house is beautiful and clean. The bedroom was spacious and well decorated. The bed was very comfortable (greatly appreciated after walking the whole day in nyc). The bathroom was big with enough shelves for your beauty product and the shower was spacious too.  The street is calm and peaceful and the neighborhood has great food offer. There is many subway station around which will take you within 20min to all the major things to do in the city. I will easily recommend a stay at Ame's to my friends!
Great location.  I was traveling mostly for work and the place was perfect for my needs.

The house and room were immaculate! Very clean and quiet, the private bathroom is a big plus. There is a train line right behind the house and I’m a notoriously light sleeper, and it never bothered me while sleeping. This room is perfect for a quick trip which is what I had over the course of a week.

A very nice place in Queens, Astoria and within 20 minutes you are in the centre of Manhattan. It's only a 5-minute walk to the metro station. Besides the good location, the apartment also offers easy access by using a code system to enter the room and there is air-conditioning available as well. The bathroom and toilet are shared with others but that was not a problem for us. Can definitely recommend this place if you want to do a city trip/road trip and planning to stay out of (pricey) Manhattan but close to the city centre for a couple of days!
Trey is a great host and this was a great place to stay  ⎯ we actually booked it in 2022 and booked here again because we were so impressed with the digs! Thanks again :)

We loved our stay at Rachel’s house.
The neighbourhood is nicely located within 20 minutes of Prospect Park, near to great food and just a few minutes away from the train station.
I was commuting into Midtown every day and the commute felt easy.
In regards to the space, it was well equiped, clean and spacious, we are a family of four and managed to stay there comfortably throughout our stay.
In terms of communication, Rachel was prompt, clear and very friendly.
I would stay here again!

Great people, location and stay. Everything was as described and Tako and Shantanu were very warm and hospitable. I had a great time and it was a perfect home base. I would recommend to anyone looking for a place in NY that’s friendly and cost effective.
Great place, great location.
great space and location, spotless clean and quiet. perfect outpost for a weekend in Manhattan.

This spot is awesome for it’s SoHo Chinatown & Tribeca all in one
&the trains to downtown then uptown are all right here =-)
Amazing basement apartment in a great neighborhood. Close to Morningside Park, lots of available street parking, too. Emilie was a prompt communicator, I would definitely stay here again.

Was exactly what we were looking for. We enjoyed our stay and had a fabulous time! Would definitely book and stay again! It was close enough to everything we wanted to do, and things that weren’t we were able to find access to public transportation! Would definitely recommend staying here! It’ll be my first choice if and when we come back to the city.

The overall stay is nice but there are some things to be noticed:
1. As described it has shared bathroom, so be prepared to share it with another guest.
2. There are some strict house rules from the host, be ready to follow it.
3. The home is relatively old, for example the window cannot be fully closed.

Deciding to stay at Lorelei and Alex place was the best I could do. Generous, warm hearted, down to earth people, open, carrying, but not too much. Place and room were exactly as decribed, good looking, clean, neighborhood good, a lot of good places to find just round the corner. Easy going to Manhattan also Brooklyn was with the Metro (2 blocks) or by foot good to reach. Two things not to miss: ask for a look at the jewellery Lorelei creates and ask Alex for the place of the Japanese food. You can ask for everything else too, easy to get in contact with both of them and if you are lucky, friends come around. 5 stars!

Die Unterkunft in Brooklyn bei Lorelei und Alex war sehr gut. Beide Gastgeber sind freundlich, warmherzig und großzügig in ihrer Art. Es ist einfach mit ihnen in Kontakt zu kommen, wenn gewünscht. Das Zimmer war sehr schön, Badezimmer ebenso, alles sehr sauber und gepflegt in einem schön restaurierten Haus. Die Wege nach Manhanttan und Brooklyn downtown sind kurz, alles ist mit der Metro (2 Blocks) oder auch innerhalb Brooklyns vieles zu Fuß erreichbar. Es gibt einige gute Restaurants, auch zum Frühstück, gleich um die Ecke. Zwei Dinge würde ich unbedingt tun: fragt Lorelei nach einem Blick auf den Schmuck, den sie fertigt und Alex nach dem unglaublich guten Japaner. 5 Sterne, gar keine Frage!
The place was just as the pictures suggested.  It was very clean and cool. The host was very helpful and friendly. Would highly recommend.
Wahid was a great host and this place has everything you would need for a stay away from home! The location is great as well, especially if you're commuting to RUMC. Definitely would recommend!
Beautiful place! Olga was very responsive and considerate. Highly recommend!
Todo correcto por lo que esperavamos. La zona es probablement lo mejor, perfecto para moverte con metro.

We stayed at Matt’s place after a last minute decision to sign up for the NYRRs NYE Midnight run in Central Park. The apartment was sun-lit and cozy and Matt was a made us felt comfortable in his home and his neighborhood.
Was a pleasure stay here very easy to get around.
This is all you need for a stay in NY city: a clean appartment, good location, airconditioning and a friendly host. Eduardo wasn’t here when we stayed here but the communication went very smooth.
Ivan was super nice and friendly. The room was clean, and I would recommend it . Only downside is a little noise from traffic outside.
Place is nice, staff are very friendly, awesome location. Thank you so much!

We had a wonderful stay! The apartment has a great layout, lots of space, wonderful light, and was well furnished. The wifi worked well. The neighborhood is very nice with good restaurants and grocery stores nearby and close access to the subway.  Our hosts were very responsive and helpful. The teenagers say: fire house! sick view!

l'appartement était très grand 3 chambres avec des lits doubles normalement c'est pour 4 personnes mais Terrick à accepter notre famille de 5 nos filles ont dormi ensemble sans problème, Terrick et un super hôte il répond directement aux messages, l'appartement est propre il est à 1h de Manhattan en métro qui se trouve à 10 minutes de marche . Notre vol de retour était la nuit mais il était impossible de laisser nos bagages dans le logement ce qui était dommage 😞 il n'y a pas de lave-vaisselle ni de lave-linge mais ça nous a pas déranger car nous étions là que pour dormir.  Merci 🙏

Dawud’s place was super clean, homely, comfortable and gorgeous. I’ve been to many Airbnbs, yet none can be compared to Dawud’s place. I wish we could have stayed longer. Beautiful and comfortable furnitures. The place is meticulously decorated. In fact the pictures on the Website are totally a misrepresentation of the beauty of the apartment. Mr Dawud was gracious enough to allow us to check in a couple of hours early because the Airbnb we had initially booked was a total nightmare.
Everything was great.
In fact , we are already thinking about coming back to Mr Dawud’s place. ⭐️ ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Great location! Very accessible to hot spots in NYC. Definitely closest to Times Square and all that stuff. Overall for the price and location you literally will not find better. It is inside of the Hampton inn hotel!

Stella's place was fantastic! In a very quiet residential area but still within walking distance of everything you need – laundromats, supermarkets, restaurants, train. She was an excellent host and quickly responded whenever I asked questions. I stayed here from August to April and only left because a prior booking began April 1st. I would stay here again without a second thought. Great value all around!

The apartment is cozy and comfortable, and very clean. Had always wanted to experience an East Coast row house...box checked. Within easy walking distance there are some nice coffee shops, restaurants, and small grocery stores, and it's an easy walk to the subway. It felt like home.
Very welcoming host. It was a pleasure to stay.

I really enjoyed staying at this hotel . The airbnb host was very responsive, the employees at the hotel were helpful when i needed to drop my luggage and explore before check in and even after i checked out they let me leave my luggage up until it was time to leave for my flight. The room was very clean with a nice view of the city . The beds were comfortable and had curtains to close for privacy . There was a fridge to store our leftovers or drinks, a kitchenette which we did not use but it was nice to have just in case . Overall i would 100% stay here again and i already recommended it to friends and family. I definitely will be coming back
Great stay and Nice location with short distance to the train and overall really satisfied.
Great host, great hospitality,  offers a lot at a great price and will return in the future if in the area. Out of all of our stays she is our favorite host!

Localisation de Nomad exceptionnel : proche à pied de l'Empire State Building, de Time Square, New York Library,... moins de 10 minutes.
A proximité d'une ligne de metro très pratique pour la visite de New York : Soho, Little Italy, China Town, World Trade Center, Brooklyn....

I’ve stayed at many Airbnbs, and this is one of the best! Jim and Barbara provided all the essentials, plus some nice little extras like milk for our coffee, make up wipes and umbrellas — those small details make a huge difference! The place was quiet overall, private, had ample space for 2 people, and was very clean. The bathroom was fantastic and modern— the only thing we didn’t love is that the sliding bathroom door doesn’t allow for much privacy; not a deal breaker, though. It’s walking distance to 2 different subways (4-7mins). All in all, a great place to stay if you’re visiting NYC and I would definitely book it again!
Candy is an Amazing human being, filled with joy and gentleness. i spent an Amazing Time, i really felt at home with a family member. great expérience !!
My husband and I loved our stay here, perfect location close to everything.  Very clean and such a beautiful view of the city! Would definitely stay again!
Exactly as described. Very communicative hosts.
Richard’s place is fantastic.  This was our second stay at this listing and we can’t wait to reserve again next time!
Beautiful unit. Very communicative host! Enjoyed my stay and the space I ended up extending one day. Juliet was a great host! I loved the look of the unit and the shower was  superb.

Anna, their family and home are a really five (or ten stars!)
She’s a kind woman, a spectacular host and their place are totaly a dream.
I mean it

Judie and Steven's home is an outstanding value and they are the great host.  I always enjoy my stay at their lovely home.  It is easy to access and  in a perfect location for restaurants, shopping and fun activities.
We had an amazing stay, so cozy and relaxing vibe, felt right at home. James was very prompt about any inquiries we had. We would book again!

Es una habitación pequeña pero muy cómoda, en una muy buena ubicación. Se duerme muy bien ya que no llega la bulla de la calle ni del vecindario. Fue muy fácil llegar por la noche y me sentí muy a gusto los días que dormí allí. Yo únicamente dormía en la habitación así que estuvo perfecto para mi plan. Hay opciones de comida saludable muy buenas muy cerca y la Pizza Suprema estuvo buenísima.

Zentrale Lage in Brooklyn, direkt an der Ubahn. Gute Restaurants in der Nähe. Zimmer gut und sauber. Die Daily fee ist doof aber das machen ja viele Hotels in NYC. Frühstücksbuffet haben wir einmal gemacht, lohnt eher nicht; Cappuccino muss man extra zahlen. Klimaanlage hatte Probleme, wurde aber schnell behoben. Insgesamt gut.

It is decent for a short stay. The room was smaller than expected, but it did the job. I liked that we could open the window for air & also control the thermostat and the bathroom was spacious enough. I had trouble at check in and lost an hour at least for the stay but had no issues at check out. Cleanliness was fine. I did not use the glasses they say is included but it was indeed provided and looked clean. There was a damaged light in the room so we relied on the smaller lights around. If I was to stay here again, I’d book directly. Additional Hotel charges to consider upon check in == nightly charges and $250 refundable deposit.
The place was perfect for our quick weekend trip for a wedding. Close enough to transit and there was stuff to do around the area!

I spent a week at Maurice's place with my family. Maurice has been very friendly with us and very responsive with our questions. The apartment has everything we needed. The neighbourhood is lively and very family friendly. Overall, the stay was a very good value.
It's really pretty, but rooms are very small. Doesn't make sense..also alot of activity in the area like homeless ppl

Excelente lugar, fácil acceso , a unos pasos de la estación del subway D, muchas grocerys a pocos pasos , cama muuuy cómoda , gran closet , la habitación bien iluminada con una nevera , ropa de cama muy cómoda, Ikello es un excelente anfitrión amistoso , tranquilo , te da tu espacio , siempre estuvo atento a nuestras necesidades tiene una pequeña perrita Nelly que es adorable le encanta que la acaricien , lugar 100% recomendable.
Gracias por todo Ikello!!
Beautiful home right by the subway station
Greqt value for money.

Le logement était conforme à la description même plus grand qu’en photo. Nous avons passé un très bon séjour et Stephen est vraiment disponible il nous a permis d’arriver 1h plus tôt et de repartir 1h plus tard. Je recommande fortement le logement et reviendrait dès mon prochain voyage à New York
Best location, walking to Broadway shows and Time Square.  Pretty much walk to every where.  Quiet apartment with the functions we need.  Easy communication, flexible check-in.
Espaço excelente, muito limpo, muito perto do metrô e o Dan sempre está disponível para tirar qualquer dúvida e sanar qualquer problema. Amamos!!
Very nice and peaceful experience!

Nice and neat, responsive host
Recommended
Melissa is a great host , we had a great time in the Rockaway’s ! I really recommend staying here!

We had a wonderful stay. The staff is so friendly. The location is unbelievable. The subway on 79th or 72nd is just a short walk. The bus that cuts through Central Park also drops nearby. So many dining options all around you. We would stay again in a heartbeat.
Chris' place is clean and comfortable.  Self check-in is a breeze!

Nick was awesome! I am a travel nurse and use his place to stay in during part of my contract. He was quick to respond to my messages and very helpful if I had any questions or needs. If you choose this place you’ll be choosing very wisely. Also, try Ciccio’s pizza at least once. You won’t be disappointed.😊

The Box House Hotel was such a perfect place to be for an extended stay in New York City. The staff was extremely friendly and willing to do anything for the guests. Clean and well maintained, and the new lobby looks great!

Keqing place was a good stay, clean, nice and beautiful hall with chandelier. When my friend and I arrived we were accommodated with waters in the fridge and also the unit was cool because the air conditioner was already on to cool the place because when we arrived it was a hot day. Keep in mind the Air unit that’s in the place literally can cool the whole place which was a plus. Only downfall was that there was only 1 tv in the living no tvs in neither of the 3 bedrooms, also there were a lot of stairs. Another thing was that there were different units in the house Its not just you, which I think that could of been kind of explained on the post when looking so people can be aware that you will not be the only one in the house that the house is broken down into about 3 other units. Overall my stay was good, not only did the rooms have heated blankets, the  kitchen and bathroom had a lot of essentials, also trash cans had trash bags in them for us to use. Everything was set up nice.

My husband and I rented this apartment to be closer to family for a month. It was very comfortable and clean. WiFi was good for working remotely. Ray and Priscilla were great hosts. The cherry on top was the incredible view and outdoor area. We had a great stay and I’m sure we’ll be back in the future.

Awesome place! Thank you both for a wonderful stay and for your kindness and hospitality!
Much Aloha,
Robbin

This is an amazing space in a vibrant neighborhood. Parking is easy, and public transportation is nearby. There is an abundance of delicious food within walking distance. I have stayed in many airbnb's in Brooklyn, and this one is really top notch. A++!

The people at the lobby were really kind and helpful. The room was like what it looked like in the pictures. The area is close to everywhere but ofcourse there is some noise accordingly, you can take some earplugs from the lobby if it bothers too much. It’s a good priced hotel with good hosts. If you’re looking for some luxury this is not the one though.
Vashti is super nice. She made me feel welcomed & I'll definitely book with her again.

This airbnb was ideal for us.   With quick access to the subways on 95th and Broadway it allowed us to move around easily. The studio has a great open feeling with the courtyard access. It was our own private studio and the owner was great at making us feel welcomed. We hope for more return visits.

Très joli appartement, dans une petite maison charmante. Très calme. Tout confort, beaucoup d'espaces de rangement et une très grande chambre. A cinq minutes du métro et de Prospect Park. Un endroit à recommander vivement.

This was our second time staying at Howard's place and we loved it, again! He's a great host and had everything we needed ready for our arrival. The place is modern and eclectic (which I love), and has everything we'd need. The bed is superbly comfortable and has us now considering getting a Tempurpedic for ourselves. Howard's apartment is becoming a second home for us and we'll definitely be staying there next time we come back to Brooklyn!
Shelley is kind and sweet, and Flatbush is cool :)
Wonderful stay. Very grateful that I was able to stay here. Clean and polite. Perfect location. Will absolutely stay here again. Thank you.
Great for a long stay! The room looks just like the pictures and the in unit washer and dryer was amazing.

Reka and Erin's apartment is in a great location. Quiet end of the street, a short walk from lots of cafés/bars and subway. Reka was very accommodating and flexible with check in/check out and storing my luggage for a few days while I was away.
The room is clean, has lots of natural light, a comfy bed and a good view. I highly recommend this apartment and would be happy to stay again should I return to NYC.

Great apartment for two, to explore Manhattan. Very spacious and comfortable, and convenient for more local attractions on foot, and with the convenience of a subway station close by for getting further afield easily. Good local amenities, and a very helpful host.
Great location. Rooms are pretty simple but the area will keep you busy!

Ravanna was overly accommodating to my friends and I during our stay and their place was amazingly gorgeous and the location was perfect and when one of my friends' trains got cancelled due to weather they even let her stay an additional night for free, which was so thoughtful and I will be forever grateful for that! Amazing amazing amazing and we all look forward to booking with Ravanna in the future!

This sunny apartment is a perfect place to explore NYC from!  It’s close to public transit and less than a mile from Prospect Park where you can run, bike, see free concerts and go to Smorgasburg ( lots of foot stands) in the summer. There’s also a great Haitian restaurant on the corner and coffee shop two blocks away, as well as a nearby grocery store. We had a very comfortable 5 day stay here
Awesome place to stay! Barry is super nice and helpful! It’s located in one of the safest neighborhood in Bronx. Easy to walk around to bay plaza and Jacobi Medical Center. Will recommend.

If there was anything greater than 5 star, Leon would be truly deserving of such. Undoubtedly the best Host I’ve ever interacted with and experienced. His SuperHost status is truly deserving; indeed a cut above the rest. Leon was very responsive, polite, kind and approachable. HIGHLY RECOMMEND THIS LISTING! The listing is exactly as portrayed in the images. Definitely will be rebooking in the future ❤️ - Z
Leon is such an amazing and hospitable person. Your personality is just as beautiful as the place. It really feels like a home. Thanks for inviting us to your thanksgiving dinner. We’ll never forget. All the best and God bless you - K
Leon is a lovely Host. Very kind in ways and attitude. House was clean; no fault at all. And to our surprise he came and asks us to join him and his families and friends to have thanksgiving with them. That was so so amazing. - Y

Me and my colleagues can definetly recommend the Estudio 129 and Ron. The apartment was great and big enough for us three (everyone has his own bed). It has a great location for exploring Manhattan and the Rest of New York. And also the neighborhood had all he needs from bars over supermarket etc. We never felt unsave also at nighttime.
Ron is a fantastic host, he helped us with everything. And whenever we had a question he answered very fast and did his best to help us.
We had a great time in NYC and we look forward to come back to this great city.
So thank you Ron for everything and once again we can only recommend this apartment.
this is the 2nd time I have stayed here, I love Laranyas house and the improvements she has done in the last yr is unreal. nothing but love from and love for Laranya
ótima estadia, ótima localização. mas apesar de ser um hotel, não havia limpeza dos quartos diariamente.
Great space; I would book again in the future.

I would highly recommend this brownstone unit! It’s full of natural light, private + it’s aesthetically pleasing which I definitely look for when booking on Airbnb. It’s no wonder it’s one awards for the way the space is designed. Overall, a great stay! Enjoyed my weekend in BK.

Clean room in a quiet neighborhood. Host was quick to correct a logistical snafu which I was grateful for (5 degrees outside, NYC in the winter!). Close to shopping and bars in Co-op City. There’s a bus to the 5 train on the same block as well as a charming Italian restaurant. If you stay here, make sure to visit Gun Hill Brewery, a few blocks away.
The communication was excellent and the apt was so charming!!! This will be my go to when family comes to town!

El lugar tal cual las fotos, tranquilo y seguro.
Lo unico negativo es que de noche mucha gente ebria en la cuadra.

I visit Sunnyside Queens a lot.  And Sammy's place might be my favorite Airbnb.  If you stay at Sammy's expect a spacious, clean and comfortable apartment in a jumping Queens location 2 blocks from the subway.   If it's available grab it.
great and responsive guy, worth every penny what you pay for

This acommodation was perfect! Our hosts were very polite, communicative and helpful. Our space was big, cosy and convenient. Neighborhood was safe and quiet. We commuted to Manhattan in 15 min. We have only good memories with Silvia's house! We recommend this place to everyone!
Good value and an interesting, calm neighborhood. A bit far from the subway but easy enough to bus even with kids.

Darya is a delightful,charming, warm-hearted friend! I love here once I met her on the street (haha that’s because we met outside of the room)She’s energetic and talktive and you can feel her passion to make your stay in NYC a beautiful thing. From her I got loads of info about great restaurants,shows and shops!
I feel so emotional when I left and sure I will come back to NYC and stay at Darya’s will be sure !
Thank you again honey!
This airbnb was awesome - super easy to get around west village and the amenities were great. Host was super responsive and made for an easy experience.
Amazing location right next to the metro station. Very comfortable rooms and great attention from host.
wasn’t all the nice it didn’t smell great and the space was smaller than i thought but it wasn’t terrible.
Nice room in the heart of Harlem.  Loved the location!
Lovely apartment. Great location. Stunning views. Really recommend this place. Absolutely gorgeous place/views

I really enjoyd staying at Yana's pretty apartment. It's clean, nice size. Shopping street and subway station are very close, so it's covenient. It's easy to go to Manhattan! At night it's very quiet and could sleep well.
I could not see Yana, but she quickly replied to every question I asked. I saw her parents, and they're so nice and kind.
I really recommend this apartment. Thanks ٩( ᐛ )و

Matt & Crutch were amazing hosts. Unfortunately I wasn’t able to see her but she always respond quickly and seemed really nice. We met Matt on our day we arrived - it was really a pleasure to met him. Always kind, helpful and respond quickly. Thanks for everything!

Place is comfortable and clean. Michael is very friendly and welcoming person. Great places around to eat.
Metro is not as close as we hoped.
PS: in my opinion letting guests to leave luggage after check-out is global practice. I understand its not host’s problem, but little understanding from his/her side would be nice.
Nous avons passé un bon moment chez Sarah. Tout était conforme à la description et Sarah nous a donné des bons plans sur place.
Good value for proximity to JFK.
Fantastic and walkable location with lots of great restaurants and shops nearby!
Lovely stay at the Manhattan Club! Great location, close to Central Park and all the festive holiday hot spots. Had a nightcap at the bar every night which was nice. Would definitely stay here again!

When you view the listing for Secil’s property, at time of writing, you don’t view a dingy, basement, dark, cold room that has a very narrow, twisted, spiralling, metal staircase leading upstairs to where the kitchen, bathroom, and living areas are. For someone charging what she is charging for one room in a subzero basement, there really should be consideration of accessibility for a guest who may need to visit the bathroom at night. The episode would look like trying to navigate in the pitch dark, cold (if winter in New York), up an unsafe staircase. The apartment is very small and tight space. The bedroom has one isolated, uncovered lightbulb over some painted cardboard and that’s the extent of lighting. Further, I realised I was sharing the apartment not just with Secil (as said), but also 3 of her friends who were crashing for the month. One bathroom, 5 people, tiny space, and someone smoking a lot of weed. Other positive reviews are definitely bribed from Secil’s friends and fam.
They will change you extra money at check in and they don’t mention in on the Airbnb app.
Excelente para quem tem conexão ou precisa estar próximo do JFK. Local super limpo e cheiroso. Tinha absolutamente tudo disponível (shampoo, condicionador, creme, etc…) inclusive creme dental.

Melissa is the perfect host. The place is really nice, clean and cozy. She supplies many accommodations, from towels to snacks, and TV that has hundreds of channels. She's also always available and easy to contact. She even offers suggestions for things to do in the city. AMAZING HOST, AMAZING PLACE.

Victoria is a very good lady.  Kitty Dalwin is cute. The apartment is located in upper east side which is a safe and beautiful neiborhood. Everything was perfect. I will def book again if I come to NY next time.
Just like the pictures, nice and clean

James’s apartment was perfect for our trip. The location was great, really close to lots of restaurants and bars around 2nd Avenue and well connected to the rest of Manhattan. The space is big and well laid out with everything we needed for our week in New York!
Kaz is an extremely communicative and friendly host! Requests were accommodated and in a timely fashion. Apartment is conveniently near two subway stations and several cafes and groceries stores.
Perfect little stay! Loved the projector! Super clean and cozy space
Teresa was a friendly, helpful & caring host. The room was clean, private & cosy. The location could not have been better for getting around & seeing the most of NYC.

We could not have asked for a lovelier, more comfortable or inviting place to stay during our time in Brooklyn. We found this to be a perfect rental in a wonderful neighborhood and will hopefully be fortunate enough to stay here again.
The room was very cozy, a little home away from home.
Ron was an amazing host, always willing to help and giving indications. The place is in a great location and you can go walking to broadway and times square. I highly recommend staying at his place.
Rosy home is awesome.. when you walk in its nothing but love.  She is sooo sweet and her family is awesome.  Im going to book again in about 2wks
Awesome place to stay! Will definitely stay at similar locations.
Joy's apartment was very cozy.   The apartment's location accommodated all of our many destinations via subway.  It completely complimented a wonderful first visit to NYC.

Emplacement très pratique !
Idéal pour 4 personnes

This is a perfect solution to staying more affordably in an Airbnb in NYC. Even though it is not an entire place to yourself, it feels like it. Sufficient privacy, along with interaction with, and lovely hospitality from the hosts if you want it. The rooms themselves were wonderfully comfortable, spacious and tasteful. The bed was extremely comfortable. And of course the location is perfect for anyone who loves Brooklyn!

We LOVED our stay at Sheilas apartment in beautiful Brooklyn/New York. The neighborhood was wonderful, outside of the main tourist areas but an easy and quick subway ride away. The apartment is just beautiful!
Great location, very clean space, clear and easy to follow instructions. Will definitely stay again if In NYC. Thanks Leona and Renee.

Great host with awesome hospitality! It’s in a very nice quiet location, very close to the subway station, going into manhattan was really convenient. I would strongly suggest this place and the host for such a price it’s a steal.

Laurence was an awesome host! I really enjoyed our conversations and especially his artistic mind. One morning we pleasantly woke up to his piano rhythms, it was a treat. He was very accommodating with our schedule and answered many of our questions. Super nice person, even after I accidentally locked him out of his own home, I felt horrible! We were in town for the Brooklyn Half Marathon and his apartment was only a 10 minute walk away from the start line and in a great neighborhood.
Gabriel's apartment was like a home away from home.  His personal touches made it extra special.  Very clean, modern, and convenient!

This place was perfect!  There is nothing negative I can say.  The staff was very friendly and when I had trouble with the TV the gentleman came up to take a look at in a matter of 5 minutes.  The bathroom and tub smelled like bleach which to me meant they took the cleaning very serious.  Complimentary coffee in the room as well as in the lobby (including tea) were an added bonus.  Complimentary snacks and water were also available.  This is my go to place for all future trips to NY
Kaz is best landlord ever. Very cosy room and friendly communication.
Space was clean , cute and quiet! Perfect for my work trip in Nyc. WiFi was a bit difficult to deal with but that’s a minor problem. Would definitely stay again

It was perfect for what I needed
When I had trouble finding the lock box they answered my phone call at 11 pm and explained where to find it. Super nice and patient! Much appreciated!!

La verdad no nos volveríamos a quedar nunca ahí, la persona que hizo el aseo no lo realizó bien, además tuvo una mala actitud con nosotros pues entregó el espacio 30 minutos después y nos dijo que no le importaba si nos íbamos porque finalmente nosotros éramos los que perdíamos el dinero y ella no. Además el sector es muy alejado de todo los sitios de interés y el ambiente no es agradable, los vecinos nos veían como bichos raros.

I think this place is overpriced. I shifted to Mariott after this and price has very little difference.
the breakfast is ehhh... you have 2 things cooked rest is all just there and they say continental breakfast. and the breakfast ends at 9.
The room was great but the issue I faced on day one was there were loud noises coming from the mechanical room besides my room.
2nd and last night the AC stopped working. not in the hands of the host but yeah caused me inconvenience that put me in the worst state possible cause I had little to no sleep in my 2 days of stay.
Absolutely perfect spot for a family. Location was awesome and so many great places to eat and quick walk to Fort Greene park
Great place to stay . Restaurants and all other amenities needed very nearby including subway. You will love walk in the river side too !

Russell's place was perfect for my short stay in Brooklyn! It was easy to get to and Russell made check in and check out very easy as well. The bed was also super comfy which was a plus! Thanks Russell!
The place has all you need. The location is ver good and Michael is very kind.
Olenka was very understanding of my situation and did everything in her power to help me. I definitely recommend staying with her.
Great stay in this apartment, the location is perfect and Jillian is very welcoming.

Staying at Joaquin and Jon’s place was honestly one of the best decisions I made in my life. I’m originally from Montreal, Canada and was moving from LA to NYC when I picked their place and they made me feel right at home. They made moving to NY a heartwarming experience and went above and beyond to make me feel comfortable (even coming to visit apartments with me!).
For anyone out there who is looking to visit NY (especially my Canadian out there), please do yourself a favor and stay at Jon and Joaquin’s place. You will not regret it. The place is even better than on the pictures!
Now that I’m in NY, I will stay in contact with Jon and Joaquin (and Molly, their amazing dog) just because they are fabulous people and I’ll never be able to thank them enough for making my move to NY so much smoother! Jon and Joaquin, THANK YOU for everything! You are the best and I already Can’t wait to see you again <3

Clean. Comfortable. Great location. Amazing hosts. 5 stars.
Absolutely amazing place. The space itself is stylish and comfortable; the appliances are all new and up to date. The location is great: parking is easy (just be mindful of street cleaning), the bus is literally outside their door, the train is a short walk away, and the grocery store is just down the street (but bring your own bags so you don't get charged for one - Cat thoughtfully provides some). And the area is safe; I traveled alone and ran around the neighborhood a few times and never felt uncomfortable.
The cherry on top during my stay was the hospitality that Cat and her partner provided. I cannot say enough great things about them; they truly made me feel like family during my stay. Cat was very responsive to my texts, in fact she was even proactive with regard to street cleaning and keeping me up to date on any changes there.
I am already recommending their place to my family and friends that visit NYC.

Our stay was pleasant and the location was conveniently located close to many eateries and the metro stop on Franklin Ave. Amenities were well stocked and we were also pleasantly surprised how many appliances were available to use in the kitchen.  Communication was very easy and clear with the hosts and check-in and check-out was very smooth. Only drawback was the lack of control over the radiators, so the unit stayed very warm at night.
Super clean and quiet space. Host provided clear instructions and accommodated all requests. 5 min walk to nearest MTA stop. Great spot for single traveler. Would book again!
Magdalene was a great host! Very responsive and gave great recommendations on where to go and what to do in the city. The place was great as well, exceeding my expectations. Would 100% recommend!

Merci beaucoup à Olivier de m'avoir accueilli , il a été très réactif et je lui remercie pour cela mais aussi ses conseils sur la visite de la ville, je suis resté un mois et cela s'est très bien passé.
the place is really clean and worth your pay I highly recommend it

My husband and I stayed at Jenni’s place’s for a week and loved every moment of it! Everything we needed was in walking distance; great restaurants, coffee shops, a CVS, literally everything. The apartment was spotless, well stocked, and even though we didn’t get a chance to use the backyard, we still enjoyed having the view. We would 100% stay here again!
Just as described! We had a wonderful stay with our family and the location right in the heart of the East Village was amazing!

James and Mina where the hosts with the mostesses!! Such lovely, welcoming and kind people. They where very keen to give advice on what to see in the local area and the states in general, they even provided a delicious breakfast. The place is super cool and clean and in a fab area close to everything a traveller could want. I would highly recommend their place.

Nice apartment. Cozy. Great for single or a young couple. New furniture. Very good location on upper west a side. Subway is only 2 minutes of walk. Close to central park, many small resturants around.
Alina was very welcoming, she was very flexible on cheacking in and out. Will stay again.
Ruben is a great host, he was very responsive and friendly all the time.

I am not exaggerating when I say, “if I could give ten stars, I WOULD.” After a first-time negative Airbnb experience at another location last month (which Airbnb was fantastic about and compensated me for, after noting they’d conduct an investigation on the host I stayed with), I was a bit apprehensive about using the platform again. I absolutely could not have experienced a better and more memorable, friendly, and kind stay with Dianna and Charlie. Dianna’s most wonderful and friendly nature was the cherry on top of a truly beautiful home and every single thing a host could possibly think of to make a guest feel welcomed and comfortable. My mind was honestly blown at the immensely positive time and care given during my stay; amenities were abundant, instructions were super clear, recommendations for restaurants and the local subway were spot on - I honestly can’t rave enough. Truly one of the BEST experiences I’ve had staying anywhere in the world. I can’t wait to return. THANK YOU!!
Jaleh was extremely sweet and accomodating! Had a lovely time and will definitely come back if I have the chance to :)
This is a great place in a great location. Only thing to note is that the unit is on the 4th floor and there is no elevator. Nikki is a great host.
Untitled is a beautiful place hidden in an artistically graffitied alley.   Staff was friendly and the place was very well appointed.  Amazing location.
This home is an excellent art-filled welcoming place with creative intelligent hosts who are a pleasure to be with.
Ubicación inmejorable. Muy amables anfitriones. Los recomiendo ampliamente
Carla was excellent, the room was clean and the apartment is in a wonderful location and it is possible to do everything walking, if you are available to walk.

Amazing location just a few hundred feet from Moynihan Train Station and a good size for NYC at this price point. Air conditioners in each room was also a huge plus.
Unfortunately I had to wait 20 minutes to be checked in despite letting them know my arrival time in advance. One toilet per floor with the number of rooms wasn't fantastic. There was trash under the sink from the previous guest as well.
It's still one of the better budget options I've seen in this part of the city though.

I loved this apt. It was so clean, comfortable, and a GREAT neighborhood. I like a little more natural light.
Richard the owner was incredibly responsive and helpful.
Loren was awesome, easy to communicate with and very kind and helpful. It’s a great rental and she was wonderful.

Savannah's place is perfectly located to explore Manhattan and surrounds.  Great market near by, super easy access to the Subway, and lots of great neighborhood dives and cafes within easy walking distance. We really enjoyed our stay

This Was My First Time Using Air BNB And I Was Really Apprehensive I Immediately Felt Comfortable When I Was Greeted By The Owner And Two Very Special Family Members And The Stay Was Wonderful Every Question I Had Was Answered Immediately No Matter The Time Of Day I Asked ! It’s An Amazing Place Don’t Hesitate To Book It Will Definitely Be Worth It !

Very old building and lacking in simple conveniences.    No luggage rack, no handrail on inside stairs.   No nightlight.    Glass jars used in bathtub & Slippery when wet.   For guests sleeping in separate beds—must be clear before checkin.     With the check in more rules are added.  No guests.   Very pricey for such a basic room.
This was an amazing spot. The host really outdid himself with this place. I felt at home and the place had everything.  Thank you again for a great stay!
Great place, highly recommend.
Very affordable and great location for our needs!

Carmen was an extremely kind host, very responsive, and very accommodating, however her actual listing left much to be desired. Within the first week, the toilet flooded the apartment, which was addressed promptly by Carmen. But from the second week on, the sink was constantly flooding the counters and kitchen floor with dirty water and refuse from the drainpipe, at least once a week. The wooden tiles from the floor were cracked as a result of it and shifted across the concrete below. There was an odd smell in the apartment most of the time, but that might’ve been reflective of the apartment building and not the specific unit. And in the last 3 weeks of my stay, I came home to the electricity shut off in the apartment multiple times, which took several hours to address by maintenance. Otherwise, the furniture and bathroom were clean, but there were some stains on the couches and chairs. Overall though, it definitely wasn’t worth the money I paid and I wouldn’t recommend staying here.

Das Zimmer entsprach genau der Beschreibung - ein super Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis. Es ist zwar sehr klein, aber man hat alles, was man braucht - für ein junges/ junggebliebenes Paar oder gute Freunde reicht es völlig aus, da man sich die meiste Zeit draußen  in Manhatten bewegt. Die Dusche und das WC waren immer sauber und im Haus war es auch nie zu laut. Besonders positiv war, dass das Zimmer ein Fenster hat, welches man auch öffnen kann (nicht selbstverständlich in NY). Der einzige Kritikpunkt ist das Stockbett, was sehr wackelig ist und wenig vertrauensvoll wirkt - eingestürzt ist es aber zum Glück nicht. Alles in Allem würde ich die Unterkunft für den Zweck der Stadtbesichtigung weiterempfehlen und selbst auch  wieder buchen.
Great location and perfect place to experience life in NYC!  Had everything we needed.  Thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would recommend Francisco’s place to others!

Sharon and her husband were amazing! Due to the weather leaving us stuck in New York they were able to accommodate the extra time we needed. In addition they are super cool and very nice. When we arrived they walked us through maps and gave us food recommendations. Mostly they made sure we had every thing we needed and were comfortable and as stress free as possible. I would definitely stay again the next time I visit New York.

Although this is a nice house in a great location, there were several problems with check-in and other guests staying in the house.
The host is never actually there, his sister, who was very nice and tried to be accommodating, is in the house.
Unfortunately, it was never communicated to her who was actually staying in what room and consequently it took forever for my room to be prepared.
That brings me to my next point, I was never made aware that other people were staying in the house. Based on what I was told it was my understanding that just his sister was in the house and I would be renting a private room and bath in another section of a house.
The guest in the room next to me was incredibly loud and noisy, and given the fact that there are wood floors with no carpeting in an old Brownstone, it is incredibly noisy. Also they were singing or humming all night, banging on walls, and their phone was going off all night.
And I hope you like cats that meow all night.
It wasn't until 4 or 5 in the morning when things finally got quiet. And by then I had had enough, got ready and just went to the airport.
And that was five hours before my flight left, I just wanted to get out of there.
It's a nice room, but the mattress is very uncomfortable, the hot water is very temperamental, and unfortunately it was too cold to take advantage of the deck outside the room.
I think a lot of these issues could have been avoided had things been communicated more clearly.
It would be nice if you could communicate with the host by phone, rather than sending several messages.
And unfortunately this ghost host never communicated clearly with his sister who was staying there and what rooms they were in.
And although you can lock the room from inside, the host never gave his sister a key to lock the door on the rooms when you leave the house. There is absolutely no privacy when you leave the room. Anyone could have had access to it.
To summarize, it's a nice house in a great neighborhood, but lack of communicating all the particulars led to a miserable stay.
Great time, room was very clean, cozy and comfortable. Great walkable location. Definitely would stay there again.

I stayed for a few months for school and I couldn’t recommend this place more. I often saw Eleanor’s father, John, and he always asked if I was okay and about my family. I felt very safe and he was so kind. I would stay again!
Lovely apartment in a great location! Stara was really helpful too and provided some great recommendations
Great host, easy check in, privacy and room is identical to photos.
Spacious and clean apartment! Check in was easy and Maruf was available to us when needed. Great value. We would book again. It was great for our family with two young kids.

John and his family were friendly. They worked with me on my space needs. Great communication. Very nice place. Easy commute with red line one block away.
I would recommend to anyone who needs to be in NYC but wants to escape midtown.
Our stay at Thomas and Terry's was great! A very clean space with everything one might need. We love Bedstuy!
Vincent made me feel very welcome and at home during the stay! Was very helpful and responsive! Would stay again!
la habitación es muy buena, tiene buena ubicación y respetan todo el intinerario, lo recomiendo

The home is clean, spacious, well stocked and just as described. Worked great for our family of 5. Great kitchen and it is extremely well stocked! Silver Lake is a beautiful area. The ferry was easy to access which we used each day to access Manhattan. Lorrie was very responsive and helpful. Highly recommend!

Spirit Retreats in NYC is the perfect affordable spot for solo travelers! As a female traveling alone, I felt completely safe and welcomed from the moment I arrived. The staff is incredibly kind and go above and beyond to help, Rose in particular was amazing! She gave me directions and wonderful local recommendations that really made my trip easier.
I also loved that they provide a delicious vegan breakfast each morning, plus snacks available throughout the day. On top of that, you get great discounts on yoga classes and massages, which made it feel like such a well-rounded, relaxing stay.
What I appreciated most was the sense of community, it’s rare to find such a kind, supportive environment in a city as big as New York. Truly the perfect place for anyone looking to feel at home while exploring the city!

We liked how close this place was to all the tourist destinations. The check-in and check-out process was extremely easy. Loved the ambiance of the place. Great natural light. The curler and hair dryer was a plus point. Marvelous place for the price and the convenience. Would definitely recommend.
Me and my family felt at home. I cooked, watched the cable TV. We really enjoyed
Beautiful appartment - yes, better than the pictures - on quiet street in lively neighborhood. Ryan is a friendly host with quick response. Would stay again next time.

Joann was such an amazing host! she was so nice and very flexible with check in and check out. She answered my texts right away and overall communicated very well. This was such a cute cozy Airbnb and away from the chaos of the city life. Close enough for you to get around. This is by far the best stay that I’ve had! Thanks so much Joann!!!

The room was very clean and comfortable.
Excellent location!

Me encantó el lugar, es pequeño y acogedor, fuimos un grupo de 5 y ellos adaptaron el apartamento, el baño es espacioso, básicamente solo lo usamos para dormir porque no la pasamos de paseo. Es una zona muy transitada por lo que hay ruido, pero eso no fue un problema en lo absoluto. Lo mejor de lo mejor es que el metro está AFUERA DEL HOTEL, lo que facilita el acceso a TODOS lados, enfrente teníamos tiendas de recuerditos muy baratos, y a dos lugares (negocios) del hotel, teníamos un McDonalds que nos sacaba de muchos apuros, sin duda alguna me volvería a hospedar ahí, todos fueron muy amables y fue un excelente servicio.
Great place to stay in. Extremely clean. Lots of space. Good location. Easy access to food. Highly recommend staying here.

Sigi is such a great host! We stayed about a week and really enjoyed the time. The place felt homey, it‘s very well equipped and also clean. Sigi was super forthcoming and helpful. She gave us a couple of recommendations for our stay and how to best navigate around the city. As stated, two dogs were staying at the house but they were very calm and friendly, so no issues at all.
The location is also great, right around the corner of a Q line subway station. We‘d definitely stay here again if we get the chance to :)
Die Unterkunft entsprach der Beschreibung. Sehr gutes Preis / Leistungsverhältnis, ruhige Gegend. Der größte Vorteil ist die wirklich sehr nahe Lage der U-Bahn-Haltestelle.
Great place close to the station. Hosts were easy to contact. Place was very spacious.
Room is big and clean. Safely. Great location! Close to public transport. Lots of bars and shops. Thank you Sole for a great stay!

My stay at "The Local Stay" in NY was a nightmare from day one. Initially, everything seemed fine - photos, prompt communication, and an easy check-in.
However, issues started on day 1st when I found the apartment super cold. The Local Stay took 9 hours to reply to my complaint, and it seemed they weren't even based in NY, responding at 1.40 AM. Despite moving me to another apartment after days of freezing, the new place had the same heating issue. It took 4 days for a plumber to confirm improper installation, which shows they don't even check if amenities are working beforehand.
I requested to check out 15 days earlier and get reimbursed. The Local Stay agreed at first, but when I finally did it, they offered excuses, ignoring me. I had to ask Airbnb for support and in the end, Airbnb reimbursed me, compensated me for the lack of heat and allowed me to check out earlier. I know The Local Stay will blame me in the comments, but the truth is I got to leave and my money back. AVOID!!
It was a really nice place not very far from the station. Not lots of stuff to do around though. But overall we really liked the place and it matches the description.

Joseph’s place is all about location! Good restaurants and shops near by.
The bed was big enough for two people.
Hot shower works fine.
Great value overall.
The location is very good, calm,  across the street from the park. A short walk to the metro and common roads.

What an AMAZING expierence!!! From the moment I booked, Yochi was extremely responsive. Upon arrival, we were met by Yochi who was an absolute delight. She made us feel at home the entire time. Offered tk make breakfast; however, wr had breakfast plans everyday. She was kind and had placed a bottle of wine in our room. When we finished that, she had another one in our room waiting for us.  The morning we left, she insisted on making cappuccino for us, which was amazing. The room was amazing, with the most comfortable bed. Closet space was penty big with robes waiting for us. We had our own bathroom which was also nice. The location was amazing. 1 block from train station and plenty of restaurants. We go to NYC often and this bt far was our best expierence.  Yochi makes you feel right at home and we felt so comfortable being in this amazing loft. We cant wait to stay here again!
Great deal and just as described!
Great location, great host, and a really comfortable and cozy place with so much helpful information and recommendations offered.
If your looking for a quick day trip, this place is ok. Bare minimum standards. Don’t plan on using the appliances. Fridge, microwave.

Lakshmee's place was an amazing combination of both affordability and its closeness in proximity to jfk, which was ideal to beat the early morning rush hour traffic towards the airport. She was great at directing me to some nice nearby restaurants, and with providing information regarding the city. She was very courteous and I would highly recommend staying here.

Me and my family had a very good time at this apartment. Everything was amazing! The apartment was super clean and cosy! There was everything that you need for comfortable staying! I would stay here again and I really recommended this place for everyone!
Thank you Tatiana and Max!
Very clean, just as described.  Beds were very comfortable!   Close proximity to everything and right by the subway.

I had a queen with balcony on 12th floor in building without the restaurants. The balcony enhanced the size of the room and enjoyable to sit outside. Always someone present at the door. Good security. Excellent location.
I do think the bathroom, which is small but functional, needed to be cleaned better. Specifically, the shower door tracks.
Overall, I would stay again.

Clean, quiet space in Brooklyn. Easy to find, located close to subway service and shops providing basic amenities. Common downstairs entry, but private door with a lock to the apartment on the third floor, where guests stay. Privacy was well provided. Host communicated promptly, and he was very helpful with various concerns and questions regarding practical matters. Neighborhood is a bit far from Manhattan, but subway service is sufficient. Safe area, quiet street. A fine room in the outer boroughs.
We loved our stay! The apartment was stylish, cozy, and super clean! Zhijian was really responsive and considerate. We would love to come back again in the future!
We loved this Airbnb!!!!! Would highly recommend for a cozy and convenient location!!! Will stay here again in the future.
A very stylish, quiet home. Very close to the subway. A most enjoyable stay!

Angel's apartment is located in a great section of Brooklyn
Very conveient to public transportation, restaurants and stores.
Angel was an excellent host and very accommodating.
The apartment was comfortable and well equipped.
We enjoyed our stay there.
Lawrence was very responsive and great to work with! We loved our NY stay.

The apartment is centrally located. Easy train access and a lot of nearby restaurant options. Great bodega next door. Place was very comfortable and clean. Would definitely stay here again for our next visit to NYC!
Clean and simple room. Perfect for a short stay and close to everything
Jaleh is such a sweetheart and the house is always super neat and tidy :)

E's studio was one of the best Airbnb experiences I've had to date. Before anything, E is an amazingly communicative host. E made sure I truly felt right at home and was quick to respond. The studio itself was a minimalist's dream stay! The bed was comfortable and the TV setup made for some great nights in with good food and Netflix. E graciously provides spare toiletries, bottled water, and then some that's ready for your arrival after any long day. Any city noise was like a pleasant ambient noise, and the neighborhood felt refreshingly local too. I'll most definitely be back for another enjoyable zen getaway in Brooklyn!
This spot was so perfect you are literally right by everything !

Michael and Molly’s home is stunning! It looks like a home from an interior design magazine! It’s very clean, and extremely comfortable to live in. Location is amazing, building is safe and well maintained, just the perfect Manhattan experience!

Horrible horrible host. Slow and unresponsive. Late check in and the place is absolutely filthy. Totally unacceptable and unhygienic.
And then when we tried to ask for a partial refund this douchebag had the audacity to say we were trying to “scam” and was totally rude and unprofessional.
It is not at all worth the $100 you might save, nightmare experience stay away.

Thanks Ronald for the stay :)
Ronald was very friendly, and communication was clear and fast. The lively street life of Soho begins right at the doorstep, and the location is excellent. The sofa bed in the living room is a bit uncomfortable for sleeping, but this can be improved with additional cushions.

Really enjoyed our stay.  Wonderful host, wonderful family.  A home away from home in a great area of Brooklyn.  Lots to do nearby.  Street parking was a breeze, public transit less than 5 min walk.  House was modern, clean, comfortable and well equipped.  We still miss the spa like shower  : )
wonderfull we will come back everything was perfect

Wow! I'm new to Airbnb but can see why people love and it and even more so why everyone LOVES staying with Alicia. I know I did :) Everything was exactly as mentioned - and better! She and her family were very warm and inviting. I was so so cozy in the room, found great food in the neighborhood and it was quick and easy to get to from other parts of the city. A highly recommended experience...I look forward to going back.

I can divide my experience at Michael's place in two parts - one positive, one negative. In the first part, I have enjoyed staying in the flat. While it is oldish and not perfectly clean, the studio is generally well kept, with all necessary furniture and equipment. It is about 40 minutes from Washington Square by subway, but close enough to several tourist attractions. Michael has been generally helpful with ordinary issues and has contacted his assistants in case of need. The second part has been a very bad experience for me. The fridge stopped working. It actually kept switching itself on and off and there was clearly an electrical problem. For some reason, Michael stubbornly refused to acknowledge this and claimed that I switched the fridge off by mistake - which could not possibly be, if anything because I speak fluently both English and Spanish and there was no reason why I would do so. He came into the studio, turned the thermostat off and took a picture, arguing that that was evidence of my bad behaviour. I have had to turn to Airbnb, sending them videos and pictures showing that the fridge was really malfunctioning. Airbnb was very helpful and in the end Michael realised that the fridge had to be replaced. I do not understand why he would insist that the fridge worked, when it was not true. All in all, it took about two weeks, or a bit more, to sort out the problem. I was in NYC for work reasons, so it was not exacly pleasant to waste time on this.
you get what you pay for! just stayed for a night and didn’t have any issues.

El lugar es justo como lo describen, nos quedamos 5 personas y fue muy cómodo.
El agua caliente siempre estuvo perfecta, las camas y la limpieza también.
Está a un minuto de la estación del metro (literal 1 minuto) y el acceso es muy fácil.
Sin duda alguna cuando regrese a NYC buscare quedarme en su lugar. (:
great communication and clean place

This place is perfect! It is clean, cozy and has everything you need. The bed was very comfortable, easy-to-control temperature, big TV, pretty electric fireplace, air mattress and towels, blankets, utensils - everything! The in-unit washer & dryer was so convenient.
Junior was so helpful & polite. He helped me park & with transportation to our venue. He was so friendly and truly a warm & kind host.
I took my Son to his 1st concert. We had an amazing time. We will stay here again!

It was an easy 15 minute walk to many great restaurants and bars, they close at 11-midnight but still very nice area. The Staten Island Ferry is NYC best kept secret, great way to get to and from NYC and only about 12 minute walk. I will absolutely stay here again!

Willie was always rouchable for some help.
Flat is nice and comfy with really well equipped

I had a great stay with Desiree! The room was really cute, and the bed was super comfortable -- better than most hotel beds. I was under the weather for a lot of my trip, and I keep to myself when traveling anyway, so the cozy room was a real treat. And I loved the tiny cat, Melanie, who made an appearance every time I stepped out.
The house was within walking distance of lots of good eats, and Desiree made some useful recommendations (+1 for Mike's Pizza!). She also accommodated my late arrival, was always responsive to messages, and made getting settled in quick and easy. Overall: I really enjoyed chatting with Desiree about world travel, the space and location were perfect, and I'll definitely come back next time I stay in Brooklyn!
PS: Neighborhood noise (sirens, dogs, a nearby trombonist) is a little louder than what you'd experience in a hotel or high-rise, so light sleepers/folks from quiet places should be prepared for that. Nothing earplugs or headphones can't handle :)

This AirBnb is at a great location in the middle of Williamsburg, Brooklyn. Easy walk to anywhere, including the L subway station. Communication with the host was always prompt.  Everything in the apartment was functional (hot water, secure locks, etc). Would stay here again when in town.
Great place ! Loved it !! Would most definitely recommend it

Lovely and very comfortable stay at Sol’s.  The space was spacious, very clean, and welcoming.  Very convenient to the subway and restaurants and just about anything you need.  Sol and Carmen were so thoughtful and their response time was almost immediate.  Our girls weekend was a huge success and we would definitely come back!

Very friendly easy to understand check in description ❤️ very comfortable beds.
Thanks sharon ❤️❤️❤️👌🏽

Everything was walking distance. It was very convenient that the uber shuttle for pick and drop off to LaGuardia airport is across the street of the hotel.
And listing shows it has mini fridge and it doesn’t. There was no mini fridge.
Clean and just as advertised

I stayed here for about a month and I absolutely loved it. Maria and Arty are super cool and nice. The location is right at Kent and N 1st. Domino park is  just around the corner. Lots of great restaurants and cafes are nearby.  Only one subway stop to manhattan. The room is super nice with a comfortable mattress. The living room is spacious with multiple couches. I highly recommend it!
Must say thanks to Anthony and Dawn for a well spent accommodation.  A heartfelt thank to Dawn for all the help she extended to us. A must visit again

Excellent place to crash before or after flying in/out of JFK. By Uber, it's only a 5 min drive and costs less than $15. Super easy! Had no problems with scheduling an Uber ride for the morning (driver found the place easily). The room is okay for one night stay. Pretty clean but you can hear the noise from other rooms and the streets. The shared kitchen is a nice addition!

I had a great stay here while visiting friends in bk. I was traveling with my infant son and wanted a relaxing and conveniently located place for us to unwind after socializing and exploring the city.
The space is quite large and had everything we needed. Even though it was just me and my baby we ended up using both beds because I realized the one in the back was much quieter than the one on the street. I'm sensitive to sound and I slept well by using a fan for some white noise.thw host also provided ear plugs but I didn't find that I needed them to sleep well.
This spot is in a very walkable location. I wish I had more time to spend to explore more of the local restaurants and cafes. would definitely return!

Lastly, like many parts of the city, such as the neighborhood of Harlem, can be dangerous/sketchy. You need to have situational awareness and not walk around distracted with earbuds in or playing on your phone. You should do the same when in the subway. If you walk like you know where you are going, make eye contact with folks wandering around the street and subway when coming back late at night, you will be safe. I have been to NYC many many times and my husband is in law enforcement and shares his tips for safety with me, so I felt safe in Harlem as a single female walking around alone because my eyes were open and aware and I made eye contact with folks wandering around so they knew I saw them and I am not an easy target if they had bad intentions or opportunistic intentions. Moral of the story, just use your head and common sense and don't be distracted. Overall, great stay!

It is a shared space. Joel’s father lives on the other side, and you will be sharing a small kitchen space. He’s very quiet, and we never saw him or heard him. You’ll also share a small fridge with your own shelf and drawer.
The “doors”, are actually just sliding closet doors. There are large gaps that you can see through, and a curtain that separates your side of the apartment from Joel’s father. Like I said, we never saw him, just something to consider. If you want the AC, make sure you tell the hosts prior to your stay, so it can be installed.
