There was no shower curtain and the mini fridge was broken so maybe double check the situation on both of those before you book.

A lovely apartment in a peaceful Harlem street, close to subway and an ideal location for exploring NYC, also a home from home retreat after a busy day. Great kitchen/diner for breakfast/quiet dinners. Local eatery 'Ponty's Bistro' a great recommendation, also enjoyed Bier International on 113th Street. Accommodating & helpful hosts we would definitely love to return.
There was also a subway nearby, so it was good to go without a car. And thank you for your kind response every time. Thanks to you, I was able to do my schedule well in New York. Thank you!

Schnelle Anbindung an U-Bahn.
Julia und Peter sind sehr nette Gastgeber die hilfreiche Tipps geben.
Best location, great bed, beautiful apartment

È stata una esperienza splendida quella di stare in questa casa! Vicino alla metropolitana, posizione fantastica per visitare tutta New York e non solo Manhattan. Quando tornerò a New York tornerò sicuramente in questo alloggio. Pulizia perfetta, letto comodo, splendida cucina!
This is the perfect place for summer or in general really. Being a fellow ny’er. This space is soo cool and comfortable.

My friends and I enjoyed a wonderful stay! Mustafa waited for us to arrive even though we had several delays from the airport due to rain. The apartment had everything we needed: plenty of towels and extra sheets and comforters to use on the two futons. Very friendly and easy to communicate with during our stay. He checked in with us a few times to make sure we were doing okay. Overall, we had a great experience!
It was exactly as listed and exactly what we needed. Great location! Kamil checked in with us and was helpful when needed. Would definitely return!
Well located apartment. Clean, good bed, nice people and cat. Host very helpful. I would do it again.

Timur’s apartment is a perfect base to explore New York City! It is in a great location with easy access to various subway lines if you need to go uptown.
Timur was always extremely prompt with all communication and the photos and description are accurate. The apartment was very clean and has everything you could possibly want including a washing machine and good quality sheets and towels.
Everything about my stay at Timur’s was fantastic and I would definitely stay here again next time I am in NYC!
Excellent place to stay that matched the description and photos. Responsive host. Would enjoy staying again!
Host met us upon arrival, showed us around the house. Fantastic location! Easy to get a hold of if we had questions. Would recommend and stay here again!

Ashley’s place was fantastic!!! Great area, reasonably priced, super clean, amazing plant decor, and any expectations were completely surpassed (and they were high to start with because of the lovely photos and prior interactions). Would love to stay again someday!
Es un buen lugar. Ameno y tranquilo. cumple con lo que promete y está cerca de supermercados farmacias y por sobre todo del metro, dónde se abre un mundo a todos los lugares turísticos de nueva York.
We had an excellent stay. Host was friendly and welcoming. We had enough space for our things. Kitchen is good to have a breakfast before get into the city.

We felt very comfortable in the apartment and in the neighborhood. Pam and Jullien gave us good advice and helped us if necessary.
It is a clean and quite place, exactly like the picture. We had a great time, thanks,

A few blocks from the Theater District, this location was unbeatable and we appreciated a clean, quiet resting place in the middle of such a bustling city. Yasu & Akiko were responsive and helpful. Would definitely stay again!

James was an excellent host and his commuiuncation was great.
The location was amazing for the subway, bars, cafes and the east river ferry. loads of space and super comfortable would definitely stay again.

El alojamiento es tal como se describe en las fotos. René siempre estuvo atento desde el primer momento a todo lo que llegáramos a requerir.
La zona aunque no es muy turística nos sentimos seguros y el metro estaba muy cerca lo cual nos permitió trasladarnos muy fácilmente.

The place is really nice and is easy to move around the city from there, Pamela and her family is really nice and helpful. The only thing is: once you're there if you want to talk to Pamela real quick you should call her and don't send a message through the app.
Another thing to keep in mind if you're traveling with big bags is that there is a few stairs.
Overall i had a great experience and would be back 100%.
Great staff, nice breakfast, comfortable room
Beautiful apartment! Perfect for our quick stay in the city! Highly recommend

Le logement ressemble aux photos, grand, spacieux, bien équipé et proches de tout !
Petit point négatif le bruit la nuit, nous entendions énormément la circulation dans la rue à part ça tout c’est très bien passé !!
Wonderful spot with plenty of room to relax after visiting the city. Great shower, kitchen and living space. Karen is a helpful and accommodating host!

I’ve never stayed in Brooklyn but we had a wedding in prospect park. We felt like we had our own apartment for a few days. The hosts went out of their way to make sure we were comfortable and even added a coffee grinder to the kitchen. There were plenty of towels and pillows and the beds were super comfortable. They did an amazing job renovating the space and if I come back to Brooklyn we would definitely stay here again. We found the cutest Italian restaurant and had a great meal and loved feeling like locals.

I arrived at midnight and there was someone to greet me so it was really nice !
The room was cleaned as well as the kitchen and the bathroom. Plus, the surroundings was quiet !
Everything Ok, good location, responsive host.
Great host and great place. Quick responses.

Alles sah neu und gepflegt aus. Beide Schlafräume hatten einen Einbauschrank, der nur für uns frei war. Die Matratzen waren sehr gut. Das Sofa in dem Wohnraum war bequem und hatte mehr Raum als auf dem Foto. Die Wohnküche hatte einen geräumigen Esstisch an dem wir oft saßen, aßen und spielten. Die Küche hatte Mikrowelle, Kühlschrank mit Gefrierteil, Herd mit Backofen, Geschirrspüler, Kaffeemaschine, Toaster und alles Geschirr, was benötigt wurde.  Die Klimaanlage in dem kleinen Schlafzimmer sorgte in der ganzen Wohnung für ein angenehmes Klima . Die Dusche in dem großen Badezimmer, ebenerdig und mit einer Glaswand abgetrennt statt den üblichen Vorhängen, war toll und hatte viel Platz. Auf dem Hinterhofplatz der Wohnung waren neben Tisch und Stühlen noch eine große Hängematte aufgestellt. Blair und Forrest waren tolle Gastgeber und sehr entgegenkommend, wir kommen gerne wieder.

The experience of living in Ahmed Apartment is awesome. He is a really nice guy and we had some good talks. The Bed is really suitable for a couple  or two friends, and if you want you could add a bed in the living room. The location is great too. Everything is walkable. This is the first comment I give on Airbnb because it worth it. Wonderful Experience!

Cali was a great host. She went out of her way to met us for an early check-in which was really appreciated. She was also really quick with her responses!
The place was clean- nicely decorated with great wifi. The building is in a safe and quiet area of NYC that is accessible by foot or transit to Times Square, Central Park, Natural History Museum, Lincoln Centre, buses and the subway.
Nice touches: Two pairs of keys, Filtered water in the fridge, Early Check-in
My husband and I had a great time and would definitely stay here again!
Thanks Cali!

We enjoyed our stay at Emma’s place. The location was great, an easy walk to great restaurants. We really liked Pylos & Lavagna. Two amazing Jewish delis are nearby too. We got to be regulars for a few nights at the pub across the street. The east village is just a nice place to be! The apartment is quite small, but well thought out & comfortable. We would definitely stay here again.
Lawrence is a fantastic host and place is everything advertised
A lovely location, very clean and such a cozy bed. The best thing however is the excellent host, Ellen!
So so sorry you had the stress of dealing with my partner’s belongings still being in the Airbnb . Thank you so much for your patience and grace with this situation

Rohit's place looks exactly like the pictures! When we arrived the home was already warm and ready for a cozy Brooklyn night. It's aesthetically appealing and has everything you need for a wonderful New York stay. I will definitely be staying again. Thank you!
Very good price for a private room with a lot of facilities. The place was clean, and the host is helpful and responds immediately.

Die Lage des Appartements ist großartig und sehr gut zu erreichen! U-Bahn Station ist gleich in der Nähe. Der Check in ist durch eine Schlüsselbox geregelt und damit super einfach und flexibel.
Cara hat uns bei jeglichen Fragen super schnell geantwortet. Leider haben wir sie nur an unserem Abreisetag persönlich getroffen. Cara ist eine sehr freundliche und aufgeschlossenen Person wir hatten ein gutes Gespräch und haben gute Tipps erhalten :-)
Das Zimmer und das Bad waren in einem top Zustand!
Wir würden auf jeden Fall ein zweites Mal hier schlafen!
Es war sehr angenehm & sauber. Die Lage war super. Für NY Verhältnis ruhig. Nur zum empfinden

Dawn doesn't deserve 5 stars, She deserves 10! Dawn is the host that everyone should have their first time traveling. This lovely lady is so kind, patient and helpful. The apartment is absolutely amazing and top notch, the pictures definitely don't do the apartment any justice. My experience here was just amazing, came with a lot of "just in case" toiletries. I'm definitely coming back!!!!!
Levi’s place was perfect for us. Great Crown Heights location. Quiet and cozy.
Everything was to our expectations. Great location. Overall good stay.
Nice space.  We only stayed a little while to help our daughter move into a new apt in the area.  Ellen helped us in and we were exhausted from the move.  One restful sleep later we were on our way.

I can’t say enough wonderful things about this space! It looks even better than the pictures and we felt right at home the second we walked in. Patricia is extremely kind, responsive, and helpful, and I am so grateful for the wonderful experience. Great neighborhood— very quiet, very clean, and we felt extremely safe. We definitely hope to return some day! It was tough to leave!

Staying at The Ridge was seamless. I was a little worried about the contactless hotel in case anything came up, but I emailed ahead of the reservation with a question and received a response very quickly. There was someone at the front desk on several occasions as well. The location and amenities were perfect for what we needed for a weekend stay. We would definitely book there again.
Séjour très agréable chez Manuel. Le lit est très confortable, le quartier est calme. Manuel est très réactif et saura répondre à vos questions. Je recommande.
Thank you so much! This house is amazing!

Convenient, affordable, clean, and welcoming. We had a great stay and would definitely do it again! Less than a 10 minute drive to the ferry and Uber’s are available to local bars and restaurants if you do not have a vehicle.

Lauras place was just beautiful, clean, and well thought out. I was able to keep up with my routines as if she new who I was, simply by how well stocked her kitchen was, great quality appliances, & a genuine heart. Thank you Laura & Hugo!
Great house in great location. Lovely host family, beautiful neighborhood. We'll be back!

I was  visiting my daughter at St. John’s University and Olga’s place was within a short walking distance and at a good value. We appreciated the water jug and hot water kettle for tea. We’d definitely stay again!

Olga is a amazing hots. The house is beautiful and has own decoration by her. I love the Vintage decoration . Free parking. Quiet community. Definitely I love it’s. Subway is 13min by walking.  A lot of restaurants in the area and shopping.

Hugo's place was absolutely wonderful! Amazing decor, stunning rooftop views, very accessible to local amenities and shopping, easy to find, wonderful location in a very walkable neighborhood. I would 1000% stay there again. I can't say enough about the place and how excellent of a host Hugo and Adam were before, during, and after my stay. Look no further and BOOK  WITH THEM NOW!! You won't regret it!
The Box House was really nice. The Staff was really friendly and helpful. Recommend this place for anyone looking for a place in brooklyn. Close to the 7 train and the Manhattan.

Natürlich! Hier ist eine sehr positive Airbnb-Bewertung für dich:
⸻
Ich hatte eine wunderbare Zeit in Tonis Unterkunft! Die Kommunikation mit Toni war durchweg hervorragend – schnell, freundlich und hilfsbereit. Die Wohnung selbst ist sehr geräumig, stilvoll eingerichtet und mit allem ausgestattet, was man braucht. Besonders hervorzuheben ist auch die tolle Lage – zentral, aber dennoch ruhig. Ich habe meinen Aufenthalt wirklich sehr genossen und kann die Unterkunft wärmstens weiterempfehlen. Vielen Dank, Toni!

I really enjoyed my stay at Yvonne’s
Amazing host !

The place is 10-15 minutes away from JFK and 20 minutes away from the nearest subway station. Plenty of street parking spots is a Plus! The master bedroom faces a busy street therefore traffic sound is continuous. Hosts were kind and responsive. They solved problems in a timely manner which caused little or no trouble to us. Recommended!

This apartment is well worth it. It is in a great neighborhood that gives you a very authentic taste of New York. The subway is close and the apartment itself is amazing. I would stay here again. The apartment came with everything we needed plus more. The hosts are great and friendly.

Staying with Kareem was a pleasure. The apartment was as described, Harlem is a little more further north than we usually stay but we were pleasantly surprised by how convenient it was. Kareem made arranging the booking and going over the various queries really easy, he replied promptly and we had a very easy and enjoyable stay. The apartment was clean, carefully and lovingly decorated, well stocked with towels and such. We would highly recommend staying here.

This apartment in Queens was fantastic! The place was incredibly clean and well-maintained, with everything feeling brand new. The mattress was super comfortable, ensuring a great night’s sleep. The host was absolutely amazing, always quick to respond, no matter the time of day. She was so welcoming and helpful, even suggesting great places to visit in NYC. When there was a bus detour that might have caused issues for our trip to JFK, she went above and beyond by offering to take us to the airport herself. I highly recommend this place!

Es war eine sehr schöne Zeit in Brooklyn! Schöne Wohnung und eine gute Ausstattung!
Zu Fuß sind es ca 5 Minuten bis zur nächsten Metro Station. Man braucht eine halbe Stunde bis Manhatten!
Francis und seine Frau sind super freundlich und hilfsbereit! Kommen gerne wieder!

This was a great unit in a great location in Brooklyn.  Having lived in the area for many years, I know the value of a venue like this so close to attractions and public transportation.  All things were as advertised, and Zalmen was a responsive and attentive host - he answered all questions w/in minutes.   Definitely coming back!

The apartment is very nice and quite spacious; it's near several amenities, including the subway. The neighbourhood is pleasant and relatively quiet with some great restaurants just steps away.
Sarah was very easy to communicate with; she responded promptly to all our messages.
Guests have no control over the building heat, so it isn't possible to adjust the temperature up or down. Out of our 7-night stay in late April, it was on 3 nights when it definitely didn't need to be. Sarah did offer a fan to compensate; we just opened windows and slept on the bed covers to try to keep cool.
Checking in and out via the lockbox was a breeze, but there is only 1 key and fob for the apartment; we would have preferred at least two sets as we weren't always returning and leaving together. We did manage to make it work using the lockbox but that was only possible because the suite is so near the building's front door. Overall, it seemed like an unnecessary inconvenience that could be easily addressed.

Araz was very sweet and accommodating. I was driving in from out of state and arrived fairly late and he was very flexible. He even offered me tea. The surrounding area is very nice, walk a few blocks and there's plenty of food, markets etc. If there was any negatives, it'd be the parking, but that's just New York for you. Highly recommended for solo travelers 🤍
Place is as advertised, clean and in a great location. Artwork in the house is fun.
Deirdre's place was great! The bed is one of the most comfortable beds we've ever slept on. Definitely, recommend anyone to stay here.

Neanna’s apartment in Bushwick is perfectly located - only a couple blocks from the Morgan L. Neanna was easy to communicate with and very accommodating. The space itself is thoughtfully decorated and included anything we might have needed during our stay. The desk nook was a plus since I had to do a little bit of work while I was there. Can’t wait to go back to NYC. I know where I’ll be staying!
Wish we could’ve stayed longer just for the room alone!

Very spacious, bright apartment with everything you need for a comfortable stay. Location is also great - close to subway, Oculus, grocery store, shops, restaurants. I highly recommend Jaclyn’s place!
If you book they might still run out of rooms
Perfect place to discover Brooklyn after spending some days in Manhattan. A nice and comfy appartment and the best host :) We didn’t see many tourists around but I highly reccomend the experience :)

The Lower East Side isn’t for everyone. But if you like the neighborhood, this apartment is fine. Ivan makes great use of the space. The lower east side is made up of old buildings, many of them walk-ups and this is no exception.  That said, it's an easy couple of flights and the place is pin drop quiet. I recommend it.

Rented this location for a romantic night with me and my wife. The host was extremely accommodating and had excellent communication. The place was extremely clean and definitely met all of our needs. I would rent this space again in the future.
Nice place, clean, with easy Subway access.

Our stay at Chito and Xavier's place was absolutely fantastic. The apartment was so homey and possibly the cleanest I have ever stayed at (easily comparable to a hotel). They thought of every last thing a guest may need, including extra pillows and blankets in the linen closet, making the stay all the more enjoyable. It was a short walk away from a subway station, and we felt very safe staying in the apartment. Chito and Xavier were wonderful hosts, and they clearly care so much about their guests. We would defintely stay here again on our next visit to New York City.
Cool apartment in Brooklyn, nice connection to Manhattan by metro. Super quickly responding host. Well equipped kitchen. Nice Terrace available for guests. Highly recommended!
Perfect location and great energy in this space. Bed comfy AF! Lol

I now understand why Angela is a super host. Her home felt like my home. She welcomed me at the door at night(I had traveledalone). Helped me bring in my luggage. She helped me rearrange my luggage to adhere to weight requirements and the best part is she gave me her own bag to use! To say that I loved her home is an understatement. I would stay there again and again and would highly recommend her home to anyone in need of a beautiful, peaceful home. Thank you Angela, you are the best
Appartement zag er netjes uit. Ook de keuken is goed voorzien. De wijk is inderdaad divers zoals ook uit andere recensies blijkt. Jennifer was erg behulpzaam met onze vragen.

Really nice room in super cool, vibrant area in brooklyn. Sigfus is also very helpful. But what really blew me away was the amazing rooftop terrace with views of the NYC skyline. Highly recommend staying here!

Wir waren 1 Woche in dieser Unterkunft und waren zufrieden. Das Personal ist super freundlich und hilft einem, wenn man auf diese zugeht, jedoch funktioniert dies besser persönlich als über eine Nachricht!
Die Lage ist gut, man kommt super schnell mit der U-Bahn überall hin und auch wieder zurück, wir hatten keinerlei keine Probleme mit dem Lärm von außen.
Der Check in und out sind super unkompliziert und es wird für alles gesorgt.
Es gibt einen großen Kühlschrank in der Lobby, welcher für alle verfügbar ist, es ist keine Minibar oder ähnliches vorhanden.
Great location, brilliant apartment. We had such a great time and can't recomend Ians place highley enough. Definitely stay here if you are going to NY.
Uns hat es sehr gefallen und wir werden die Unterkunft weiter empfehlen!
Lots of stairs to walk up. While it was “open and airy” the bedroom does not have black out curtains and there is a lot of light from street and also very noisy all night.

I had a wonderful stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was very responsive and made sure everything we needed was taken care of. Great location and excellent value for money. I would definitely stay here again!
This is my 3rd time staying at Untitled, and would highly suggest it for it's proximity to everything in the City, and ease to getting out to Brooklyn. 10 out of 10!
Appartement conforme à nos attentes. Les attentions portées à l’accueil sont appréciables. Bonne localisation très bon quartier.
Such an amazing location! I’ll stay here any time I come to New York!

I could not have asked for a better stay. It was raining upon arrival and we missed the door completely and had to call Remo. He answered on the 2nd ring. Once we knew where we were going it was extremely easy, and i’m certain that had it not been raining we wouldn’t have needed to contact him at all. We got in later and with very little of the necessary toiletries. Small travel sizes of shampoo, conditioner, and body wash were provided. There was also condiments in the fridge.
The location was better than i expected for the price! The owner of Happy Cork was extremely kind as well. It’s just below the Airbnb. Bodega, Mcdonald’s,Popeyes and Chinese food close!
There’s a book with instructions and contact information, but that was also messaged to me on the day of reservation. The bedding was cozy, towels were provided (2 per bed), full kitchen of dishes. The apartment itself was very homey and comfortable. There’s beautiful paintings on the walls, and streaming services on TV. THANKS
Hancheng was a wonderful host. His home was exactly as described in his listing. It’s a close walk to public transportation and a 20 minute bus ride to Central Park. I highly recommend this listing.

Gostamos muito!!! O apartamento tem os itens necessários. A Dora nos proporcionou uma boa hospitalidade. A localização é ótima, sendo fácil ir para Manhattan de metrô, não foi necessário usar ônibus. O bairro é muito bom, me senti segura caminhando no bairro de dia e à noite.
Very clean, cozy and nice place💕 will come again

Séjour parfait dans l’appartement de Deborah à greenpoint ! L’appartement est propre, bien décoré et parfaitement situé. Le quartier est animé, proche des transports , et l’hôte a été très réactif. Je recommande vivement cet endroit pour un séjour agréable à New York ! Je reviendrais les yeux fermés
Merci !

Check-In was easy and the place is nicely located. Unfortunately tho we were not completely happy with our stay at Jacks Airbnb. We waited long for replies and never got answers to two of our questions. Also found a dead cockroach in the kitchen. Other than that it’s a decent place  for the price.

SUCH a great deal for the price and location! Shared bathroom was never a problem. The room itself is smaller than expected, but it’s all you really need to keep luggage during the day and sleep at night. Would stay here again!

Such a convenient location and the bedroom was comfortable. Slept well!  Sparkling bathroom :). Felt completely safe walking late at night. Thank you for the fresh coffee, Jeanne! May your dragon fruit plants grown big!

This was my first time using Air bnb and the experience was great. I had a very quick booking experience and Carmen was very helpful with everything.
The room was very nice and the bed was comfortable. Had everything I needed for a night!
Good place to stay. Host was very nice.

Lovely modern apartment in Williamsburg with a full kitchen! The back garden is really nice and sunny too. Jamie is a great host - his communication was excellent and accommodated our check in/out so well.  It was about a 10 minute walk from the water/subways/main shops. However the bus stop is right outside which we used to go to Dumbo.  There is noise from upstairs if there are guests staying there and some street noise from the bedroom.
This was a fantastic place in a fantastic location. I would absolutely stay here again. In fact, I’m intentionally planning my next stay!

They place was super great, super close to the train station, small food vendors. It was great. Only thing I would say that can help it is- darker curtains to excluded excessive light. I know this is out of their hands but lots of noise during the middle of the night that would wake me up. overall, great place!

You have to stay here. The place is amazing and staying in a brownstone was on my bucket list and this place lived up to my expectations. Everything you need is provided and some extra touches. Jules and Michelle are great hosts and so friendly. It’s a great location with subway close by and a great restaurant and bakery. Go for it you won’t regret it !!

Lory and Cindy's place is in a great location, not too far from Prospect Park and various subway lines. The house is charming and has lots of character.  I would recommend the place if you want to stay in a local neighborhood and an easy starting point for exploring the city.

Jonathan and Daphne couldn't be lovelier. They put a lot of care into renovating and decorating this home, and everything worked great. We ended up staying considerably longer than we expected, and they were flexible throughout. Their street is a gracious, tree-lined street with lots of families, close to an express train and with a bakery around the corner (try the local barbecue, gelato and nail salon too). Jonathan was probably the most responsive host I have ever had. He acted very quickly in response to messages and was quick to show up with a tool or a customer-service rep already on the line where needed. Highly recommend these hosts and this lovely home, especially if you are traveling with children of any age.

El lugar es acogedor y centrado en temas de transporte y movilidad, en general esta bien por el precio pagado, creería que se debería de mejor un poco el aspecto de la entrada, y el patio trasero, del resto cumplió mis expectativas.
Lovely host, good location, great value in Bay Ridge!

We stayed at Dan’s garden apartment for our last three days as brooklynites, as the movers packed up our apartment. It was absolutely perfect. Clean, well appointed, cozy and convenient — and on one of the most charming blocks in the neighborhood.  We loved it and plan to stay there any time we come back to Sunset Park to visit!!

Good value for the location. John is an excellent host, and we even had a few run-ins where we had some nice conversations. He was super helpful with providing a great, scenic bar to go to.
The room was cozy and a bit tight. And it was quite loud due to its proximity to the busy highway. If you're on a business trip or similar and plan to be out most of the day, it's great for a place to crash. But if you're looking for more of a place to hang out with family or as a couple, this may not be the place for you. There's shampoo and body wash in the shower. And the A/C unit was a life saver during the hot, muggy NYC days.
The location was great right next to the popular area of Dumbo in Brooklyn. It is about a 10-15 minute walk to the closest subway. There is a Citi Bike dock right outside the place, so that was convenient and I used a bike one night to get to SoHo.

Honestly, in the many years I have stayed at airbnbs, Ying went above and beyond my expectations. Not only was the place was kept well maintained and clean, but Ying was extremely friendly and I felt just right at home. I was able to discuss any issues or concerns I had with her.
This place is perfect for anyone looking to move in to the city. The room was great and did not have any issues and as someone who works from home, I thoroughly enjoyed the amenities that were here.
Additionally the location is close to the subway and a quick 15 minute walk to laundry/gym/grocery makes this an extremely ideal location for anyone unfamiliar with the city.
This place truly is quite the hidden gem for anyone valuing convenience, price, and cleanliness.

Jeff a été un hôte très réactif et très communicant… malgré les aléas côté propreté de notre arrivée, Jeff a su réagir. Cote transports avec la ligne 4 nous étions en 30/40 mns directement dans le centre de Manhattan. Seul bémol l’appartement est plus adapté pour 4 personnes que pour 6 car le canapé ne se transforme pas en lit car il n’est pas convertible.

Airbnb sécurisant dans un quartier authentique de Brooklynn !
Métro à 10 minutes de marche, et donc 40 minutes de Manhattan.

Alfred and his entire staff did the very utmost to make guest feel comfortable, great communication ahead and during stay, always a smile on their faces. Location next to MSG and PennStation and easily walkeable to TimeSquare. Accomodation itself as described, small pods with open ceiling so you hear a lot, but even though there were a lot of people, everyone was super considered and respectful who I felt was a testament to Alfred and team being able to communicate their philosophy. If you are tall, probably not for you, beds are rather short and between two walls. My room was right next to kitchen and so I was woken up as soon as breakfast service started (upside freshly and homemade muffins, downside due to open ceiling, you hear everything). On my floor toilets and showers were in one room, co-ed, just something to keep in mind.

This stay was phenomenal. Alaric has placed tremendous amount of work in the home and has restored it to it’s original state. This is a timeless treasure. The detailing and architecture truly speaks volumes to the work that has gone into the home. Alaric is a caretaker and really illustrates this is in how well the home is maintained.
A simple stay- amazing for short trips

Recomendable al máximo! Casa limpia sin ruidos, familia encantadora, serviciales , educadisimos, nos obsequiaron con el desayuno el primer día!!! Todo un detalle, dispuestos a ayudar en todo momento, hemos quedado encantadas repetiríamos sin dudar!
Do not be scared from first sight, mainly in night :D House from outside looks like uninhabited, but ist not and inside is really nice. Everything was allright.THANKS

Nice location
Clean home
Very welcoming space
I would stay again !
Peaceful and quiet stay - and a short walk from everything including the pier! We felt very welcome, like personal guests. I would definitely stay here again.

We had a fantastic stay here! My boyfriend and I rented this place for nearly 3 months, and it was very comfortable. It's a studio, so not huge, but more spacious than we expected. The closet was big enough for both of us. Best of all was the host's response times whenever we had a question or request - great service, and we definitely recommend staying here.

Angelika was the perfect host - responsive to our questions before arrival, helpful and attentive as we settled in and respectful of our privacy.  Really great experience for us as she made this an oasis after long days enjoying the city.

Thomas was cooperative & reliable in ensuring that we we had easy access and were comfortable. Place was much as we imagined -fantastic location - some noise noise from above at night but we expected that this could be the case. Loved the fact that it was ckearly not a tourist neighbourhood - great watching the locals wander around. We had everything we needed but as Thomas points out - it is a little tight for 2 including big suitcases but I would still come again as I loved the location.  Donna
Our stay was very comfortable and everything was clean.  Everything you can possibly need, outside of food was provided.  She even set out welcome snacks which we truly appreciated. ;o)
Had an amazing stay. The apartment is beautiful. Such a nice space. Like staying at a boutique hotel. Very clean. And super close to the subway.

Great place to stay, just 5 minutes walk to subway station. The stay was great and the price is perfect.

Cherisse and Patricia they are very helpful and kind and funny .
I definitely recommend this place

This was our first trip to NYC and Veronica’s Airbnb was a great place to stay.

The Airbnb was in a great location, with close access to the Q train and a short walk to Prospect Park.
If we come back, we would certainly stay here again!

Sheila is a wonderful host ! Cute and cozy spot. Felt save for the most part. There is never a dull moment in Nyc so if you don’t like a little noise from the cars on the highway going by it isn’t for you. Very close to the airports, which was helpful
Great location, comfy apartment, warm family atmosphere.
Exactly as described. Hard to find a cozier place in NYC for the price!
Cheryl is super kind, she is very thoughtful for guests.

very convenient place, I really liked this place and I am regretting now why I didn't book his place for my complete trip, there are many restaurants and grocery shops nearby, Metro is few blocks away, I will definitely return for my next trip,

The room is spacious and the bed is very comfortable. The location is close to the subway station which allows you to reach midtown of Manhattan in just 15 minutes.
I recommend this place!

Eric and Sharon are wonderful hosts. Anything we needed they were there to answer. The house has plenty of room, big kitchen and worked out great for us. Our daughter goes to St. John's University and the house is just half a block from there. It is about a 25 minute ride to the city and subway station is about a mile or so away but the bus stop is right around the corner which will drop you off right at the subway station. We will be back and we all enjoyed our stay.

I loved staying in this apartment. bed is cozy and Lloyd and his family are very kind.
The room looks exactly same as pictures👍
Very welcoming and convenient location for taxi to JFK in the morning.

We loved our stay in Hiokit and Harold’s place! The Airbnb was easy to find and the check-in instructions were simple. The whole Airbnb was clean and homey. I would definitely recommend people visiting Queens/NYC to stay here :)
Great location and communication! The room was comfortable, clean, and felt private.

Perfect location was very near to the subway and to everything ... clean and neat apartment the kitchen was full ready for cooking .... there was a space for my children to play ..... great host thanks a lot for your hospitality
It is hard to get a quiet room in NYC, but fortunately this is one.
Thank you for a wonderful stay! The apartment is very cozy, and the neighborhood is quiet. The subway is just a 6-minute walk away. The hosts are very hospitable.

Really nice place to stay in Manhattan with Central Park almost at the doorstep, a metro station just 2 minutes away and 2 Delis nearby if you need groceries. Patrick was welcoming and very respectful of our privacy. The location was amazing and the apartment was beautiful. Would highly recommend!!

My friends and I had such a nice weekend trip and the airbnb was the perfect place to host us. We arrived very early to the city and our host was very kind to prioritize our room to be cleaned first. It was a 10 min walk to grand central and the area felt very safe. I would definitely recommend coming back! The host was very kind and helpful!
Side note, there is no elevator so be aware when trying to bring heavy checked bags!
A wonderful stay in this lovely Park Slope neighborhood. Her place is squeaky clean, quiet, and comfortable. Rebecca is a reliable and responsive host. We highly recommend her place.
Super godt sted, ligger super godt!
Hands-down the best accommodations in the city that I’ve had. Quiet street in one of the best parts of the city, ample space, beautifully designed, clean, and on and on.

First of all, we are nurses and visited this location from TN.  I've stayed in walkable locations before and this location was great.   Breakfast, lunch, dinner, bars, dry cleaners, and almost anything else one could need were as little as a 2-5 minute walk from the front door.  The subway may seem a little far for some at 1 mile, or fifteen minutes, but this was not a problem for us.  The flat is on the fifth floor, first floor being the first floor above the ground, and the stairs are steep.  Climbing the stairs can be exhausting if you're not used to strenuous exercise (and I am, and it was still tuff), but the price and benefits certainly out weighed the only down side to accessing the flat.  There was great communication on Sarah's part and she left us relevant suggestions that highlighted the benefits of the community.  I wouldn't hesitate to go back and stay at this location again.  Enjoy!

The experience was great. The only weakness was that the apartment is a bit far away from Manhattan, but on the other hand the neighbourhood is really quiet and has very good public means of transport.
Additionally, the host was really kind and was always available for us.
I will definately recommend it.
Great spot! quiet neighborhood, great views from the rooftop/bedroom. Pretty accessible, ferry to Brooklyn Bridge/DUMBO close by - Train about 12 min walk. Russel was very communicative and polite!

Maria and her son were incredibly kind hosts and the place was very clean. Would highly recommend.
this place is great, I'd definitely stay here again. great location too!

The Yochis are wonderful hosts.  They live in an excellent location and their home is very clean and full of interesting art pieces.  Our bed was comfortable and they made sure we had everything we needed.  We enjoyed getting to know them and look forward to staying with them in the future.

Aleksandr was prompt, professional and polite from the start. We were pleasantly surprised to find that the home was even more welcoming than we could have imagined. It was exceptionally helpful to have guidance about parking in the locale, although we were lucky enough to find a spot on the street. We felt very secure and safe at Aleksandr's AirBnB, and very much like the idea of visiting again soon.

Bree is such a nice and friendly host. The apartment is incredibly nice and the cats are cuddly and welcoming. It’s also very conveniently located, short walk to the L stop and JMZ stop. Overall, I really enjoy my stay.

Appartement très bien situé, prix très correct.

je recommande.

Excellent rapport qualité prix pour une localisation idéale. La chambre est petite mais fonctionnelle et propre,le lit est très confortable. Le personnel est agréable. Pour ce qui est du bruit de la rue très animée,des bouchons d’oreille permettent de passer une bonne nuit. Je recommande.

Thank you Kevin for hosting us. We had a great time staying at your place. The appartment in itself is spacious, well equipped, has three sets of keys (which comes in really handy when travelling in a group) and Kevin has been really helpful and forthcoming with anything that came up. Nice stay. Calm neighbourhood, easy parking and close to a metro station.

Michael & Sharon were very helpful and accommodating to my needs. Airports only 10-15 minutes away.

Property manager did a great job with helping me settle in. Clear and easy communication. Quick response to my questions! Thank you!
Amazing place to stay!!

Absolutely huge apartment with nice comfortable furniture, high-end bedding and a beautiful well-appointed kitchen. Couldn't have been easier to come/go - apartment is on the first floor and it's a short walk to subway stations. Truly a special space in a special place.
Fatima's space is truly a beautiful oasis. So warm and inviting, and in an ideal neighborhood!

I thoroughly enjoyed the meal and the overall experience. I'm already looking forward to booking again!

Great place to stay and a good host 👍

This house is awesome! so much character and plenty of room for our group. The kitchen has everything you'll need and the beds were comfy. The house is older but that adds to the charm. Definitely gives you the real Harlem experience.
Nice little hotel in a convenient location
Great apartment in great location. Mark communicated really well. We loved our stay and look forward to returning!
Beautiful historic hotel! We loved it!

We recently stayed at Lexia's place and found it to be a comfortable and cozy option with everything one might need for a pleasant stay. Lexia was also very friendly and responsive throughout the process.

We had a really great stay at Julia and Kier's place, it's very well connected, only a short walk to the nearest metro, and the wider neighbourhood is beautiful and full of great restaurants, amenities and local businesses. The space had everything we needed, and we were made to feel very welcome.

Agnes was extremely welcoming and nice to us on our stay. We were supposed to stay 3 nights total but ending up having to leave before the third night. Agnes was so understanding and offered hospitality to us even though we were leaving on short notice. Great stay!

Danielle’s place was so lovely! The beds were super comfortable and the whole house was very spacious. We loved relaxing here after going out in the city. The coffee and fruit was also a nice touch. We had everything we needed for a comfortable stay!

Well located, clean, easy to access and friendly service. Would definitely come back!

In general we appreciated very much staying with Jhon and Trang. They where also fast to reply any question we had.

The apartment was well kept and maintained, the check in was super easy, Jason was super helpful over message (we had the place to ourselves) and assisted me with any questions I had. It’s a nice home base for your trip into the city.
Amazing space welll worth the price. Very kind host and perfect location!

The room itself is lovely; bright, and large. The bed is also super comfortable. Our main issues were to do with the noise of the AC unit and the shower. In the description of the place the room is described as being super quiet, which for us felt misleading once we turned on the AC unit (a must in the NYC heat!). The AC unit was effective though, so no qualms there. The shower was really average. Bad pressure and only the hot tap seemed to work. So for those reasons, we weren't over the moon about the deal here. That said, if you're looking for a comfy bed, and don't mind a noisy AC unit and average shower then this place is definitely more affordable than other options we found more central.
The place is pretty good if you are gonna stay outside knowing the city, it is close to a station and the host is a really good person, I think it is worth the price
The place was clean, modern, and convenient. Host was very accommodating, and in-building laundry was a big plus

We made this cute place our home for two months and felt cozy between the wooden floor, beams, and old fireplace.  The house is old has lots of character. We felt welcome, and communication went super smoothly. The bathroom and bedroom are spacious, with built-in closet space. Also, the bedroom door opens to a patio which was nice for our small dog. Overall we noticed that we were staying in an old house, but we greatly enjoyed this little nest and beautiful neighborhood. Thanks, Ofer & Brooke!!
We had a great stay

Charlene's place was great! I was a bit nervous not having a living room, but we actually had plenty of enough space for the 4 of us. It was me, my husband, our 20 year old son, and granddaughter. We stayed here as part of a 2 week trip to NYC, and we arrived early in the morning. We were able to park our car on the street and explored the Brooklyn Bridge before checking in. The neighborhood felt safe and we never had an issue waking to the bus stop on Utica. My husband and son even walked to a Chinese restaurant 1/2 mile away, and never felt unsafe. Street parking was never an issue and we were always able to find a spot on the same street as the Airbnb. Overall, this might have been my favorite Airbnb I've stayed in and I would definitely recommend Charlene's place when you visit NYC!!
Great spot in great location. Only downside was the stairs to climb. Other than that it’s a good spot for a  few days getaway.

Overall I enjoyed my stay here. I highly recommend!
A comfortable stay in the best neighborhood.

Wonderful place. Great hospitality provided by the host. Everything was where it was supposed to be. Parking was as it always is in NY but you expect that. We however, didn't have a problem finding a space on the block or around the corner.
Clean, beautifully kept, kid friendly and spacious. Can't beat it!

Had a great stay at Milton’s place. He was very welcoming. I recommend his place if you need some where to stay while in NYC.
