data la posizione, la stanza è rumorosa giorno e notte
la finestra lascia entrare molti spifferi d'aria (purtroppo abbiamo trovato brutto tempo e la stanza era fredda)

Shanti is very sweet and very responsive.  Her place met all my needs, and always felt welcoming!  She was overly concerned that the location is in an all-Black area of Brooklyn.  Having lived in WashDC, this was nothing new, but I understand that not everyone is familiar with that.  The only minor issue is the distance to walk to the subway.  Not overly far, but quite noisy (somehow more so than in Manhattan).  This is nothing about Shanti or her wonderful place, but it will be a unique experience for someone more used to countryside quietness.  The subways are not particularly difficult to figure out (google-maps on my phone was fairly good at identifying the best train to use).  I used the unlimited week-pass.  And either Shanti or Mo always had a welcoming smile regardless of when I "got back home" to her place.  I would gladly stay at Shanti's place again.

This place was beautiful. The pictures was great online but in person it was breathtaking. Mrs. Lisa is a dope host. I’ve always skipped over the BnBs with the hosts on the premises but from her reviews i was like let me try it out. I’m glad i did. She was welcoming to my children and answered any questions i had. She even came out and had a conversation with us when we first got there. Love her personality!! Look no further and book.  You won’t be disappointed
It’s nice cozy place. Very earthly and spiritual. Amenities are more of rustic experience as opposed to typical hotel chain. You will enjoy it.
Easy communication, great host. We asked if we can get new towels and they showed up in 30mins. Great experience!

Great Airbnb!! Highly recommend, easy to check in and check out.
Nomad was super helpful on our big group situation.
The location is also close to a lot of attractions in New York.

Fomos recebidos com muita atenção pela anfitriã e seu marido. Recebemos várias dicas para passeios e compras em Nova York. O apartamento é realmente como anunciado. Apesar de ficar um pouco distante de Manhattan vale pelo custo-benefício

I have stayed at numerous Airbnbs domestically and abroad and have met various kind of hosts. Laura is by far the most thoughtful and kind host I have ever come across. She put so much thoughtful designs into both the bedrooms as well as the shared living space and made sure that I have everything I need throughout my stay. The apartment itself is very nice. There’s lots of sunlight during the day and very quiet at night, which is rare for any NYC apartments. Would recommend Laura’s place to anyone who’s visiting the Big Apple!

It was clean and exactly as described, with furniture that felt cheap and minimal. The bed mattress is soft in the middle and caused us to slide into the center and wake with backache.
A microwave and TV would be a nice addition for quick meals and evening relaxation. We were uncomfortable having all dishes / pans stored under the kitchen sink area. The refrigerator was hotel size. We stayed 1 week.

Excellent place to stay! Great location and fun to walk around neighborhood. Also a great place to work remote from. Had a good dedicated desk space and reliable internet. Great little kitchenette with stocked pantry. Adam was a responsive and helpful host. Honestly the perfect place to stay while working remote and wanting to enjoy the area. Would recommend this place to anyone!
Aaron provided clear directions and instructions for our stay. House was clean and spacious.
Great place to stay! Would stay again.
Wonderful and relaxing stay at this beautiful brooklyn brownstone. Quiet neighborhood. Host was very nice and extremely accomadating!

Notre séjour chez Demi s'est trés bien déroulé.
Le quartier est trés sympa. nous nous sommes sentis parfaitement en sécurité. il y a tout un tas de choses a proximité. Supermarché commerces vins laverie....
le metro est a 10 min a pieds et on est a 20 min de manhatan une fois dans le metro ou 40 min du MET qui est quasi tout en haut.
A proximité il y a aussi le brooklyn botanical garden et le BK museum.
Le must de l'appartement et les jardin privatif qui est une vraie bulle d'air lorsque l'on rentre de journées bruyantes et harasante. C'est vraiment une piece en plus qui a change notre séjour. (ptit dej et diner dehors). L'appartement en lui meme est fidele a la description. Trés calme et sans bruit nous avons parfaitement dormis.
Demie est tres sympa et elle nous a bien renseigné sur les differents points d'interets du quartier.
Seul bémol suivants les jours quelque avion decolle de JFK qui est non loin mais c'est vraiment pas grand choses et totalement inaudible de l'intérieur de l'appartement.
Pour un séjour sympa a BK je recommande sans probleme.
Malik is a courteous and helpful guy!
Absolutely wonderful! It was very easy to get into the Airbnb and check out for my early morning flight! It was a wonderful location for any LaGuardia flight!!
La estancia con Lana ha sido fantástica, la zona muy buena, muy bien comunicado con el transporte público o con coche propio, excelente

Joanne was responsive even prior to booking
location was perfect for my needs
check-in instructions were clear, which made the process seamless

What a unique way to spend time by the beach!
My family had a terrific stay on Angus and Lisa's sweet little boathouse! We had everything that we needed.
The best part was the special attention that our hosts gave us,
Angus and Lisa were both so accommodating! We felt very welcome and were even given rides to and from the train station when needed! Above and beyond service!!!
We were traveling with our two small boys which is a challenge
but we all fit nicely in the boat and had a really fun time!
Coney Island, the beach and the aquarium area all nearby. We took a short bus ride from a very close bus stop to the Sheepshead Bay train station. Coney island is just a few stops on the train, a very easy trek. Getting into the city was a bit more of a journey but very do-able. We enjoyed the ethnic restaurants in the area, particularly on Sheepshead Bay Rd and the very impressive Cherry Hill Market! All within a mile or two. If you like traveling a bit off of the beaten path as we do and if you want character, you'll have it here!
We love the location, access to restaurants, shops, public transportation. We love having a place to gather with several friends. We love the charm of the home, and Elizabeth's thoughtful touches.
A lovely cottage in a pretty garden at a great location. Kathleen is a delightful host.
Great host, beautiful place, lots of space, the only thing to consider is that the place is a studio setup, with no doors on bedrooms

Vadim's apartment was absolutely WONDERFUL !   As soon as we walked in we saw a sparkling clean apartment with beautiful views of Manhattan!  Vadim was so thoughtful to  have a few "necessity items" in the fridge until we were able to get to the grocery store.   A GREAT added  benefit that we didn't realize until we arrived was that there is a Costco Warehouse 5 minutes by walk from the apartment!  A wonderful added cost saving benefit for travelers with a membership - especially if staying over a week or so!  Additionally, the bus stop is literally right across the street which is very convenient to get to the subway (which actually is also convenient if you want to walk about a short half mile).   Not only was Vadim's apartment beautiful and clean, the building itself is very well maintained with a LARGE beautiful roof top patio.   We will definitely be back and hope to be able to rent this space again!!!!
Stayed for nearly a week with friends and it was exactly what we were looking for. Quick access to plenty of good food and transit within walking distance.
Ozzy was a great host. Very accommodating and helpful. The place itself was clean and comfortable, and the location was extremely convenient. I’d definelty stay again.

We planned this trip for almost a year. My best friend, her 14yr old daughter, and me. This space is literally a half a block away from the R line in the subway. This line took us to every single stop we wanted to make i.e. times square, Staten Island ferry, herald square, and China town. Negra was quick to respond to my many questions and was wonderful to deal with. We stayed on the 3rd floor of the brownstone and had more than enough room for 3 of us. It was clean, had a full kitchen, and free internet with Netflix and Hulu. The neighborhood was quiet at all hours. The shower was WONDERFUL and a favorite of mine. I can't say enough about how great this place was and if we can ever return to nyc we will be looking at properties where Negra is the host.

The apartment was clean. In a perfect spot for where we wanted to be. The host has great communication and even went above and beyond for me. Booking with this host is 100% worth it, I highly recommend it!

Wir hatten eine super Zeit in Brooklyn, NY.
Shanti‘s schönes Zuhause war leicht zu finden & mit den vielen öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln war es nicht schwer ganz New York zu erkunden.
Shanti ist eine wunderbare Gastgeberin, die unser sauberes Zimmer mit viel Liebe eingerichtet hat & immer als Ansprechpartnerin sofort erreichbar war.
Liebe Grüße & bis zum nächsten mal. :)
Jules & Corinne

This place was good for the value and serves well as a place to sleep while visiting the city on a quick trip. Ren was communicative and checked in regularly to ensure all was right with the stay.
The location is close to the subway, but solo travelers should be mindful of the area, especially if they will be traveling at night.
Spotless, cozy place in a great Brooklyn neighborhood. Enjoyed it very much!

First of all, AMAZING views! And very clean. We stayed for 3 nights with our 3 small children and it never felt cluttered. There was just enough space for a long weekend. Very easy to travel into the city. Also close to major highways so we could see family in Queens. Host was very responsive and helped quickly with any questions we had.
The place is amazing, it’s better that I expected

We had a great stay at Xiren’s apartment! The place was comfortable, clean, and nicely decorated.  We were a short walk to a ton of bars and restaurants and enjoyed exploring the neighborhood.  Xiren was very responsive and helpful, providing us with a bunch of useful tips and recommendations.  Overall, we would definitely recommend this apartment!
Stylish space with convenient access to the subway! I was comfortable and productive working remotely from this apartment :)
Great for a stay near Central Park.

El lugar es exactamente como en las fotos. El barrio hiper tranquilo. Llegué caminando a las 2am con las valijas y todo ok. La ubicación es buenisima. A dos cuadras del subte N/W que en 4 estaciones aprox ya te deja en Manhattan. Super recomendable
Had a very enjoyable stay at Alex’s place. He is a super nice guy, and will help you with whatever you need. Would definetly recommend.

Cathy is an excellent host who respects her guests privacy. Upon arrival, Cathy introduced herself to us and asked if we required anything else during our stay.
Her apartment is very nice and very clean and it has everything that is required whilst away from home.
The subway stop is just a 5 min walk away and the train has you in Manhattan in 20-30 mins ( depends if you get the faster A train or the slower local C train). The subway is $2.50 each way which is excellent value however if you prefer to get a taxi back at night (recommended) a yellow cab will cost $40 - $50 however if you register for Uber before you leave your home country it will cost between $25 and $35 and the cars are more comfortable and modern.
The locals in the neighbourhood are friendly and will have a conversation with you if you talk to them but mostly people will keep themselves to themselves.
All in all we would highly recommend Cathy apartment for your stay in New York as long as you don't mind the travelling back and forth to and from Manhattan.
Many thanks Cathy for the use of your excellent apartment.
Ron and Carole
Edinburgh
Scotland
Recomiendo. La habitación era tal cual se muestra en las fotos. El personal súper amable. Muy cerca de todo. Definitivamente volvería.

I had an incredible stay. The host was very responsive and even accommodated a late check out. Everything was just as described. The space was beautifully decorated and felt like a home away from home. Would stay here again.
Spacious, clean and well-equipped apartment; has everything you need. Had a great stay
Great location with lots of shops and foods on every street. The apartment was very comfortable & the host was very responsive. Overall a great stay. Will definitely be back!
Apartamento limpio y cercano al metro lo cual facilita la conexión

We weren’t really sure what to expect as this was our first trip to NY. Everything went better then I thought it could have. First the location, we walked, all day everyday, it was great homebase to get to everything we wanted to see. The apartment was clean private and The Lombardy has the best hotel employees. To name 2 in particular, Jimmy the bellman and a maid that I feel terrible I never got her name but always made sure we had chocolates.
We would stay here hands down again on our next trip to NY. Don’t hesitate booking, you wont be disappointed.
Thank you Ian!
Jose was great and the place looks just as it is pictured! Great area too. Would stay here again!

Spacious and tastefully furnished apartment, walking distance to stores and metro. The host was responsive and helpful. Nice place and would definitely return. Only downside; parking in front of the apartment was impossible to find, potentially due to the holiday, but there was a nearby paid parking garage that we used.

This was my WORST Airbnb experience.
I prefer to be truly honest I will not recommend Lunara place even if there are many pros for a stay at her place. For the FIRST time in more than 55 airbnb guest experiences I decided to reduce my stay because of the hosting. I was feeling very bad because of Lunara way of acting. I decided to leave her place 2 days before the end of my reservations. She accepted to change the date (but honestly if she declined I could just cancel the last 2 days according to the cancellation policy of Airbnb)
Pros:
- Location : Near Manhattan, near long island city, near coffee shop and grocery store. Times Square is closer from Lunara’s place than others manhattan district
- The flexibility of Lunara. I had to change my arrival date because of a flight cancellation and she said yes.
- The bed and the room : Nice bed comfortable. The room have place to put your stuff and USB plug for your phone.
Cons:
- The cleanness: the bathroom was clearly not clean and the kitchen was not the cleanest place where I have cooked. It’s ok but not clean.
- The hospitality of Lunara: honestly I felt not welcome. For me it was like if I was in the way/not wanted. I have used Airbnb for more than 50 trips and I was an host in the past. I know how to welcome and host, believe me it’s not the Airbnb standard. It’s very far from my previous experience.
- The noise: It’s a city so noise is still normal but it’s not impossible to sleep even without earplug except if someone is taking a shower. In fact, be aware that the room is next to the bathroom. Last night Lunara took a bath during the night at 1 am and it was very noisy so it wake me up.
- The politeness of Lunara: Saying hello, how are you. It’s a basic. Getting a hello was already very complicated. I tried to be polite so that’s why I said to her I have to leave because of a flight change. In response I received a morality speech about how much money she will lose. She said she is making an exception for me while accepting to change the date. But the truth is that the announce policy allow me to leave and get a refund for my 2 last days. So that’s not « generosity », that was my right.
-
Conclusion:
Lunara’s place is amazing even if sometimes cleanliness leaves much to be desired. But the hosting experience and the behavior of Lunara are the main cons. You will feel that you are just an income line for her and that you are not welcome. I will NOT recommend that place to stay.

This first-floor apartment accommodates two people easily.   The back patio is an added luxury opening onto a private land, worlds away from the hubbub of downtown.  The gracious hosts are responsive to messages and compiled a large notebook of facts and hints.  The rooms are beautiful with oak paneling and hardwood floors, so conducive to a homey and relaxed feeling.

Nice comfy place. A decent size with a good living area. The bar downstairs can be noisy but only at the weekends. Great location, just 5 minutes walk from Bedford Avenue where there are plenty of bars, restaurants and the L-Train. Decor is a little "esoteric". The shower is a bit temperamental and there's not much hot water, but Brady did make this clear in his communication with us.

Note: There are only two comfortable "beds", the other is a mattress on the floor. Practically this was comfy enough but didn't seem clear from the photos.
The experice has been very satisfactory. She has been very friendly and a good host, she and her husband make the stay  very nice. Definitely i recommend Nancy and this appartment.
Beautiful place and location.

A great airbnb, we’ll managed place with a very responsive host.
Some heavy construction was happening on the street in Jan 2022 which wasn’t mentioned even after we told them we were travelling with a young baby. Although it didn’t disturb us hugely, we feel it should have been mentioned when enquiring about the suitability for a baby. I assume the construction will be over now, so not a problem for future guests. We’d definitely stay again, it’s a great place and beautiful neighborhood.
Richard is a super host. He is attentive and efficient. The apartment is sparkling clean, great location and very safe. 100 % recommended.

I absolutely loved staying at Craig’s place. It was a dream i had to stay in a place like this. Felt like a beautiful classic NYC movie apartment . Thank you for letting us stay at your house and make us feel welcome.
Excellent place right off of Central Park. They have towels and sheets, so you don’t need to bring them. Joe answered all my questions quickly. Highly recommend!

Had an excellent week long stay. A great location for adapting to the city. Close enough to commute, far enough to feel peaceful. Den was fantastic and so helpful, and even extended check out for convenience. Would recommend!

The place was perfect for my quick stay. It is a great location in Williamsburg, easy check in, well decorated, clean room, and comfortable bed. Would recommend staying here. Kind and communicative hosts as well.

This place is great! It’s clean, convenient, safe and affordable. Estelle has a wonderful place, however communication could have been better. I was a little surprised to see a lot of Estelles items in the Airbnb, but found none of it to be in the way. Overall, it was a wonderful stay and I would definitely recommend! A suggestion for anyone booking would be to communicate as much as possible before hand to save yourself the trouble on your trip.
Lovely host & very clean space

Clean and spacious, very conveniently located close to shops, restaurants and the subway station and yet the house is located on a quiet street. It was perfect for visiting our daughter's family living a few blocks away.

La verdad muy buena ubicación.  Son muy amables cuando tienes algún problema. Es un poco ruidosa pero es lógico estando en esa zona genial cerca de todo. Volvería siempre. Lo que si no tiene microondas y eso a veces afecta tu economía pero te la puedes arreglar. Gracias por una bella estadia!!!
El lugar es tal como se muestra, nuestra estancia fue muy buena, recomendaría mayor mantenimiento en las zonas generales del edificio, por lo demás todo excelente
Morlisa was an amazing host! The space was great and exactly like described ! She was responsive I will definitely stay here again!
Great location in vibrant east village, Leo was always available, had a good time!

Viki's apartment is a dream. Beautifully decorated, clean and comfortable. She is a lovely and gracious host - easy going, communicative and helpful. The neighborhood is fabulous and close to great restaurants and shops, plus an easy time to Manhattan on the F. Would wholeheartedly recommend Viki's place to anyone!

Brady는 우리에게 친절하게 체크인을 설명해주었으며, 집을 찾는 것은 매우 쉬웠습니다.
집 위치가 좋아서 이동에 편리했습니다.
집이 넓은 편은 아니지만 5명이 생활하기에 불편하지는 않았습니다.
다만 환기가 잘 되지 않아 조금 더웠습니다.

A perfect experience from booking through check-out. Lovely, spacious, quiet apt. in a very safe building with every amenity needed to feel at home.  Apt. was meticulously clean on arrival & check-in was a cinch with codes.  Comfy seating & bedding, 2 large screen TVs, stylish modern bathroom w/perfect combo of deep soaking tub & shower heads.   Owner & assistant were very gracious & hospitable.  Highly recommend this apt. in every regard!

Very comfortable, easy stay! This was a business trip for myself and a coworker. With one bedroom and a convertible sofa in the living room, we had enough privacy to enjoy our 2-week stay.
When I had a question, the response time was almost immediate!
Kind, personable hosts and a very clean, comfortable space.
They stay at Carlos place was amazing, very calming, very relaxed place. Everything is communicated properly and the hosting is great!

Agnes is a great host !! She provides great amenities with a clean space. Also, the location is very close to metro station and we did not have any difficulties. She responds very quickly to any questions. I would definitely recommend her place for a good comfortable stay !!
The apartment was lovely, spacious, clean and cozy. We couldn’t have asked for a more ideal place to spend a week! Our host was incredibly attentive. Unbelievably great water pressure in the shower!
Very clean and in a great location. Would definitely stay here again.

Basic but very well taken care of studio in a convenient location in the East Village. NYC is expensive, so the price felt relatively right for what it offers (essentially, a clean and spacious space to sleep with a kitchen). Mohin is an excellent and responsive host!

Overall, I had a great experience with this host and the BNB itself. This apartment is in the perfect location in accordance with touristy sights, and is a great place to relax and eat some amazing local food. The apartment itself was in pretty good condition, there were a few things that need fixing, the only mentionable thing is the radiator which made the apartment too warm. The only other problem I had was the entrance into the apartment building itself, you have to work into the door to open in, so be ready. The service was exceptional all the way around, we were in great communication with the host throughout the trip, she was very responsive and kind, and were even able to check in four hours early!
Overall, this was a great experience and I would be happy to work with this host again.

Logement d'un excellent rapport qualité / prix et refait récemment. Situé au nord de Harlem, il est à 40 minutes en métro de Times Square (c'est le seul bémol pour ceux qui veulent rentrer en cours de journée) : très bien desservi par la ligne 2 ou 3. Il dispose d'une pièce centrale et d'une salle de bain correctement aménagée et plutôt vaste (un lot serviettes propres est mis à disposition, c'est appréciable) . Nous étions 4 avec 2 ados : limite en place une fois le canapé lit déployé. Par contre nous avons trouvé que les matelas étaient confortables. Pas de volets mais des stores, donc lever avec le jour. Un wifi un peu anémié, ne comptez pas faire du streaming. Sinon, quartier globalement tranquille, les habitants sont charmants et toujours prêts à vous aider. Côté supermarché, il faut aller à la 125èm street (possible en métro ou à pied) au Whole Market pour avoir du choix et une cafèteria qui dépanne bien (les épiceries locales sont vraiment riquiqui).

Kate’s place was ideal because of its proximity to my friend’s place, the D and N lines and shops and eateries. Her place in Brooklyn is safe. Nothing fancy just a basic place for a base while in NYC.

Cudowny pokój zapewniający pełną prywatność. świetnie zorganizowane multimedia.
Gościnne przyjęcie, elastyczność dla klienta, szybka komunikacja.
pokój bardzo blisko lotniska. 15 min lyftem
Jak przyjechaliśmy czekały na nas zapalone światła i łóżeczko dla córki, którego nie było w ofercie. To było bardzo miłe.
Nasz pierwszy pobyt w NYC zaskoczył nas nie tylko niesamowitymi wieżowcami ale również niesamowitym gospodarzem i apartamentem.
Jak będziemy tu ponownie z pewnością wybierzemy ponownie to miejsce!
dziękujemy

We had an amazing time at Greg’s apartment. We felt just like home. The loft is super sunny and incredibely designed. We were travelling with our 1 year old and Greg arranged everything for us. Lovely neighbourhood. Highly recommended

Olá!!!
Todos os funcionários do hoste foram muito gentis e atenciosos e tudo correu muito bem. A localização é excelente para conhecer NY.
Ótima opção para quem viaja sozinho e procura um lugar tranquilo.
Obrigado a Sunny e os demais anfitriões
Great spacious apartment, very close to the metro and a lot of lovely restaurants in the area! All the ingredients you need for an amazing New York trip
I was only there for a few hrs in between flights but I was a great place to crash and roll out really quick to JFK in the early a.m.!

The apartment was an inviting place; the hosts made us feel welcome - tips and details about the apartment were clearly communicated. The space was quiet and very warm during the coldest of days in New York. The kitchen contained excellent equipment and made cooking a pleasure. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay.

We’ve had a pleasant stay at Sayra’s !
Would recommend !
Responsive host and clean facilities. The location is just a bit further than we would’ve liked.
Incredibly convenient for the price. Tons of restaurants.

Silene is not a SuperHost...well not just a SuperHost but also a SuperMom! She was a doting mother..making sure our stay was as comfortable as possible. Even when my wife fell ill she did her best to make sure she got the right medicine....this is way and above the role of a SuperHost. She is incredible.
With regards to the property, everything was as per advertised. The location is actually quite ideal . You are only about 10-15 minutes walk away from the theatre district. So you have the convenience of proximity without the chaos of Times Square. The apartment is located within a block of a supermarket chain and also CVS pharmacy. The restaurants nearby are also great...from pizzas to Thai to bars. The area is safe and quiet. Silene's unit is very spacious and clean. The showers are hot and water pressure was good and consistent (I hate it when it isn't). Thoroughly recommend you stay with Silene when you are in town!
Great deal! Very nice location! Would go back again 🙂

Anyone looking for a short (or long) stay in New York, this is the place.
The location is perfect, the staff very friendly and helpful, and the room itself is better than most.
10/10 would recommend and cannot wait to stay here again the next time I visit New York
Great price for a quality stay in New York! Will be coming back again.
It was an amazing stay it was easy to get to everywhere do you want to go around the city amazing rooftop with a cool view

You get what you pay for I guess.
There’s no natural light in the room. There’s no toilet or shower in the room. Our bed was uneven. We had cockroaches in our bedroom. The fridge was very loud during the night and woke us up. There was rats running around near the lockbox. Also the complex is quite loud with other people coming and going. We had small blankets for towels. We had two horrible nights.
Location is good and the host communicates well.

The location is pretty convenient with a subway station a 15min walk away and a 711 right across the street. The room is also very functional, bed was comfortable, and it was clean.
However, there were also a few downsides:
I messaged the hosts the day before arrival if an early check in was possible and they didn't get back to me until late morning the next day that maybe 1 PM could work - didn't hear anything until 3 PM despite additional messages.
You are not staying with the family. It's an apartment with two bedrooms, both being rented out to guests. Your experience depends on who the other guests are. Mine listened to music quite loud and often - didn't bother me but your experience might vary.
Additionally, while my room was clean, there was a full trash bag sitting in the kitchen and there were loads of dark long hairs in the bathroom when I arrived. Apparently both weren't cleaned.
Also, there were no towels available and the hosts were unable to provide any during my stay.
The apartment was so great - it's close to all the amenities and has a lot of great restaurants. And the host, Giam is always very responsive and friendly. I would definitely use this apt again!
Heilly place was very clean and comfortable. She’s a great host and she responds to any questions you have quickly. I would definitely come back and stay there again!

Ivan’s apartment was lovely and in a convenient location. The bed was very comfortable, with Egyptian cotton sheets, and the room so dark and quiet that I slept like a baby. Ivan was very quick to respond to any questions I had. I would highly recommend a stay here.

The apartment is nice and looks just like the pictures. I especially loved the neighborhood because there are so many great shops, restaurants and cafés around, which made the stay super enjoyable and interesting. The apartment could have been a little cleaner in some areas but that didn’t really affect the overall experience.
The check-in process was smooth and straightforward, making it easy to settle in right away. The check-out was also very flexible, which I really appreciated.
One cool thing about staying here is that you get the chance to meet and connect with other residents. For people who don’t know anyone in Brooklyn, it’s a great way to make new friends and feel more at home during your stay.
Overall I’d definitely recommend this place especially to anyone who hasn’t experienced Brooklyn yet. I’m a huge fan and think this area is a great place to start.

This was a perfect little place for our stay in NYC. The apartment was comfortable and clean and had lots of thoughtful touches. The neighborhood was safe and close to where we needed to be. Daniel was very responsive to our questions. Would definitely stay here again.

We loved staying at this apartment. The host accommodated for an early check in. We cooked, did laundry every day, and enjoyed watching movies after returning from days of full activities in the city. I had an opportunity to have a very nice conversation with the host. I recommend this place.

We had a wonderful time staying at Michael’s! He was a generous host, and it was great being just steps from Prospect Park, the subway, the Brooklyn Museum, and many restaurants. The home was charming, and we never felt uncomfortable using the shared space (living room, kitchen, etc.). We’d stay here again on our next trip without hesitation.

This is a hidden gem on the west side of town.  The location is fabulous, and you can walk to Times Square, and many other areas.  Subway stations are close as well.  Michael was a fabulous host, and the Landmark Tavern downstairs had fabulous food.  The smells alone as you walked downstairs made you hungry.  The apartment is so spacious, and I loved the history of the building.  I will definitely try to book this space on my next trip to NY.

Ho’s place was amazing, a lot better than we expected!
He was very flexible with the hours that we get to the apartment and also with the hours that we left.
Of course my friends and I recommend this place and if we come back to New York we will try to stay here again!

Ian and Patrick’s apartment was perfect!! Super cute, great location, everything was very clean. Also I’m always wary of NYC apartments and outside noise, but their apartment was very calm and tranquil!
Only tiny issue I had was the bed was a bit squeaky as I’m quite a light sleeper, but my husband had no issue with it.
We were running around for our time in NY, and only wish had more time to spend with Ian and Patrick! They were truly the best hosts and we would absolutely stay again.

Lovely garden in back is the perfect place to sit with a cup of coffee in the morning to plan your day.
Helen and Alfred were punctual in their replies and generous with their recommendations.

We had an incredible time staying here. Excellent communication and she really went beyond what we could have expected. The place is in an excellent location with very convenient transport links and it couldn’t have been any easier to travel within and slightly beyond nyc during our stay. The place itself is so beautiful as well. Thank you so much!!
Enjoyed my stay. The room was big and all the services were impeccable too.

Great stay in Bed-Stuy. Easy 10-min walk to Kingston-Throop Ave (A/C lines). Room is exactly as described - big enough, quiet and the air con was definitely a lifesaver. Great for those wanting a competitive price on NYC accommodation
Great host and lovely apartment

Die Unterkunft bei Angelica war wirklich gut. Man brauch zu Fuß ca. 10 min zur U-Bahn, die direkt in Manhattan hält.
Nach Manhattan brauch man inklusive Fußweg ca. 30 min.
In der Nähe befindet sich eine kleine Innenstadt und ein Supermarkt.
Das Zimmer sah aus wie auf den Bildern. Es war alles sauber und ordentlich.
Hat also alles gepasst.
Das einzige was gewöhnungsbedürftig war, war die Tür zur Toilette und dusche. Das ist nur eine Schiebetür mit Löchern. Also hört man quasi alles was auf der Toilette passiert.
Im Winter muss man ein wenig auf die Heizung achten. Das Rohr zur Heizung wird sehr sehr heiss.
Aber ansonsten eignet sich das zimmer super für einen Trip nach Manhattan, wenn man auch die U-Bahn nutzen möchte. Die Umgebung ist auch ruhig, so dass man nachts seine Ruhe hat. Wir haben uns wohl gefühlt.
lovely place to spend time....loved it

Hugh’s place was the perfect homebase for a long weekend in the city. Not only is the space comfortable with every amenity we needed, but it’s really beautiful, too. The location and neighborhood were great as well. We would absolutely stay again!

Amazing person! I felt just right at home. She was kind and caring about me. Always responsive and willing to do anything to make you feel like home. Amazing and amazing!! And as I said I will be staying here every single time I come to Brooklyn.
It was literally just 10 minutes walking to the train station pretty centric place and the bus stop is right in front of the house. Thanks for having me at your home
Perfect location, close to trains and shops. Very walkable and quiet location.

We had a wonderful stay at Matt & Annie’s place in Bushwick! Annie was incredibly responsive and very helpful with logistics, even arranging luggage storage for us before and after our stay. The neighborhood is lively and full of great spots to eat or grab a drink, with plenty of vibrant street life to enjoy. The L train is just a 5-minute walk away, making it super easy to get into the city.
The apartment itself was perfect for our needs—well equipped, tastefully furnished, and nicely private from the rest of the building. Overall, we were very happy with our stay and would gladly return!

This is really the best place to stay in New York! De room is big enough. You have a really nice private bathroom and the location is perfect! The only thing I can think of is that the wifi wasn’t good in our room
Totally recommend. Check-in and out was smooth and the location is great. Melbourne is a superstar in terms of customer service.
Easy place to stay if waiting for a morning flight from jfk. Clean room in a house with others.
They are amazing people! Thank you once again for the hospitality❤️

Nous avons passé 10 jours formidables dans l’appartement d’Elizabeth.
L’appartement est grand, paisible et très agréable à vivre.
La chambre est au calme, l’appartement fait tout le dernier étage donc personne à côté ni au dessus, c’est très plaisant ☺️.
Le quartier est très bien desservi par les transports en commun.
Nous reviendrons avec grand plaisir la prochaine fois.
It is a hotel so I did not really felt at home. The neighborhood is not nice and transportation is an issue. Employees were nice
The stay was great,the location was good and close to the bus & train station,laundry and couple stores…. Also you wouldn’t be sharing anything  with no one…
Great place to stay, we would come back no questions!
Nice place to stay if you’re staying for a weekend. Very nice to have to yourself.

Je suis restée 2 semaines chez Marcello et Elias et le séjour a été parfait ! L'appartement est très beau, superbement décoré. Les deux chats sont adorables et tres câlins. La chambre parfaite, avec un placard pour ranger ses affaires et un petir frigo. Elias m'a aidé a porter mes valises à mon arrivée. L'appartement est très calme, bien climatisé, idéal pour un séjour long. Il est très bien desservi, je mettais 20/25 minutes pour aller travailler à Manhattan tous les matins. Je me suis sentie à la maison, Marcello et Elias sont très discrets et chaleureux en même temps. Je recommande vivement de rester chez eux !

Emplacement parfait dans NY, chambre confortable avec douche à l’intérieure.
Toilettes sur le palier, mais cela est bien précisé dans l’annonce.
Hôte disponible et arrangeant.
Je recommande cet Airbnb.
Amazing place with such a good smile and great hospitality, I will definitely would like to be back.
It’s a little small but cute

This is a very nice place. It was clean, comfortable and conveniently located. I stayed within the queens area and everything was on average about 15 to 20 minutes away. Certain shopping areas were 5 minutes away. Manuel provided a parking space in the driveway which was great and made moving around easy as I didn’t have to search for a spot. Quiet neighborhood and overall just a great place!
Vey easy to find , great costumer service , clean and over all great location near many atractions !

This is my second stay at Milton place , I enjoyed my stay the first time returned on this trip to nyc ; Milton has a beautiful home in Olinville area , very clean felt like home , he’s very fast at communicating and at making arrangements to stay.
Bon séjour et bon host.
Andre is a great host, he shares the kitchen and food with us. We have a good communication! But I think the bedroom is not the one that the picture shows.

Mari's place is beautifully decorated, and she ensures that it remains clean and organized for all guests!
Lovely, eclectic space for a calm stay in a nice, green Brooklyn neighborhood
It’s so comfy and cozy. I’d like to come again! So kind host!

Diana truly made me feel welcomed. I arrived later than expected and she responded promptly and was able to make check-in easy. I used to live in the area, so it was nice to see it again, it's an excellent location. The whole apartment is super creative and well decorated. The additional guests were incredibly friendly and quiet after 10pm. I'd love to go back for a longer stay next time, if it's available again especially if the rate is discounted. I plan on going back with some artwork for them to add to their walls along with some tasty snacks from my hometown. Warm environment, smooth relaxing music played, cozy little notes everywhere.

The four of us had a great stay - close to the wedding venue, we were able to walk just about everywhere but we still had a quiet, clean and lovely place at night to rest. Very accommodating to our schedule. Thanks again!
Joel fue muy agradable, nos mostró el Airbnb y nos dio la bienvenida a NYC. El lugar es muy agradable y acogedor. Regresare pronto y le pondré en contacto con él.
Hosts were very responsive and amiable to any needs and questions. Also provided great recommendations.

Localización 9/10
Servicios 8/10
Amabilidad del personal 9/10
Contacto con anfitriones 2/10
PROS a destacar:
- Ubicación
- Calidad/Precio
- Habitación tranquila, limpia y funcional.
CONS a mejorar:
- Los anfitriones NO respondieron a nuestros mensajes.
- La cafetera más que cafetera es un hervidor, que vale para infusiones pero no para café.
- En la habitación había varios desperfectos de mantenimiento (fácilmente subsanables) especialmente en el baño. Nada grave.
- En la habitación hay ciertas amenities comestibles y bebibles (sin indicar precio por lado alguno) causando la impresión de que podrían ser gratis (y no lo son)
Great spot! Very clean and safe.
Great stay! Had everything I needed and guerline was available at all times to speak with us and assist with whatever we needed. She had lots of suggestions and insight on what to do and where to go.

Thank you so much for the beautiful stay.
I enjoyed the clean and peaceful atmosphere.
Good and welcoming place to stay.
Thank you so much .
C’était super on recommande vivement cet hôtel très bien placé 🤍 Merci pour ce séjour
Great location and stay! Francisca was very communicative and helpful throughout our stay

Shanique was extremely responsive. Her home was also beautiful with amazing LED lights in the living room, with a beautiful projector. He was also super kind and gave us some sweets and sparkling water as well. I would love to stay at her place again!

Room is as described. Cleanliness in the house is beyond any comparison. It was very nice and relaxing from first step in.
The host, Ms Demetria, well there is no words to describe her and her 2 kids. She is always there if you need her but at the same time manages to give you your private space. She's always going the extra mile to make you feel comfortable.
Location is great. Very calm neighborhood and just few minutes walk to Utica train station.
I won't hesitate a second to stay there on my next stop.
Cheers.
Great location, clean place, John was a great host and made sure I had everything that I needed during my stay
As usual, our stay at Yochi's was terrific.  We would not stay anywhere else in New York.  He really looks after us and the apartment is great.

This was such a great place to stay in Brooklyn for our little group! Excellent location near a subway line, and lots of convenient shops and restaurants in the surrounding area. Was incredibly clean and had great air conditioning too. :) Host was very responsive. Highly recommend!
Great location, but the rooms aren’t Value for money.

This place is perfect for a couple days in the city. Full kitchen! Hot breakfast! We saved $ not eating out every meal.  Parking across the street (book on Spothero). Fruit available in the lobby (nice touch). Will stay here again!
Fabulous place, great location... close to WBurg and Bushwick. Wonderful host!
Staying at Omwattie’s was great! She was flexible, attentive and helpful during our whole stay and made it amazing. So thankful!
La ubicación es genial. Llegas caminando al Time Sq, en El Barrio hay muchas opciones de comida y conexiones de subte.
El alojamiento es muy limpio y cómodo, suficiente para llegar a descansar.
Nice stay, very clean space. Kind host, nice bathroom. Location is a bit out of the way and right off highway but a great option in a pinch

Le logement en lui-même est identique à la description. Tout était très propre et la decoration sympa. Jarrod est extrêmement réactif et vraiment très arrangeant. Plusieurs lignes de métro sont à maximum 10 mn de marche.
Le principal problème est l'environnement direct qui au premier abord peut ne pas rassurer. Mais notre séjour s'est bien déroulé. Le logement est assez grand pour 8 personnes mais la cuisine manque encore d'équipements (seulement 5 assiettes, pas de bouilloire ni de machine à café...). Le logement est cependant récent et sera peut être mieux équipé dans le futur.
Lovely place, great location, easy check-in. S.M. is a great host. She was very responsive and thorough, and gave great recommendations.

Deirdre's place is in a great location. The building is in the process of being renovated, but the apartment itself is finished. This is definitely a "no frills" place, so if you want just the basics (a bed and a bathroom) for the night, this is a great value. The building is a bit chilly, but Dierdre leaves a space heater for your use. Note that the walls are thin (we woke up to dogs barking around 6am and you can hear movement outside of the apartment).
Great location, close to subway. Rebecca was so nice and accommodating. Would definitely stay here next time

Perfect location in the middle of everything for a quick NYC trip! We arrived at 3 am and had easy check in. Room was small and bathroom a bit dated, but the bed was comfy and bathroom stocked with everything you’d need. Overall great value!

Right next to the Metro station, Not Too close to Judy downtown and also not Too far away from the city center 👍
Also got a supermarket right next door!
Check-in was also easy and flexible.
The bedroom was spacious and comfortable. Both bedroom and bathroom were clean.
Chris is a lovely host, very friendly and was able to make good suggestions for nice spots in the neighborhood 😊
If we come back we would gladly stay at Chris‘ place again.
Had a great stay at M Social Times Square.
Overall, very good place for 4 of us.

The room was tasteful and comfortable, with adequate access to the bathroom even with three guests. No TV, no coffee maker, things I'm used to but could live without. In general, I thought of this as "Vigil's salon". She herself - a teacher and filmmaker - is a lively conversationalist, but this was also the first place where I've interacted with the other guests - a Dutch director of special need programs and a retired German school inspector who, at 85, is still an enthusiastic traveler - with whom I got into a passionate discussion of the Ottonians (that's right, the Ottonians - look them up).
The neighborhood and building are both generally neat and quiet, with the one exception of a large group that gathers around a corner across the street, talking and playing music until after 11. I managed to sleep well nonetheless. But it's a reminder that today's Harlem is a funny mix of extreme gentrification (the Gap, Whole Foods, gourmet food shops) and a long-standing street life.
Yves place is clean and convenient to and from LGA/ JFK. A 12 minute walk to the train station, if you want to explore the city. Safe environment, safe place to be if your a woman alone.

We loved how everything was nearby, how responsive the host was on this app. the place was okay. we had quite a few issues, but the host clarified everything for us.
issues with the front desk, we also wanted to use the resort cuz we read that they'd charge us for it, but the pool was empty, the elevators were broken for a while which made it a nightmare getting down from tue 48th floor. I think only one elevator was working when we checked in.
other than that, we liked the stay, we loved how quickly the host responded to us and fixed our check out day, we loved how close everything was. thank you!

Lourdes was a fantastic host; incredibly kind, responsive and proactively sent information at check-in and check-out. The apartment looked just like the online pictures and had everything I needed for a weekend stay.  I really appreciated the extra touches she provided like the bottled water, kind bar and coffee - so nice when you are tired from travelling. The location was great, very close to the subway so I could get everywhere quickly, but also had great markets and restaurants within walking distance. The apartment and building felt very safe, as I had my own code to  use with the keyless lock system. Would definitely recommend and hope to stay again.

I’m not sure if it’s the norm to have mildew and moldy scents in New York apartments but the moment you enter the building there is a strong musty odor. There’s mildew in the shower and the rooms smell as though the sheets were washed but forgotten in the washer so there’s a soggy scent to them. Otherwise the space is clean (all things considered), appliances work and location was fine. RJ is mostly responsive but you may need to follow up depending on time of day. For the price and considering we were out most of the time - not the worst of the worst but not the best either.
Great stay during my Ny visit!

Leecia and Mike are really nice hosts, let us in at night after late flight, always responded to any questions and we could even leave our luggage after check-out. Apartment is well-located, close to subway station (5 min walking) and then it's 30 minutes to Manhattan. There is nice bakery nearby and laundromat are just steps from their house. However, there were some issues during our stay. Internet signal was very unstable and slow, I had to ask Leecia to reset router many times, but it didn't helped a lot. Then we saw cockroach in the sink - giant black monster, it was so disgusting! Overall it is good place for budget travelers who don't intend to spend whole days at home and plan to explore NYC instead. But again, Leecia is brilliant!
The apartment was in a good location. There were lots of restaurants and bars right on the block. The apartment was bigger in person. Will consider staying here again for future trips.
Best part is the location and size of the room. Great for a few days
Space was much more than I expected for the price. Very gracious host.

The location was great and close to a lot of restaurants, coffee, and the subway. The apartment was well decorated and our room was cozy. Martin sent helpful and clear directions before our stay that made it very easy!

Super plek voor onze kids van 15 en 16 jaar oud en onszelf. Er zit een leuk restaurantje beneden en de staf is heel erg vriendelijk. De voorzieningen die erbij zitten zijn echt top. We komen hier zeker weer terug.

We arrived in NYC around 9pm Saturday. We were luckily able to find on street parking and paid $10 on the meter (starting 12am Sunday was free meter). It was a block from the hotel which was easy to find. Considering on how late it was, check in was pretty speedy. The room was pretty clean for the most part (there were a few stains on the rug and some on the sheets). Bathroom was clean, shower water was hot and had good pressure. The air conditioner worked well too. Overall the stay was pretty comfortable. Plenty to do nearby. I recommend!

I traveled with my mom to New York and it was a pleasure to stay in Tommie’s house. We felt as home, Tommie and Nicole were super kindness and always they were always attentive of everything that we could needed it.
We would like to stay there in another opportunity, the house has everything that you can need it. Definitely, it has been one of my best experiences ❤️
I recommend this place 100%. Thanks for everything Tommie and Nicole ❤️

Wir waren bereits zum zweiten Mal bei Ming und Matt und hatten wieder eine wunderbare Zeit. Die Wohnung und die Gastgeber sind in allen Belangen grossartig! Ich würde diese Unterkunft jederzeit meinen Freunden und Familie weiterempfehlen.
It was a great quick place to stay.
Alex fue un anfitrion amable y atento. Tuvo un problema en el fregadero 3 dias que no fue culpa suya pero le faltó un poco de comunicacion al respecto. Por lo demas todo bien.

Our stay at Andre and Sylvia's was perfect. They were fast to respond with all communication and were very helpful. The space was beautiful and clean...we especially loved the big kitchen and lovely outdoor space with the fire. The location was also perfect...close to tons of stores and restaurants, as well as just a few blocks from the park. My family is already talking about returning next year!

Every listing description is accurate.  Dane, our host, was soooo friendly and helpful to answer our questions.  The Welcome Book helped us a lot provide all the essential info to enjoy the apartment and the neighborhood.  There are some nice and cozy eateries, which are all within a few blocks away.  When it comes to public transportation, we took full advantage of using A or C lines of the subway, the fastest and the cheapest way to get to the central Manhattan.  Overall I strongly recommend this place.  They never let you down.

Tyler was a great host! Super responsive and friendly - he was quick to respond if we needed anything.
The place itself was neat and fit our needs great. The location is great with plenty of restaurants, bars, and a park within walking distance. Street parking was easy.

I enjoy staying with them.
And It was very convenient to go to Manhattan :)

The Airbnb comfortably fitted five adults for a long weekend getaway. It served our needs perfectly. It was in a great location and near the underground (about a 5-10 minute walk to the underground train). Inside, the apartment looked modern and neat. It also has a washer, dryer, dishwasher in the unit. We didn't use the washer and dryer, but it was great knowing it was accessible to us. There are plenty of restaurants and cafes in the area, plus a small farmer's market in the nearby park on Sundays. I would stay here again if in town. Dave was a great host and very accommodating. Thanks, Dave!

My friend and I had a wonderful stay! The room was cozy, and the bathroom was spotless. Dee was very attentive with her messages and made check-in easy. The only drawback was that traveling to Manhattan could take quite a while, as could returning to the Airbnb.
Cando was very helpful during our stay and extremely quick in responding back to any questions we had.

Sunny's place was great! Just as described. Nicely equipped and very clean. The neighbourhood was good too; interesting with great restaurants and convenience stores. Highly recommend Nana Ramen around the and David's Brisket House one subway stop away.
Nancy was an excellent host. Very accommodating, friendly and easy to communicate with. The apartment was clean, modern and exactly as advertised
Mutale & Heidi were very flexible and accommodating to our unforeseen circumstances

Melissa is an incredible host AND her place is so adorable! Art is everywhere, full blue tile bathroom, high ceilings and the bedroom was perfect for me as a solo traveler. It had all the little amenities in my room like a microwave, mini fridge and coffee area so it felt like a cozy dorm room. Her cats were like the cherry on top of everything else, I loved my stay!! Highly recommend!
Excellent location and host

everything that was posted about it was pretty accurate. echoing what other reviews have said, when people push the intercom thing at night it is insanely loud and can be annoying, but only happened about 3 times during our 2 month stay. the smaller bedroom is reallyyy small. the whole visit we didn’t have any problems with bugs, appliances, or too much at all. just please please don’t forget your keys in the apt as if you do you’ll need to have $75 of cash handy. the proximity to the 6 train is so amazing (literally outside the door), especially late at night when you don’t wanna be walking around too much. proximity to central park is also superb for runs/walks/chilling in the park.

Joshua & Whitney are super nice hosts.
The apartment is classy and in a great neighbourhood.
Combined with five star hospitality by the hosts, it was a memorable experience for me.
Central Park, Museum, Great places to eat, proximity to the metro - the list goes on.
The weekly maid service really helped during the long stay. Thank you Lorena.
Khoi home is amazing!!! Communication with Khori is A1 he respond very quickly. If I could give khori’s home 100 stars I would.

La casa di Lola è situata nella zona Upper East Side di NYC. La zona è super sicura ed è molto ben collegata da due linee metropolitane in particolare quella gialla. Consiglio di fare la metrocard per vivere la città da vero newyorkese e quindi evitare i taxy. Dopo aver capito il meccanismo la metro è molto semplice e conveniente da usare.
La mia stanza era spaziosa, pulita e luminosa. Il check-in è stato veloce e facile. La vera sorpresa pero' sono gli amici a quattro zampe di Lola in particolare King Arthur (il cagnolino di casa) che mi faceva sempre tante feste quando tornavo da fuori.
Sicuramente scegliero' in futuro nuovamente questa sistemazione per tornare a NYC!

I stayed here for a month with my family while on travel work in long Island. Micheline was a great host, quick to respond if we needed anything and very hospitable. Apartment was clean and even larger than it looked in the photos. Finding street parking nearby was never an issue unlike other parts of queens I stayed in. I would recommend this apartment.
Top Lage, Zimmer war sauber, wir würden jederzeit wieder kommen

You get what you pay for with this apartment: for the low price the amenities are very spare, but the location is good. Host is friendly and responsive but not flexible. A few issues with cleanliness: ants in the bathroom and a cockroach in the main room.
Place is really good, the host is one message away for anything.
Great location at center of Manhattan very near main attractions.

I really loved staying in this place for several nights. The room was small, but clean and cozy. Actually all the hostel is very cozy, silent, the atmosphere was 🙏. Staff were very helpful and the guests were respectful and nice. The location couldn't be better. The place is clean, I loved vegetarian breakfast which were free, I was allowed to leave my and my friends' bags there until 9 pm. Special thanks to Sunny, who was especially friendly and helpful 🌞
Great location away from midtown and easy subway access! Super responsive hosts and very accommodating! Highly recommend over the touristy overpriced hotel options!

The apartment was very stylish and extremely clean throughout.
We had a lovely stay, thanks so much!
Yamin was a great host - very responsive for all needs and gave excellent neighborhood suggestions.
This apartment was just as described. We liked staying here. One of the bathrooms is pretty unconventional with the shower and toilet in the same small space.

If you’re looking for an authentic Williamsburg residential experience, then this is the place for you. Located just slightly off the beaten path, yet close enough for a comfortable walk to two L train subway stops, Christine’s place is the right mix of comfort and eclectic. The private bathroom is a nice bonus! Great place to stay.
Très bien placé. Logement propre. Hôte très réactif. Excellent séjour

A very nice house in a quiet neighborhood, in the northwest corner of Staten island. Close to anywhere on the island, and right across the channel from New Jersey. I stayed for a total of four nights, and was very happy.
Not a lot of places within walking distance, but you are a short bus ride to the Staten Island ferry. DoorDash and other delivery service services deliver to the house no problem at all.
Adekunle and his brother were wonderful. Very friendly, very helpful, very proactive if I had any questions. He let me park in his driveway The first night, the rest of the time I stayed there there was no problem at all finding street parking. The upstairs bedroom was very nice, I could see New Jersey from the window. The TV had a great picture, Wi-Fi was fast enough to stream video, and the bathroom was spotless.
A fantastic stay, I hope this place is available the next time I’m on the island. Thank you

Abdon, gave the most detailed instructions on where the keys were at, how to get in and much more. Great host with great communication skills. Was able to get the place ready for me 9 HOURS before my check in absolutely unheard of. I think he should start his own hotel in my opinion, he could run circles around holiday inn! Would highly recommend place is cute and quaint and just relaxing overall!
The listing was accurately described.  The location of the listing was great very close to public transportation and eating places.
Gem of a place! Loved the washer dryer. Great location if you love Harlem. Steep stairs to unit. WiFi spotty. Very clean.
Amazing location if your looking for a full nyc experience

Loved this place and would definitely stay again. Juanita’s house was warm and inviting. Loved being able to stay in a brownstone in New York. We spent a days out and nights back on the stoop. We spent a lot of time in Prospect park with live music and food vendors.  Perfect to go bring a blanket and spend the day.   Juanita’s recommendations for local places and how to get around were very detailed and helpful.
Jaleh's place is excellent for a comfortable stay with a lovely host, I felt like in home. I'd come back for sure.

Jamilya is the perfect host.  The apartment is very clean, so you feel right at home.  The only disturbing thing is the very bright house, but you get used to it, also because the neighbours don't behave loudly.
Very clean rooms and amazing proximity to the heart of Manhattan.

Unbeatable location right in front of the Oculus! Super convenient to the Fulton Street station, making it easy to get anywhere in the city. The views were stunning and the stay was perfect. Would book again without hesitation!
Mike was a wonderful and accommodating host and overall a great person to talk to. The place was clean and close to some great restaurants. Will definitely come back the next time!
very close to jfl. quiet. very clean bathroom and bedroom. kind host. but it was a bit chilly at night.
Great place for a visit to NYC, great location, beach across the street, bus stop less than a block away
Great location. Honestly, no need to take Uber or taxi because location is close to subway. I had a great time!

Kates place is a must stay in the west village. You get the most bang for your buck with a full size kitchen and a separate living room. I stayed for a month and her charming apartment offers a quaint lifestyle while being in close proximity to everything NYC has to offer. It was a very memorable stay.

Russell was an awesome host and his place was superb.  Even my friends from Astoria who stopped by said they were impressed by how great the amenities and space is.  We had 5 people and there was enough beds and space for all of us to comfortably sleep and then get ready for our days in NYC.  I would absolutely stay here again.
Appartement idéalement situé proche des métros et restaurant quartier au top nous avons pris a chaque fois le métro deux accès possible impeccable
A beautiful, comfortable, well-organized and extremely clean studio apartment that contained every amenity.  Very close to subway station and very responsive and thoughtful host.

I really enjoyed my stay here. Very clean and quite. Location is perfect easy access to transportation. Maria was quick to respond to questions I had although she sent clear in instructions before arrival which was very helpful. I highly recommend staying her would definitely book again on my next visit.
Excellent séjour. Pearline est une excellente hote, très accueillante et attentionnée. Le logement est spacieux, confortable et très pratique, à proximité du métro. Nous recommandons vivement.

Great hospitality particularly the free coffee and pastries
Excellent facilities and super location.
Only feedback is it would be good to have a bedside table on both sides. Thanks for the stay

Marjories place was definitely worth the value while staying in the city. The suite is very private and clean. You could tell the renovations were done with lots of care and style. I would definitely stay here again.
Shemi was very communicative and offered a location in a lovely area. The unit was very clean and Shemi offered every detail needed for me and my friends to have an enjoyable stay.
We loved this spot! Edna and Isaiah were very helpful and responded right away to all of my questions : ) great spot!
Cassia is a best host!  Super friendly. Her place is great; clean; I had a great time!!

He cancelled on me last minute  because he was paranoid I was a local and not from Britain, they thought I was going to have a party which is very unfair and also left me without a place for the night.
Md and his wife were amazing hosts, the place was spotless and very welcoming.

Everything was perfect !

Our stay in Gin's place was okay however we had some issues that made the experience far from perfect.
Pros:
The bedding and towels were clean and there were plenty of towels available.
The water pressure and heat in the shower and sinks were great.
There's a convenience store/bodega at the end of the block for any small or quick purchases you may need to make.
Times Square is a roughly 40 minute train ride from the studio.

Cons:
Communication was ok - we asked for a late checkout and only received a response two months later, by which time we had made alternative plans. There was zero communication during our stay, not even to as if we had arrived or if everything was okay.
The apartment had some cleaning issues, e.g. the fridge and other kitchen appliances were dirty, and so were the bathroom wall tiles.
We also feel like we shouldn't be asked to run the dishwasher and strip the bed when we're paying an $100 cleaning fee.
Despite being noted in the listing, there were no salt, pepper, or oil so it was an inconvenience to make even basic meals.
We were only provided with two toilet papers for eight nights which ran out midway through our stay.
The blinds are see-through, far from ideal in a ground floor apartment where homeless people dig through the bins right outside the window. We had to stick plastic bags on the windows to have some privacy.
Gin was responsive when we mentioned the cleaning issues and she agreed to refund us 50% of the cleaning fee.
All in all, we feel there are many improvements to be made until we could recommended the place to others.
