Had a great staycation at Christopher’s property! A very spacious studio that made for a great home away from home! The furniture layout is well thought out and was perfect for my solo stay! I will definitely stay again and look forward to trying more vegan food options in the area!
Had an amazing stay will do it again
Giselle’s place is perfect for a single female traveller to NYC! Everything i could have hoped for.

Such a cool experience! A great HOME in the middle of Manhattan. Spacious, airy, quiet and safe. Lots of restaurants close by, Central Park not too far of a walk, and a great coffee shop right next door. Would definitely recommend and stay again!

Just like the photos! On the smaller side of other hotels I stayed at but it is NY & didn’t bother myself or friend either! Stayed in a room with a queen bed on the 14th floor. Loved the vibe of the room, super comfy bed, & fun bar (definitely for a younger crowd only at night). There was another restaurant that we didn’t get to try but I definitely think we’ll back here. The hotel staff are super friendly!Helped us with a car parking garage issue quickly! The breakfast cafe was so convenient to hit before we left! Great stay!
Your home , hospitality was greatly appreciated looking forward to visiting again best regards John
Great , very professional

Can’t beat the location. A lot of party/street noise at night, but beds were comfortable, kitchen was nice with a washer and dryer available. Air conditioning worked great. Updated bathrooms, and lots to do in the area. Very close to the subway, ground zero, oculus mall, O’Hara’s pub, George’s Restaurant, Dunkin Donuts, pastry shops and pizza parlor.
I would definitely stay here again, and recommend to others.

I stayed at Qai’s Airbnb for 7 months and had a great experience. The bedroom had everything I needed for a comfortable long-term stay. The room had a queen-sized bed with two sets of bedding. There's an air conditioner as well as a radiator and portable heater.
Qai was a thoughtful and organized host—she made sure there was plenty of space in the kitchen, bathroom and shoe rack to accommodate guests.
The location was quiet and conveniently close to the subway, making it easy to get around. There are restaurants and grocery stores nearby, as well as a laundromat, which made day-to-day living super convenient.
I highly recommend this Airbnb if you’re looking for a clean, quiet, and well-located place for a long-term stay!

This little spot was perfect for our purposes (visiting Fordham and seeing friends in Little Italy in the Bronx).  It's not fancy, and that's great, the price is right and it was clean and inviting.  Thank you, Greg!

It was a cute little basement apartment that was only a 9 minute walk from our family!  It met all our basic needs.  Ziggy and Rome were lovely hosts.  When there was an issue it was fixed, except the porch light.  It wasn't working the whole time we were there, even though we informed them about it.  The neighborhood was lovely.  I highly recommend Bushwick Burgers, right down the street, they are great!  All in all, it was a wonderful stay!  Thank You!

Jason’s place looked liked the photos and it was easy to walk to the subway or walk to many places. We found good Asian food around and a convenient store at the corner. It was a bit weird that the entrance wasn’t the entrance on the listing, different building. A downside for us was having only one key to get into the building. We had to share a key. They should have 2. There were 4 flights of stairs and no elevator. Not a big deal if you are in shape and have no physical problems, having to carry luggage up to the 4th floor could be an issue for some people.
I was happy the couch was wide and I could sleep in it because the bed has a skylight right on top and when the sun came out it’d wake me up so I had to go sleep on the couch.
Nice touch was that he had coffee and creamer, he was very communicative before check in. He let us check out late which was awesome! I found this apartment to be a good price for the weekend before Christmas.

If you are prepared to travel with quite effective and quick public transportation to Manhattan, or to JFK, this is your place. If you expect quality space for 4 adults, this is your place. If you would like to live like an American, this is your place. This was our place, thanks Sophie.
Place was amazing would recommend for anyone to stay ! Great location ! And lots of things close to here if you need
Great and communicative host as well as a nice, clean space made for a great stay

I loved the accommodations - it felt like going to a spa! Large, comfortable king size bedroom, no clutter, beautiful artwork, large updated bathroom, and all tastefully decorated. The subway and bus stop are steps from the brownstone which made it easy to get to.

From beginning to end this trip was spectacular. The unit was immaculate from the entrance to the back rooms. Every area was nicely put together for our comfort and we felt right at home! Pictures are exactly how the space is presented, plus some. We weren’t anticipating all the stairs to the property which was a little hectic with the stroller carseat and luggage & parking was a bit of a hassle but that was the least, we also went Thanksgiving week for the streets were busy and …ITS NYC! . Everything else from the comfort of the unit to all the extras (a bottle of wine, snacks for the children, pantry and bathroom items). This is definitely one of the best properties ever visited and we will be back again for sure. The only thing I would suggest is having the shower head changed to one with a hose to make for easier bathing for children as well as the water pressure in the bathroom was very low and could be corrected. Otherwise, 100 out of 10 ! Thank you Naana and Chenits!!

This was my second stay at Untitled, and everything went smoothly! I arrived early on my check-in date and they let me store my luggage, which was a great help. I also loved starting each morning with a drink and pastry in the lounge—such a nice perk!

Alex and Lorelei made us very welcome in their lovely home and were very helpful and generous hosts.  The accommodation was very stylish,comfortable and well located near subway and great cafes and we  recommend it wholeheartedly. My daughter and I felt very relaxed and welcome.

Diego's apartment is conveniently located in Williamsburg -- close to to shops, restaurants and the train.  Proximity to the train made it especially easy to get to and from Manhattan.  The apartment itself is stylishly decorated and thoughtfully appointed.  We will surely be back for another visit.  Thank you, Diego!
Vi ble godt tatt imot og leiligheten var som forventet. Vi likte oss godt her.
Great place! I love the decor and price.
Comfortable, clean, and spacious.

Loved the place, it’s super homely and VERY clean. Super efficient with door codes, so no need to keep track of keys. Access to laundry and only a 10-20 walk to public transport. Would definitely stay again!

Couldn't have dreamed it would be so great! Michael and Busser were wonderful hosts - gracious, welcoming, and accommodating in every way. Staying in their home definitely enriched our visit to NY. The 35th Street location has everything you need (food, drink, transit) within a minutes walk away, yet is wonderfully quiet. The property itself is stunning with a masterful mix of art, high-design and contemporary and antique furnishings and decor. The 4th floor apartment is part of the residence but is private, tucked high into the tress, impeccably clean and well appointed (coffee machine, clean linens, comfortable bed, bottled water in fridge, etc), and is spacious with a separate bedroom and open kitchen and living area. Surrounded by an array of amazing art, one feels as though they're living in a gallery. It was the best Air B&B stay we have ever had.
Lovely place in a lovely neighbourhood of Brooklyn! Real Brooklyn feel which was cool, very safe area, but was a bit far from manhattan! Very quick at responding to questions and queries!

A perfect place for a trip to NY. Very close to mid Manhatten.
Vigil was very nice and always there if needed.
Appartamento pulito e essenziale, unico “problema” la doccia piccola e malfunzionante. Ottima la posizione.
I stayed there for about a month and would gladly stay there again.  Very polite and responsive host, comfortable bed, fridge in the room, walkable to the local stores and locations.

El apartamento es muy bonito y amplio, tiene todo lo que uno necesita para una estancia perfecta. Tiene un patio hermoso, que en verano debe ser increíble.
El único detalle es la ubicación, el metro está bastante lejos, como a 900 metros, y por la noche devolverse es un poco oscuro.
Jenny fue muy amable y simpática, siempre atenta las necesidades que teníamos.
Great apartment in Park Slope Brooklyn. Quiet block, clean, air conditioners in every room. Easy check in an check out process. Consistent accurate communication throughout our stay.
Noelky was a great host. Very hospitable, quick to respond, and ready to help at all times. The space itself was great, very modern and cozy. Would definitely recommend!
Host has excellent communication.

Perfect location. Lovely neighborhood. Everything you need is within a couple block radius.
Clean, comfortable.
We will definitely stay here again.
Very convenient and pleasant area. Room and bath were very compact but clean and comfortable.
nothing but pure excellence

The apartment was perfect for our visit to NYC. We appreciated having an elevator and a washer and dryer in the apartment. Very close to grocery stores and restaurants as well as Central Park.
Communication with the host was excellent and our two issues were resolved quickly with frequent updates on the progress.
We would definitely stay there again.
Beautiful place to stay.
Great location in a great neighborhood!  Clean, large apartment.
Easy to find and a very nice location! Just what we needed for our stay. Easy to check in and out:)

The house was beautiful. It was a small comfy 1 bedroom located on the first floor. You won't have to worry about parking the wifi connection was A1. The apartment also had cooling system for
the hot nights. The bed was very comfortable and soft the bedroom had a walk-in closet. Overall I will definitely come back again.
Perfect for our short stay. A bit further from the city but the subway is very close and the staff was very helpful.

We had a great stay in Sharon’s spacious apartment. We were relieved that there was always parking available on the street. Not a ton of restaurants or bars nearby, so we ordered in most nights. Overall a great place!

Spacious, clean,  well equipped; if you need a comfortable place to stay in Brooklyn you need look no further than this. Liat goes out of his way to make you feel welcome.  I would heartily recommend this place to future travelers.
Great location, easy access to public transportation and walkable. The place is good for a short trip. The host was very responsive.

This outlines my personal experience and opinions staying there for two nights in August 2020.
There is a fundamental lack of clear communication. Ranging from the hotel website, the Airbnb listing as well as in person interactions at checkin. The listing was not reflective of the current state of the hotel and it’s a amenities.
Upon checkin the AC was out in the entire building, something that the staff failed to mention until we called after spending 20 minutes trying to get it working in our unit. No updates were issued and the host was not responsive on Airbnb. The rooftop deck would have provided some relief from the 83 degree temperature in our room but there is no guarantee that guests of the hotel have access to it. That’s something that gets booked in advance and is available to the public. Eventually someone came in to fix it in the evening, and while I understand the difficulty of navigating this, going from unit to unit with no sanitization is not the most COVID friendly approach. And while we are on the topic of navigating this during the pandemic, the sanitizing stations available in the public areas were all empty, the lobby is very crowded and the elevator experience is about as slow and cramped as I’ve ever experienced it. Additionally the room smelled like cigarettes and weed the entire weekend, from either the unit across or directly below.
Overall I think the standards are pretty low even for a budget hotel and better communication and attention to cleanliness would greatly improve the stay.
Excellent apartment for long stays, and a great location. We really enjoyed it.

Mary Sue's apartment is located in the very desirable upper westside of NYC and for anyone seeking adventure like me it was the perfect location to explore downtown, Times Square, the boroughs, the museums, broadway shows and...shopping. There's a Bloomingdale's Outlets Store 3 blocks away...what! Quelle surprise. The reasonably priced month's rent allowed me freedom to do more, buy more and have more fun. It was well worth sharing the living space with Mary Sue who just happens to be a fabulous hostess. I had to purchase an extra piece of luggage to bring everything back home but...so what!
I highly recommend.  Thank you for being so accommodating

I had a great stay. The location is excellent - making it ideal for both business and leisure. The rooms are modern and spacious and the staff were friendly and efficient throughout. Good value for money and would definitely return.

I really enjoyed staying at Christopher's apartment. Though he was on a business trip himself, he answered every question helpfully. Supermarket, metro and countless restaurants were a stone's throw away. It was hygienic and tidy, I was satisfied and his cats were just the icing on the cake. Thank you, Christopher, for having us and an amazing stay.

Renee is a nice host responding to any question on time
the place is clean, has all what you will need and near to bus station
small room but was more than enough for my stay
will use It again if I will come to NY

The Interfaith Retreat is the perfect place to stay in NYC if you’re looking for somewhere to rest your head. Friendly and helpful team always available to answer any questions. Light morning breakfast is great. Bathrooms clean. As mentioned in their description, there’s no room in your room, so if you’re a light sleeper it may be noisy. However, they are very very quick to quieten any noisy guests and it was never an issue for me. I would definitely return here.

Très bel accueil. Nathalie s'est montrée une excellente hôte. Le logement était charmant. Il y avait tout ce qu'il fallait pour que notre séjour soit agréable et confortable. Le quartier est modeste et sécuritaire et on y est bien. Plein de petites épiceries, de boulangeries et proche des métros. Je recommande sans hésiter Les Sirènes !
We had a great time at Jessica's place. The space is  great, nicely decorated,  and is clean and spacious .  You can't beat the location. Jessica was quick to respond to our questions.

Chris’ place is quite refreshing with the skylight and openness of space. The plants add more lives to the space.
Location is surrounded by couple of subway lines, so it’s easy to go any direction in NYC.
Chris is a very friendly and communicative host. I appreciate the communication before, during, and post the stay. I would recommend friends this place or I will come back again.
The host is really kind. He prepared everything well and cared how we feel when we stayed there. My friend and I appreciate the host and his family a lot.
Location was just down the street from our son’s home.  Great location, clean and welcoming.
Marjorie hosted very well! She was easy to deal with and her place was kept up and very clean. I’d recommend her to anyone

3 good sized double bedrooms,  ample shared space, and v close to subway. Surrounding neighbourhood not necessarily nicest place, but as a base to head out from and have a really good amount of room to come back to, tough to beat.
The room is quite small but except for this fact all the other aspects such as the location, price, cleaness, service, and etc were excellent.
Great stay! Check-in process was very clear and easy. Room was clean, quiet, and well-kept. Perfect for my short stay in New York.

Good stay at Daniel's, so close to central park and every coffee shop you could want! we loved the neighborhood. Host was very prompt in responding and ordered the items that we requested immediately. Room was garden level which helped keep out all light. Great storage space for a month despite a small space - well utilized.
Location was amazing.
Only cons- apartment was a little low on sunlight, and a few basics were missing.
Overall good experience, a few more touches could make it even more homey!

I will stay here again in a HEARTBEAT. Quiet neighborhood close to subway and amazing budget friendly places to eat and to top that the sweetest host who makes you feel like you are right at home- what more can u ask for. :)

Claudia's place absolutely exceeded my expectations! Not only was her condo in a great location, but it was extremely clean and had everything you could possibly need to stay long term(soap, toilet paper, paper towels, etc)! It also had a breathtaking view that you could see all night from bed, as well as super friendly doormen 24/7. I also loved that there was a whole foods about a five minute walk away and not to mention so many wonderful restaurants and coffee shops! And anytime I had a question, Claudia got back to me right away, she was a pleasure to interact with! If you're looking for a place right in Nolita/near Soho Claudia's place is definitely the one to stay at!

Our stay was exactly what we needed for the time. We were renovating our apartment and had to vacate for 3-4weeks. The location was great, very close to the 79th St. crosstown bus which comes fairly frequently. The building staff is so nice and super helpful. The host was incredibly communicative and very responsive. We were missing several amenities…glassware, tea kettle and coffee maker but had them within a couple of days as they ordered them right away. The kitchen is a bit bare bones as far as pots and pans, but you can make do…no matching lids. But if you’re just visiting and out for meals this is a great place. Not much offered as far as garbage bags, dishwashing detergent or cleaning supplies. we had to buy our own.
The main issue we had was plumbing, we had a major leak in the bathroom sink and the tub backed up with water a couple of times. The super was very quick to come and fix every problem though. The apartment itself is very quiet. Overall a nice stay.

Marianny's apartment was picturesque, fragrant, and extremely comfortable.  The beds were so soft and were welcome respites after full days of travel and walking around Manhattan.  The kitchenette has everything one could need for eating on the go (except for your food, of course!)... including a variety of local delivery menus fitting a variety of tastes.  The distance to the Metro line is ideal, and the neighborhood was quiet, even at night - so much so that my daughter and I felt relatively safe walking home from the Metro at midnight after a Broadway show (keep your city senses/wits about you).  Marianny responds to messages extremely quickly whenever I had a question and checked in with us appropriately, which as a host, I appreciated.  Kacey, the manager, greeted us and was always available to us for questions or help.  I would most definitely look to stay here again should we return to the City.

A great place to stay! The bed was very comfortable, and  I slept great. Angella  is a wonderful host. I flew into JFK Airport  really  late and she sent me clear check in directions with pictures to make sure my check in was easy.

My wife and I came to visit NYC and absolutely loved our stay. The place was clean, quiet, easy access to the metro line. We had everything we needed and felt very comfortable!  Far enough from city center to enjoy some peace, close enough to easily enjoy the city; also very close to JFK which makes for easy travel, just take the metro to the airport and then the air train, no need to get an uber/lyft. There is a great grocery store nearby and also some nice local restaurants just a few stops down the road. The beach was beautiful in the winter. 10/10 recommend staying here!
Čisté, útulné, pohodlná postel.
I Took my family there for a couple nights and let me tell you: Good place to stay , clean and close to everything. Quick responses from host.

We loved this space. So adorable and in a wonderful area. There is a sweet little brewery up the street with amazing pizza and steps from the subway. Was so clean and well equipped. Thank you for making our time in Brooklyn one for the books xo

Caroline is very thoughtful and kind when entering the home she had placed champagne and two glasses and a card welcoming us and expressing a happy birthday to my daughter, which that was our trip for her birthday. Any questions we had she was quick to answer back also she
had laid out ropes and slippers. The house looked just as it appeared in the picture. Definitely would recommend staying here quite neighborhood very comfortable thanks for letting us stay in your cozy little home away from home.
Perfect place for me

This place is spot on as described. The location is perfect and the place is perfect. The place has everything you need for a stay.  The house has everything needed to cook or order in. The beds and furniture were very comfortable. The tv projector was an amazing touch, great way to unwind. There are restaurants, corner markets, and bars super close. We had everything we needed for our stay.  Look forward to another trip soon!
Loved this sweet apartment. Great location, very homey, reasonable price. We loved our stay!

Our stay was great.  The apartment was very nice and very clean.  Had a little trouble with the door lock into the apartment, it seemed a bit temperamental.  Other than that we couldn't have been happier.

While a nice apartment generally speaking (especially by the looks of the advertisement / listing alone), looks can be a bit deceiving depending on your goal. It must be understood the "host's" approach here is not comfort and a "do as little as possible" to pass muster. The location is for tourists and not that great at all (and noisy on weekends). So, if your goal is stay a week or two and explore NY for vacation (and you don't care about any comfort or quality), then it could be great. But, if your goal is longer range plans and work, I would not recommend this apartment at all.
Honestly would love to have this exact spot everytime I come to be New York if it’s available.

Excelente comunicación con Sandra desde antes de nuestra llegada y muy buena explicación para que el acceso no fuera complicado. Muchas gracias por sus atenciones, por brindarnos amenidades como café, azúcar, agua, jabón, shampoo y acondicionador. Pareciera que todo lo que necesita uno como viajero ellos lo tienen. Dormimos muy agusto. Gracias por activar el calefactor cuando hacia frío y dejarlo encendido por el resto de los días. Son unas personas muy amables.

It was a great stay at Diana’s place.
She is very responsive and her place is accessible by metro and bus.

Kostas' place is in a wonderful location close to shopping, great restaurants, transportation and laundry facilities nearby.  It is warm, cozy and clean with extra linen, kitchen cookware and dishes.  Kostas and his family are always available if you need them.  Parking is difficult to find but it is NY.  I highly recommend public transportation.

Very cute space that has everything you need for a short stay! The duvet was very warm, almost too warm and since the lower bunk bed is right next to the heater, I recommend sleeping on the upper bunk if you tend to get warm. The shower has everything you need and there are two closets. I didn’t love the fact the bathroom was across the hall, but I was alright. Overall, really nice place, location is near Metro so easy access to anywhere else! Koichi is also very responsive so if you have any questions, he most likely answers them within the day!
2nd time in Judy’s place and 2nd time happy with our stay. I will definitely come back and I highly recommend it.

Located in a nice neighborhood. Near metro station made it easy to explore both  Manhattan or Williamsburg. Cee greeted us during check-in and was quite responsive with messages. Place was clean and nicely organized.
This place was perfect for a one night stay! It is close to UBS Arena which was perfect!
Such a cute and very spacious suite. It was in a great location with many local eats and attractions.
Everything was ok. There is everything you need in the apartment,  Good location.
This cute, quaint Brooklyn apartment was perfect for my busy holiday stay. Pervaiz was extremely helpful and communicated very quickly to answer any questions, despite the holiday season!!!

Emily and Saul were checking in on me throughout the entire visit making sure I got settled in and didn’t have any issues with check in. The neighborhood was so nice, had great restaurants and walking to the bridge after dinner was beautiful. If I am traveling through NYC again I will definitely be staying here again!

WiFi wasn’t great it kept cutting out. I couldn’t have a 5 mins video conference call.
Check in and out was easy.
Walls are VERY thin!
The fire alarm was periodically going off, after calling the contact number, they said maintenance was working on it, but there was no notification of this prior to it happening.
My A/C was having issues and I had to call maintenance, they were able to fix it, but didn’t really explain why it was broken.
Overall it wasn’t bad, but it wasn’t amazing either.
Place was clean, perfect location, and Ayana was a thorough host personally ensuring we understood the ins and outs of the space when we arrived. Would book again!

Mo and Dom are amazing hosts! Their place was exactly as described on airbnb and in the pictures. It is affordable, beautiful, and had everything we needed. I went with a couple girlfriends for new years and they made us feel right at home. They were available for any questions I had after I booked and when I got there. They got back to me quickly every time. They told us to help ourselves to anything in their apartment and even left us presents. Their place is close to all the hot spots in Chinatown, LES, Little Italy, and the Williamsburg bridge. It only took us 5-6 subway stops to get to Time Square and Midtown. Very convenient and easy! I would recommend their place to anyone and I will definitely be back anytime I am in the city!
Very warm welcome, great anf friendly people. Amazing experience!
Communication is the key. So easy and perfect place for the trip!

When I walked into Diane's place, I immediately felt like I was "home". It's so homely, so comfortable, and so relaxing.
The neighbourhood is great, too. There's great bars, great music venues, and great restaurants.
And, Diane communicates extremely well. She's so helpful, and she'll always respond.
Carlos's place was very nice and spacious. He was very quick to respond to our questions. His place is a few blocks to Times Square and in a quite neighborhood. We would stay there again.
Great location (well for us anyways), nice and quiet and Maya was very easy to deal with. Keen to check out her other offerings on our next jaunt :)

Bigger and better than the pictures. Close to subway station yet so quiet, and safe neighbourhood. Jerry is easy to reach if needed. Easy check in with detailed instructions. Would definitely go back.
perfect location, near the airport.  bedroom full of details.
Awesome place super friendly area and place highly recommend will be back again very impressed huge thank you

The place was located in  a decent part of Williamsburg, close to multiple stops. A good launching pad for exploring both Brooklyn and Manhattan. Didn't see Paige the entire time I was there but she provided instructions to check-in. Easy to get in and out
Very Clean and Relaxing, I will be coming back.

Le logement était très accueillant, idéalement situé dans un quartier avec plusieurs commerces de proximité.
La propreté des lieux et la réactivité de l’hôte ont fait de mon passage une expérience satisfaisante.
Die Wohnung hat eine prima Lage in Greenpoint und ist sehr gut ausgestattet und bietet ausreichend Platz. Jennifer ist eine freundliche, schnell reagierende Gastgeberin.

This place is worth it! Conveniently located, just right by the Q train. Lots of great food options nearby. I stayed for a month. It was clean and well kept. The apartment has everything you need! Anything you can think of (toiletries, kitchen utensils, laundry items, and more!), this apartment has it. It’s spacious that I was able to open all 3 of my full sized luggages. Building has an elevator which is rare in NYC. The apartment was light filled, bright, and extremely quiet. Hosts were lovely and accessible in case I had questions. The basement laundry only has 1 dryer and 1 washer but I did not have trouble as it was not busy.

Great experience! I felt like at home and loved the clean & private bathroom and bedroom. Both Ines and Chris were friendly and welcoming. Ramen was adorable too! 8 mins walk to the metro Ralph st and a grocery shop nearby. Definitely will stay again if I’d have the chance.
Hosts are amazing and attentive, tons of suggestions for places to go and things to see. Be sure to stop at their coffee shop! Will stay again
Exactly as described. Good for a quick getaway. Very responsive host and super clean.

Denise and her lively young son are friendly, clean and respectful people to live with! Denise is easy and quick communicator. Location is perfect for BronxCare medical students and I would highly recommend other AUC/Ross/SGU students lock this place down!

We had a great stay. Benjamin was very responsive to our questions before and during our stay. It was an easy commute during our stay to wherever we wanted to go, and the space itself was very clean and well-furnished.
Lugar muy cómodo, limpio y cercano al metro (10 minutos caminando). La estadía fue muy buena y la comunicación con Karim fue buena. Recomendable

The apartment was nice and clean, and everything was exactly as advertised. Beautiful neighborhood and right next to the subway. Donny was a sweetheart, and he helped me any way he could. I had a lovely experience and made a new friend. What else could I ask for? ^^

The place was very clean, very close to the Jefferson St metro Station, which gives you acces to the L line. Overall we had a great time at Sharon and Tom's place. They weren't there to receive us, but they were quick to answer all of our questions.
If there's anything we can comment about, is that this is like a basement, more like an appartment in the ground floor, so be prepared to hear the steps from people walking above.

Leisha and Ronald’s place is the perfect, spacious apartment for a trip to NYC. The place is clean, comes with all of the basic needs, is relatively close to two subway entrances and in a beautiful, vibrant neighbourhood. I would absolutely book here again. The hosts are also incredibly responsive and friendly. Thanks for everything!

This stay was great! The location is right by the subway, making it easy to explore the city. The unit itself was spotless and had everything I needed, and both the kitchen and bathroom were well-equipped.
Trey and Tamika were incredibly responsive and helpful. They made check-in and check-out a breeze. I’d definitely stay here again!
Great place, absolutely recommend! Alex was very friendly and helpful, she gave us really nice suggestions of where to go and what to do as tourists in NY. I would definitely stay there again.

This place seemed like a great deal for my travel needs in the city but the apartment did have a very intense cigarette smoke odor that was overpowering. Because of allergies I was unable to stay in this spot however I was able to call the host as soon as I arrived and let him know this would not be a good fit for me and my friend. I requested the booking be canceled so we could find a place quickly that was up to par with what we needed. He took care of it ASAP, and air bnb told me they would issue a full refund as soon as they could.
It was very convenient to stay at Jay's place. He was very quick in responding to my messages and my arrival was very easy. I highly recommand this place!

Our stay at Jess' place was super comfortable. The place is small and would consider it as a studio rather than a 1 bedroom but with the beautiful outdoor space and thoughtful layout of the apt, it was overall a great stay for me and my husband.  The apt is half a block from Bedford Ave L stop and it was near great restaurants. Check-in/out was super easy and Jess was very quick with communication and checked in on us often. It was a great stay!

Joseph is an excellent host and the space is great. It's clean, comfortable, in a great location, and had everything we needed. Joseph is available if you need him, but out of your way if you don't. Highly recommend.

The apartment was perfect for us! Communication with Eyal before we arrived was excellent. Checking in and out was a breeze. The location is great, a short walk to the metro and The Highline! The apartment was immaculate and had everything (and more!) that we needed to have a comfortable stay. The little things, like snacks and a stocked fridge were fantastic. We had a late afternoon flight on our last day and Eyal allowed a later checkout. I would highly recommend staying here!

I almost stayed 3weeks in Ruth house. During staying her house, I feel like my cozy home in my country. Garden view room I stayed 2weeks is too cosy and clean but little bit small room. There are two windows, sunny and quite. Bedding is so comfortable and air-conditioner worked very well. Main St. subway to go to the Manhattan is 15 minutes by walk from Ruth house. Co-host Belly explain how to go to the subway station for me when I arrived Ruth house.
Ruth and co-host Belly is kind for me. Her son is also very kind. If I should travel to NY again, I want to stay Ruth house again.

Miriam is the perfect host - warm, welcoming, and courteous. Beautifully lived in and loved for home, in the best neighbourhood.. central to all we wanted to see and do in NYC!

the arbnb very clean, excellent attention from Carlos, good location in Brooklyn.
Good location and nice rooftop.
We had a great stay. The apartment is in a great location near lots of shops and food. The hosts are friendly, quick to respond, and give great recommendations around the neighborhood.

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour. L’appartement est parfait pour visiter New York. Le rapport qualité prix est nickel. Cela change si vous avez l’habitude de séjourner sur Manhattan. Muy buen lugar para alojarse con la familia. Después que te familiarizas con el trasporte público es fácil movilizarse. Jenny es muy amable. Y facilita tu estadía. gracias
It was a very nice stay I was comfortable
great little place in great location, host was extremely easy to communicate with!
very close to the metro
Very Clean, Very beautiful nice interior , well designed loved the shower. Would stay again . Great area

Aswad is friendly and professional guy good with communication. and helped us check out late , flat was clean and like the pictures ... it had good local spots to check out connections to trains very near a real Brooklyn experience

Our stay at Shai's apartment was great. The apartment itself is spacious and comfortable, and you can sense the care and attention to detail that went into its remodeling. The bathrooms and kitchen are all stand-out -- sparkly clean and with a minimalist aesthetic, yet the kitchen is stocked with everything you'll need. Bedrooms are also nicely decorated and comfortable. The many windows bring a lot of light into the apartment, which is also nice.
The location in Hell's Kitchen is great for proximity to lots of restaurants and bars, there are multiple grocery options nearby, and we were able to walk to work (in Midtown). It's a bit of a walk to the closest subway stations, but that wasn't a major issue for us.
Shai was also very responsive and friendly on the couple of times we had questions or needed help. I would definitely recommend his apartment, and I would welcome the opportunity to stay there again!
Great place! Clean and friendly
The house has everything you need for a comfortable stay, it is clean. we'll be back.

I recommend to everyone who visits NYC to consider Adam's place. It is what makes airbnb great. It was much less expensive than surrounding hotels so that those on a budget can visit this beautiful city. The place was stocked with everything you could need including gourmet coffee and many items like salt, sugar, and others although I just ate out due to the myriad restaurants. There was air conditioning, tv, a desk, a table, nice bathroom including shampoo and even tooth paste as I didn't have any. lol. Adam himself was a nice young man and responded to any of my requests including needed ice trays. Great place, great location, great host. All airbnb's should use this place as a model. (Oh yeah it is in Brooklyn which is really artistic, but it is easy to get to manhattan by subway two blocks away. Buy the week pass for 34 dollars as you'll spend double that if you buy single passes)

Verny nice clean place, I keep coming back every time I travel to NY for work. Very responsive and accommodating owners.
Thank you

This was our second time staying with Michelle and it was just as wonderful as the first. Spotless bedroo. and shared bath, easy checkin and check out, and thoughful snacks in the room. Looking forward to staying again.

I had a quick one night stay in Erica’s apartment, and she made me feel right at home. It’s cozy and clean and located right in the heart of Williamsburg. Erica is a gracious host. Would happily stay there again.

A perfect airbnb experience!

Todo bien, la pieza limpia, el baño siempre limpio, la cocina igual. Ningún problema con eso. Pero no sabíamos que había otra pieza que se arrendaba y llegó una pareja que metía ruido hasta las 3 de la mañana y obviamente no era agradable al dormir.

We had a great stay at Assiatis and Tonderais Airbnb. The apartment is located closely to the metro station. The owners are very friendly and answer promptly on messages. Checkin was very easy. The apartment is big and very clean. We will definitely recommend!!!

Terrance thanks for hosting us on our recent trip to New York, I cannot think of anything more you could have done as a host to make us feel at home . I wanted to be in a local neighborhood . The police were also very polite and friendly my wife and I made a point to speak to them when every we pass them on the street. We love the fact that there was so many shops and restaurants close by. When ever we come back to New York, we will be back to stay there. My wife send a special thanks she said she felt very safe staying there .
Great, cozy apartment in beautiful Bed Stuy. Extremely close to transit, restaurants and shops. Safe and comfortable location.
Nice apartment with good security in an awesome location. Paola, the hostess, is cool.
Stylish, tidy place in a great location!
Estadía de 8 adultos 2 niños de Colombia, la ubicación del apartamento es inmejorable, todo es cerca, el host es muy amable y servicial, todo muy limpio, un poco ruidoso, pero así es NY.

Hôte tres accueillante, tres souriante, tres chaleureux. L appartement est facile d acces et decrit comme dans l annonce. Literie tres confortable et tout a disposition. J y retournerais sans hesitation

Everything about this place was amazing. Incredibly clean. Bright. Comfortable. Heated floor in the bathroom. Full-kitchen. Heaters in every room. Looking forward to booking again in the future! Oh yes, we will be back!

Accès facile, instructions clair. Il faut arriver pas trop tard pour s’assurer d’avoir de la place dans la rue pour se parker. Great apartment in a nice area!

Apartment is exactly like the pictures. Great location, comfortable and well furnished.

Ebony was a great host. She is always standby to support guests. She even dropped me to the station. I will come back again and recommend others to stay with her.
I had a great time at Jude’s place. Public transportation near by. Modern space with a Huge TV. Plus, It’s very clean and cozy. I’d definitely stay here again!
Uno de los mejores lugares en los que he estado, no tengo queja alguna Yvonne fue muy bien anfitriona siempre amigable y servicial, volveremos definitivamente
perfect spot to start exploring new York. great price 👍🏾
Our stay at Dan's place was great. It's a great location and very spacious compared to other NYC Airbnbs we have stayed at in the past.

Maribel es una Host Espectacular, ella esta atenta a cada uno de los detalles. El departamento es una preciosura, todo en su sitio, todo prolijo, todo funciona. en fin cada detalle the hace sentir seguro y que nada te falta. Gracias Maribel por tu tiempo y dedicacion!!!
I had a very good experience during my stay. This is a clean and quite apartment and location is aweosome. Close to subway and tons of stores, restaurants ... around.  Thank you Daniel!

Carol Ann and George jumped in with suggestions as soon as they saw she might be uncomfortable sleeping on a separate floor from us and had all the bedding and resources needed to accommodate us. We also loved having the kitchen downstairs for breakfast and coffee and the hosts even had breakfast food stocked for us! Wow! I couldn’t recommend this airb&b any higher for anyone looking for an affordable, roomy, homey, convenient place to stay while visiting NYC! Carol Ann and George were amazing hosts.
Most amazing stay in New York by far. As someone whose stayed at Waldorf and the Plaza I will go to Park Lane every time
Everything was perfect. The place is very clean and smells good. Great location in Brooklyn with a train to Manhattan a few blocks away.

Nicolas was super communicative and helpful, the place was perfect for my needs
Meine beste Freundin und ich waren zwei Wochen bei Rahul - es war alles top und wir können uns über nichts beschweren! Wir würden jederzeit wiederkommen!

Loved staying at Rosy’s. She’s a great host.

Un accueil parfait !

Seul petit hic pour les sensibles au bruit, cette chambre donne sur la rue....mais rien de bien méchant.

This was exactly what we were looking for during our month long stay in NY. Kyle's place is spacious, tidy, and charming with nice natural light and a good office space to work from. Kyle was very responsive and provided everything needed for a comfortable stay. Highly recommend!
Thank you for a wonderful stay, Angelica! The room was exactly as described. Very spacious and lovely.

Emmanuel is very kind and attentive. The location is fantastic! Close to the Long Island Railroad plus lots of great restaurants and cafes.

2 arrêts de métro à 10 et 5 minutes à pieds pour rejoindre Manhattan.

Great location to explore NYC

This was the perfect place for our vacation since our focus was spending a good amount of time at the Museum of Natural History which was right across the street!
Wendell's a lovely and well-spoken host. I slept soundly in a remarkably comfortable bed. I would definitely recommend this as a great place to stay.

Nice stay! Good position, quiet neighborhood, everything is clean and tidy.
Great apartment in new york. Most everything is perfect but a little bit hard to carry luggage to upstairs.

Great place to stay over. Very close to JFK and easy to reach. The place was super clean and all basic amenities were readily available. The bathroom was also very clean.

This was my second time staying with Alicia and her family and it was perfect. The communication was easy and clear. The room was comfortable and cozy and the view of the George Washington Bridge was fantastic. A truly great experience!!! I'll be back.

Charles was understanding.

El hospedaje de Sammy está bien ubicado, cerca del metro y es seguro para caminar en la noche, muy aseado y tiene todas las comodidades que necesitas para ir de paseo a New York, gracias Sammy por todo
Good place to stay in Brooklyn, Caroline is friendly and kind.
Our stay was amazing! We were so happy with the kindness, cleanliness, and easiness of the stay. Recommend always!

Very cozy apt in a beautiful and quiet neighbourhood. Demi was a very good host and we had a wonderful time in Prospect Heights. We almost felt like we were actually living in Brooklyn, but we were still only a relatively short subway ride away from the hazzle-dazzle of downtown manhattan.
Andrada was a responsive and thoughtful host.  The bedroom and bathroom were very clean.  The decor was lovely.
Lovely place!! Just what we were looking for. Had everything we needed, prime location to spend New Years!! Thanks Anayah!
Great stay, hosts were very welcoming.

Clean and nice apartment.  We stayed more than a month and really feel like stayed at home. Perfect location with less than 10 mins walk to Time Square, down stair right next to a subway station. Todo muy bueno, el Depto es como lo muestran, y los encargados siempre en comunicación para resolver los problemas, la ubicación es perfecta a dos cuadras de Time Square, lo único q no me gustó fue q el apartamento está dividido de otro apartamento por una puerta, q está trabada pero se escuchaba absolutamente todo del vecino, el resto todo perfecto

Spent a few days in Midtown and the Alex’s property was the perfect home base for myself, my family and friends! Very clean and had everything we needed for the trip. If I ever find myself in Manhattan again, I would 100% want to stay here again!

Anatha et Jean-Paul vous reçoivent comme si vous étiez des amis. Nous avons apprécié leur  hospitalité et leurs bons conseils (en français!). L'appartement, très confortable, est située dans une maison magnifique au cœur d'Harlem. La terrasse sur le toit est particulièrement agréable! Merci!

Appartement impeccable ! C'est spacieux, lumineux et bien décoré, très agréable ! Très bonne literie. Nous étions une famille de 5 et vraiment bien installés. Excelente lugar para quedarse, muy lindo, limpísimo y cómodo, realmente Andrada se preocupa porque tengas una muy buena estancia y hacerte sentir muy bien, piensa en todos los detalles y tiene muy buen gusto para la decoración. Great place exactly as pictures located 2 block from Beford/Nostrand on the G line easy in and out of Manhattan every day and easy access to JFK on the A train. 5 stars would definitely return

great room and perfect location
Great value for a lovely private dwelling. Great local restaurants and cute decor. Amy was very communicative and responsive. Lovely time!!

if youre looking for a small stay or a long one this is the place to stay. it feels right at home and the streets felt safe at night. A perfect stay for 1-2 people! everything in the description is accurate and very well done. I would come back every year if I could!

The weather was quite cold when I visited, but I found the indoor heating and blanket provided more than enough warmth at night. I would happily rebook this room the next time I'm visiting New York City!
Amazing place! Neat and clean! Super comfortable!

Todo muy bien, facil transporte hacia ny, Jason estuvo muy pendiente de nuestra estadia e hizo un mapa de sitios de interés para nosotros, el apartamento es muy bonito y comodo. Mil gracias. Muy recomendado!!!

At the last moment, my plans changed and wasn't able to make the trip.  However, my daughter stepped in a accompanied her brother on this trip.  They found everything to be just as advertised. You have a mutual respect of each other and their belongings noise etc. This is in Harlem. It can be loud and chaotic outside. I always felt safe in the building. The building is actually very quiet. I stayed during the summertime so the AC box drowned out nearly all the sound. In the winter you would need some sort of white noise with the sounds of Harlem. It’d a few blocks away from the subway. 6 blocks from Whole Foods. The reason I gave it a 4. Is because yes the building is an old brownstone I get that. But, I wish the appliances were updated. The microwave was very small and old. You can get a nice new large microwave for 50 bucks. Same with fridge and stove and some of the furniture. A couple hundred bucks spent at ikea would go a long way here. This is a 5th floor walk up, embrace the work out.
Loved the apartment and the location. Hosts are responsive and kind. Good place to stay.
Amazing Host!!! She was very nice. Place as described. Will visit again
Very nice location. Was worth the price great deal!
perfect place to stay after running around the city all day. super clean, peaceful and relaxing. great area.

Great experience. Location can’t be beat. Close to the action of Atlantic Ave, quick walk to all the shops and restaurants on Montague. Everything from grocery stores, to subway, to restaurants and retail was very accessible.  The apartment itself…just off a refresh.Everything appeared brand new. Kitchen was well stocked with high end cookware and supplies. Bed was comfortable, furnishings were very nice.  Henry Street is relatively quiet, but with the apartment on the courtyard side, not street side, it is even quieter. Courtyard trees in bloom were an additional treat. Management company was great. Check in was a breeze and being able to use our phones for access was very easy.  We had two minor maintenance issues that needed attention. Both happened after hours. We texted our need and both times the issue was fixed the next morning. Things to know………it’s New York. Second floor walk up is 37 stairs. Bedroom layout with step requires some agility. We loved it and will stay again.

muy buen alojamiento muy bonito lugar
recomendable

If you’re looking for a home away from home while in NYC, this is it. A respite from the energy of the city, Travis’s place was comforting, warm, and a peaceful place to stay.! More than enough space for 2 people or a couple to share, it had all the amenities and feels of being in your own home.
We will definitely check here first the next time we’re in NYC - which is saying a lot for me because prior to my stay here, I was usually more of a hotel stayer. Travis put a lot of thought into every detail, amd it shows! He’s made a convert out of me.
My faborite features; the hested bathroom floors, the kitchen and island area, and the diffuser attachemnt for the blow dryer - a MUST for curly girls like me, and often overlooked in many hotels. … its the little things that make a difference.

This place is wonderful! As advertised, easy access to public transit and anything else you could need. The apartment itself was perfect and well-kept. Jillian was easily accessible, and prompt in her responses. Clear instructions for check-in and check-out. I would highly recommend.

We had a wonderful stay at Rochel's place. There were 5 of us, and there was lots of room for all of us to relax. Everything was exactly as described, it's stylishly decorated, and everything was spotlessly clean. The beds and pillows were very comfortable, and the whole space is warm and cosy. The lounge area downstairs is perfect for relaxing after a long day of sightseeing and walking,  and we loved having a selection of classic games to play. The kitchen was well stocked (always appreciate having the basics - oil, vinegar, salt, pepper and spices!) and the laundry room was also appreciated. It's an easy walk from two subway lines, so no trouble if you want to go in to Manhattan, or explore Brooklyn. Slightly longer, but a very easy half hour walk to Prospect Park and the Brooklyn Museum (which is always worth a visit). Rochel was super responsive to a couple of questions we had, and an absolute pleasure to deal with. If I return to NYC with a group, I would love to stay again!

Over the past 4 years I spent at least 1 month every summer at NYC to work and Freda's apartment was one of the best ones. The location is great, wholefoods at the same block, only 5 min walk to subway station, and all 2nd avenue restaurants. The apartment itself is renovated and clean and unlike other places that I stayed before, it has a very good AC for summer time. Freda is very friendly and she responses your massages promptly if you need anything. I will definitely stay again.
Thank you Freda.
Amanda's stay was great she even had let us check in early , it was very private and peaceful i would definitely stay here again when i come back in a few months !
Great room, great location. This is what you want an Airbnb experience to be. Meela was super responsive and everything was as described. No complaints here.
Amazing deal for a place to just sleep and just a 15 minute walk to the train for the main city. Very nice and responsive host. Convenient and cheap if you want a place near JFK.
Great little place to stay when traveling to NYC! Definitely recommend
I thoroughly enjoyed my stay. Chi and his wife were super friendly and the apartment was absolutely spotless. Amazing hospitality and very nice room, I would recommend this booking to everyone.
If deciding between another Airbnb and this one, choose this one. The host has thought of everything you might need. Place looks better than the photos and is worth it cost.
Stephanie’s apartment worked well for our needs! Would recommend for anyone visiting Park Slope/South Brooklyn.

I really enjoyed my stay in this lovely bachlor basement. I felt very safe and we managed to park our vehicle right outside the door. It came with everything plus more (towels, plates, etc). Although I never met Mark he left a folder with places to eat and shop. I would definitely stay here again! The only downfall about staying here was the distance from downtown manhattan. The cab ride was approx $40 one way including a toll for the tunnel.

Liqin's place was clean and comfortable. Her communication and instruction were prompt and smooth. The place was clean, conveniently located, and has everything for my short term stay. This was a good find in the heart of Flushing. I highly recommend it!
Responsive, helpful, and kind hosts! The stay is exactly as described and shown, and it was a good space to come back to after long days in Manhattan & Brooklyn.
Very clean and in a great location

We had a great stay at The Box House with great hospitality shown by all of the staff. We used the car several times on the rainy days to get us to the train and a neighborhood restaurant which was quite handy. The room was comfortable and exactly as anticipated based on the pictures. Most importantly the manager helped us to get the room in a day when a place we had originally rented cancelled on us a day before our arrival. It was a great experience.

It was such a pleasure staying at Annkellie's airbnb. I HONESTLY canNOT find anything bad to say! I had no reason whats so ever to contact the host for anything, the directions were spot on,if you can't understand instructions that's on you but her information was spot on. The place smelled amazing, the place was very very clean and peaceful. Annkellie was very kind and flexible and accommodated to my needs on such short notice. I loved that in the room there was extra blankets, a portable heater next to the bed, Netflix, a table and 2 chairs where you can get work done and also eat. I also love the huge mirror and those cute reminders on the wall was chefs kiss! its the small details, the bed was very comfy and i slept like a baby, i dont even know if it had other people there or not. If you love Hot water baby it could be a sauna if you want it to be! I would DEFINITELY recommend staying there it was worth the price, comfortable and felt like home. I would absolutely stay there again
Very comfortable, private space. Easy in and out.
Loved it! So close to restaurants and the Metro.

This was a great long term stay. The place is cozy and had everything I needed. It is also close to everything so it was perfect. Francine was also an AMAZING host and made me feel right at home. I would highly recommend this stay!!

Our family had a very nice experience in Colin’s house and he was in touch with us throughout the weekend making sure that all was going well. The house is neat and spacious with adequate parking space.  I hope to stay there again when I am back in Queens.
Dan is a great and relaxed guy who makes you feel at home. We were happy to stay at his place.
Highly recommend this apartment. It’s clean, quiet, and ideally located. Near lots of great restaurants and cafés in a calm convivial neighborhood. Brandon was the perfect host.

Jose’s place is perfect.
Exactly as advertised.
Really great communication and value.

La casa è come da foto, la zona noi l'abbiamo trovata autentica, la vera vita neworkese, abbiamo adorato il quartiere. La metropolitana a pochi passi, in 20 minuti si arriva a Manhattan. Casa tranquilla,pulita, ha un grande potenziale, credo che Zenobia stia provvedendo ai piccoli deficit che ci sono ma che non compromettono il soggiorno (tipo il soffitto non completamente isolato, qualche crepa che andrebbe ripristinata). Un piccolo giardino dove poter fare colazione in tutta tranquillità,doccia funzionale, corredata di saponi. Insomma un posto ideale per visitare NY. Zenobia si è mostrata davvero molto disponibile e ospitale, ci ha fatto sentire a casa. Consiglio la soluzione assolutamente. Grazie Zenobia.

One of the best Airbnb experiences that i’ve had. Everything was as said in the description and Naomi was a great host, the most thoughtful I’ve experienced. If I ever return to the area I would book with her again.

A great stay! 3 of my friends and I were only in the city for a night and this was a perfect stay. Petra was very sweet, responsive, helpful and friendly! Had a bit of a hard time finding parking in the area but other than that everything went smoothly!
Very great place to stay in New York. I stayed a week there and Valentine is really cool and available for cool advices on New York ;) I trully recommand it
Epic house! Loved it

Mo’s place was spectacular! My boyfriend and I spent the weekend there and we felt right at home. The place was super clean and had everything you would need. Mo was also super responsive and a great hostess. Thank you so much!

We stayed at Danielle’s for 5 nights in December. House was clean and warm. Check in was 4pm but the house wasn’t ready in time and we were given the wrong code to get into the house, but luckily someone was there to let us in. The house is very old and quirky, needs some light repairs, our biggest concern was the stairs (as they are uneven at the bottom). It’s missing a microwave and some kitchen essentials like cooking oil and pepper. Other than that, it was a good stay.
Wendy is very hands-off, yet attentive. It's a great location and also quite comfortable.

Yolanda y Francisco unos excelentes anfitriones, siempre estaban dispuesto a ayudar o responder cualquier consulta, todo era como lo detallado, un bonito barrio en un sector muy tranquilo muy cerca de la estación del metro con llegada directa a manhattan.
Muy recomendado volvería a hospedarme ahi.

Den was a perfect host with his house. He gave us a lot of amenities and also snacks to welcome us. In the house you have everything you need. A plus for the tv and the big bed. It is a little bit far from Nyc but you already know it before booking.
Would recommend it to everyone and would stay here again.
Thank you Den!

Top position. Apartment with a fantastic view of Central Park. Large bedroom and living. Modern bathroom with large shower.
Will return

Amazing stay from start to finish. Anthony was very accommodating and patient. Check-in as well as check-out were simple. By far the best experience I've had with AirBnB. Everything is as pictured. Highly recommend his AirBnB experience.

La casa de Kathleen es preciosa - de un cuento de hadas y Kathleen es un encanto. Somos cuatro de familia, con dos adolescentes. Las dos grandes camas de matrimonio eran super cómodos, y nuestros hijos les encantaron tener que subir las escaleras y dormir arriba. Hacía mucha calor en la calle, pero el aire acondicionado y el ventilador de techo hacía que la casa siempre estaba perfecta. Y tenía todas las comodidades y mas - toallas, sabanas, galletas, banana cake, cafetera, jabón etc, etc, etc.
Coger la Staten Island Ferry a Manhattan era una experiencia inolvidable y preciosa. Nosotros tuvimos un coche alquilado, y lo usamos para llegar a la ferry, que es unos 30 minutos de distancia en coche y así nos fue genial, aunque tener cuidado donde aparcáis en USA si decidáis aparcar en la calle -
multan sin piedad por aparcar enfrente del toma de agua de los bomberos. También hay autobús y tren al ferry desde la casa de Kathleen, pero no lo usamos.
Entre ir al Museo de Historia Natural y el Metropolitan - ir al Metropolitan. Es un museo increíble. Pensabamos que era de Arte (de lo cual no entendemos) sin embargo tiene tanta cosas interesantes de Egipto, Grecia, los Romanos, etc! Fuimos dos días, y nuestros hijos con 16 años estuvimos encantados - igualmente con el Guggenheim.
Volveremos en cuanto podamos.

A very cute quaint space! Very close to Central Park, and an easy 10 minute walk to the subway station. It was very clean, and very easy to navigate check in. I would recommend this space to anyone staying in NYC :)
Don’t hesitate to book it’s worth the money and definitely one of the cleanest air bnb’s out there

We were informed on the check-in day that the place wouldn't be ready until 5 pm and therefore had to reschedule our plans for the evening. After checking in, we noticed that the bedsheets, pillows and blankets were noticably dirty (with some hair). The place wasn't properly cleaned even though we were made to wait for the check-in. The place needs a lot of maintenance. The windows in the bedroom and the living room were sealed off using duct tape, and there was wind sneaking in thru the unsealed parts, that made the rooms cold. They provide very thin blankets, and when we asked for extra blankets, the host denied (even though the listing said they provide extra blankets).
We had a great stay at Edna and Isaiah’s home!

Return visitor. Lovely place to stay in Brooklyn with the nicest hosts. Everything you would want in an Airbnb. Exactly as described. Very accommodating hosts and just a wonderful experience. Close to everything that Brooklyn has to offer and perfect location near subways and the LIRR. Thanks again Allen and Ann!
Very nice place to stay !

This is a long awaited opportunity for this neighborhood that is located in the heart of what has made Manhattan memorable. The apartment is as pictured and comfortable and I look forward to returning.
Beautiful space and view.
Cozy place in a great location! Easy walk to Grand Central, Empire State Building, and the ferry. Tons of places to eat. AnnaMarie is a fantastic host. Would definitely book this listing again!

Accurate description of what you get! Extremely clean and comfortable Appartment and lovely area to stay with kids! If you are looking to stay out of Manhattan and have kids this  is definitely a place to consider!! We had a great stay
Tanesha was a wonderful host. Very good communication. Apartment is so cute and fun. We had a very good stay. 10 out of 10! 😃♥️

El alojó tenia muy buenas referencias, pero siento qué tal vez no fue buena fecha para ir. Will estaba ocupado, nos hizo esperar en el check in, hubo problemas con el baño por huéspedes pasados al parecer, Will salió corriendo detrás de nosotros por las llaves cuando aún no hacíamos el check out. Me termine sintiendo incomodo y pasado a llevar . No fue una grata experiencia y un baño para hartas personas no es suficiente.

Camille is very helpful with prompt responses before our trip, which is nice. The apartment is lovely in a quite neighborhood in Brooklyn.
As this is our first time to New York, travelling to Manhanttan is our daily schedule, which is a bit far if we are travelling to mid or uptown which is the downside. However, there is easy access to the Q train, which makes the long commute easier.

I had a great week in NYC even through my trip was only supposed to last a few days and was unexpectedly extended due to Hurricane Sandy. I absolutely LOVED staying at Michael's place, he was such a gracious and generous host. The location was ideal - just around the corner from the subway, right in the heart of Harlem with plenty of great shops and surrounded by little hidden gems like: Chocolate (amazing brunch on Sundays), Mocha Lounge, Bake My Cake bakery and many more. Staying at this place and in Harlem is the way to see the REAL NYC. The apartment was very clean and comfortable and safe and the shower was amazing!! I never got bored or felt unsafe walking the neighborhood and in fact walked home many days from my outings as there seemed to be something of interest around nearly every corner of the city. I would love to come back to NYC and would certainly check to see if this apartment is available for rent ahead of anything else. You will not be disappointed staying here for such a great price. Thank you Michael!!

Catia's place is perfect for a couple who want to really feel like they are living in the city, even if just for a few days! Easy to get to by subway, super-clean and charming -- full of delightful decor. Catia was very welcoming and sent useful information well in advance. She was also available for any questions throughout our stay. A great host! The location is really good for getting to all parts of the city, and there are lovely green spaces just a few blocks away. Can't wait to come back!

I used to live in Astoria, so finding a place so close to my old haunts was a big plus. And Astoria is just so convenient to the rest of the city. This location didn't disappoint. Easy ride from LGA, quick walk to the subway. The street was charming. The night was quiet. Thoroughly enjoyed it!
The host is very hospitable and very quick to response.
Great place, great host, and great location!

It was a perfect stay!
Maria was very helpful, attentive and the place suited all of our needs during our stay. I woudk highly reccomend Thai location!
Private. Comfortable. Clean. Accessible and not far from Manhattan or the airport!

Wanlys place is perfect for a quick stay if you’re passing through. Clean place, 420 friendly. Basic amenities for a short stay. Minute walk to the train at the end of the 3 line. Areas not as bad as people make it out to be.

The apartment has a great feel--interesting artwork and comfortable beds and furniture.  It requires climbing stairs, but we didn't find that an obstacle.  Iradj was a great host and helped us get our luggage up to the apartment.  When we noticed problems with the cable box and TV he took care of it promptly.  We would definitely stay here again.

Devin thank you so much for the price and such a great/beautiful condo! I hope one day to return and stay there again! I can’t thank you enough for your hospitality and quick response. I encourage anyone to stay there if you want a true experience of the views.

Extremely stress free experience. Literally no issues whatsoever. After spending an entire day out in NYC, tired and beaten, I was looking forward to getting back here! Tash is a great host and the place was spectacular.

What you can expect at Mins’ place is a comfy, homey, beautiful apartment that is in the city of manhattan. It’s quaint, cozy, clean, relaxing, and Min is the perfect host! I kept bothering Min because I had questions but she never took it as a bother and was always so kind to help. There’s any shop you can think of right around the corner or just a train away. Times square and downtown NYC is just a 25 min train ride. Min makes you feel at ease if you’re new to the city, because she has the best hospitality you’ll see in NY! Min, thank you so much for having me and sharing your space. I’d love to come back again!

We really enjoyed our stay at Esteban's place. Esteban is a great host, the place is very clean and the room was great. It's around 5mins away from subway, the neighbourhood felt safe even at 2am. We could check-in early in the morning instead of the afternoon, and Esteban offered we stay after the check-out hours because our flight was in the afternoon. I have only great things to say about our stay at Esteban’s place.

I participated in a 5-week long program in NYC this past summer (June-July 2025). Nat's place was a perfect place to stay. The air conditioning unit was a life saver from the crazy hot and humid days. Arrival was easy, directions were clear, and the unit was cleanly. The bathroom situation is not ideal but there is a female restroom that you have to open with a key, which helped keep it clean. There seemed to be mostly males living in the complex so the male bathroom was not very clean (or at least up to my personal cleanliness standards). Sometimes I would have to resort to using the male bathroom if the female bathroom was being used. lt was convenient to have a laundry facility in the building too and the app made it easy to use. I would just suggest they clean the washing machines more regularly to avoid mold growth. The neighbors were mostly quiet. There were a few nights during my stay where the neighbors were being a little loud but I wear earplugs to bed so it didn't bother me.

Really beautiful and cozy space in a great spot. Lovely views and lots of stuff to do right nearby. Convenient check in and out. Sadly the terrace was closed due to rain which was what I was looking forward to most. Wish we had access to it anyway, or at least a part of it. Otherwise it was great!
Great location, easy to access. Aspano is incredibly responsive and was very helpful during our stay.
Great spot in Flushing. Very walkable to the train station to get into Manhattan. Great spot for those who don’t want to break the bank, but still visit NYC.

You'll get a place appropriate for the price.The host was nice and always available, check-in was easy, but I tried to stay there as little as possible...  In the hall there was this kind of smell you can't clean away, we found two bugs one day, and the upper bed was annoyingly loud, also one of the two mattresses was very bumpy.

I sent the host a message prior to check in and didn’t receive a reply (red flag). Upon arrival we were greeted by an employee at the front desk. He offered us a “better” room. When we arrived to room the windows were dirty and the lamp didn’t work. We attempted to call the front desk but the phone wasn’t working. We immediately went down to the front desk to inform hotel staff. Unfortunately, we were told there was nothing they could do, as he was the only worker on site tonight and housing keeping couldn’t “check” the room. Therefore, the room couldn’t be resold tonight. It was almost 9pm and I doubt they were fully booked but we didn’t make a fuss. I messaged the host and never received a response. We went out later on and came back to find the heat didn’t work. A worker had to come fix it 3 times. An associate offered extra blankets instead of a different room initially. Overall, the hotel was filthy, the host was non responsive, & the hotel staff wasn’t great. DO NOT BOOK
Alice is an amazing host! She is always responsive and very friendly and helpful! I will be recommending this place to many friends and will book it again!
Everything was fine, I recommend it and it was in a good location everything was close to the place. La guardia airport is the closest. But overall great airbnb.
This spot was perfect for what we needed. Small, but much better than a hotel. Duane shared very helpful information to help us plan our visit. Wish we could have spent more time there :)

We had an excellent experience staying at this hotel near Times Square and Broadway. I was traveling with my children, and everything about our stay exceeded expectations. The hotel was exceptionally clean, the staff were friendly, professional, and always helpful, and the overall atmosphere was welcoming and safe.
One of the highlights was the rooftop—absolutely magnificent! After long days exploring the city, it was such a treat to unwind there with a drink while taking in the stunning views of the skyline.
The location is perfect—just steps away from Broadway shows, close to restaurants, and incredibly convenient to subways and buses. Whether you're sightseeing, shopping, or catching a show, this hotel puts you right in the heart of it all.
I highly recommend this hotel to anyone visiting New York City, especially families. We’ll definitely stay here again the next time we're in town!

Moying was the sweetest host, really warm, communicative, and thoughtful! Loved the space too—mere blocks from good food, shopping, and sights downtown, and a few minutes walk from multiple subway stations. Great for a quick getaway to the city
Enjoyed staying in this cozy space! The kitchen was what I needed for easy at-home cooking. Plenty of accommodations. I would definitely stay again!

Great location and price. Towels need to be replaced. The twin bed isn’t an actual bed. It’s a fold out with a 4 inch foam topper. Still comfortable, but not what was expected. Place could use a deep clean in hard to reach areas. If you have food, be sure to put it in a hard container or the fridge or you will be sharing it with the rats.
Karen's place was very clean, comfortable, cozy, and private. I highly recommend it!
It was a great place to stay, host was very responsive! 10/10
Clean and exactly what's required

Jewel is a very good person, very communicative and welcoming. We felt respect of privacy, everything you need is available, she even decorated the room with x'mas tree shining in the dining room, even though she didn't spent xmas at home. A lot of suggestions about NY are quite helpful.
미드타운 명소가 가깝고 버스이동 편해요. 이동거리가 적어서 뉴욕여행이 좋았습니다. 안전한 지역이라 아이들과도 좋았어요. 호스트 부부가 정말 친절하고 안내 잘받았습니다. 조용한 숙소. 정원에 나무 정말좋았어요. 숙소시설이 잘갖춰져있어 4인가족 정말좋았어요. 뉴욕 다시온다면 또 이용하고 싶은마음 100프로입니다. 나이스한 숙소.
Loved everything about it! My mom was able to early check in with ease, and her room was available a few hours before the check in time! So so awesome and everyone is sweet.
Nice place! A little older than I expected, but still very nice host and clean space.
By far one of the nicest airbnbs we’ve stayed in and very cozy, would highly suggest to anyone
Stella was very helpful and communicative. I enjoyed the room and experience overall would definitely come back and stay here my next time being in NYC!
Great place to stay! Definitely recommend!

Alexandre's apartment is very stylish and comfortable. In the kitchen there are all the necessary tools. All the rooms were very clean. Metro station is very close. We would highly recommend staying at Alexandre's place.
Christine’s place is very comfortable and cozy & she makes sure you have your privacy. She is a very responsive & sweet person .
Alex place was in a nice location with walking distance to train station. Very responsive and easy to find. Would stay again in the future.

My partner and I had an amazing stay at Soon’s place. They both are so friendly and helpful with lots of recommendations. The location is awesome, so close to the subway and the subway line there takes you about anywhere.
We felt right at home and had so much fun talking to Soon and his wife about our day every night! Thank you ☺️
Herman is very friendly, an excellent host. This is my 3rd time here. Five stars rating
I stayed at Nia’s place for a month and it was perfect for what I needed! Really easy commute into the city, lots of great spots to check out really close by! The space itself was always very clean.

Tak til Michael - for en dejlig uge i Harlem.
Alt fungerede så fint. Vi ændrede datoer i sidste øjeblik, uden problemer og ekstra omkostninger og vi fik den fineste modtagelse, selvom flyet var forsinket og vi ankom sent om natten. Køle- og køkken-skabe var fyldt med drikkevarer, frugt og madvarer :-) Boligen var som billederne og passede fint til 3 personer. Vi havde stor glæde af terrassen - efter lange dage i larm og mylder i byen, kunne vi her nyde ro, fuglefløjt og åben himmel. Alt i alt en velfungerende og imødekommende bolig. Nabolaget er venligt, med masser af gode restauranter og musiksteder. Vores kontakt til Michael, også ved afgang, fungerede helt ukompliceret og meget fleksibelt. Vi vender tilbage - de bedste hilsner Mette
Loved it. Will be back.

Great location and beautiful space!! It was awesome that we could travel with two pups to NYC and feel so comfortable. The space is in a great location and is within close proximity to Fort Greene Park (bring your dogs before 9 AM so they can run off leash!), bars, restaurants, and shopping!

Le studio est conforme à l’annonce. Idéalement placé pour un séjour à New-York; quartier très sympa et proche de tous les transports.
Il y a deux toilettes sur le palier donc très pratique. Le studio est confortable et la cuisine pratique, nous avons adoré!
Pensez juste bien aux boules quiès, la ville est bruyante.
Je recommande ce logement pour un séjour à New York!
Sharon is a nice person. She would like to help if you could let her know your questions or problems earlier.

I would really like to thank Kishorie and her family for welcoming us into their  beautiful home. She was extremely warm and helpful. She gave us a quick tour and gave us the keys. The private studio is exactly as described, provided us with extra toiletries, additional sheets, coffee, water, wifi, tv, takeout menus, etc... We throughly enjoyed our stay do plan on revisiting.  Thanks again!

Excelente costo - beneficio. A unas 3 cuadras de todas las tiendas de time square. Cerca de estaciones del subway para moverte a otras partes de la ciudad. Es fácil de llegar del aeropuerto al hotel en el subway. Incluye el desayuno lo cual te ahorra al menos unos 25 dólares diarios por persona y tiempo en la mañanas para salir a conocer la ciudad.
Ubicación, desayuno y costo.
Nice bath towels.  Ac was not in operation.  Get WiFi password from host when you check in
The bed is comfortable, bathroom and terrace are excellent. Location is incredible.
Unit was well kept and close to transportation.  Parking was pretty good as well.  The unit is brand new and clean.

Very clean smell very good love the location
You won’t be disappointed

Location, Location, Location! This is the place to truly enjoy NYC. We were battling between this gem and 2 (adjoining) hotel rooms for 2 kids (10 & 15) and 2 adults. Everything was either more expensive or no availability to our adjoining rooms and locality criteria.
It was easy to get around mid-town, downtown, Flatiron district, uptown (central park), Chelsea - all on foot. Yes, we loved walking everywhere and this gem made it so easy. The place is 30 sec walk from K-town street and few minutes from Time Square. Food is everywhere around this place.
Although the views from the bedroom are stunning, we mostly use the apartment to crash and breakfast (which was take out from local deli and coffee place). We wanted to live like locals in middle of NYC and this place was spot on to make it happen.
