All amenities were perfect as described, laundry was easy to use and it was super peaceful inside the apartment.
Yes there are other options nearby but this one worked for us best.

Die Lage ist fantastisch, Wohnung und Bad sind nett, aber winzig und wir waren nur zum schlafen da. Leider haben wir wegen des Lärms von der Straße und den Klimaanlagen auf der Terrasse nur wenig Schlaf gefunden. Die Fenster lassen sich nicht öffnen und die Heizung kann nicht reguliert werden -, Klimaanlage haben wir nicht genutzt. Wir haben es  als sehr authentisch erlebt 😊
Overall, the transportation is convenient and fairly clean.

Becky's place is FABULOUS - great location, super host, very responsive. We love that it is close to Franklin Avenue and sub stop, restaurants, etc. Had a great time staying at Becky's while visiting our son in Brooklyn, would love to stay again next time we come to visit.

Great stay!
Brigitte is super kind and takes great care of you.
The apartment is spacious and comfy. The bed is comfortable and the bathroom and kitchen are great too.
The area is quiet and very close to the park and to a couple of subway stations.
Would totally come back.
Cute, clean place! Paula and her husband are hospitable and super helpful. Will visit again next time in New York.

Overall, my stay was great and served what I needed. The bed was a little small for me (I'm almost 6 ft) and the area was so so for me being a little far, but your mileage will vary.  Other than that, Steve was a fantastic host and that really matters: to know I can count on my host. Always there to take care of any of my needs and was extremely kind to me.

Great stay and very conveniently placed 2 blocks from the subway. Walkable to a few restaurants and McDonald’s as well. Stanley was very friendly and helpful with check-in and willing to let us drop our stuff off early the day of our check in, so we could make the most of our trip and not carry our bags around. Definitely recommend staying here and hope to be back in the future.

What a great find! Negra’s place was amazing. Beautiful inside and really well provisioned. Incredibly handy to the Subway. Couldn’t recommend it more highly. If you’re coming to NYC this is a great place to stay.
Hidden lil gem .. This place is so convenient!  Parking was amazing . Check in was easy and communication was superb!  I’d definitely stay here again. It’s simple, neat, and clean. Loved it 🥰

The apartment and location were fantastic. Vibe apartments were very helpful and responsive and looked after anything I needed. I highly recommend renting this apartment and will be renting again in the future!
Excellent stay.everything was perfect.

Rena’s plant-filled space is lovely, and she is a very gracious host.
There is also a rooftop garden with an exceptional view of the city skyline.
The room also had a wonderful view of NYC .
A great nights’s sleep in a great location with a gracious host. I’m
Everything is beautiful and clean

Perfect location!
Clean and comfortable apartment. Kitchen fully equipped

Wij hebben 5 dagen overnacht in deze airbnb.
Wij kunnen het iedereen aanbevelen. Leuk en gezellig ingericht en goede bedden.Dicht bij een metrostation in Brooklyn.
Assiati is erg aardig en behulpzaam.Ze gaf ons nog een tip over een goede en betaalbare pizzeria in de buurt👍
great place to stay and very good comunicación.
Wonderful. Victoria’s standards are high & she has amazing taste. She is also a so a wonderful human, I feel lucky to have found her Airbnb.
Great place, really helped me as I was moving into NYC for a new job and this worked perfectly.  Great hosts as well.
Great room, in a great place in the bronx
Great place, big rooms, clean. Everything necessary.

Unser Aufenthalt bei Hans und Sandra verlief sehr angenehm und problemlos. Leider haben wir die beiden nicht zu Gesicht bekommen, doch wurden sie von Silvia - einer Freundin - sehr gut vertreten, die uns alles zeigte und uns über wichtige Dinge aufklärte. Das Zimmer war sehr sauber und gut ausgestattet.
Alles in allem ein sehr angenehmer Aufenthalt, wenn man nicht direkt in der Großstadt unterkommen möchte.
Super pokój w bardzo dobrej lokalizacji. Parking za darmo pod domem. Gospodarz bardzo miły i pomocny. Pokój i łazienka bardzo czyste.

Christina was a wonderful host! She was easy to communicate with over texting.  The room was warm and cozy! I am allergic to cats but had no problems with her cat who stayed mostly on the first floor. The location is a 20 minute walk to Flushing Chinatown and easy to get to/from the airports LaGuardia and JFK by public transit. I would recommend her Airbnb place to anyone who is visiting the area!

David's apartment is in a great location, with the subway right outside and many other great shops within walking distance. The apartment was clean and the beds were great – great value for money for NYC.
David always responded quickly and kindly – ​​thank you so much!
Very nice apartment. There is everything you need. The hostess is pleasant and responsive. Thank you!
Great apartment. Close to everything
Все было отлично. Десмар был учтив и внимателен.

Stephens spot is absolutely cozy.  It offers great light, separate spaces for privacy, cozy living room. The apt is very peaceful and location is great to explore Brooklyn or head into Manhatttan.  Stephen was very responsive to any needs, was a great stay.

It's a perfect location, walkable + bonus connections to other neighborhoods & Manhattan from the Atlantic Terminal transit hub. If you're looking for a quiet break after a day of sightseeing, Michael's patio is also hard to beat.

Großartig! Die beiden sind sympathische Gastgeber - wir waren eher zurückhaltend, aber wer will, kann sicherlich noch mehr mit Ihnen machen. Location ist großartig - Ubahn nach Manhattan gleich um die Ecke. Toller Stadtteil!! Zimmer und eigenes Bad sind absolut sauber, ist vergleichbar mit sehr gutem hotelstndard.  -Um ins Bad zu kommen, muss man durch einen gemeinsamen Flur, fanden wir aber nicht schlimm. Der Hund ist super süß, finden selbst Menschen, die keine Hunde Fans sind. Es gibt wirklich nichts zu meckern - Preis Leistung sind top!!! Nur einige Dinge zu wissen:  das Appartement und das Zimmer sind super hellhörig - wenn die beiden sich in der Küche nebenan unterhalten, hört man jedes Wort. Wenn Sie einen Film gucken, guckt man mit. Und: derzeit (und es sieht noch nach ein paar Wochen aus) gibt es Bauarbeiten vor der Haustür - ab ca 7 uhr ist es schlichtweg sehr laut durch Lkw, Kräne etc. außerdem gibt es keine dunklen Vorhänge im Zimmer - nur weiße, es ist also ab morgens hell. Ansonsten: zugreifen. Es lohnt sich. Allein schon wegen es Blicks auf die Manhattan Skyline :)
This is the best stay you will find in Brooklyn, period. Location is a 10, room and amenities 10. JUST 10/10!

This Airbnb is amazing. Very clean and so comfortable. It’s also very quiet. Two big rooms with queen beds, there are desk in each room,  There is a kitchen fully loaded with stove and fridge. Big bathroom as well. Hosts are just lovely people, very lovely and communicative.

Gigi was very nice and attentive. The apartment is very simple, beautiful and very clean. I would definitely book again for future stays. She was able to accommodate my check in at 2am and my checkout at 6am which I appreciated very much.

The room was clean and exactly as described with a comfortable bed and more storage room than I expected. I didn't really spend much time in the appartment apart from sleeping there but the kitchen looked well equipped and the bathroom was clean. Vigil was a great host - approachable and helpful. The place is easy to reach with public transport. Shops, restaurants and other necessities are in walking distance. Even though it's located in a vibrant area I had no problems sleeping because the room faces the back of the building. All in all I had an uncomplicated and pleasant stay at Vigil's place.
Excellent place, location and host!

I spent a week with my brother in Reka and Erin's apartment (August-September 2013) and it was a great experience. Lovely place (amazing terrace facing downtown), big bed, clean bathroom, good neighborhood... And these two girls are such kind hosts! Absolutely recommended.

Muy buena ubicación para trasladarse en metro, aunque en la estación más cercana siempre encontrarás homeless pidiendo dinero o fumando marihuana (muy común por varias zonas), que en realidad no te hacen nada por si decides hospedarte no te asustes, o como otra opción, busca la ruta de las otras estaciones de metro que están como a 4 cuadras.
Por el precio está elevado al compartir baño (lo renté sabiendo esa situación), afortunadamente pocas veces coincides con que esté ocupado.
Ventaja que tenga aire acondicionado en verano, hace demasiado calor.
Tash was a great, responsive host!
Great place to stay. Super close to train and bus station.

Le logement de Mark est conforme à la description.
Les instructions et informations pour entrer dans l’appartement ont été très claires. Mark a été très réactif à la moindre sollicitation tout au long du séjour. Son appartement est très bien situé au cœur de Brooklyn : on trouve tous les commerces et restaurants dont on a besoin. Et le quartier est paisible.
Je recommande vivement cet appartement ! 🙂

Great place to stay. If you are single I think it is more confortable than if you come with your couple. Bathroom was clean. Location is uptown but price great. Dan is a great host and the apartment is as described.

Great location, walking distance to many amenities.
Air vents were very dusty and AC units had mold in them.
Clean safe sweet room  friendly kind warm owner
thanks Tyn.   We loved our month long stay at your place.   The place was nice and clean.  it was ideally located for us.
Great and easy place to stay!

Yeun-Ah is very sweet. My friend and I are older and she ran down the many stairs and took both of our suitcases upstairs. The house was very clean.
Most other airbnb's have included use of their kitchen and have made an attempt to include at least a morning beverage. That wasn't included but there are coffee shops close by. .
We did have access to great bathrooms and clean towels.
We were gone most of the day and when our flight was delayed 10 hours she allowed us to keep our bags at her house until 5 pm.
Clean, nice and cosy apartment. Can absolutely recommend it!

This is a great place to stay if you are looking for a private affordable stay! I appreciated the private bathroom and quiet neighborhood. It felt like we had our own unit. We were able to easily travel using the subway and our host was able to give us directions multiple times. Great working a/c and very nice appliances and television. Would recommend staying here
Very sweet hosts! Helped us figure out where to park(: area is safe and cool with lots of walkable coffee shops, restaurants and the subway is only a couple blocks away!

Great room in a well kept, quiet neighborhood, close to LIRR and other public transportations. There was a typo in the address and I ended up at the wrong house, but the host was quick to respond and guide me to the correct location. Stayed there 5 months with no issues.
I loved my stay here. Great choice for a Brooklyn apt. Thanks, Cathy! Hope to rent again soon
Shay is a fantastic host and you will thoroughly enjoy your stay at her place. It is in an accessible area and is meticulously clean! She goes above and beyond to ensure you have a wonderful stay. 😊

Can you give a six star rating? It would be worth it. Matthew’s apartment is in a great location in a nice, quiet street but there’s a plethora of restaurants and shops only a block away in either direction. The apartment itself was a great place to stay for 6 weeks - had everything I needed, and Matthew was great to communicate with. I wouldn’t hesitate to book it again.
Great place for our family to stay we really enjoyed all the toys they left and surprisingly loved not having a tv! Our kids did not want to leave
Great place! The host was super communicative and the place was clean. Overall we enjoyed our stay!

Jiang was an amazingly hospitable host. She is very communicative in the app and responds fast. I felt very safe staying at her place. The bedroom was large and comfortable. Her place is a close walk to a subway station, just be aware that its under construction and not wheelchair accessible.

Great place to stay for a great price. We were first time NYC visitors and it ended up being a great location for us. The value was incredible - they allowed us early check in and kept our bags for us after checkout. Rooms were clean and AC was great. Highly recommend

Heidi is good people and a genuine, good host. Her house is clean and is located on a quite residential block. She and her 10 y/o daughter warmly greeted us upon arrival and gladly answered our  questions about NYC. The room is fairly spacious and has a comfy bed, a large dresser and mirror as well as a desk. Pull the curtains if you like to sleep in as it gets nice early morning light. The room has a lock and is off a hallway that connects to the bathroom, kitchen and front door so you are not faced with awkwardly walking through someones living room all the time. There is a convenient mini mall 5 minutes away on foot. There are numerous bars and restaurants nearby representing various cultures. We would definitely stay with Heidi again and recommend her place to others!
Tony is such a great and friendly host. The place is near subway and convenience stores. He was flexible and helpful when it came to alternate street parking.

Nadege and her family were responsive, warm, friendly and super-accomodating of my needs.
The house is in a lovely, quiet neighborhood, minutes away from shopping, restaurants, public transport and a small park.
The studio is compact, with excellent private bathroom, and a kitchenette on one wall. The huge windows offer wonderful light, and the home is quiet and safe.
The studio has a period atmosphere that was perfectly conducive to my work as a translator.

Un lugar muy cómodo, excelente relación calidad - precio. El staff es muy amigable y atento, la cama es muy cómoda y los baños estaban muy limpios a pesar de compartirlos con los demás huéspedes de piso. Volvería sin dudar.

My guests and I had a great time. The place was very nice and clean. Everything was as it looked in pictures. The location was convenient as it was close to the airport as well on a bus route to make traveling around easier. Dean was an amazing host who is very quick to respond to any questions or concerns that may come up. Would definitely consider staying here again if I plan a return visit to New York.
Cozy room, great stay. Host was very responsive and helpful.

My mom and I stayed 1 week at Orestes´ place and we loved it! Orestes is a great host - he gives you your privacy, but is always there to answer any question you may have.
The room is very nice and cozy. Comfortable beds!
The neighborhood felt save and only a short walk from the water where I went running alone in the morning. It is so much more quit than down-/uptown New York which we really appreciated.
There is a lot of nice places to eat and the supermarked is right around the corner.
The metro/train is only 5 minutes away and runs all the time.

I/we have only positive things to say about Orestes and his place, and I/we highly recommend other people to stay there if they want to visit New York City.
If I/we am/are going to New York again, I/we hope that Orestes has room for us :)

I had a fabulous stay here! The apartment was spacious and clean, and the room even had a small balcony which is hard to find in NY at this price. The place is less than a 5min walk from the J line, and there are many mini marts around. I would definitely recommend!

Liz's place near Union Square is a fantastic apartment in an amazing location, and Liz is an excellent host who always takes care to ensure her guests have a great stay. Liz was quick to respond to any questions I had and made my stay in New York City very enjoyable. The apartment is within walking distance of over a dozen subway lines and bus routes on 5th and 6th Avenues, and great amenities, from Madison Square Park to Chelsea Market just minutes away. The place itself is clean and comfortable, and offers a peaceful and quiet space to stay while in the city.
Beautiful property. Felt right at home. Communication from the host was responsive and friendly. Would definitely recommend!

Sandrine was very responsive and helpful. Although we did run into a few bugs in the beginning of our stay, her place was still very beautiful and the neighborhood was very pleasant. Great walking distance to the metro and there is a halal food spot just across the street that is open until 1am. Great for late night snacks!
Great location, warm feeling and very hospitable with the breakfast area. Neighbors were a little questionable.

Lovely loft.
Majorie was a really helpful host in giving me local recommendations for restaurants and cafes.
Place looked exactly as described - just the wall in the bedroom is blue now - nicely coloured.
Might be a bit too expensive for a few because you’re not allowed to use the kitchen but it was perfect for a couple of days.
It takes 30-60min with the bus and the subway to get into the heart of Manhattan.
Home away very home. Clean apartment, great host.

We loved our stay! The apartment was very clean and welcoming. The subway station was very close which made getting to Manhattan easy. Negra quickly responded to questions we had, and she had very clear instructions on checking in. She also gave us information on getting to the apartment from the airport hotel. There was a favorite bagel shop just a few blocks away that we ate at every morning before our adventures! Our visit to NYC was even better than we expected and a big part of that was having a clean, comfortable apartment to come back to
each night!!
It's near the park, a quiet and nice place. The landlord is warmhearted. Good choice!
John’s place was located very close to subway stations. It was very comfortable to stay. Communication was very quick and smooth. I will definitely come back to this place when visiting NY again!
Very stylish and cozy! Will miss staying there!

Wonderful stay. Elba’s home is truly one of a kind. The space is technically a room and a small private living room. It was nice to be able to stretch out. Wonderful part of Brooklyn, train easily accessible. Elba was nice and accommodating.

Love, love, love this loft.  Don’t look any further, this is where you want to stay.  What a pleasant surprise when the elevator door opened to a beautiful brick, NYC loft.  The loft is extremely spacious with comfortable beds, two full bathrooms, and a great kitchen.  Perfect location in Little Italy, next to Chinatown.  It was so much fun walking around the neighborhood.  Fabulous food choices all within walking distance, street shopping on Canal Street, with the subway right down the street. You can go anywhere from this location!! Hosts were wonderful and made us feel right at home.  Best decision to stay here and if we come back, we will definitely stay here again.  If anyone in your party has mobility issues, this loft is perfect with the elevator, no stairs to worry about.
Laurence couldn’t have been nicer or more accommodating.  Fantastic location!  Everything we could hope for.

Thank you so so much to cindy. It was really amazing to stay in her accomodation. The accomodation are really big, cool, comfortable, and stylish. I like everything there. The price is very good, wifi, kitchen, sofa, bathroom, bedroom, TV and many other things are excellent. Neighbourhood is good. Cindy is really kind, friendly, and cheerful person. She give me the best services at accomodation i have ever had. She helps me a lot in many many aspects. Like provide maps, snacks, give recommend place to visit and many other things. Sometimes we spent time together sharing and discuss and talk about ourselves. Overall i really satisfied with everything. And if i have another opportunity to visit newyork.i'll come back there again ! :)

Ubytování ve skvělé lokalitě. Jedná se o několika patrový hotel, takže se pokoje mohou lišit. My jsme ale ve dvou dostali hodně malý pokoj s malou postelí. V pokoji byla zima a bylo potřeba zapínat elektrický přímotop.

I truly enjoyed my experience staying at this lovely apartment.  The home was beautiful and clean. Aaron greeted us at the door and was super friendly. He had such a wonderful aura about him. The bed was very comfortable. Loved the character of the home.  Would highly recommend staying here.  It is in the heart of Harlem so it was great to just walk around and explore. I am already planning on another trip back.

Christopher did a great job preparing the space. They even went above and beyond and built a new couch. The interior design of the studio is very aesthetically pleasing and makes the apartment very cozy. We really enjoyed our stay and would definitely come back if given the chance. Thank you again!

I am very lucky to be able to stay at this house. The host Lakshmee is so kind and helpful lady. She is so kind to even upgrade my room to a private room with private bathroom without any extra charges. When I want to go to downtown, she even offer to fetch me to nearest station and guide me through how to reach the destination. Will definitely stay in this property again next time. Fully recommended.
beautiful home, great value, big kitchen, and lovely shower! love it!

The studio is bright and spacious and matches that in the ad. Its location is fantastic. Parks, eateries, fine restaurants, groceries, department stores, banks, subway/bus/ ferry …are all within walking distance. Noomi is always responsive and friendly. I’ve recommended my friends to stay here when they come to NYC.
Recomended.. I  will stay there again

There were no surprises and everything went smoothly, except maybe the place could have been better stocked on towels considering the number of people staying. Wi-Fi was good, plenty of outlets, hot and cold water in the shower, beds were as expected. Thank you Lawrence for a great stay!

This apartment had everything we wished for. The location is in a safe neighborhood, only one block away from the L train , and 10 min walk from the A, C subway. In 20 min you are in Manhattan. The apartment is clean and is foreseen with every supply you can think of, enough clean towels, soap, shampoo etc. The apartment is bigger than most places in NY or Brooklyn and it is so clean, modern, cool, hip!
Carmia and Joe are always available, you can ask them for a restaurant locations, or take out food, they are very open to talk to, and they will help you in any matter they can.
We loved this place and we will be back! Keep it up guys!

We had such an amazing experience! The apartment was clean and fully equiped..
Check in and communication with Elena was super easy! We would really enjoy coming back!

We had a lovely time at Sewa’s place. The house was great, we had our privacy, and when we did see Sewa, he was very warm and welcoming, he also gave us some great sightseeing suggestions that were very much worth it! Thank you.
My only comment is about the location, and not about the house. We struggled to find good coffee places around, which you should keep in mind if you’re a coffee addict like us!
The apartment is clean but extremely basic and bare bones with barely enough linens and no amenities. The shower is great, there is air conditioning, and parking was easy and free.

Host was responsive & helpful .
Room & bed were very comfortable.

Super cozy apartment with an equally cozy room we stayed in. Bed with special functionality (massage and stuff), huge TV with lots of live services in our room and an incredibly friendly and helpful host. Also: her dog is absolutely adorable.
It is located in the safest neighborhood in Manhattan and the subway is only 3 Minutes away.
There are also many possibilities to get food, condiments and clothing in near vicinity.
Would recommend!
A wonderful little apartment in Brooklyn! Petra was very responsive and a great host.  She and Tony also saved a parking space for me, which made life much easier

it was my second visit at this place. based between L and M train stops in a lively local neighborhood. this is a perfect base to explore Brooklyn nightlife and original food. wouldn't recommend it maybe for a first time visitor, but for advanced NY explorers it just a great homebase well connected to Manhattan

It is a walk-up (we were aware), but the stairs are steep, long, and curved.  We traveled with elderly folks and it was more challenging than expected.  Also, there are 3 additional stairs within the unit.  Otherwise, all was as advertised and the location was great for our purposes!
This is a great place to stay. Great location, clean, good communication, accommodating. Walking distance to tons of great bars and restaurants.
Todo perfecto. Ben es un gran anfitrión.
Beautiful space. My go to Airbnb in Brooklyn

We were flying from Cyprus, and the day before our departure, we discovered that our passports with American visas were left in another country, which I immediately informed Jennifer about, asking to change our stay dates since we wouldn’t be able to arrive. The trip was planned for a week, and it would take two days to fly to the country where the passports were and two days back. But Jennifer refused us. She gave us the number for their customer service. Surprisingly, she continued to send codes for key collection, etc. After the second time, I stopped responding to her because I felt like I wasn’t being heard—my replies that the trip couldn’t happen without visas didn’t resonate! I also asked customer service to change the dates since the airline changed our tickets to late February to early March2025. Despite our Christmas trip being ruined, we are parents of three children, and it was the first time in a long while that we planned to spend time just together but no understanding…
Great and centrally located - bigger than expected!
Danny was an excellent host. The flat had all the amenities. İdeally located.

Great stay, and relatively easy to reach (12 mins walk from the subway station, bus option available too). I you plan to visit Manhattan you will have to do 40mins commuting, once in the morning and once in the evening. A time investment that is offset by the reduced cost of renting, especially considering that if you want to visit NYC, you would need to commute anyways - regardless of your starting point.  Many people advised me against this location because of the known bed reputation and this was my biggest concern, however, it didn't seem to be the case to me. Even when coming back home late at night, there was nothing dangerous or creepy about the neighbor, nothing more than you would find anywhere else in NYC.  I felt like this reputation is mostly a relic of the past.  The check-in was smooth and the room was clean. I didn't use the kitchen but it looked very nicely equipped.
Everything was great at Beekman place. Walking distance to attractions.
Near the river, nice and chill!! The house always clean and comfortable, always have free coffee!!
good place with affordable pricing in nyc w competitive location. bring your own shower shoes since its a shared bathroom
Great hotel and location for a reasonably great price.
Awful owner, he does not withdraw money from the card at such a difficult time and does not return the deposit! I do not recommend it to anyone! Although the rooms themselves are great!

Mel’s place was the perfect homebase for us. We were travelling with kids and needed to feel comfortable and safe. This was just that, and Mel was super helpful throughout the stay and even went above and beyond when we needed assistance receiving a package.
I had a wonderful time at your house thank you having me welcome

This location was wonderful for my short 2-day trip to NYC. The room looked exactly as it did in the photos and the building is very easy to find. All the staff were extremely nice and helpful.
It was very easy to walk to Little Italy and Chinatown from this location, and it was a short 10-minute walk to a nearby subway station that took us to other parts of the city.
The bed and pillows were extremely comfortable and the showers were very nice! I would stay here again the next time I visit NYC.
And oh! The complimentary coffee and pastries in the morning was a nice touch. The pastries were so good.

Vigil's apartment is nice and quiet, even though it's conveniently located near a very lively area (Harlem's 125th street.) I stayed in two different bedrooms: the one listed as "Cosy and Quiet", and the one list as "Quaint & Relaxing". Cosy and Quiet couldn't be a better description: it faces the back alley, meaning no street noise. (Downside is it doesn't get much natural daylight, especially in winter.) The bedroom isn't big but very comfy and it has plenty of storage room. Quaint & Relaxing is a bigger bedroom that faces the street, meaning it gets a good share of natural daylight, but it is potentially noisier. In winter, with fewer people hanging out and windows closed I had no problem whatsoever. Vigil herself is a very gentle person, and also very quiet—so these listings are good for people who are willing to help foster that mood in the apartment. All in all a great stay!

Not enough stars on the ranking system for this place and this host!! A+ 100 tiptop just book it now.
You know how sometimes the city can be overwhelming and exhausting — you are out all day drinking in the sights and culture, but at some point you just want to find a clean toilet, take a shower and pass out? Sure, for about the same price, you could return to a windowless shoebox hotel room. But coming back to Johnny’s is coming HOME. His wonderful home: lived-in, well-appointed, spacious and sparkling.
Johnny is such a kind, thoughtful, proactive, tasteful, considerate lamb. He can read a room — can lean in to a meaningful conversation, or lean out of the shared space and give privacy. As a solo-traveling lady, I never stay in someone’s airbnb with them. This was my first time. I trusted the glowing reviews, and I’d like to add another to the pile. There’s not much I can add that hasn’t been said already. Except, maybe how convenient it is to/from the Amtrak station. I’ll be back!

Super semaine passée chez Elias & Marcello. Nous nous sommes sentis comme à la maison, bien accueillis, entourés et chouchoutés.
L’appart est idéalement situé, en quelques stations de métro nous sommes à Manhattan avec toutes les activités à proximité. Super bien desservi et facile d’accès. L’appartement est très cosy et nous avons pu utiliser la cuisine sans souci.
Luna et Ray les 2 chats sont choux.

Sweet little basement place, perfect as a Base for a trip to NY. Real close to prospect park station so Manhattan aka the island is only a 20 min ride away. We walked into manhattan on our 2nd day through prospect park, suburban Brooklyn, over the Brooklyn bridge and up through downtown, I would recommend this walk to everyone. Even more so if you got the weather. Jessica's place was peaceful, comfortable and real clean which is always an important factor. Would stay again for sure.

I enjoyed my stay immensely in New York. Johnny's place was immaculately clean, smelled good all the time and the interiors were tastefully done and was very comfortable. His place has easy access to Broadway, shopping, port authority, restaurants, fast food . . .everything was in walking distance. He also has an elevator which for me is important especially if you plan to do a lot of shopping. The doorman was very polite and helpful.
The host Johnny is such a wonderful person. He is kind , patient , genuine, and caring and I found a friend in him. He made my trip to New York memorable relaxing and because of this I look forward to coming back.
Great ! Marie is very kind!!!!

Sarah’s space is clean, spacious, and comfortable. Location is awesome - everything needed in walking distance. Sarah is a kind, respectful,  pleasant, easy going host and you are free to be comfortable in the space. The artwork in the apartment is a beautiful touch. Thank you Sarah!
New York City wouldn’t be the same without staying in this awesome place! Gotta come back.
Great location! Great space! The library in the lobby is amazing!

Wonderful! Easy check in, communication, lovely space, great location. Honestly a great value for the price. I will say it is a bit of a trek to the train, which might be an issue in the cold months but was no problem for me during a fall stay. Also, very friendly host. Two trains (m and L) near so very convenient.

This place is nicer than most of the 3 star hotels in the area like holiday inn and more value for money.  Beds were extremely comfortable and the linens were pristine. Bathroom was spotless and pest free. There isn’t really a working kitchen, but there is just about every plug-in kitchen appliance imaginable plus a nespresso machine with plenty of pods. You’d have no problem prepping a full breakfast and/or a light lunch. There’s no elevator, but I had no issues getting up 2 flights of stairs on my own with a small suitcase and backpack. 8 min walking to grand central. Overall, I feel really lucky to have found this spot on short notice and would stay again!
I loved this place! I will be coming back.

This apartment was comfortable, clean, well appointed and well decorated. I felt comfortable there during my two-night stay. The location is convenient for both Red Hook and Carrol Gardens, although it’s sandwiched between the BQE and the tunnel into Manhattan so to get out of the neighborhood can require going over a pedestrian overpass. The highway is also audible, but the hosts kindly provided ear plugs, a white noise machine and blackout curtains, which I really appreciated.
La habitación mejor que un hotel 5 estrellas. Un lujo. Volvería sin dudarlo.

Andrea's place was exactly was my in-laws needed to have a comfortable stay while they visited us. The apartment was clean, it had everything they needed and Andrea left them some welcome treats which they really enjoyed!

Do not hesitate to book Aron’s place!!! His communication was A++ including accommodating my group’s needs. The location was perfect and the Citibikes and the park is a big plus. Be mindful that parking was a bit hectic at night. I would definitely stay again and recommend to family and friends.
Perfect place if you’re on a budget! VERY SAFE!! There’s three different locks before you get to your cubicle. In a good area and everyone that works here is super super nice and helpful.
everything was great. will stay again in the future
A great location and a great host. Easy to move about New York and explore the city.
Good experience, friendly hosts!

My girlfriend and I stayed the night because we went to a concert at Webster Hall. Maia was the best! The apartment was clean and comfortable + the cat was so cute and friendly. Great location too. Would definitely stay again!

The appartment was a lot more than we imagined, it was great : nice comfy area, fully equiped kitchen, 2 separate bedrooms, perfect bathroom. Everything was really clean and nice. Jennifer brought us a huge bowl of fruit and giant bagels the first morning. She was so sweet and welcoming, ckecking on us during our stay and easy going for the checking/checkout. I would definitely stay there again and I already recommend it to my friends back home.
The area was nice too : subway really close, you can be in the center of Manhattan within 35min. Big supermarket 2 blocks away, bars...
The perfect stay for the 3 of us !

We felt very comfortable in Ivan's very well-equipped apartment. The apartment is located in a quiet, friendly environment and is lovingly furnished. During our 9-day visit, we particularly enjoyed the morning breakfast in the beautiful garden. Ivan is very friendly and was on hand to help and advise us. Thank you very much!

If you are looking for a classic NYC experience and want to stay on the upper west side, this is a great spot. The balcony really is amazing and the location is very walkable.
Be prepared for the experience of staying at a friend’s place or something similar. It feels like someone is still living there - clothes in the closet, condiments in the fridge, clutter in the cupboards, etc. This isn’t a pristine, hotel-like space, it’s someone’s classic three-story walk-up appt that they vacate when you come.
Lei is very flexible and responsive. I had a great time in her place.
Excelente estancia! Mitch siempre muy amable y predispuesta a ayudarnos en lo que necesitáramos. El departamento luce tal cual las fotos. Cerca de la estación de subte.
Great spot in Dumbo - a bit noisy (not specifically this apartment, but Dumbo in general since your close to brooklyn and Williamsburg bridge, with subways
This apartment is ideal for one or two people. A great location !
Cosy apartment with all the basics

Ame is a wonderful host- very responsive and flexible. Her place is in a great location, very close to the subway with lots of great cafés and restaurants around. My mum and I had a lovely stay with her and would definitely visit again. The house is super clean and tidy and very beautiful with treasures from all around the world :)

Mark's place was lovely and spacious for NYC.  Super clean and up-to-date bathroom and shower.  Pretty street with old brownstones.  Mark is a great host.  We will definitely stay here next time in town visiting our daughter.
Location was perfect, a bit noisy but because it is in the center of nyc

Wonderful place to stay! Mark was kind and helpful upon check-in, giving us some great food recommendations. He quickly fixed an electrical issue in the place when asked, and then we didn’t see him for the rest of our stay. We almost forgot he was there! A perfect, quiet spot to stay within walking distance of a subway station. Lots of great eats nearby and fun things to discover in the area. Would highly recommend!
My stay at Chester's Place was great.Chester is a great host n very understanding.

It was a homely place to stay. Good to experience life in Brooklyn. There's Dunkin donut and Chinese fast-food place nearby. Few houses away from the metro.
But place is 45mins away from Manhattan by metro. But for the price was a great deal.

Good location for Chelsea, Meatpacking areas and downtown Manhattan as a whole. Studio was clean and well looked after, and the host was prompt and friendly.

My only issue was the studio is direcltly adjacent to the entrance for the building, so I was awakened several times by other people entering or leaving the building. (Doors slamming and motion sensitive lights coming on) If you are a light sleeper, this would be a major issue.

Other, a nice studio

This is a really well designed, comfortable, and centrally located space and was excellent to stay in. Farhad and Krissy made the check- in process extremely easy and functional. Along with "Blue" the clever guardian cat to keep us company, this is a great space nestled on the East side of Harlem for visitors.  I cannot recommend this space enough.  10 stars!
Très bon emplacement et un rapport qualité/prix appréciable! Lits impeccables, cuisine bien équipée, et quartier calme!

Carlos's apartment was perfect! The building is well kept. Great elevator! Rooftop view is amazing! Short distance to some great resturants! Small market, diner, Dunkin, Starbucks, & plenty of places to eat close by. Short walk to Times Square & all theaters. Safe neighborhood. Apartment was clean, fresh flowers on table nice touch! Thank you Carlos for a very enjoyable stay!

L’appartement de Béatrice est idéalement situé, proche des commerces, bars, métro. Le logement est spacieux, la chambre très grande, les literies super confortables.
Le plus, le jardin privé, génial.
Béatrice est une honte adorable, très arrangeante .
Je vous recommande

Logement très bien situé au sud de Times Square et proche des arrêts de métro. Le bâtiment est surveillé par un service de sécurité à la réception. La chambre et la salle de bain étaient propres et bien équipés. Mais, cela ne sentait pas bon à notre arrivée et le plafond a besoin de réparations : il y a une grosse fissure et beaucoup de plafonnage est tombé sur nos affaires à la salle de bain.

I absolutely enjoyed staying at Doug's place - the neighborhood is very cool and offers everything needed - restaurants, some bars, public transport, park etc.
Doug is very friendly and gave a lot of recommendations. Would come back anytime :)

Een fijn verblijf gehad bij Chris. Chris geeft je veel privacy en ruimte, je merkt vaak niet dat er nog iemand thuis is. Het appartement heeft een hele gunstige locatie. Met zonnig weer kan het warm worden op de kamer maar er zijn genoeg voorzieningen beschikbaar om het aangenaam te maken (ventilatoren).
The place is in a great location for seeing plays and restaurants. Bed was very comfortable and the hotel quiet and charming. We had a great stay.

We spent a couple of weeks in Hector's place while visiting NYC in august. We recommend it as we found it accurately clean and renovated, offered all that we needed to prepare our meals at home from time to time and it's very well connected through several metro line and buses. Neighborhood combines liveliness and historical interest. We particularly enjoyed walking around old Jackson Heights blocks at dusk.
Great stay at Manuel's place - easy to communicate with and responsive. The location is prime with a lot of amazing spots in the area and close to the parks and the main transportation lines.
the worst host ever they are not helpful and careless about their gusts don’t expect them to be flexible with you especially during these days which we  are all suffering with Coved-19 .

As a Brooklynite I can say this is one of the best setups I've had the pleasure of staying in. The space is utilized extremely well and all the amenities are fantastic! Chan was very accommodating. 10/10
Great apartment in a great location!  Josh and Whitney were super responsive and helpful!

Le séjour chez Landy a été très bien. Landy est accueillant et attentif aux demandes de ses locataires. Il réagit immédiatement aux demandes et les informations sont claires. L'appartement est parfaitement conforme à l'annonce, spacieux et adapté à un séjour. Il dispose de tout ce qui est utile. Le quartier est assez dépaysant (quartier chinois de Brooklyn) mais on s'y sent toujours en sécurité et on ne manque pas de restaurants ni de vendeurs de rue, y compris tard dans la nuit !
Une petite limite : la rue principale est très bruyante, y compris la nuit.
Kelly was fantastic to work with. Super responsive, apartment was clean. Beds were comfortable. And an amazing location near four subway lines.
Such a great location for exploring Manhattan by public transportation, bicycle and on foot.
Great value. Great location for family’s with children. Not as busy as the northern areas but quick subway access to get there if you want.

Everything was excellent. There are a couple of things as a feedback, the mattress is not ergonomic, so it may not be good for people with back problems (it's not a complain). Second thing is that there is no carpet on the floor, we stayed in a somewhat cold season and it was a bad experience to walk without shoes in the apartment. Other than that is was a good experience, we liked the privacy and how open the hosts are.
Definitely exceeded  my expectation  as this was my first time in a Airbnb like this. Will be booking again in the near future

This was my second stay at Eric’s place. I travel to NY for work and sometimes have longer stays. I was so comfortable in the apartment during the summer that I booked it again for a week in the fall. Eric was just as helpful the second time around, and I found the place as clean and comfortable as it was before. I would certainly recommend it.

This is probably the best Airbnb experience we’ve had. Extremely clear instructions for getting to the location, checking in, and so much thoughtfulness put into amenities for guests, you feel like you’re in a hotel. Hiokit and Harold were kind, welcoming and INCREDIBLY responsive hosts. Highly recommend!
Great little place which was perfect for me and my colleague to explore te city. In-keeper is very friendly and flexible.
This place is in a great area for bars and restaurants and a short walk to just about anything else!  The sofa in the living area is as comfortable as it looks after a long day out....

At Pettrina‘s home I was very warmly welcomed by her mother and was shown to the room. It is a very cozy home within a lively neighborhood. I would absolutely recommend this AirBnb for solo travellers and people who have already been in NY once and want to discover Brooklyn and the Caribbean neighborhood. However you are only a subway ride away from Manhattan and other Brooklyn neighborhoods. I would always come back!
Host was very friendly and extremely clean!

I cannot believe five days went by so quickly. Both hosts are so nice, warm and welcoming. The place is spot clean and the cats are really cute. The reason to do Airbnb is exactly because we can enjoy the travel and make friends. I feel I’ve made the best friends already! Highly recommend the place!

Cute place and perfectly located by the airport. She was great to communicate with in a snap when I was stressing about cancelled flights and what to do.
Upstairs neighbors are a tad noisy and/ or the floors are just really easy to hear through. I wish there was another TV in the bedroom to drown out the noise of the TV you can hear upstairs.

La descripción de Airbnb es bastante exacta comparado a lo que ves al llegar. Tiene todo lo necesario, microondas, nevera pequeña, toallas, cafetera, televisión, aire acondicionado.
El baño tiene lo necesario y tiene agua caliente el cual beneficia si vienes en invierno.
La estación de tren más cercana está a unos 12-13 minutos caminando.
Es una buena opción si no quieres pagar un alto precio en la ciudad de Manhattan pero a su vez quieres sentirte en un lugar limpio, tranquilo y seguro. 100% recomendado!

Great find right in Brooklyn. Very clean, comfortable and convenient location. We stayed two nights, it was quiet in the morning and evenings. Kitchen worked well enough for our needs, though lacking proper cutlery (disposable plate, cups and cutlery). We found parking on the street both nights. Highly recommended for a convenient Brooklyn stay.
It's a nice and cozy place.
Kara is very nice and cooperatuve even the other tenants there are also very nice. I have enjoyed perfectly my stay over there and definitely stay there again

A/C did not work well.
It does not matter what temp setting is, heater is always on, so we need to turn off time to time.
Location is great, nice coffee shops around and walkable to Times Square.
It is IHG hotel and you also charge extra taxis/fees outside of what you paid to AirB&B
Todo bien a buena hora

Very nice and clean two bedroom house on a quiet street. We enjoyed the stay and it’s close to some great restaurants, especially Werkstatt. There is not a kitchen, but a mini fridge, microwave, and coffee maker which were just fine for us. The closest coffee shop is unfortunately 15 minutes away walking. It is on the third floor so if you have any trouble going up stairs it might be an issue. I would definitely stay there again, great place.

Robert was a great host, communicative and knowledgeable about the area.
The home was very clean and comfortable. I really enjoyed my stay!

Staying at Daisy's place added an authentic touch to my New York stay you can't get from a basic hotel. The central location meant so much was within walking distance or only a quick subway ride away. Between bursts of exploring the city I enjoyed discussing art and history with Daisy in her stylish accommodations. Would book again.

Mary Ann's place is in a good location to explore Brooklyn from. For those who are sensitive to perfumed smells (Glade plug-ins, strong laundry detergent), I would recommend you look elsewhere. If you're planning on cooking a lot, the kitchen is lacking some basics.
Marek and his cohost/sister were very communicative and accommodating, we loved our stay in greenpoint at their lovely apartment and would book again if ever back in the area!
Great place, super central, and really appreciated Machel’s responsiveness. Highly recommend :)
Excellent ! Je recommande
Great place and as pictured! Location is perfect.

Juan is a fantastic host. He is very caring and will go above and beyond to make sure his hosts have a good stay. The apartment is also very nice with lots of daylight and everything needed to work remotely. The district is great with lots of nice bars and restaurants.

This is really a one-of-a-kind listing, a completely separate structure in the heart of Victorian Flatbush,.  The barn has been lovingly restored, with lots of great period details (original plank floors and beams), but has a very modern and well-equipped kitchen and bath, although the steep stairs to the bedroom floor could be challenging for some.  The hosts are on-site (the barn is in their backyard), very friendly and helpful.  It's on a lovely, tree-shaded street in a wonderful neighborhood near Brooklyn College, five blocks from the Q train, with quick access to Prospect Park, all major Brooklyn attractions and Manhattan.  We look forward to our next stay there.
Very nice host. The place is affordable and you get a very good deal. Mr Kim is a very respectful and quick to respond host. Highly recommend.
just enough for everything that we need for a vacation
This place is absolutely lovely. Beautifully furnished, exactly like it looks in the photos. Good location. We really enjoyed our stay!
Coming back again ! this is the best Brooklyn room you can get !!
El check in fue fácil, el apartamento esta muy seguro y todo estaba muy limpio y organizado.
Great location …. Our 4th time staying there …. We love it
Loved this Airbnb! So many great design elements, and great location - fun to leave and fun to come back!
Great location. Lots of restaurants and easy subway access
Wonderful hosts. Great value, transit near by, easy access to lower manhattan. Has everything you need and was great for me as a summer intern on a budget.

Shean’s house was perfect for the four of us.
It was very comfortable, clean, and exactly like the pictures.
The space was beautifully decorated and fully equipped with everything we needed.
There was plenty of space for us to relax and enjoy our stay.
Shean was very communicative and helpful throughout our stay, and his mom, Izona, was also lovely and gave us a warm welcome.
We truly appreciated their support during our time there.
Highly recommend this Airbnb😊

This is the best place and best host I have ever encountered on this platform. She was amazing and went above and beyond!!! The place is beautiful and in the perfect  area and close to everything in NY! The views and the place are so beautiful. The comfort level is a 10 all the way!! The cleanest place you will ever stay in!!! Thank you for having your place available. I will be back and always book this place when I visit NY. 10 Stars!!!

Really great value for the location! While minimal, this is a clean and comfortable space and the host was very communicative and helpful.
The surrounding blocks of this neighborhood are quiet but it’s just a short walk to the train and nearby shops and restaurants. The highway is also easily accessible and street parking is relatively easy to find during the day (harder at night but that’s normal for this part of Brooklyn).
The apartment was easy to enter/exit and has the basics: comfortable bed, air conditioning in two rooms, staple kitchen appliances, and a clean bathroom. That’s all we needed while exploring the city! Will definitely be back.

I stayed at Hector's place for a week during a trip to NYC. I specifically wanted to stay in Jackson Heights because it's very conveniently located with a lot of good food (vs being in Manhattan). I loved the stay!! Hector was very responsive, helped me with a bunch of questions. The apartment itself has all the essentials. Although it was close to the 7 train, you couldn't really hear the train noise that much. It was quite but close to everything (there's even a gym 2 blocks down). Thanks Hector!! Hope I can come back again soon.

It's a small apartment, overall clean, tidy and simple; I think good value. It has all that it say it has. I also want to add that even though they don't show it in the pictures they have a small closet.
The check- in was super easy, they just left an envelope with my name on the front desk. On check-out I gave the key back to the front desk.
It's in a great location: walking I could get to Penn Station, Times Square, the NY library, empire state, Rockefeller, to name some attractions. Also there's a subway station nearby, and a few rental bikes racks. You also don't have to walk too far to find food or drinks.
The only reasons I don't rate it 4 stars: one could be fixed but the other may not be fixable but you should know in order to see if you accommodate to it: I think the mattress and pillows need to be changed. The mattress is sagging on one side and the pillows are just not comfortable. I wouldn't say I loved the sleep I got.
The other issue is that even though I was surprised to not hear the traffic (it's on the 7th floor), on the 4 nights I was there, there were always people yelling (also not helping with my sleep). It seemed it came from others inside the building. Lastly, a guy offered drugs right outside the building door. I saw this dude twice.
Overall, it's good value and greatly located.

Mark was incredibly responsive and understanding. We experienced some challenges with the warm temperature of the house but Mark quickly resolved the issue and made our stay very comfortable. He also was gracious and allowed a later check out time without any additional cost. The home was comfortable and perfect for my family of 6. I would definitely stay here again.

We got exactly the view that was shown in the listing. Room is a typical hotel room that you would expect for a higher price point. Super walkable to anywhere in lower manhattan, and taxis are always nearby if you want to go somewhere farther. Our stay was a magical new year’s experience. I highly recommend this hotel that is located in a prime location in downtown.
Excelente ubicación excelente servicio lo recomiendo muy cerca de todo
it was a very comfortable stay, great communication with Nazeeha, the place had everything we needed and more!
Great stay :) Highly recommend
Very nice and safe place in a convenient location. Open floorplan. Description was accurate and host was responsive. We had a great stay.

Our two families (1 adult, 2 kids each) had a lovely 2-night stay at Ryan's place. From the outset, Ryan was very responsive, and provided clear instructions on how to enter. We were able to use an app for wireless entry, and there is also a pin code. The apartment is spacious, brand new and clean. Plenty of room for a large group. The kitchen had everything you'd need (even a Keurig with pods).
As for location - assuming that any guests know about Bed-Stuy before they come here. My group had lived in Brooklyn for years, and was coming back for a visit. Visitors should be aware that this is "real" Brooklyn - dirty, loud, sketchy, etc. The subway does go right by the house - you can hear it, but it's not distracting. On the other hand, the subway is right there - so easy commute to wherever you need to go.
For the price - excellent place to stay in Bed-Stuy/Crown Heights Brooklyn.
Take it! Best option in NYC. Not far from Manhattan
Ron is a great host, very responsive and proactive. Neighborhood is safe, felt like home.

I was dead on my feet after a 15 hr flight and I was beyond grateful for Nicole accommodating my early check in. She was kind enough to meet me at the door when my uber dropped my off and she and her daughter helped my lug my suitcases to my room. Our brief interaction left such a warm impression! The free snacks were also a godsend since I was too tired to even think about ordering in. I slept like the dead in the large comfy bed and the room itself had so many thoughtful touches. Definitely 10/10
I enjoyed my stay here, and the bed was super comfy! Response time is super quick and they were very accommodating. I would definitely book again.

Delicia’s place was so cozy and comfortable, but it was my two favorite things: clean and cold! More than enough space, but i genuinely appreciated having a sitting area to relax and get fresh air. I will be back for sure!

Al, their partner, and doggos were incredibly kind and hospitable! They made it clear that while my partner and I were there, it was our home too, which created an immediate sense of warmth and ease. Al was very accommodating to an earlier check in, and later check out. We were staying one night for my birthday, before heading upstate and this beautiful home was the perfect way to begin my week of relaxation! I even awoke up to a sweet birthday card and message — genuinely the sweetest hosts! The photos truly don’t do their stunning and cozy home justice. The bedding was luxurious, like sleeping under a weighted cloud. The bathroom amenities were also luxe! And the walk to the subway stations were super close. Loved the quiet neighborhood and easy parking! Pro tip: be mindful of no parking during street cleaning hours.
We had a wonderful stay at Pablo’s apartment , nice place, clean and well appointed. Lots to do in the area, safe street and great food too! Thank you
We immediately felt very welcome with Carl and he gave us helpful tips. Highly recommended.

Lucy is very kind. She treated me just like my own sister. Because of her, I felt at home during my stay with her. I really thank her and appreciate her generosity and kindness. I will definitely go back to her if I go back to NYC again.
Everything was ok!! Clean, comfortable, location! I can go again

We had an amazing stay here! The space is just as beautiful as the  pictures. From the gentleman that helped us with our bags at check-in, to all of the staff with helpful recommendations, we had a 10/10 stay! Definitely will be visiting again!

Eric is one of the best airbnb hosts that I've ever dealt with. He is very well organized and professional. Communication was great throughout my stay and even though my flight was delayed Eric was understanding. The apartment is nice, clean and warm. It's one block away from the 6 train which will take you up and down manhattan. There are a few nice bars and restaurants in the area. Highly recommend staying with Eric.
Had a great stay, the room was nice and clean and in a great location. Excellent value for money, would highly recommend.
Benja was an really good host, ensuring a comfortable and enjoyable stay. The place was clean and well-maintained, and the location was perfext. Overall, it was a wonderful experience.

Denise and Richard were perfect hosts - super responsive and friendly, accommodating and helpful. The apartment is beautiful and in an excellent neighborhood, with great access into Manhattan. You can’t not love this place!

We had a great stay at the hotel! It is extremely well located with it being just a short walk over to Times Square. It’s also an easy walk up to Central Park or to access the subway and other locations in the city. We enjoyed the breakfast and had a wonderful man help us make waffles. Thank you for the stay!

We loved staying at Young's apartment.  A large room with a comfortable bed and clean bathroom.  Young's hospitality is proactive and genuine.   The treats he provided on our arrival made us feel very welcomed.  The subway, local restaurants, supermarket, laundromat, bottle shop ... all on the doorstep.  A great location and we would stay again!

Mateo, Greg, and Apollo🐶 were great hosts! We arrived super late but address was easy to find and host was waiting for us with slippers and bottled water. Location has great access to trains- you can see the shuttle stop from the front stoop. Apollo is a sweetheart - totally respectful and quiet. We’d love to stay here again next time we’re in the city.
Calidad-precio merece la pena

I had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb in the Bronx! The place was spotless—both the room and bathroom were exceptionally clean and well-maintained. Everything was thoughtfully organized, creating a peaceful and quiet atmosphere that made me feel right at home. I truly appreciated the privacy and comfort throughout my stay. The check-in and check-out instructions were crystal clear, making the whole process smooth and stress-free. Most importantly, the hostess was amazing—always kind, responsive, and genuinely caring. Her hospitality made all the difference. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a relaxing and hassle-free stay in NYC!

Diana's place is very charming and has a wonderful taste. Diana and Marco were so generous to have let my luggage placed before check-in and after check-out. The location of the house was just 5mins away from the station and very easy to commute to Manhattan and Brooklyn. I loved staying there and I highly recommend this place for everyone!

Our stay in Tom's apartment was really nice ! Clean, with style decorated and cozy. Everything what we needed for cooking we had in the kitchen. Definitely we would book that apartment for our next stay 😁
Great room, amazing location. Walking distance to all the stores and subway station and Central Park! Lovely host, respond to messages really fast.

It was a great place to stay. The place was clean and according to the description. The subway station is also very close by and takes around 30-40 min to 34th street Herald square Manhattan. The locality was safe and and beds were also comfortable. Its an awesome place to stay and I would recommend to others. The host was also great.

My boyfriend and I stayed here over new year - firstly the apartment was much cheaper than hotels and this apartment had great reviews so we decided to stay.

The apartment is wonderful. It is small however does not feel cramped at all and contains lots of quirky decorations.

East village is a great area as it contains lots of lovely restaurants and bars. Xiren gave us a list of places to get good coffee, brunch etc before we came aswell. It is easy to get about with two tube stations close to the apartment.

As hosts Xiren and Corey were excellent and very helpful. They were easy to get hold of during the holiday and any problems we had they would sort out very quickly.

We couldn't recommend staying here more. Definately will try to stay here next time we are in NYC.

Great apartment to stay in Brooklyn. Kitchen is well equipped. It’s a short walk away from two local subway stations, so it’s easy to get around the city. The area is safe and walkable. We would definitely stay again!

Eric's apartment is up there with one of the best we have stayed in through AirBNB it terms of location, value, cleanliness, style.. The lot! We spent two weeks there, and may have wanted to make it our home! Firstly, the location is fantastic. Chelsea is a great neighbourhood in itself to explore, but even if you're only in NYC for a few days, it's well situated to head uptown, downtown or cross town via subway, walking, running, uber, bike, skateboard or whatever mode of transportation takes your fancy. A lot of eateries, bars and supermarkets close by with a laundromat across the road if needed. The space itself has a nice clean feel to it given the white palette, but also felt homely with some nice indoor plants and choice homewares  (e.g bunny with reindeer ears). They left details about the local area and provided tea and coffee for the stay. Communication was a breeze as well, with the checkin/out process as simple as they come. Definitely recommend this place to anyone headed to NYC, and we will be keen to return in the future!
Wonderful place! Great experience.

Central location close to main attractions, walking distance from Times Square and Empire State Building. Room was small and difficult to move around with two people and luggage but this was expected and the photos were accurate about this. Some improvements regarding bathroom cleanliness could be implemented, but overall our stay was good and the price for the accommodation was a good deal for New York standards. Be mindful that the space is shared so sometimes there is noise from other guests (not the fault of the host). Overall, it is a fine place to stay if you are in New York for a few nights.

I have enjoy my stay as it is so typical, and have just use hotels in the past.
Easy to commute, easy to find something to eat outside.
Just be prepared about the noise outside in early morning as some workers start really early. But, close the windows and it should be ok.

ubicación accesible dentro de Queens, el metro pasa justo a la par por lo que es muy conectado pero tambien si eres de sueño sensible debes analizarlo; el baño es compartido pero posee todo lo que se necesita

Louann’s place is AMAZING. We stayed in the purple room and it was a comfy place to rest between going to and from Manhattan. The room was private clean and comfortable. She and her husband went above and beyond to make it a home away from home, including snacks and food to keep us nourished during our stay. Can’t thank them enough!
Great stay. Love staying at this place. Great hospitality, great location, and very private.
Excellent hosts who went above and beyond. The location is great as well. Right next to the 6 and Q, close to Central Park, and plenty of food and bar options nearby.

We did pay cash for the cleaning fee and were left a note with our change requesting to take the trash out and recycle the bottle and there where no plastic bags for garbage.
We still went ahead and did it but it made us 20 minutes late to an important meeting.
There were also no laundry detergent. We bought some laundry detergent and left it there for other guests to use.
There was also no coffee.
One of the beds was kinda flimsy.
Location was great, right next to the subway. The place was clean. Thanks
Milton was a great host who greeted us at check in. The apartment was very clean and had everything we needed!

Pros: One of the best bnb’s I’ve booked. Clean, comfortable space. Sheila’s response time was under 15min every time. Clear and concise check-in instructions and rules. Street parking was available the entire time, no issues with finding parking. Working WiFi!! Excellent cooling units in each room. I would most definitely book with her again!

Great place to stay,
spacious clean apartment,

Host was great. Very responsive and airbnb was immaculate. Very happy!!
Great staff. Helpful and generous. We were travelling with a toddler and the room size was just right for us. The mini kitchen helped a lot too. We ran out of tea bags and they gave extra supplies.

N’hésitez surtout pas à réserver cet appartement !! Il est parfait, très propre, bien décoré et fonctionnel. Mélissa est disponible et nous a très bien accueilli !

Great place. It is by the subway station, and it’s a great deal. The house was very clean, and so was the kitchen and the bathroom. It’s a great experience.
Hi Tammie, everything was perfect at your house, much better than the information on the website suggests. Your hospitality and your home are absolutely wonderful! Thanks again and see you soon…
El apartamento es mas confortable de lo que dice las fotos. Excelente anfitrión

That being said, some details weren't clear that would have been helpful, especially for a long-term stay. For instance, the washer/dryer is technically in the building but not in unit as I was initially informed; you will have to go outside the building to access the laundry. Additionally, there is a cat in the laundry room, which although adorable, would have been helpful to know about prior. Furthermore, the apartment wasn't ready at all when I arrived. I had to wait 2.5 hours outside the apartment while it was being cleaned, and still had to do some cleaning myself.
Altogether, a convenient spot if you're looking for a place with easy access to many locations, but perhaps should consider other places for long-term stays.

Great stay and value. Nice and comfortable place to stay at in Brooklyn. Jacqueline was very helpful and responsive. The location is easy to connect with the bus and subway if you want to visit the highlights in NYC. I recommend it!

AMAZING PLACE TO STAY!!! Very clean, and very cozy!! Andre was awesome!! Never really seen him, but responded to my messages quickly!!  Rockaway Beach was definitely an experience we will never forget!! ❤️❤️

Fantastic location and lovely apartment. Giampiero was friendly, easy to contact and helpful.

We had an amazing stay at Nick's house. It is beautiful, spacious and stylish with lots of natural light, all the amenities and a chefs kitchen.

Leider ist das Zimmer doch recht klein und bietet keinerlei Platz für Koffer und / oder Gepäck. So hat man bei 4 Koffern gerade einmal 30 cm Platz zum "umkurven" der Betten bzw. des Gepäcks. Es gibt keine Möglichkeit am Tisch zu Essen, da einfach der Platz fehlt.

Gepäck muss bis in den vierten Stock über eine ständig knatschende Treppe manövriert werden.
Die Dusche und Toilette wird von 12 Personen auf dem Stockwerk genutzt.
Dieses Zimmer ist aus meiner / unserer Sicht für max. 2-3 Personen geeignet, die nur dort schlafen möchten.
Für Familien (insbesondere mit kleinen Kindern) ist diese Unterkunft nicht zu empfehlen.
Dennoch hatten wir 2 schöne Tage

Super!

we had an excellent time.  Elizabeth is great - the home was beautiful.

전반적으로 매우 만족한 숙소였습니다. 무엇보다 위치가 매우 훌륭했고, 깔끔했고, 숙소의 디자인 역시 훌륭했습니다. 프라이빗한 공간 역시 아주 만족했구요. 전반적으로 매우 만족한 숙소입니다.
다만, 서비스 측면에서나 의사소통 측면에서 약간의 아쉬움이 있습니다. 기본적인 수건과 휴지, 세제, 샴푸 등이 제공되나 장기간 숙박할 경우 부족할 수도 있을 것 같습니다. 커피머신은 있으나, 기본적으로 제공되는 커피는 없습니다. 냉장고와 식기는 있으나 기본적인 소금이나 후추, 오일은 없습니다. 모두 자신이 준비를 하여야 합니다.
짐보관 등의 추가적인 서비스는 기대하기 어렵습니다. 의사소통은 약간 느린 편이고 게스트 친화적이라기보다 업무 형식적인 느낌입니다. 게스트의 실수에도 게스트 우호적인 양해를 기대하기는 어렵습니다. 이곳에 머무를 게스트들은 정책을 꼼꼼히 읽고 잘 숙지하시길 추천드립니다.
이 모든 사항들을 고려하고서라도 다시 뉴욕을 방문한다면 다시 머무를 의사가 있는 숙소입니다.

sinon l'appartement aurait pu être un peu mieux nettoyé à notre arrivée, spécifiquement dans la cuisine et la salle de bain.

I would not recommend this stay. The host was not present, which appears to violate NYC law requiring hosts to live on-site for private room rentals under 30 days. The shared areas were dirty, and the room hadn’t been cleaned—personal items were left behind, including a vibrator in the first aid bag. The bed was rock hard, the couch was falling apart, and the room was uncomfortably hot unless the window was kept open. I was given one tiny microfiber towel, no toiletries, and a nearly empty roll of toilet paper. The host ignored my messages. The neighborhood felt unsafe—I was assaulted just outside the building—and the price was extremely high given the poor quality of the space. I reported all of this to Airbnb, but was told it didn’t violate policy. This listing fails to meet basic standards of safety, cleanliness, and legality.

I have no words to say how amazing and beautiful the place was I will definitely book again if I am staying in the island it deserves a 5 stars !!!
Everything was good, clean,nice, good man, good location 👌👌
Joel’s place is great! Very comfortable and plenty of street parking. Access is also very private.

Vadim is an excellent host. He met us late at night due to our flight being late to give us a full tour of the Bdlg. As the listing states, the Subway is about 12 minutes (.6 miles away).  Keep this in mind if you need to take it often.  The bedroom looks NOTHING like the pictures in the listing.  It is furnished with inexpensive Ikea furniture and has no drapes on the windows.  Keep this in mind if you need darkness to sleep.  There are blinds but they do not do a good job of blocking the light.  There is NO dresser, and the bedding is a sheet with a duvet insert (no duvet) and a blanket on top.  there are two lumpy pillows.  The kitchen has high end appliances, but is lacking in a few items that would make cooking easier.  There is one small skillet which can accomodate 2 eggs, and no measuring cups.  The wood floors are great and the building seems very secure.  The listing mentions Zip car rentals, but this is only useful if you are a member of the Zipcar program, otherwise, this will do you no good.  Good restaurants are at least .6 to 1 mile away if not further.  There is a very nice rooftop area and a nice gym and lounge area.  the neighborhood is very close to a Costco which is handy if you are planning to stay for any length of time.  The area is on a major street, so there is noise in the morning hours.  There is no regular TV...only internet TV.  Overall, we had a great stay and Vadim was a very nice guy and a great communicator.  The biggest issue was the bedroom and cooking items.
