The apartment is in great conditions and have all the things you will need..  the hosts, Will and Julie are very helpful and will answer any questions you may have very quickly.  We felt the  ambience in the neighborhood not 100% save at night, so just be careful if you are travelling in metro and getting in & out late at night.

Wir waren zwei Pärchen und haben drei Nächte in Sandrines Appartement verbracht. Sandrine war zum verabredeten Zeitpunkt da, hat uns herzlich empfangen und uns für die erste Orientierung wertvolle Tips gegeben. Die Kommunikation war insgesamt freundlich, schnell und unkompliziert. Das Apartment ist sehr schön, sauber, geräumig und sehr gut ausgestattet. Es waren kuschelige Handtücher in ausreichender Menge vorhanden. Die Betten waren sehr bequem. Die Schlafzimmer liegen nach hinten und sind dadurch sehr ruhig. Das freie WLan hat einwandfrei funktioniert. Die Gegend ist charakterisiert durch die typischen Brooklyner Backsteinhäuser. Geschäfte des täglichen Bedarfs und einige Restaurants sowie zwei Metrostationen mit Anschluß nach Manhattan und zum JFK Flughafen liegen in maximal zehnminütiger Laufentfernung. Wir haben uns zu jedem Zeitpunkt - auch spät abends - sicher gefühlt. Insgesamt eine tolle, empfehlenswerte Unterkunft, die Ihren Preis absolut wert ist.

Excellent location and good space for a studio. Jeremy was very responsive with questions/needs before and during the stay. My daughter stayed here for a long college internship and felt very safe and enjoyed all the East Village had to offer. Close to the 6 for getting places and quiet enough for getting work done on the days she worked from home. Definitely recommend working with Jeremy and also this apartment!

Appartamento molto ampio in una zona tranquilla di NY lontano dal traffico di Manatthan raggiungibile con la metro il 15-20 min la fermata dista circa 400 metri da casa. Maurice è un host presente e pronto a soddisfare ogni VS richiesta. Pulizia impeccabile. Consigliato
Absolutely AMAZING!!!! Our stay was great eventhough we only stayed one night. We definitively wanted to stay longer. Fred was absolutely accomodating with our request. THANK YOU!!!!
Great place to stay before a flight. Room is clean. Quiet area. 45min from terminal 8 ticket counter via Airtrain and walking. However, recommend a $18 Uber ride in the morning.

My mom was stranded in New York because of a storm, all flights were cancelled. I was so stressed out thinking where she could stay for the entire night!! She's 72 years old and she definitely couldn't stay at the airport. That's when I came across Lou's place. I just sent a message and immediately I got a response!! My mom stayed there and was amazed by the amazing place!
Lou's family was just so welcoming and loving, they helped my mom settle in and made her feel like at home!!
Excellent setting! Excellent location for JFK passengers. Room was impeccable lots of goodies. And the best was meeting Louann and her husband Elijah. Beautiful people, awesome hosts. A+ (those are my mom's words).
I recommend this place 100000%!!
Thank you again Lou for making this experience for my mom the safest and most comfortable ever! I wish you the best and hope that we get to meet one day. Definitely staying there when I visit New York, for sure!!
Great host.  Cozy place.

Nya and her gf are nice and responsive.  When I joined the house, there was no furniture in the living room for at least 2 days when I arrived.  No wonder there were no pics of the living room, kitchen, and bathroom in the ad.  I checked into the room fairly easily but when I went to bed at 11 the first night, Nya and her gf knock on my room at midnight to hand me body soap and then have the audacity to ask if I’m alright because I looked startled from the rude awakening.  I have no idea why they woke me up at such an odd hour to give me body soap when they could’ve waited till the next morning.  I’m sure the next person’s stay will be better since there’s actual furniture in the Airbnb but when I got there it’s like they had the idea to turn my room into an Airbnb the day prior.

Staying there were fantastic. The location is perfect close to subway and everything you need. The apartment is great, beautiful as in the pictures, clean, excellent shower, very comfortable bed, TV and Internet very good as well.
Ty is great. Very kind and friendly. We felt like we were home. He offered coffee as we arrived and helped us with the luggage. Very kind!!! I would definitely recommend Ty's apartment. It was the first time we stayed with RBnB and we are very satisfied.
It’s been okay , just the WiFi issues sometimes here and then made working at home a little hard but I love the accessibility and her willingness to help in every situation

Notre séjour à été exceptionnel ! Jonathan est un hôte à la fois serviable et discret, nous avons vraiment appréciés séjourner dans cet appartement propre et cosy, fidèle à la description. Si nous pouvons , nous reviendrons sans hésiter chez Jonathan !!!

Overall, Jason’s place is great. When I first checked in, I a had a couple of issues with the cleanliness such as dirty bathroom floor and some long black hairs in the cupboard etc but Jason was very fast to sort things out. The cleaners returned and things were left lovely and clean so after that there were no issues in that department. Check-in was very easy and I was able to check in early and also check out late. The area feels safe and is very quiet at night time except for the odd racer zooming down the street. The subway is a 10 minute walk away and there’s plenty of corner shops near the area. The only couple of criticisms I do have for the place is: one toilet roll for a whole week (I did ask Jason about this and he told me where the spare is kept in the building but there should’ve been more than one in the apartment); only one towel hook; no face cloths, hand towel or bath mat provided (until the cleaners came back and gave me a bath mat); the bathroom sink is very small but that’s easily fixed by just using the kitchen sink. Apart from that, we had a lovely stay and would 100% return. Thank you.
This is a great place for anyone visiting the city. We especially wanted to spend time at the big museums, and this place kept them within walking distance.
Super clean and had everything you would need. Exactly as described. Safe and nice neighborhood.

We had a wonderful time staying with Tokunbo. She was a great host and for anybody not familiar with NY Public Transport the airport pickup is a great otion.
The appartment is as described and has a lot of shopping and eating options close by including an 24 hour 7 Eleven just on the other side of the street.
The connection to the Subway is also great. The A-Train from Nostrand Ave. Station which is a 5-10 Minutes walk takes about 20 Minutes to get to Lower Manhattan and has a lot of options to connect with other lines on the way.
Highly recommended!

Spacious, good location and a very accommodating host who was always quick to respond. As the pictures show there isn't much furniture, but the towels and bed sheets were new and the bed comfortable. Would stay again.

If your aim is to see as many Broadway shows as possible without the cost and hassle of staying in Manhattan, look no further!!!! The N and W trains go straight to Broadway from the nearby Dittmars station, so we were able to pack in a bunch while enjoying peaceful surroundings and birdsong! This spot was perfect for us and we slept well each night. Big thanks to Justin for flexible bag drop off and a wonderful stay! Fingers crossed we can grab this gem next time we are Broadway-bound! Thank you!

Das Apartment von Chester ist perfekt für Leute, die fürs Sightseeing nach NYC kommen. Das Zimmer, Bad und Küche sind sehr sauber. Man braucht max. 5 Min zur Subway und ist mit dem A-Train (Express) unter 20 Minuten am Times Square. An der Station hat man morgens direkt die Möglichkeit mit Starbucks, Bagels oder anderen Lokalen in den Tag zu starten. Chester antwortet sehr schnell auf Fragen und ist sehr freundlich. Wir können das Apartment nur weiterempfehlen.

Nous avons vraiment apprécié "The Brownstone" dont les photos reflètent la réalité.Bien situé, proche de tout, métro, commerces, restaurants et autres, nous avons assez rapidement sympathisé avec les gens du quartier. Nous avons été facilement intégrés dans cette communauté que nous avons découverte à l'occasion de ce premier séjour à Harlem et un seul mot nous vient en tête, génial. Simon est un hôte parfait, toujours prêt à vous rendre service et à vous dépanner si vous en ressentez le besoin et en plus, il est d'une gentillesse.....
Nous y retournerons sans hésiter. Très belle expérience.

Great location and apartment. Due to being on the lower level, there was noise from those living above. Everything was clean and check-in was easy. Polina was a quick communicator. The fold out beds were not the most comfortable, but using the extra bedding was very helpful.

3 cockroaches calmly walked in our room, only one cockroach managed to get rid of. We didn't sleep because we were with the children. We were afraid for the children, the worst experience in this hotel.

I booked this apartment for my mom and aunt and they were absolutely pleased. Thank you!
The accommodation has a good location to easily reach different areas in NYC from. The hotel staff are kind and helpful. Recommended for those on a budget and traveling for a few days.
Very nice will visit again
Julie was an outstanding host. Her place is sparkling clean and the bed was really comfy. She was very helpful and caring.
Great stay! Everything was amazing and the place was very comfortable.

Jeffrey is a very nice person, always available to help you! Strongly advised
Clean, good communication,  very basic accommodation close to LGA.

It’s a great place for a couple , amazing location , such stylish and cute place to get away to. Loved how the place had everything you need. I would recommend this place 1000 percent !
Ms Sumeira was amazing host , didn’t get to meet but she was very quick and helpful!
I would definitely stay here again!
Very nice people, very nice location.
Susi is great! Very nice and accommodating. Went out of her way to make sure we were comfortable in all aspects. House has a very "home" feeling to it. Will stay again!

Host was very friendly and courteous.

Neighborhood was nice
Michael and Sharon place was very comfortable and clean. It was the perfect place for a short getaway with my family for the weekend.

We enjoyed our stay in Christopher's lovely brownstone. It felt like something out of movies for us coming from Europe :)
The location is perfect for exploring Manhattan, as the subway station is located close by. We felt safe throughout our stay as well.

Perfect place to stay away from the hustle and bustle of Manhattan. Only a few minute walk to the subway.

Wonderful find! Clean and welcoming. Old world charm with nice staff and responsive host. Very accommodating. Parking garage close, street parking  available if you are lucky. Walkable to Manhattan School of Music, Columbia, Jewish School of Theology. Neighborhood is quiet and charming. Close to Morningside park. Would stay again!

A beautiful property with free on-street parking in easy walking distance to 2 subway stations. The house is gorgeous with loads of history and lots and lots of space. 6 of us stayed for my husband’s birthday and it was perfect. Maya and Christopher are wonderful hosts and super friendly. We really recommend  this property if you are looking for a larger space to stay with easy access to downtown.

only complaint was the how loud the streets were. There was construction each night and not only that, loud cars. Obviously this is out of their control. Just bring some GOOD ear plugs. Otherwise a pleasant stay. Staff was so nice and helpful!
Amazing stay! I thank you for your responses and being very accommodating!

Absolutely perfect!! Everything!! Negra and Edo are incredible hosts and they made all the possible to make us feel like home.  And they did it! The communication by email had always inmediate answer and they were always thiking about our wellness.  About the appartment...what to say... It's exactly as shown in the pictures. Clean, lovely, cozy... a great place to come back after a tiring day walking throught the city.  And with the best bed I have ever slept in!!!! 50 meters from the subway and 15 min to the center of NY in a nice neighborhood. I would like to speak better english for be able to say all the good things about our stay here.... ;)) Definitively, the best place I have stayed  with Airbnb and of course a place were I'm sure I  will come back again next time in NY. Thank you guys, you made our holidays better.
You literally get a hotel room. Not much to complain about there
Well run Airbnb, clean and near subway.

Jack y el anfitrión (que no me acuerdo cómo se llama) fueron muy amables y comunicativos.

La experiencia fue buena y puede que vuelva.
Spotlessly clean, cute, small studio. Very convenient for a solo weekend in Brooklyn. Extremely prompt & communicative hosts!

Great place, clean and convenient location. The host provided very clear instruction. The parking garage right next to the apartment is clean, safe and not expensive. Thanks to the host! We love your place.

Martha and Pat are the most amazing hosts. They made us feel right at home and shared their space so generously. We absolutely loved our time in their home, would 100% stay again, and confidently recommend this home to anyone looking for accommodations near NYC. It was well located for our interests, had super easy and free parking, and was pristinely clean. We could not have asked for a better stay. Thank you both. Hopefully our paths will cross again.
Helen and Alfred are great hosts! And the place is charming - you feel at home!
No fridge, internet in room 1922 is not good and the outlets are an issue. not real breakfast,  just snacks. Not enough towels,

Kate is a really a nice host !!!

The appartement is very nice and clean, the location is perfect: the neighborhood is really fantastic, lots of restaurants, bar, and nice place to see! Close to the metro too !

Kate makes me really enjoy my trip in NewYork ! :)
Tutto molto curato, ottima pulizia, posizione comodissima, Giampiero molto disponibile... unica cosa da tenere in conto è l’assenza di un ascensore per tre piani di scale

Pulito, vicino alla metropolitana e prezzo molto competitivo. Alcune stanze non erano ben oscurate e si sentiva il rumore delle strade circostanti trafficate. Ottimo il rapporto qualità/prezzo.

tout etait parfait j
Great space and location with everything you need in the city.

I had a lovely stay at Andrew’s apartment. The room was super clean, had a ton of light, a great view and the bed was comfy. The location was perfect! Surrounded by nice places to eat and cool stores. The metro is a short walk away and it felt like a safe neighbourhood. Would come back again!
Wing is a very considerate host and the place is one of a kind. Greatly enjoyed my peaceful retreat without having to leave the city!

Jeffrey was such a great host. Went out of his way just to ensure everything is in order. Will definitely recommend his place to friends and relatives. Will book his place again on my next visit to NYC!

This place really exceeded my expectations! Because of some of the reviews, I was expecting a small cramped run down space but it was absolutely none of that. The size was perfect for what you pay and we didn’t have any issues with the elevator being busy. The place was very clean and well kept, and the hotel staff was just wonderful. The best part was how close it is to everything, I definitely feel like I got very lucky finding this spot and I would recommend staying there.

The stay at D's was uncomplicated and very clean. It took us almost 2 hours to get to her place by metro from the airport, so if someone wants to save money by not taking a taxi (60 dollars), keep that in mind.
The dogs were very cute, Mia and Enzo. But you always need to close the door when you prefer them out of your room. Even though they just wanted some cuddling!
The metro station is directly on the opposite site of the building, there is a mini shop around the corner with delicious freshly made sandwiches. Also a supermarket just two minutes walking distance. Very cheap in comparison with the rest of NY.
The room was clean but the windows were somehow broken,not fully isolated. It got pretty cold in the night. The heater is rustic and loud but spends a lot of warmth. The walls are very thin. If you're a light sleeper - this might not be the right place for you.
In spite of the points mentioned above we had a very easy and uncomplicated time at D's place. She was very nice and she provided bath utensils for Airbnb guests! No hesitating in asking D for something, she was always helpful.
Appartement propre et calme, bien entretenu, facile d'accès et bien desservi. Le seul petit hic est la fréquentation du quartier le soir

Soggiornare da Alfred è stata un’esperienza unica e piacevole. Trovarsi nel cuore di Manhattan, a pochi passi da Penn Station e Times Square, è davvero impagabile.
Le stanze, più che camere tradizionali, ricordavano le cabine di una barca: piccole ma incredibilmente funzionali, con tutto il necessario a portata di mano. Il bagno era pulito e confortevole. A disposizione degli ospiti c’erano tè, caffè e acqua fresca, sempre pronti.
La colazione, vegetariana, era a base di prodotti genuini e di qualità, con muffin e scones freschi preparati ogni giorno.
Il personale era estremamente gentile e, anche quando era necessario richiamare all’ordine per garantire silenzio e rispetto degli altri ospiti, lo faceva sempre con educazione e cortesia.
Durante il soggiorno ho avuto modo di conoscere persone cordiali e curiose, che hanno reso l’esperienza ancora più piacevole.
Un luogo in cui tornare sicuramente!

Blanca & Teddy were lovely hosts, kind, helpful and welcoming. The apartment is spacious, immaculately clean and extremely comfortable, with all amenities and a great kitchen. The location is great too. A two minute walk to the subway, supermarkets, excellent restaurants and a short stroll to Central Park and the museum strip.

We will definitely be back! Thank you so much Blanca & Teddy!
Great Stay. Would stay again.
We had a great, short stay for the weekend! Very easy check-in and check-out

De hoofdfoto, de woonkamer, is de reden waarom mijn dochter het pand had uitgekozen. Volgens mij was het niet de bedoeling dat we daar gebruik van zouden maken. Maar we hadden genoeg aan de keuken en de slaapkamers, omdat we toch vooral in de stad waren.
Het is een lekkere rustige plek en Marialuisa is een fijne host.

Responsive host who puts the needs of the guests at the center of the equation.
Centrally located apartment with easy access to everything - subways, restaurants and shops. Nick’s space is bright, roomy and clean. The overall energy of the place is nice, upbeat yet serene.
A perfect place to relax and unwind. While it’s located in a somewhat industrial area, the space itself is quiet, comfortable, and very enjoyable.

The space was perfectly clean and comfortable and was a great spot to relax and recharge after a full day.
Walking distance to a handful of restaurants and coffee shops with incredible food.
Ben had great communication and left detailed instructions for check-in and check-out which were very helpful.
Would definitely stay here again in the future and recommend it to anyone who would like a comfortable place after a long day in NYC.

This is a perfect apartment for a restful night’s sleep after a full day taking in all that Brooklyn and the greater NYC area has to offer.  Property was immaculate and very comfortable. Location is ideal, tons of coffee houses, restaurants of all types and fun things to see and do. Plus an easy commute to Manhattan.  It was quiet and felt secure. There were even some very nice touches in the snacks and beverages/coffee provided. Thanks so much for our very pleasant stay. We hope to return soon!

This was a bucket list trip for my husband and myself. The place was beautiful and clean. Great location. Our hosts were so kind and knowledgeable anytime we had a question the immediately responded. They also had wonderful recommendations of places to eat, shop and see the beautiful holiday light. I would love to come back again when we have even more time. We loved it here and made unforgettable memories.

We had a great 6-nights stay in this spacious, well thought-out apartment!
The place has everything you need, as you can see from the description. The bed is comfortable and the shower pressure is good. The kitchen is fully stocked with cookware etc. The neighbourhood is as expected - not the cleanest, nor the quietest, but conveniently close to the subway and trains going to Manhattan (a half-hour journey). It's mainly Spanish-speaking and Asian immigrants living in the area. A lot of police at subway stations and on the streets, so it's quite safe. We had a wonderful time, no problems whatsoever and would definitely come back when visiting NYC. Highly recommend!

Fantastic stay! the rooftop was beautiful at night to watch some old NYC movies and eat Chinese food ☺️ The hotel was very clean and modern, comfortable bedding (a bit hot/sweaty due to the slip, but that's not a big deal) and in a decent location

We had a great experience staying at Christopher’s townhouse for my brother’s graduation! Nice location, and had a lot of privacy considering we were in one of the busiest cities in the world. Would highly recommend!

Sehr empfehlenswert. Die Subway ist vor der Tür, ein paar Geschäfte für den täglichen Bedarf. Die Küche ist sehr gut ausgestattet. Schön, im Garten zu sitzen. Wer mit BedStuy vertraut ist, wird die Wohnung und die Lage sehr schätzen.

Great apartment!

Great location in Greenwich, in a great neighborhood, with easy access to the subway. Also had fun just walking around the neighborhood and stopping for a bite to eat. Apartment was very clean and had all the necessary amenities. Would definitely recommend!
Clean, accommodating and smooth move in/out

Had a good stay and despite one hiccup with the front door mechanism locking me inside, had to call a number to get it to open which seemed strange. But other than that was a good stay and definitely worth it based on location and amenities provided, and there were nice complimentary cookies.
It was a beautiful home and great environment, the host was very accommodating and helpful. She was also a sweetheart I would definitely stay again!

Insanely accommodating, everything was beyond great! The attention and service we received from Mohamed was amazing and greatly appreciated. Definitely will stay here again! Thank you again Mohamed for allowing us to stay!
great last minute option and would be a great first choice. a little bit of an odd layout, but very comfortable!
Clean place and good located in NYC

Susan and Rick were extremely helpful and welcoming. Quick and straightforward communication. The space was cozy, quiet and charming with lots of cable channels and a nice A/C unit. They have an amazingly sweet, welcoming, & fun cat who is a great ambassador for their space. I really appreciated how easy they made everything & how they made me feel at ease & at home.

Greg & Adriane's place was amazing and exceeded our expectations. Greeted by a beautifully designed space and great tips regarding the nearby services and amenities, we couldn't ask any better. Nice apartment, you can live here für month. Amir was very helpful. We had a self caused problem, he helped us very fast.

Chuck and Tiffany were great hosts and responded quickly to our queries and even sorted out a babysitter for us.  The apartment is in a great location, close to lots of nice restaurants and walking distance to Brooklyn Bridge Park.  It is also great for children with a fantastic little garden with a treehouse.

Lovely place, terrific host, great smoothie😊👍👍

She was usually not around, otherwise she tried her best to stay at her own space and gave me privacy. The apartment has everything you need for a short stay.  There is also a laundry room in the building, which was convenient for me to wash my clothes. Overall, I think the value of the Airbnb is great for what I got from Melissa. Thank you for hosting me!

Alla’s place was amazing! Pictures didn’t do it justice, I felt very comfortable and at home. Her Airbnb was beautiful and close to the subways(only a couple minutes). Alla was also extremely helpful and responded quickly. Thank you Alla for the great stay, will book again when I’m in town :)!
It was a pleasure to stay at the Box House Hotel. The room was very beautiful und comfortable. Highly recommend!

KerryAnne’s Place was outstanding. If you’re considering booking this location, go ahead and do it—you won’t regret it. Situated in a quiet area, it is within walking distance to the bodega, Walgreens, and local fast food restaurants like Popeyes and Dunkin Donuts. Additionally, it’s conveniently located not far from the airport.
The pictures online do not do this place justice; it exceeded all expectations. The property is spacious and beautifully furnished, with a particularly impressive living room couch. The security system was top-notch, providing an extra sense of safety. The host was exceptionally attentive and ensured the house met all guests’ needs. Don’t hesitate—book this place now!
The home was exactly as it was listed and Christina was a great host. Very comfortable room and I look to return in the future.
Great location and very welcoming host! Would highly recommend!
Waldemar was very friendly and welcoming.  Great neighborhood, easy to find, comfortable accommodations.
Had a great stay. The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was easy to communicate with and very responsive. Would definitely stay again.
Very kind, reactive, and welcoming host!
Our stay was very accommodating to surrounding attractions and Wanly was the best host!! Response time, genuineness and cleanliness were very superb. I would definitely stay at this location again!

Soon and Francine's apartment is ideally located in a safe cosmopolitan area, close  to numerous restaurants, transport and music venues. Soon and Francine have a great knowledge of New York and are very helpful.
Jessica, thanks for sharing your lovely apartment. I enjoyed my stay. Dorothy

Al's place is very clean.  The bed was comfortable and the neighbourhood is safe. It's also very near the G line on subway. Al was always in contact over messages and gave his guests full privacy. I didn't see Al throughout my stay at all but he answered all my questions whenever I have any. I think it's value for money 😊
Richard is a flexible host with a great place, especially for our needs which was to sleep and commute into manhattan. Will stay here in the future :)

What a wonderful experience! Agnes was an amazing host, even doing tons of extras like free water and breakfast that I never expected. The room was both large and comfortable, we fit 2 people in easily. The location is a true gem, an interesting neighborhood where I always felt safe and only steps away from the train to city center and anywhere else. Highly recommended.
Jesse was very kind and helpful. Thank you.
Unbeatable location; spacious and comfy apartment; and helpful and gracious hosts. A perfect combo!
Good location and good price

If your algorithm led you to this place, this is a must-go! J is a super nice host who is very considerate and thoughtful. He was just right there whenever I needed some help and took care of it like a pro. Plus, he knows lots of hidden gems of the city so you might just find some true local spots! The location, needless to say, is perfect for you to access the Midtown area. Also, it’s close to piers and esplanades along the Hudson River which I found really delightful to walk and run. The place itself is clean, tidy, quiet and calm. It was so nice to have a little sanctuary where I can enjoy relaxation and tranquility in the middle of a loud and noisy city. Overall, it was truly a fantastic stay for me. I hope you find this helpful and wish you to be the lucky one to stay here as well!

This beautiful home is spacious, clean, comfortable and is located at a very convenient location. We walked to coffee shops, convenience stores, drug stores, banks and subway stations all the time. We felt at home right when we arrived.
The best part of our stay was that we got to know not only our hostess Eleonora, but also her very cute pet dog Pupton.
Eleonora was very warm, thoughtful and accommodating to our needs, she is also very generous to share everything, including Pupton, with my daughter and me. Her hospitality was definitely why we enjoyed our stay so much that we wish we could have stayed much longer.
We spent a lot of time playing with Pupton, he's well behaved and a lot of fun to play with. During our four-night stay I totally fell in love with this warm, personal and adorable little friend of mine, in fact, I was in tears when I had to say goodbye to him.
We look forward to seeing both of you very soon, our dear friends, Eleonora and Pupton!
Anne was amazing, very easy to comunicate with. Very clean an cozy space. Close to The Subway And treat us very well.
This is our Second time staying at this place and its wonderful! Super close to the subway, clean, and the host is the best!!! We will stay again next year!!

Die Unterkunft ist sehr gut gegenlesen. Leider mussten wir noch pro Nacht 35 $ zusätzlich zahlen. Irgendeine Service Gebühr. Ich hatte im Vorfeld gefragt, ob noch Gebühren drauf kommen und leider keine Antwort bekommen. Das sollte man wissen.
Ansonsten war das Zimmer wesentlich kleiner als auf den Fotos dargestellt.
Für uns war die Lage gut.

What an incredible experience! This beautiful place gave my family a perfect home base for the week that we came to explore NYC. All communication with our host was timely, accurate and helpful at every step. So many fantastic restaurants within just a couple of blocks, but our favorite meal that we had came from turning your fresh basil from the fabulous back yard garden into a yummy pesto in the house's fully-equipped gourmet kitchen! We all slept great on the comfy beds and enjoyed the Boll and Branch linens. 5 out of 5 stars for sure!!!
Great location, extremely silent, you will have a good sleep, very clean modern furnitured, good value for money. Our room has two windows facing wall a bit dark until noon when sun finds the way.

Very beautiful space and very clean. No issues and very accommodating host! I loved the decor and we had a lot of parking and actually had no issues that needed fixing. Would definitely come here again!

Large rooms, Beautiful decor, Warm and Inviting... Great location for bus routes, and subway stations in walking distance. Dawn and her father were extremely helpful and welcoming.  We arrived to beautifully typed up instructions for local transport links, a handy manual displaying various attractions and routes to them.

I had a great stay at Ronald’s. The unit is clean and quiet. It’s close to two train stations and there are lots of great nearby places to eat and grab coffee. I also enjoyed speaking with Ron and Sia. I ran in Central Park-less than four blocks away, most mornings I was there. I would stay here again.

Daichi’s place was great for a quick weekend getaway. The location had a lot nearby while being quiet and residential. Daichi responded to messages quickly and check in was easy. Would definitely stay again!

Kelly is a fabulous host--very attentive, excellent communicator. Everything about our weekend in Park Slope was perfect. We would love to stay in this beautiful, sun-drenched apartment again. Delightfully decorated space with amazing books and architectural details.
Cute and cozy room in bedstuyv close to the subway A and C. Friendly and super nice host solved any issues almost instantly. Great stay. Great price!
We had a great time staying at Eric’s place. The location is perfect and the apartment definitely exceeded our expectations. Would recommend!

This was a great neighborhood, close to the 7th Avenue Subway station, a great market, nice little Italian restaurant across the street (that we were extremely grateful for after our long day of traveling) and within walking distance to Prospect Park.  We loved it!  The apartment was immaculate and the perfect size for the two of us, and we appreciated the coffee and tea so we didn't have to run out first thing to get our caffeine.
Super clean and very quick responses. Super friendly and flexible with your needs!

Good value, great spot to explore nyc!
+cute dogs ☺️
We enjoyed our stay, fine and clean appartment. Public transport (bus) could be better but we got used to it

The accommodation meets expectations. Alexander is a very friendly and attentive host. He is always in touch and ready to help. The place is quiet, calm and safe. There is a convenient access to the ocean. I travel with my family and recommend this accommodation to all travelers.

Definitely a gem for the price. It’s a smaller unit (which shouldn’t be surprising in NYC) but in a great neighborhood. Lots of restaurants around and an easy walk to Broadway shows. Michael is also a fantastic communicator and host.

I booked a room in this flat, turned out I was alone, which was great. There are two other rooms, sharing the amenities, which isnt entirely clear from the info. If you had a small group, this would be a great flat to take in its entirety. The real question is about location - it is in the Bronx, you do walk past people filling pipes and/or staggering under opioid influence. Nothing happened to me and I never felt threatened. But some might. The subway is 5 minutes walk away, the ride into town takes about 50 minutes. Most things in NYC are probably in Manhattan. But you gets what you pays for - this place was much cheaper. The kitchen and bathroom were good, if I was staying there with other unrelated tenants, I would want a lock on the bedroom door.

Ester's place is located very close to the light rail and to excellent local shops. The neighborhood is quiet, clean & safe. We were less than 10 minutes away from LGA (20 min by public bus) and logistics to Manhattan were simple, straightforward and inexpensive using public transportation. The room was clean and fresh (no smells of smoke or animals) and the fruit she provided in the morning for breakfast was a nice touch. Ester, thank you for opening your wonderful house and your heart to us on our trip!

L'appartement est très propre et à  5-10 min du ferry gratuit qui relie staten island à  Manhattan. Les hôtes sont très sympas et n'hésitent pas à partager ! On a vraiment fait comme chez nous la cuisine est équipée et la déco sympa.
Nous avons passé un excellent séjour chez Robin ,un accueil top,et une grande gentillesse .L’appartement est très bien situé et très calme .
Eric’s place looks as it is listed for the most part.
Sweet cozy room in tiny apartment exactly as pictured. Street parking was easy and Rory was very responsive.
Amazing stay, highly recommend

I stayed here for three months while interning in midtown. Dianna is an excellent host. The place is always clean and I always felt welcome. I loved the cats very much and feel sad to leave because I will miss them a lot. Both the cats are angels. The only con according to me is that all subway stations are at least 16 mins away walking. However downtown itself has a lot of restaurants and bars so depending on what you want to do you may not have to move around so much. The room is perfect. There is a bed and a couch. The bathroom was always clean and I never had any issues. The place is also quiet and I never had problems sleeping. There is also an AC right in the room. The rest of the house is also pretty cool even during hot temperatures outside. The kitchen is also nice and I used it intermittently. Dianna and her daughter also very nice with sharing their kitchen.

Neighberhood was very calm and pretty.
Room is quite large, bed is not very comfortable, but it's ok;)
Marley is very symphatic and helpful person.
Perfect for what I needed during my stay in the city!
Perfect. I stayed briefly but Anisia was responsive, helpful and even helped me retrieve a gift I had left behind. Will definitely be returning. Thank you !
We really enjoyed our stay. Apartment was even better than in pictures. Great location and had no problems with anything.

Grand appartement à Brooklyn dans un quartier calme juste à coté du Subway donc très facile d'aller à Manhattan en métro (15 min).
Belle cuisine bien équipée, literie très confortable. Prestations de qualité pour une famille avec 2 enfants.
A 25 minutes de marche du parc botanique, à 2 arrêts de métro de Dumbo.
Nous recommandons chaudement cet emplacement.
Mia est réactive dans ses réponses. Elle s'est même arrangée pour nous trouver un endroit où laisser nos bagages le jour de notre départ pour que nous puissions profiter de la journée avant de reprendre l'avion.
Perfect place for us! Very accommodating. Very comfy cozy location and easy access to the city.

Anfitrião Antônio muito cortez e solícito. Sempre pronto pra ajudar. Ótima localização, a estação do metrô fica à poucos metros do apartamento. Somente 3 paradas para Manhattan. Quarto confortável. Com certeza me hospedarei mais vezes. Recomendo!!
Tracey is a great host. The house was pretty clean. Enjoyed my stay here.

We enjoyed our stay in this  comfortable and clean accommodation in Brooklyn at Queens side in a quiet quartier.  Handy to have deli shops close by. Twenty minutes walk to the express metro line to Manhattan Downtown.

Julie was a fantastic host, very accommodating and easy going! The apartment was spacious and cozy, definitely felt at home here. Thank you again for allowing me to stay in your wonderful home. Will definitely be back! :)
This was a very nice stay. Very close to a subway station, easy check in and access. Petra is very friendly and helpful.
Everything is exactly as described. Best coffee! Best mattress! Best host turns to be best friend! Can’t wait to see you in October!
Literally was perfect , Joshua was the perfect host. Definitely will book again !
Great place to stay at
AMAZING PLACE! Loved the instruments. Played some piano! Chess board is great! The art is amazing and it’s so unique and so much thought out into every inch of the space! At a great price!
Great place. Felt safe in the neighborhood. Close to the train, restaurants, coffee. Great location

Problemloses Check-In/Out.
Das Zimmer war reduziert eingerichtet.
Es gab nur einen Nachttisch. Es fehlte ein Tisch und ein Stuhl.

Mark, and his place, are both gems. The place itself has historic charm with modern comfort. If you like living like a local while being treated like a valued hotel guest, it’s perfect. Mark himself went above and beyond, first by making it easy to check in early after a red eye, and then by informing me that I had left the door open (accidentally) and easily helping to have a neighbor come and lock it up for me. He wasn’t upset, just chill. These things really matter. Oh yes, and having a parking place open to us right in front of the house? Game changer. Only drawback is the neighborhood, while up and coming, doesn’t have many coffee/restaurant options and does get loud as it’s next to the main road. Given the cost and all I said above, it’s an incredible value still. I will definitely consider staying here again.

Great, clean apartment, easy self check in, helpful prompt communication by host.  Fantastic location for subway to anywhere but also East Village is a great place to hang out.  The apartment is close to lots of amenities restaurants, bars, market, supermarket.  The apartment is at back of building so nice and quiet.  Great place!
This place was excellent. Super clean, Jiang was very quick to respond and respected our privacy. Would definitely stay here again!
I stayed and left happily was bit loud building kinda, sounds could hear from everywhere. So my sleeping wasn’t best :(

Karen was an outstanding host. Quick response and very kind. Her place was way better than I was expecting and much larger than most New York apartments. The house was very clean and stylish. Completed renovated. She had a basket of snacks, lots of coffee and creamer, drinks in the fridge and lots of kitchenware to use. The neighborhood was very quiet and parking was easy to find. My family enjoyed the stay and look forward to booking this home again.
Loved staying here. Felt like home. Will definitely stay here when i am in new york again!!

Christina is probably the perfect host. She was very welcoming and answered tons of questions we asked about everything at our arrival. She even looked up the conversion between celsius and fahrenheit so we could understand the weather. Our second host, Winki the cat, was also very kind. I think he liked us as much as he liked staring the wall. The apartment was great (don't know why but I really liked the bathroom) and really close to Manhattan, but as we were told - and it turned out to be true - there were a lot of great places in Williamsburg as well. We almost bought everything there to bring home as gifts. This was our first airbnb experience and our first trip to the US. Christina made it perfect and I hope I could say that all of us became friends by the end of our stay.
Linda and Robert are terrific hosts. They have a lovely family and made us feel welcome. They helped us a great deal on our first visit to NYC. Gave us many tips. We would recommend them.
Warm house and happy to live, but some windows and door lock were unworkable, anyway we are appreciate living and having a nice week, thank you.

I really enjoyed staying at Patrick’s place, especially for the price paid. The TV, AC and toiletries offered were very much worth every penny. The surrounding neighborhood is rich with Brooklyn culture and interesting locales.
Charlene’s air bnb was so comfy and clean! Great area, and accessible parking:) We really enjoyed our stay here!
There is a $40 hidden fee right away when you check in. Checking in with the self help kiosks was extremely slow and annoying. Place itself was okay and matches what was seen in the pictures.
Pat was a great host, and offered a very clean and comfortable room. I would stay here again!
This place is the perfect size for a weekend in NY. Very close to subway and a few food shops. The place is nice and clean.
Michael’s place is clean, comfortable and in a super convenient location. It had plenty of space for us. It was quiet and peaceful. Would book again!

An amazing location. Right in the middle of the action in the West Village. The corner apartment has windows like few others in the area. Great light and a great space. Blake was easy to deal with and it all quickly felt like home. We will definitely return.

First, I want to preface this that have I never had a bad experience with an Airbnb. So leaving not a 5 star makes me sad. The good: Check in was smooth, communication was great and the place was cute. But truly meant for 6 not 8. But when we got there it was cold. We found AC units in the windows with outside (22 degree) air coming in. When I messaged about whether they had an extra space heater, I was then called by the concierge to be told at that time there was a giant hole in the wall. It has been there for two days and people would come the next day to fix it. We had to sleep in air with a hole in a pre-war building which could be toxic. Men did come the next morning, yet they woke us up as we were not told a time as a warning.  They did fix the hole and removed the AC units sealing the walls so after that it was warm and cozy. I did not realize to tell Airbnb then but now asking for a small refund of 50% off first night, host refused. Sad as rats could have been in the walls. :(

I recently stayed in the lovely home of Marlyn and Hollis. Their entire property is amazing. Super spacious home and yard area. We had 6 adults and were more than comfortable. The host were so very gracious and welcoming. They provided everything we could and for and MORE !!
I will certainly be coming back to Brooklyn and staying here. The home is in a nice family neighborhood; we were able to park our car in front of the house and not move until we left town. Absolutely Love the hosts and their property.

Maurice & Angelica are fantastic hosts. All our questions were answered quickly and communication was excellent. If you're looking to stay in Brooklyn, this historic brownstone with many architectural details is sure to please.
Honestly, the pictures don’t do justice for how beautiful  and comfortable this stay actually is. The host was super responsive, the stay was comfortable and also really clean. It was perfect!
Did not provide a key at the time of rental and check in then afterwards wanted to meet in person. Not safe bad way to start!
Ci ci at front desk was great. Room 401 , rear of bldg, quiet.

Firstly, every bit of the description of this listing is accurate. Martin is a great host, who takes a lot of pride in hosting, and only asks that you abide by the rules setup on the listing. He prefers open communication, and expects the guests clean up after themselves especially in the common areas of the apartment.
Apartment is conveniently located with easy access to Williamsburg neighborhood as well as a 20min ride to Manhattan.
One Note: I wasn't sure if it was listed or not but there's no elevator in the building. So expect to climb three floors.
TLDR: great location, host expects privacy and cleanliness, close to Williamsburg, three flight of stairs to climb.

L’appartement de Jean est superbe, bien équipé et bien situé. Je n’avais pas seulement envie de me promener à New York, je voulais également profiter d’un endroit agréable, confortable et spacieux pour que toute la famille se retrouve et partage des moments chaleureux. Cette location a parfaitement répondu à mes attentes et si je reviens à New York, j’espère pouvoir y retourner.
Super stylish room, and Diane is so friendly and good at cooking,really enjoyed her house and this trip,highly recommend for a vacation and traveling.

Apartamento tal cual se ve en las fotos, muy tranquilo, con todo lo necesario y con fácil acceso a Manhattan (el metro está a pocos metros y son 20 minutos que se pasan volando).
Natalia ha estado pendiente en todo momento.
Muchas gracias, repetiremos!!
최고의 숙소와 그녀의 배려가 있었습니다.
Simple, easy to check in, location about 10 min walk from the G train.

The room is very clean. The shared bathroom is also kept really clean at all times. It can get pretty noisy and the room was extremely cold and you couldn’t control the temperature. Good communication and easy check in.

This is a really great place to stay for anyone wanting to visit New York and stay in Brooklyn. It's a fantastic area with good transport links to Manhattan. The flat is a really nice space, big, stylish and although we didn't make use the garden, it might provide a nice extra for other guests. We would definitely stay here again when visiting New York. Thanks!
One of the cleanest rooms I’ve ever stayed in! Location is great but waaayyy too many homeless people at night.

We had a lovely stay here! It was super clean, cozy and comfortable. Well worth the price to easily hold several people, and an easy 10 minute walk from the Staten Island ferry straight into Manhattan. Would stay again if I return! :)

O apartamento é, na vedade, melhor do que nas fotos. É bastante espaçoso,  recebe luz natural, tem boas roupas de cama e banho, boa quanitdade de utensílios domésticos, dois armários de bons tamanhos com muitos cabides. A localização é muito boa, nos arredores tem bons restaurantes e cafés, mercado, lojas, estação de metrô. O anfitrião é muito rápido nas respostas e muito solícito, voltaria a ficar nesse apartamento sem nenhuma contraindicação.

It was an absolute pleasure to stay at Joaquin and John's gorgeous home, which was as great as their photos suggested. They were fun and gracious hosts (thanks for the morning coffee, Joaquin!), and within a short time we felt very comfortable coming and going, chatting, and hanging out with Maggie, their dog. We weren't able to use their beautiful outdoor space due to the weather, but like the house overall, the private bedroom was lovely, spacious and well-decorated. Being in a low-key but lively residential neighbourhood was also a great change of pace after the frenzy of Manhattan, and the views from Sunset Park were wonderful. We'd definitely recommend visiting!

McArthur’s place was great. The place looks just like the pictures and was very clean. There was a slight storm the day I was checking in and McArthur was very accommodating to letting me check in a bit earlier. His hospitality was amazing and I would definitely stay here again.

My partner and I have had a great first experience with Airbnb. Daniel, his mother and brother were all very friendly, and Daniel was an excellent communicator. This place was exactly what we were looking for: extremely clean, safe, affordable, and offered us easy access to downtown Manhattan. A BIG thanks to Daniel for helping to make our trip to NYC the wonderful experience we had hoped for!

Clean apartment in a safe neighborhood. Cute cafe walkable to grab coffee and pastries.
The apartment's heater and hot water felt good in the cold winter weather. The host was responsive.
If you have a car, budget time for finding street parking. Before check out, tidying and trash disposing are required despite paying the cleaning fee.
Overall, great stay for 1 week!
한 달 동안 이곳에서 머물렀어요. 숙소 너무 따뜻하고 편안하게 잘 지냈어요. 친절한 호스트와 귀여운 강아지와 함께해서 더 행복했습니다.
Wonderful place to stay! Loved our visit!

Shanna was great. She was very nice, showed up at 230am to let me in which wasn’t convenient at all for her.
The apartment itself was just ok but it served the purpose for myself and my dogs while I was there for work.
There is not “on premise” parking as the listing states and the key to get into the building didn’t always work.
There is no longer an air mattress as previous reviews have noted.
Caroline was a very communicative, kind, helpful host with a beautiful apartment. Would stay again anytime!
great location and amazing hosts! would definitely recommend
Great stay again! Very clean and responsive host!

The host was great. The house was beautiful and clean. It was private. Gorgeous furniture. And the host was very friendly and accommodating. I would recommend this house to anyone who wants to feel comfortable and secure and feel relaxed right at home 🏡.

Hôtel Vintage idéalement situé dans un super quartier avec plein de chouettes restaurants et bars près d'Union Square, endroit très bien desservi en transport en commun.
Le service de nettoyage est très bien. Tout est toujours très propre. La salle de bains partagée est nettoyée plusieurs fois par jour. Ce n'est pas un problème de partager la salle de bains, elle était toujours libre quand j'en avais besoin. Il y a un lavabo dans la chambre ce qui est très pratique. L'eau du lavabo est trop chaude à certaines heures et le froid ne coulait pas bien mais c'est le seul problème. Je recommande l'hôtel pour son rapport qualité prix.
Everything was really good. Andrew is really friendly and his place is really nice.
Great Place, Excellent host. Really close to the train.
Safe, friendly, comfortable, pleasant and extremely clean!

This apartment is pretty centric, between 2 metro stations, close to restaurants, delis, supermarket. It is a few short rides away from downtown and all the attractions. It is a good value for the price, but keep in mind that there is 6 flights of stairs. It is bigger than in the pictures.
This place was cute & quaint. Amazing location and close to supermarket as well as other stores.

I highly recommend this place to anyone who is in need of a lot of space in the Queens area. We came into town with a party of 6 and there was more than enough space and beds to sleep in for us all.
The place was very clean and stocked with the essentials. Next time we are in the area and we need the amount of space this Airbnb provides, I will definitely book here again!

A lovely apartment in an ideal location for the subway. A friendly neighbourhood and all amenities within walking distance. The apartment had everything we needed and the air con was greatly appreciated with some very hot weather outside! Sandra was extremely responsive and helpful right throughout our two week stay.
Great location! We had everything we needed right there in the neighborhood. Our host was very response and proactive about our check in.

Everything was exactly as described, very quiet and clean. Parking was stated as first come first serve on the street and for this being New York I found parking on the street over just fine! Would book again

Beatriz and Will were great hosts. The space was very clean and organized and they checked in periodically to see how the stay was going. I would definitely stay here again if I ever went back to New York.
Cara was an absolute joy to meet and communicate with. She made our stay comfortable :D
Great stay. Accessible location, just one block from the subway and close to the supermarket. Comfortable private room. Parking available. Host is very attentive and kind. Would recommend!
Great place and close to the airport! Totally recommend the place. Thank you Carlos!
Angel's place is a great value for an affordable price. It's very close to a bus stop and neighbourhood is quiet and safe. I would definitely recommend staying here.
We had a very nice time at Avraham’s place. Very nice and clean and he gave us clear instructions that made it very easy to find and get in. Fit 7 of us perfectly, it was a great deal!
Ady was great and very helpful.
Great stay, as advertised. Well decorated, clean, organized and well kept

Can't say enough good things about Yaritza's place! We absolutely loved it. So cozy and nice to come home to each day, but also had plenty of space! Stocked with every thing you could think of and more. Absolutely would stay here again. Also, she was great at communicating/responding to any questions. Our trip was fantastic in large part because of the comfort in coming home to a lovely apartment each night!

Travis’ home was welcoming, it was airy, modern and stylish. Heated floors in the bathroom were amazing. The bathroom was amazing, my favorite part of the apartment. California king sized bed was perfect for my sister and I to rest and relax after spending days walking around in the city. It’s located near a ton of stores and restaurants, so anything you need is within walking distance. The home was sparkling clean. Travis was very nice and prompt when we communicated via text. I love this home and if I’m visiting Brooklyn I would definitely stay here again!
Highly recommend this place to stay when you in nyc!!

A great Brownstone experience in Brooklyn. The room is perfect, bed is very comfy, bathroom is well equipped with a nice rainfall shower head. Dee is a perfect host, easy to communicate with and very responsive.

Zainab provided a lovely, clean and affordable place for my first time in NYC! She was very helpful and responsive.
Lex (the tenant) was also very sweet, easy to talk to and helped me navigate Brooklyn.
Thank you both so much!
Amazing host, beautiful home. Absolutely loved it would definitely stay here again.

Very very small but bath is good size and pretty.
Comfy room with good location
We had a wonderful stay! We would highly recommend. It was clean and comfortable and in a great location. Very easy to park and it is a wonderful walkable neighborhood.
Zona tranquilla ben collegata con i mezzi, la casa come da foto e descrizione

Alloggio un po’ datato, piccolo ma essenziale nel cuore di Harlem. Zona tutto sommato tranquilla. Cucina abbastanza fornita dell’essenziale; lenzuola e asciugamani puliti e confortevoli. Mancherebbe un piccolo armadio (anche aperto) per appendere gli indumenti. Silenzioso. Prezzo adeguato all’offerta di NY (che è molto cara per gli alloggi).
In generale esperienza positiva e consigliabile!
Small and cosy appartment, great location, near central park and subway. Gina is very hospitable and nice. We have stayed a really good week

Beauty’s place is in a perfect location! Literally so close to the J train and a quick walk to stores. I always felt safe in the neighborhood, even at night. Beauty was also super sweet and it was a pleasure meeting her.

Earlene’s home is beautiful, modern, very clean and the area is really quiet. Communication with Earlene was great from the start. If I had any questions she was prompt to respond. She’s a very caring host and it shows. I will definitely book this air bnb again.
Jamie’s apartment was centrally located, was clean and had great natural light. Jamie gave lots of helpful tips that only added to our amount of local fun we had! Definitely recommend her place!

Cercano al metro. Zona súper tranquila. Comercios cercanos y restaurantes bien de precio y buenos. Recomiendo a Dely en la esquina. Los anfitriones respondieron rápidamente y muy amables. El apartamento es pequeño pero para 4 personas es perfecto
Oscar's place was immaculate, stylishly decorated, comfortable and well-equipped.  It is located centrally and is a very short walk to the subway, fun cafés, restaurants and parks.

Estuve muy a gusto en la habitación con mis dos niños, el lugar está muy bien ubicado, tiene varias opciones de supermercado, así como de lugares donde hacer compras, cerca de Union Square donde hay varias lineas de metro, hacia otra dirección, esta como a una cuadra de otra línea de metro. El lugar es seguro y tranquilo, aunque supongo que depende de las personas que ahí se estén hospedando, a nosotros nos tocó un ambiente muy tranquilo al interior del edificio. Me gustó que hacían limpieza en áreas comunes todos los días. La primera noche, me dí cuenta que la llave de agua fría de la regadera no servía, al día siguiente envié un mensaje, y esa misma tarde, incluso me tocaron la puerta, para decirme que ya estaba arreglado. Siempre estuvieron al pendiente las personas encargadas, la información que dieron para llegar y para salir, fue detallada e impecable. Definitivamente si tenemos oportunidad de regresar a NY, será el lugar que elija para hacerlo, nos sentimos en casa.  Gracias!

This is such a great place!  The area is so delightful!!!  We loved everything about it!  Super close to great places to eat and the subway is very close. We will stay again and again!!  Do yourself a favor and book it!!!
I don’t think the pics do the place justice! Felt very homely and cozy. We had a great stay. Would stay again
He has great communication

Henry è una persona gentilissima e sempre pronta a soddisfare i bisogni di tutti.
La camera è spaziosa e silenziosa rispetto ai rumori della città.
La zona non ha tutto vicinissimo, ma a 5/10 minuti.
La metro è a due passi.
Se si vuole stare tranquilli lo consiglio, se invece si vuole vivere la città meno.

The apartment was so lovely! Our stay was here was everything we wanted, close to Central Park, great food near by and a clean comfy place to come back to. We had a great time going to Central Park and being there within 5 minutes. The place felt secure, and was clean and had everything we needed. Thank you Jocqui for letting us stay at your wonderful apartment!
The room was very clean and very cozy. The room was as shown in the pictures and the view was nice. Very comfortable stay and relaxing vacations. Local to a lot of shopping and some good food spots.

I recommend this place if you want to be in the heart beat of Manhattan.  But if you want a place to rest,  this is not your à place for that. it's a place to visit  and explore the city, you have the subway  at the next door. We enjoy  our 3 days in the city  there
Un buen lugar para alojarse, muy cercano a zonas turísticas de New York y cuenta con acceso al metro muy cerca
Very nice cute appartment. Very tidy and stylish interior. Kaitlyn responded quickly to requests. I recommend the room!
Great home in a nice secluded area. 10/10 experience I just want to inform you that it gets hot in the wee hours but the A/C units will cool it down
prompt and easy communication, clean spot exactly as advertised, great location in the heart of everything. fun and super smooth stay all around!

I had a great month at this apartment. It was well appointed and had everything I needed already in it, so I didn't need to buy much to get set up. Very quiet part of the UES but still close to public transit and just a few blocks from the Met and the Guggenheim.

Andres and his wife Marina were lovely hosts, and this Dominican neighborhood was perfect for my nearby activities. The area is lively with music, dominoes players, and a constant street festival of items for purchase. There are supermarkets and bodegas and restaurants galore. It is easy to walk to the #1 and A trains, as well as several buses, and a Post Office. I was delighted with the energy and safe feeling of the area.
My favorite Brooklyn airbnb thus far. Beautiful, Wide open space. Clean as a high end hotel. Private bathroom. Amazing stay, especially considering the price.

We had a great time here! The location is central to a lot of
places and very close to subway for easy travel. I loved the big windows in our place.

We had a fantastic stay in Fernando's apartment. The location is amazing, it was so easy to explore NYC all day and night. I was worried about the apartment being cold in the subzero temperatures outside but it was beautifully warm, as was the shower! The apartment is typically New York size but suited our family of four perfectly.
Fernando was lovely to communicate with and attentive to our needs. I hope to stay again
Outstanding location, spacious Property and gracious accommodating hosts.
Easy check in. Very spacious. Excellent for large groups. Quiet area, close to the subway. Street parking. Overall wonderful experience.
Great place to stay, just as described. Comfortable. Close to the areas we wanted to visit and easy to get to the subway. Everything worked out well.
Nate is a brilliant host! The accomadaton is great value and Bed-stuy is amazing.
Recommend for a group
All in all, it feels good!

Emil was so friendly and great to work with! He was very responsive and checked in to make sure we had everything we needed. The townhome was cozy & clean and was the perfect place to stay for the weekend! Plenty of places in the area to go to and the subway is not too far either!

I liked the place it’s small but will fit 5 ppl comfortably, kept hearing clanking or rattling in the room every day we were there I think it was the pipes but other than that it was great and the check-in and out process was great. They also offer luggage storage , we had a bathroom in our room but across the hall there is communal bathrooms with showers
Overall the stay was good. It was kinda hard locating the spot at first.

Nicholas it’s a great host! The airbnb it’s pretty close from subway station, and also there’s so many places to eat/buy groceries.
The room was clean, and it had everything that we needed.
Thank you Nicholas for all your help!

Chris made our first Airbnb experience very enjoyable! He was a great host. He was super flexible with our early arrival and late departure times. Along with that, he had great recommendations for both restaurants and things to do. The location is nice and super close to the C train. Chris was great!

L’emplacement est idéal pour un séjour de courte durée. Proche de la station de métro. L’hôte est super gentil et réactive. Très bien accueilli avec une collation et des boissons offertes par l’hôte à notre arrivé. Je recommande l’adresse.

Marc’s place was a GREAT value for the price and location. You honestly can’t beat it. Close to the F train, you can get anywhere in the city very easily. Tons of cool restaurants and bars within a few blocks. My favorites were 169 bar on E. Broadway and Holy Cow on Canal. There was a sushi place about a 10 minute walk that was SO good. This apartment is a 7 minute walk to a Target and Trader Joe’s, which made things SO easy.
The space itself was more cluttered than the pictures show, but the bathroom was clean and I didn’t feel unsafe or like the building was falling apart, which can definitely happen in New York. I used to live in the city so it was nice being close to friends and made it easy to catch up with people instead of staying further out in Brooklyn or Queens. Marc supplied towels, sheets, pillowcases, paper towels, toilet paper, dishes, wifi and more! Marc was also flexible with my checkout time, as my flight was in the evening. Good experience overall!
We had a great stay at Ca’s! The place was very clean and stylish. Ca and her husband were very helpful and available anytime we needed.

The place was great for our trip. Only feedback I have is that the shower curtain kept falling down which was kind of annoying. Also there is a cut out above the door of the 2nd bedroom leaving it open to noise/light from the living area which wasn't great when traveling with kids.

Excellent place to stay in NYC. Great location and fantastic rooms. Walking distance to Times Square and so many restaurants. It's a time-share building that also acts like a hotel, like ice machines in the hallways.
Clean and comfortable. Everything seemed sanitary - down to the ziplocked remote controls. Excellent water pressure from the shower. My room came with a sink, dishwasher, fridge, micro and plates/glasses/silverware. There was a pull-out couch (which we never used) and a separate room with a king sized bed. Wifi was perfect. Two large tvs fit the bill.
The first impression of the reception staff set the positive tone for a great stay. Oddly quiet room considering the location.
I could see staying there again.
Fantastic to find a great space down the block for guests. Living in NY It is sometimes necessary to find extra space and Roger's space was perfect according to my guest.
Very friendly host! clean and cozy room. Nice building. Everything great

This AirBnB was just what we needed. The area was a little rough but we were aware of our surroundings, did not walk around the neighborhood at night, and once we were inside we felt safe. The place was spotless and updated. Bed and couches were very comfortable. Felt like a mini home away from home. We couldn’t beat the price compared to hotels in the area. The subway station is less than a mile away and we used that to get to manhattan and almost anywhere. Would definitely stay here again for our next NY adventure.
Space look exactly like the photos the host were responsive and it was very clean and homey

The best part was the private off street parking so close to the city!! Awesome stay super close to the bus stop, east to get to the Staten Island ferry right into downtown. We got downtown in less than 30 minutes using the public transportation. Great stay, felt comfortable walking around the area. The actual Airbnb is located on a beautiful quiet street. Jovanna is very responsive! Small place but would recommend to anyone looking to venture into the city
Great hosts, nice room and backyard, and a friendly cat.
Hale is probably the most helpful host I've stayed with. Was super helpful with all our requests. the place itself was great and very cute. Would definitely stay again.
This was a lovely spot in a great location and a great value.
The space has a cool and stylish vibe! The location is great! It’s close to the subway station, and there are a lot of spots near it to explore.
Kathy provides Excellent Services
Carlos place is very spacious and comfortable, parking in the evening was a challenge but during the day was good. Carlos comunícate quick and he was always in touch with us all our stay.
Nice place and close to subway and restaurants. Neat old home and Gil was very nice
Really nice place would com stay again
Really enjoyed my stay here! The place is so cute and it felt like living in new york. Nearby plenty of restaurants and the metro. Looking forward to come back someday!
Awesome place to stay, I felt safe in this area even at night. Everything was clean and comfy. Would definitely stay here again next time.
Excellent super comfortable & convenient

This is a great place to stay, location in park slope is excellent, lovely street and really close to all the shops. Less than 10mins to subway even with three kids.
Beds really comfortable and great brand new appliances. Air con decent and in all rooms.
Overall had a great stay here

This was one of the best Airbnb experiences we have had!  Gladys was so sweet and welcoming and incredibly helpful from check-in to check-out.  The proximity to the subway was awesome and made our entire stay so easy.  We will definitely be back!

Really great location for tourists!! The BQ and F line are about a 10 min walk away and there’s a lot of neat stores and restaurants nearby. The neighborhood was a good location too, I felt very safe walking to the subway alone. Marco was very prompt and helpful with responding to any problems that arose. Glad I got to see this side of New York, I would definitely come back to this place again in future visits :)

Other reviews said, "cozy space"..they were right. Very cozy and comfy as described. Walking distance to everything you need (bank, deli, restaurants, CVS, Dunkin' Donuts, etc..). Shower has great HOT water for the winter, the kitchen has utensils and all cookware you'll need, and the convertible couch/bed is perfect size for the space. I travel with a support dog and was just the right amount of space needed. I'll be staying again in future visits to Staten Island

Steven’s place was perfect for our weekend stay in New York. Not only was it sparkling clean but it was much roomier than other NY apartments. It’s also near so many good restaurants. Steven responded quickly to any questions we had and is one of the best hosts!

Very nice stay. The host is very welcoming and is great at helping if you need anything.
Great opportunity to make food in the kitchen
As far as NYC hostels go, this was a great place to stay for a night as a single person. Everyone was kind and respectful. Fresh fruit and access to basic kitchen supplies was appreciated.
I was so happy I was able to stay here with my dog. Such a cool hotel and amazing location. I’ll be back

Excelente localização, próximo do metrô e de atrações clássicas da cidade. A equipe estava sempre disposta a nos ajudar no que precisávamos. Todos os equipamentos do apartamento estavam ótimos, tudo muito funcional e bom para acomodar grupos, estávamos em 7. Com certeza retornaremos!

A clean small efficient room. Had everything I needed. No coffee or tea in room but I was ok with that. The shower door kept sliding open . I used a washcloth to keep it closed while I was showering to keep the floor from getting wet. The heated towel rack was a plus. A bit warm. Kept the window open for venting bathroom and whole room.

Stayed at Brando's between Christmas and New Year. Check in was simply as was check out. Apartment was neat, clean and tidy with everything we needed.
We were 4, so space was limited but adequate as you don't spend much time in the apartment. Location is its best quality if you're in NY to see the sights. Quick walk to Time Square, 5th Avenue and the park, and Penn Station is a couple hundred meters away to take you everywhere else. Certainly would recommend to others.

Annette’s place was perfect! Lots of space, very quiet so after being out all day it was nice to have a peaceful area. It was close enough to the subway to get around as well. There were plenty of easy to read books on where to eat, etiquette, and more about NY which was super thoughtful as well.

This has to be the best spot to stay in Brooklyn. The art, food, people and experience make this so much more than just a place to spend some time. I loved getting fresh sheets/bedding every day and learning about soca and Caribbean music and art. Do not pass up this experience!!
It's my second time stay in Véronique's apartment.  The location again is perfect, lots of restaurant, cafe, delis in the neighborhood. Surrounding by Shopping and interesting destinations.
Super clean room in a building with security. Great price for the location in manhattan
Wonderful staff excellent rooms and very private. All in all it’s a 10/10

Central Park Suite was cozy, clean, and just what we were looking for on a weekend visit to NYC. The location absolutely can't be beat: steps from the American Museum of Natural History and a block from Central Park, subways, and great restaurants. Our host, Evan, was very responsive and helpful and even offered us an extra night's stay when his next guests cancelled. We're already looking forward to our next visit!

The location is perfect and the subway is literally 5 minutes walk away. Target, starbucks, 7-eleven, sephore and much more stores are also a 5 minute walk away. The only bad thing is that the walls are pretty thin so you can hear all the neighbors in the building and traffic from the outside. The place has all the basic thing you need like a heater, towels, water boiler, hairdryer, microwave and fridge. We stayed here for 8 nights and it was just fine.

Nina! I can't wait to come back very very responsive, nice, and funny. Place was peaceful and had great ambiance for when I had to work remotely or take late night meetings. Accessible to public transportation infrastructure. CLEAN! Hope to come again soon.

I can't recommend this accommodation highly enough. It was very pleasant to spend a few days there, with a large comfortable room, a very clean and practical personal bathroom and good coffees to choose from in the morning. Above all, I particularly appreciated the quality of Richard's welcome, his kindness and his recommendations.
Amazingly beautiful and comfortable accommodation.  My wife and I liked everything very much.  I will be staying here next year.

Charming apartment and the most welcoming host! Our flight came in late, but John was up waiting for us with a glass of wine and a piece of cake. Would definitely recommend to anyone staying in the area.

We had an amazing stay at Atsako and Peter flat . We were travelling with this small children and had absolutely everything we needed. The place is clean , spacious , the host are lovely and there are few subway stations close by and a great coffee shop pretty much around the corner. We felt safe and at home so if you are looking for a place to stay in BK we would definitely recommend it.
Eva

The room was nice, I didn't know there was a shared bathroom and kitchen, but with a room as small as the one I was in it makes sense. Had no problems checking in and the whole experience was smooth and positive

Anthony est un hôte parfait. Toujours disponible et sympathique. je suis resté 3 semaines dans le logement et il m'a proposé de changer les serviettes, les draps de me rajouter du café. Merci encore :)
Le logement est parfaitement conforme à l'annonce et très propre. Étant resté un long moment, je me suis sentis à l'aise dans cet appartement. Je mettrai cependant un léger axe d'amélioration sur la chambre : le lit grince fortement au moindre mouvement et l'absence de volet ou de rideau vraiment occultant. Mais cela reste du détail qui semble n'avoir dérangé que moi :)
Concernant l'emplacement, l'appartement est très pratique et à 15 minutes à pied du métro qui emmène directement à Grand Central. Par contre, même si la rue du logement est charmante, je ne me suis pas toujours senti en sécurité aux alentours du métro, surtout celle à la 125 avenue. Il y a énormément de drogués dans cette zone et l’accès au métro a parfois été compliqué, surtout le soir.
Merci encore pour l’accueil :)

The Local Stay is a great company to work with if you are looking for a no hassle, straight forward visit to NYC.  The accommodations are decorated tastefully and equipped with all you would will need to feel at home.  Their team is responsive and friendly both via messaging and in person.  They are eager to make your stay successful.  The locations are convenient to subways and are in safe neighborhoods.  Highly recommend!
Close to jfk, perfect place for layover for  people to stay over in New York . Quiet and relaxing place with excellent communication always . Safety and privacy was taken well care of .
Great apartment great host
Great spot that is super convenient to everything. We couldn't ask for a better place to stay.

Great location! It's close to LaGuardia Airport (a 10-minute Uber ride) and a 10-to-15-minute walk to the MTA station. The place is easy to find, and the private room is very quiet. I really enjoyed my stay. Sonam is a great host who made things incredibly easy for me; she was friendly, welcoming, provided excellent recommendations, and responded quickly.

We very much enjoyed staying at Josh's place on the Upper West Side. It's a quieter place than one usually finds in New York and the location was great--easy to get to wherever we wanted to go, safe area. Josh, his wife, and his sister were so friendly and interesting to talk to and gave us lots of excellent suggestions about where to shop, where to eat, etc. We had never stayed on the UWS before, so their help was invaluable. As well, we appreciated Josh's quick responses to all our questions or requests. The room was large and very comfortable--we especially liked the huge closet. This is a great place to stay in New York, and we highly recommend it. Thank you, Josh!
Great place. Would recommend it to everyone!
This was a great stay.
The place is not as clean as we expected, but the location is very good to reach with the metro. The neighborhood is calm and nice

Perfect place!
Everything, from the first contact till the check-out were perfect. Eyal's apartment is very comfortable, clean and equipped with everything a person should need to feel like at home. The location is perfect, near of subway and a walking distance of several must go places for tourists in Manhattan. Eyal is easy to communicate, dedicated and helpful. He makes our experience even better then we expected. I strongly recommend Eyal's apartment and hope to stay here again.
Thanks Eyal.

Amazing place, it matched the pictures exactly. Travis was super responsive throughout the stay. We had no issues whatsoever. Quick walk to the train and Fulton Street, which had several stores for all your necessities. The heated floors in the bathroom were a highlight. Also had kitchen appliances outside of a coffee machine such as a blender, and tea kettle.

Beautiful location, very clean and accurately described. The view is wonderful and the lighthouse is super cool. Easily within walking distance to Coney Island activities, as well as a bus line that goes directly to the subway for further afield outings. You do need to have a new security code for each day of your stay, which I didn't realize, but once that was sorted out, there were no issues.
