We had a great stay with no hitches. Check in was ideal with no stress and the night was quiet. My girlfriend felt the area was safe and comfortable, even when arriving late the first night. This is my first choice next time I come to BKYN.

I had a wonderful stay at Liqin room bnb . It was just right for the night . I felt like I was in a room from a 5 star hotel , sheets and Towels was clean and fresh . I would definitely recommend a stay here . But the only thing there was no TV in the room But I still got the rest I needed.Also parking was not that great to find so I called the host and she responded very quickly and got parking on the Premises for a small fee .

I gave a rating of five stars for Diane being a great host,  her place being very clean, met our expectations based on the description and Diane communicated well with me.  For us; the beds were a bit hard.  We are used to sleeping on softer beds.  But, I didn’t want to take a star away for that.  I just wanted to mention in the review for folks who need a more conforming/softer bed.

Wir hatten einen großartigen Aufenthalt bei Sigfus! Für uns war es das erste Mal, in einem geteilten Apartment zu wohnen, und es war wirklich eine mega Erfahrung. Wir haben uns das Apartment mit zwei weiteren Zimmern geteilt und hatten ein eigenes Badezimmer sowie eine Küche zur gemeinsamen Nutzung – alles hat einwandfrei funktioniert.
Die Nachbarn waren super freundlich und haben zu der insgesamt sehr angenehmen Atmosphäre beigetragen. Wir haben uns jederzeit wohl und sicher gefühlt.
Wir würden definitiv sofort wieder buchen! Vielen Dank für diese tolle Experience, Sigfus!
Great place. Great location. Spacious and way better than a traditional hotel. I’d recommend to anyone.
Our stay at Mark’s was great! The check in process was seamless, the location was perfect for our stay in Brooklyn and we’ll definitely try to book again in the future! Highly recommend!

Gisela’s apartment is a lovely apartment for a New York trip! It was cozy, well decorated and had all the amenities needed for a nice stay. It was easy to find, and close to several cute restaurants, transportation and shops in the neighborhood.
Maurice is fun and was a great host. This place was a perfect for 6 traveling musicians.
Très jolie maison et très jolie chambre! Tout était parfait, merci Andrew :).

Mr. James is a great host.  His place is beautiful, welcoming, clean and peaceful. Everything that you need he has it ready for you. His place is like a home away from home (safe). I would definitely recommend it over and over again.

My daughter stayed here for two months and overall it worked well for what she needed. The location was a big plus — the apartment is about a five-minute walk to the train, which made getting around Manhattan very easy. One thing that meant a lot to me was that she felt safe in the apartment and the surrounding area. That peace of mind goes a long way.
As someone helping a young person arrange housing from outside the city, I also really appreciated the reassurance of booking through Airbnb. Renting from afar can come with concerns about scams, so having a legitimate listing and a clear booking process made the experience much more comfortable for us.
The room itself was a decent size, and while the apartment isn’t luxurious, it’s a good place to stay if you’re looking for something simple in a convenient location.
There were a couple of small maintenance issues during the stay — the shower drained very slowly at first and sometimes took quite a while to clear, and there were a few

Joseph is an excellent host. He gives you the only real private room in his entire apartment, makes sure you know how to work the keys, is very friendly and has great stories. He's very respectful and goes to great lengths to make you feel welcome.
The place itself is super convenient located. Only a short walk to Central Park and with easy access to the subway system. Or walking if you prefer! 10/10 would stay again.

Honestly best experience Ive had at Airbnb.  Yochi and Yochi (husband and wife) are gracious, large clean space, seriously accomodating, and great location.  Would recommend to anyone needing to stay in manhattan.   Better experience than the Standard or the W.  10 stars.

It was great! Lamee was very helpful!
It was clean and there's a lot of space!
I'll come back
Nice spot to stay in

Just Wonderful!

We can't speak highly enough about Chris & Zora and their beautiful brownstone apartment. Myself, my wife and our infant son stayed for 5 nights and they did everything they could to make us feel welcome. We had some special requests for our son, crib etc. and that was accommodated.

The apartment is roomy for New York with a bedroom, en suite, kitchen, living room and eating area. The kitchen is well stocked and all appliances throughout the apartment are of great quality and well maintained if not new.

The house is very close (250m) to the subway and there are great local restaurants and cafes nearby. Saranginas and Alice' Arbor would be two favourites of ours.

Chris & Zora keep getting 5-star reviews for very good reasons and ours is no different.
My family and I really enjoyed our stay at Brenda's place.  It is on a beautiful street and the park nearby is a true gem if you have kids. There is also easy access to subways and yummy restaurants.

My sister, my mom, and I simply loved this place! It was just as described and definitely a sanctuary in the city. Margo was very communicative and even when we arrived late because of a delayed flight, she made sure we got into the house okay. We got the pleasure to meet her and she was just as nice in person. The beds were comfortable, the place was immaculate, the yard was so pretty, and we had everything we needed. It was so close to the subway that it was very easy to get around. There was more then plenty of room for us and that is such a luxury in the city! Next time we come to NYC we will definitely check to make sure Margo’s place is free first because it was like a little home away from home. Thanks Margo for everything!

Great place and unique area of NYC! I felt it was very spacious for an NYC apartment. Bedrooms were comfortable too. Everything you could need in the kitchen, but some really good food nearby too. It was fun exploring a different side of NY, I felt safe in this area and the beach right down the block is nice, fun to look for shells and watch the surfers even in the offseason. My son also loved watching the planes coming in from the window! Just a heads up for kids it is 2 flights up and would be good to bring a gate for the top of the stairs, but something could be maneuvered to block it if you aren't able to bring one!
Spent a few days in town for Christmas in NYC! Perfect location. Short subway ride for everything. 10/10!

What a gem in NYC! Newly renovated and cozy space that was comfortable for 5 of us. It’s definitely a treat to have 3 full bathrooms especially when traveling with kids as they take forever. Only couple of flights of stairs so bringing luggage was a breeze. Location is absolutely awesome with subway station nearby and plenty of restaurants. Deemir was a great host and made sure that we were comfortable and communicated all the instructions well. We will be back! Thank you for a great stay.
Excellent place to say in NY! Great ubication and good places near by to go.

R,J is a very good host. He’s always ready to help if you have a problem. You can call him whenever you want. His apartment is really comfortable and it’s also situated in a nice and safe place! The neighbours  were also very gentle.  It was for sure a cool experience and my girlfriend and I will definitely rebook this apartment again!

Ich habe 4 Monate in diesem Apartment verbracht und kann es nur wärmstens weiterempfehlen.
Schon der Check-In hat einwandfrei funktioniert und der Concierge hat mir geholfen mein Gepäck in den 5. Stock (4 Treppen) hochzutragen.
Das Apartment war sehr sauber wie ich es beteten habe und es war schön hergerichtet. Die Ausstattung war für eine Person vollkommen ausreichend und ist auch bestimmt für zwei Personen passend.
Die Wohnung ist fantastisch angebunden: es waren sehr viele verschiedene U-Bahn-Linien in der direkten Umgebung (Umkreis von 10 Minuten). Die Mitarbeiter am Empfang waren immer sehr nett und hilfsbereit und es gab keinerlei Probleme mit Paketen oder sonstigem.
Ich habe mich in der Wohnung wie zuhause gefühlt und war sehr traurig als meine Zeit zu Ende war. Ich würde jederzeit in dieses Apartment zurückkommen.
Beim Check-Out gab es auch keinerlei Probleme und sie waren sehr flexibel mit der Uhrzeit!
Danke an das ganze Bridge Suites Team!

Bertha is a warm and friendly host, and her place is spotless. Clean, good-sized room with lots of natural light, plus the ensuite half bathroom is the cherry on top. Just one block from the 1 local train 207 street station in the Inwood neighborhood on the UWS, and walking distance to the A and C lines at 207 and Broadway.  Great value for anyone on a tight budget!

This place was amazing, perfect for our trip. Dawn & Vernon went above and beyond to make sure our stay was enjoyable. We highly recommend this place, you won’t regret it.
Thank you Dawn & Vernon ❤️

Yang’s place was very clean, comfortable, and perfectly located for the activities we had planned. The check-in process was very easy, and communication during our stay was great. Would absolutely stay there again!
Interfaith is great place to stay. The staff are very welcoming and friendly. The breakfast amenities are great. It’s an easy place to feel comfortable and at home.

Raymond’s place was easy and quite which is rare for New York City. Super smooth instructions to get in and out and the 7 station is a 7 min walk from the Aparment. I look forward to staying there again my next New York trip

This place is in a really cute neighborhood in Bushwick, Brooklyn. If you’re not familiar with NYC (like me) just note that it’s about 45 mins - an hour by subway to all the “tourist” attractions like Central Park, Empire State Building, Manhattan etc etc.
I found the subway really easy to navigate, the place itself had a really easy check in system. The hosts were super accommodating and generous with advice and information.
They do have a super cute dog that gets really excited to meet you, be mindful if you aren’t a fan of dogs, he doesn’t really bother you but will try to be your best friend upon arrival (which is typical).
The surrounding area had great nightlife and food options, it’s extremely walkable and the neighborhood felt very safe to me.
The room itself is very comfortable. The hosts made sure to have comfortable sheets and bedding and I slept like a baby every night.
If you’re looking for an affordable and comfortable place to stay I recommend booking here.
Amazing find. Would stay here anytime.
Thank you Juliette for our lovely, peaceful staying at your cute home and for all your kidness and handful help to discover things about NYC. We wish we have could stay longer. 🤗

Sono stato benissimo a casa di Karen e Dough. Sono due persone meravigliose, sempre sorridenti, pronti a chiaccherare di qualsiasi argomento e a farti un po' di compagnia. Inoltre sono due artisti e in casa vedi dipinti fatti da Karen e strumenti musicali suonati da Dough. Lo spazio è accogliente e la stanza è comoda.
Il quartiere è autentico, nessun turista.
Grazie Karen e Dough!
This place and Ben were great. Perfect tucked away location but still with everything you need right around you.

Staying at Linda's house was great. She wasn't home when I arrived and since I was only there to sleep, I never met anyone who lived there. The room was nice, and having the bus stop just a few steps away is super convenient! I think it's worth mentioning that the bathroom door isn't a traditional door. It's an accordion style door with opaque windows, and a curtain for added privacy. Very pretty, but not entirely private. Overall, this listing worked out great for my needs!
Spent a week here, and had a great stay.  Apartment was as expected.   Easy access to bus and subway.  Kareem was very quick with responses to questions and issues.

Adam’s place was definitely an excellent and well-priced find in such an popular location with quick access to great restaurants and public trans.  While small, it was the perfect place for a quick overnight or brief weekend stay; very accurate to pictures.  Adam was friendly, made it super easy to coordinate, and was flexible with check-in time’s making it a breeze of a stay.
Audra is a great host. I recommend her place to everyone. Very clean, & cozy.
Excellent hosts. Mimi and Andres took very good care of us. Place is convenient and well furnished. Subway stop literally 1 min away.
Cute and clean 😻

We enjoyed our stay at Daphney’s apartment, it was clean and had all the amenities we needed. The subway stations, bus and groceries stores were all within few mins walk.
AC unit in the front bedroom was a little noisy, but other than that no issues. I would definitely stay here again.
Great stay everything very easy

Irene is very friendly and considerate.

The apartment is nice and clean, has a very comfy bed and lots of light during the day.

A great location.
Marie’s place was exactly as described. It’s perfect for short visits to downtown Manhattan. Clean, good space, very nice location with plenty of great restaurants around. Highly recommended!

Herzlichen Dank an Brian und Paul für die tolle Unterbringung in eurem Haus. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Uns hat es an nichts gefehlt und es war sehr großzügig uns den letzten Tag noch bis zum Abflug am Abend die Wohnung zu überlassen. Es ist kein Problem von eurem Standort alle Unternehmungen zu starten, mit der Bahn kommt man überall hin nach Manhattan und was man sonst alles sehen möchte. Auch in Brooklyn selbst in der Nähe der Bahnstation gibt es tolle Geschäfte und Einkaufsmöglichkeiten. Wir hatten eine sehr schöne Zeit. Ihr seid tolle Gastgeber und wir kommen gerne wieder auf einen Besuch in diese tolle Stadt zu euch. Alles Gute für euch von Iris und Ina

This apt was perfect for my trip. I was out and about most of the time exploring but this had everything I needed. The apt was very clean and I was comfortable.
Location and building felt super safe (I was solo traveling, so this was important)
Lots to do around the area - within walking distance of some good food and attractions. And really close to a subway station so very easy to explore. Lee was very friendly and accommodating! Super responsive and I had no issues checking in or checking out. If I come back and want to stay in Manhattan I would definitely book this spot again.
Thank you!!

Anderson was a great host. She was thoughtful and caring. She helped me get through a tough time..
Oscar was also a great host!

Laurence est un hôte très agréable.
Le quartier est charmant et proche de Manhattan.

Jake fue súper amable. Contesta muy rápido a los mensajes en caso de que haya algún problema y es muy claro con las instrucciones de entrada y salida.
El alojamiento está muy bien ubicado y se corresponde con la descripción y las fotos. Echamos de menos un poquito más de limpieza, pero no nos quejamos. Ha sido todo lo que necesitábamos para conocer por primera vez la ciudad. Volveremos!!
Awesome place for a quick stay! Plenty of safe parking on the street if driving. The 5 train station is a quick walk up the block too. Tuan is a great host and was available for assistance if needed.

Robbin and Jennifer helped us out at short notice when we were let down by another host, and I'm really happy we stayed in this apartment.
The apartment is REALLY stylish. Bare brick walls, wooden floors, cool furnishings. Both beds (one in the bedroom and the sofa bed in the lounge area) were very comfortable. There's a turntable in the lounge, wall mounted speakers, and some great vinyl. the kitchen and bathroom are both tastefully decorated, and the kitchen has every appliance to make your stay comfortable. there's also fast Wifi.
Greenpoint is the best neighbourhood in Brooklyn IMO. Great restaurants, leafy, quiet, but a short walk to Williamsburg and easy transport links on the G or L lines. The neighbourhood is also safe.
thanks again for a great stay - and hope to be back soon!
Super nice place, great host.

I had previously stayed at Patricia's for a few days (there is another review by me). After trying another AirBNB location, which was a nightmare, I decided that if it isn't broke, don't fix it. I booked a few more days at Patricia's and it was a great decision. Super clean and great hospitality!
Great stay! Very affordable for New York, clean, enough space in living room and kitchen. Just good!
Privacy and hospitality, not much more you could ask for.
Elsa’s place was the perfect location to stay a couple of nights while we attended the nearby US Open. Her place was very clean.

Everything ok. What you pay is what you get!
Very kind host, flat in great conditions, good location even if Brooklyn is not the best place in NYC.

Our stay was fantastic! No complaints at all. We were definitely glad we chose to stay here. The managers were easy to get a hold of and very accommodating. Our flight got in early that morning so they allowed us to leave our bags in the unit before check in, which was greatly appreciated! If we ever stay in Brooklyn again we will definitely stay here!

Andre’s place was great! It’s conveniently located near the subway and there’s lots of great cafe’s, bars and restaurants within walking distance. The apartment was spotless and located on a quiet street. Andre’s communication was excellent. He reached out to make sure my stay was going well and that I had everything I needed. I’ll definitely be staying at Andre’s place again next time I’m visiting the city!
our stay was awesome
We stayed in Jeremy’s house over Christmas and we had the best time. We can def recommend this place.
Love the house and the neighborhood. Will stay here again if its possible.
Lou is AMAZING!! Great space, given the neighborhood and great hospitality. I’d recommend

I have nothing but good things to say about my experience. From the beginning, Kim was a gentleman and helped with my luggage and making sure I was comfortable. He is always responsive and helpful. He takes care of the property daily- bathroom, kitchen, floors, garbage, recycling- daily. Shoveling and salt was down during storms ensuring our safety. Kim is very generous even replenishes napkins, paper towels, q-tips and toilet paper- something I did not anticipate but was grateful for.  Everything was stocked for daily use and stay. Roomates were kind and respectful, allthough I barely saw or heard them, making my studying and working frm my laptop a quiet and comfortable breeze. Subway, supermarkets, laundry- everything steps away.  Neighborhood and locals are friendly and hospitable. I felt very welcome and safe. I cannot say enough good things about Kim and my stay.

This is the classic example of getting what you pay for. Keep in mind that this accommodation is very inexpensive. If all you want is a bed (big and comfy) a shower (hot and steamy) and a place to make your coffee, then this is for you. The entrance is through the living/kitchen area and the bedroom is at the back. This ground floor is dark and gloomy at all times and not at all inviting. The garden at the back needs serious attention.
My flight was delayed and I arrived at midnight, no fault of mine. The welcome was cold and minimal. I was virtually banished to my room. Next morning Waldemar proved to be more personable and forthcoming with local information. (Some brochures, maps would be useful.) Wifi is fine. I had to provide my own coffee.
The subway is a short block-and-a-half walk and access to Manhattan is easy. Buses are close by.
I wouldn't recommend this accommodation to my friends, without the above provisos.
Great home friendly host
great place. would definitely stay again.

Very nice appt next to central park with all needed equipment. Safe and quiet place, easy to reach via metro.Lisa has also been really nice and helpful during our stay. Nicolas and Catherine (Belgium)

Nick's place was charming.  I really enjoyed staying at his beautiful, clean and quiet studio.  It was perfect for my needs, close to subway, restaurants, shopping and parks.  A true home away from home in a neighbor friendly block.  Nick was so accommodating when I had scheduling problems and worked with me to make things right.  I would stay at his place in a heartbeat next time I travel to NY.

Jason war sehr freundlich und lösungsorientiert, alles hat gut geklappt. 10 min. ( zu Fuß) Ultica AV. Subway A-C-E, 20 min bis Gates Street Subway J. Wir dürften ohne Aufpreis early Check-in und late Check-out machen.
Super Preis - Leistungsverhältnis
Dankeschön

Couldn't recommend more.
Good size studio, well equipped and furnished, modern, clean.
The staff - from the doormen to the online support (especially Lyv) were amazing. Cesar was friendly and helpful when we arrived and throughout our stay when we needed him (we couldn't figure out the cable TV, but he quickly and kindly showed us how easy it is).
There is a communal space and gym area which we didn't make much use of, but are great to have access to.
The area is bang in the middle of where you want to be when arriving in NY. Right next to Korea Town, a block away from Madison Square Gardens, a 10 minute walk from Bryant Park, walking distance to Central Park or Downtown.
Massively exceeded our expectations and the best value for money you will find in the city.
Great people to work with! Gets back to you right away. Easy check in. Beautiful location. Close to restaurants, coffee shop, boutique shopping, train etc. Would stay again!
We had a great stay at RJ’s place! He was a very accommodating host and the apartment was freshly renovated. We didn’t have any issues at all and would definitely stay here again!

Great location, close to Times Square, broadway and the subway. Nice updated unit. Host was very friendly and responded quickly.
Shower had great water pressure.
One thing to note is this unit is a fourth floor walk up with no elevator and no stairs. So make sure you take that into account when packing.
Overall a great stay. Would definitely recommend.
5 star Review. Great stay and a clean home. Very responsive host .

it was a pretty good room but it was overpriced and they charge you for early check in about 100 dollars so I had to stay outside even though there were rooms available and I paid a bit over 400 dollars for a single night aside from those problems it was an okay stay
Nice quiet neighborhood. Easy access to the subway. The place was cute and comfortable. Christopher was extremely helpful and quick to respond when ever I had questions.

Clean, affordable & comfortable room
Accurate to the listing; pleasant staff
Would stay here again
Ika's place is clean, spacious, and he's a great housemate. Neighborhood has everything you could want for this part of town, and the park nearby is good for jogging and views of the Hudson.
Very cozy places, very welcome host and great location!

Mary’s place was a great size, spotless, and near restaurants, coffee shops, a grocery store, multiple subway stops, and a big park. I would recommend this to any friends coming into the city and would stay here again.

We had a lovely second stay at Viki's apartment. It's in a perfect Brooklyn location, and is nicely decorated and clean. Viki is always very helpful and makes every effort to answer questions and accommodates needs. Highly recommended!

Our stay was perfect! The first room when you walked in did not have a window as it shows in the pictures, but it ended up being nice! Fans worked perfectly! My family and I really enjoyed our stay! Very quiet! Felt right at home! And you really can’t beat the location! Right across the street from subway and shopping mall! And bagel shop right down stairs! This place is a gem! Emily and her assistant were amazing!!! Super friendly and accommodating! Love love love! I will be back!

En relación calidad precio es simplemente excelente. La ubicación, la comodidad, la hospitalidad, etc etc etc. Rentamos 2 cuartos para 4 personas cada uno y realmente todos agradecidos con Pamela. Es una extraordinaria host!

Alexis spot and hospitality skills were absolutely astonishing and well put together when it came to the decor. The inside most definitely gives Luxury Miami condo vibes. Looks just like the photos. Will love to stay here again. 😇
It was great! Location couldn't be better

My stay was wonderful. The place is very clean and very comfortable.
It is close to superkmakets, subways and bus stops. The place is very easy to find and the check in was very quick.
I stayed for 3 nights, it was very quiet and peaceful throughout the night, we didn’t have problems with noise at all. The bed and the sofa are extremely comfortable and we got plenty of rest.
The whole vibe of the apartment was very cozy and also quite luxurious. The aesthetic of the apartment is very elegant and pleasing.
One thing that really impressed me is how clean the apartment is, it looks like a new apartment. It was completely spotless, it is also very organized. There is no clutter and no messiness.
Larry is a great communicator, he responds very quickly and clearly to messages.
I recommend this place to everyone, it is absolutely great! You should definitely book it, if I come back to New York I will definitely book here again without hesitation!
Amazing location. Very walkable and central but also quiet. We would definitely stay there again!
Overall had a good stay! A small room but great value for the location and I was in new York for a concert so didn’t need a big place to stay anyways!

This place was perfect for my first airbnb. It’s not in the city so the neighborhood isn’t too loud but there’s still nice food places and stores close by. The subway into Manhattan is also only a couple of blocks away which is nice. The process was easy and Brady was super helpful with anything I needed. I will totally be coming here again.

As advertised, absolutely spectacular.  Alex was a great host before and during our stay.  We were able to street park out front.  Nice market around the corner for the basics.  Neighborhood is a little gritty, but we liked it very much and never felt un-safe, even late at night.  Nice coffee shop on 9th where we started our day.  Fun German restaurant down the block which was also very good.   Cabs rolling by at all hours, we did not use the local public transportation.  Open space kitchen, living room, and deck were as pictured and very cool/relaxing.  We had great weather so the deck was used a lot and it was great.  Beds were excellent, showers and bathrooms, excellent.  Just can't say enough about this place it was great.
The apartment was spacious, temp controlled and comfortable. Everything was as advertised and the host was responsive and friendly.

Die Unterkunft war fantastisch, besonders gut ist die Lage, die Anbindung zu den Zügen sind in paar Minuten zu Fuß erreichbar. Falls man Spaziergänge mag, ist der Central Park quasi ums Eck.
Die Unterkunft war sehr sauber und hatte die nötigen Utensilien und ein Highlight ist die Dachluke, mit der man auf das Dach kann.
Die Gastgeberin Min ist super gut erreichbar und antwortet sehr schnell auf Fragen und macht alles damit es einem gut geht. Sie ist eine nette in zuvorkommende Gastgeberin.
Perfect stay in every way. Would love to book again if available on our next trip to NYC. So quiet and peaceful - felt like our own home in beautiful Gramercy. Host is so sweet.
It's convient and close to the railway station with supermarket around. It's well equiped with all necessities.

Loved my stay at Holiday Inn. This location was so close to everything. I was surprised at the subway system in Manhattan. No car needed as it felt everything was within walking distance. I would reccomend this because it was one the least expensive choices to stay in New York and was close to so much. The host and staff were very friendly.
The room is very clean and the apartment is cozy .. I had a goodnight sleep there .. I stayed only one night everything was perfect 👌🏻

My sister and two nephews and I stayed here for five days during a sightseeing trip to NYC. This apartment was perfect! It was incredibly clean, well laid out so that everyone had enough space and privacy, and despite how busy Eastern Parkway is, it’s a pretty quiet apartment. Also we love the neighborhood, so many cultures coming together on one corner. Great location, easy access to Manhattan. I would definitely recommend it! Shanice was super fast in her responses to us any time that we had a question and it was helpful that the option was open to store our bags since everyone flew in early and left late. Thanks for a great stay!
Thanks for sharing your space with us, greatly appreciated. Everything went smoothly, Great place host is responsive, place was clean and smelled great.
parfait! bien placé et un accueil au top !
Convenient, cosy and warm. Easy communication and lockbox makes access flexible in a picturesque and safe street. Anastasia is a kind and discrete host.

We love Victoria’s place . It was exactly like the photos , open , spacious and very well decorated showing her great taste for art , books and nature . The kitchen had everything we need for make our quick meals . The neighborhood felt safe and quiet . We went for a week at artexponewyork and it was easy to get to the subway . We will definitely stay here again . Yesterday we tried the restaurant locanda 2 blocks away from her place and we love it . Victorias was very responsive and great host❤️
Great place in a great location, I would stay here again!
A beautiful and comfortable place to stay, very accesible and walkable, Amy is a great host, I definitely recommend it!
You have made my first stay in New York way more special with your stories and your tips. I enjoyed the time spent in the apartment as much as outside of it. :)

Lovely apartment with some special extras like the games room and whirlpool bath. Kitchen was very well stocked with equipment as well as a generous amount of coffee pods, tea and hot chocolate plus candy and popcorn for the kids. Very comfy and spacious living area.The location felt safe and friendly. The apartment is close to the airport, so obvious aeroplane noise, but after the first night we didn't really notice it indoors. Kids enjoyed aeroplane spotting in the lovely park opposite, where we also saw turtles and some interesting birds. There's a decent supermarket 15 mins walk away, and some takeaway food places. The train station (LIRR) is a 20 min walk from the apartment, with regular trains to Grand Central/Penn taking 30-40 min.  Not part of the metro system, so it's an extra ticket, which is expensive at peak times. Worked out ok for us, but worth looking at restrictions if you'll be dependent on public transport. Highly recommended apartment, we didn't want to leave!
Spacious & living room pull-out beds were big, close to Chelsea Market was a plus!

What else do I need to say than "we felt like home" !!
From the welcome with all the details on the apartment to the easy communication in advance and during the stay – just perfect.

The apartment is very clean and everything is there what you could imagine to need during your stay. We were a group of 4 adults and that was very convenient. Enough space to put your stuff and two large beds. You would have even more space for additional kids in the loft bed. The balcony is quiet and very green and we loved the spacious open kitchen - living and dining room.

The neighborhood is really quiet and nice and 2 subway stations just around the corner (2-5min walk). We mainly used Atlantic Av. Since you have more lines optional. The C-line from the airport is also very close only a 5-10min walk away.

There is a church in the street where we got invited to join the service when we walked along. A really cool experience.

Thanks Helena for being our host and if we come back we will check in if possible again.
Space was not as advertised and had clear signs of rodents. Canceled as fast as I could.

Herman is a fantastic host! The place is clean, and centrally located. Having this place for a month while I was back and forth from NYC really helped me establish a home base in the city. I would absolutely stay with Herman again!
Great spot, great location. Clean, spacious, open and bright. Would definitely stay here again!

Very comfortable for my family, we needed two bedrooms and that’s not super common in NYC at this price point so we were thrilled to find this place.
We loved the neighborhood; great restaurants and close to the subway. It took us about 30-45 minutes to get to most of our Manhattan destinations and also enjoyed BK exploration as well.
Would recommend.
We really enjoyed our stay in Amy's beautiful unit. It is in a lovely neighborhood and very convenient. Amy's communications were timely. The unit has an upbeat millennial vib.
Hôtes très accueillants et arrangeants. Quartier calme. Proche du métro. Très bien situé. Je recommande
We had a great stay at Ahmed’s.  Excellent location right by the N/W Broadway station, very nice place and very communicative host.
The room was super clean and cozy I would definitely recommend it to a friend
The location was great and easy to find and the description of the space was accurate.  We had a great time while in the city and would stay there again!
Kindness and hospitality people!

Edna & Isaiah’s place worked out very well for a brief weekend getaway for myself and three others. Priced fairly comparable to other local listings, but we were pleasantly surprised with how spacious the apartment was.
Overall nice and clean.
Within half a mile of walking distance to many good restaurants and coffee shops.
The entrance to the apartment is not the most scenic and can be loud outside, however the bedrooms are at the back of the apartment and we were not disturbed by the nighttime city sounds.
Great Location, Nice size apartment , Very clean, Highly Recommended.

Venant d'Europe avec mes 3 grands ados.
Le logement est extrêmement propre, pratique et spacieux.
L'accueil de Marco a été parfait.
Nous avons adoré le fait que le logement se situe au milieu d'un quartier résidentiel Caraibien. Nous avons donc aussi pu profiter de ce coté multiculturel de Brooklyn. Les transports en communs vers Manhattan sont existants, mais à quelques blocs de marches.
Paul was a great host, the place was clean and it was a good distance from the city. Overall, it was good experience.

I’ve been to the city many times, and staying at Morlisa’s for my birthday weekend was amazing. Everything looked exactly like the pictures and I felt right at home. Morlisa was super sweet and helpful and made sure I had everything I needed to feel comfy. She even decorated the room with balloons for my birthday. Every time I come to the city morlisas place will be the place for me!!

Nous sommes restés chez Maribel pour une durée de 10 jours et que dire si ce n’est que tout était absolument magique.
L’appartement est impeccable, tout équipé, à deux pas des lignes vertes et rouge express permettant de naviguer dans Manhattan en 15-20 minutes,
Maribel a été très disponible, accueillante et nous a recommandé des choses dans le coin et des tips.
Tout était absolument parfait pour notre séjour ! Si nous pouvions mettre 6 étoiles, nous le ferions.

Lovely and clean place. Near the train station, 40 mins to Manhattan. Comfortable bed and proper working kitchen. Bathroom with shower and everything you need.Quiet neighborhood and markets nearby. The host is helpful, reliable and a very kind person. I’d recommend it if you want to spend your holidays in NYC.

Great apartment in Cobble Hill. Very clean and lovely decor. Located close to many cafes/restaurants and walking distance to the subway. Charles was a wonderful host: easy check-in and communicated well. Would stay again!

Thanks Caitlin for such amazing gracious hospitality.You made my first stay in NY stress free and I felt completely looked after by this lovely woman.Caitlin has a gorgeous apartment in a really nice area .Not once have I felt unsafe actually quite the opposite, with people going out of their way to help.Having Central Park so close is just such a bonus and easy walk to a lot of art galleries/museums .Straight forward location for accessing all areas by a short walk to subway...and the bed is OUTSTANDING..ten outta ten Ms Caitlin

Increíble alojamiento muy cerca de los barrios de soho, Chinatown y little Italy.
Positivo: personal amble y siempre con una sonrisa, café y pastel INCLUIDO EN EL PRECIO para desayunar todos los días de tu estancia, muy buena localización (cerca de Chinatown o Little Italy y a 30 min andando de Wall Street), habitación bastante limpia y múltiples opciones de metro alrededor.
Negativo: la limpieza de la habitación tiene un coste de 70$/limpieza que no se informa en el anuncio.
Repetiría sin duda!

Kaz and Kayo and the whole team where amazing! Best customer service on Airbnb. Whenever something didnt work the fixed it in no time. Whenever I wrote to them they replied instantly and very friendly. The apartment was taken care of excellent and with everything you need. And greatly located in a quite neighbourhood. Recommend 1000%

I enjoyed this unit. It was quiet & peaceful so I could get my work done. It was very close & walkable to several restaurants, gyms, coffee shops, stores, train station and everything I needed. I would definitely book it again.
No problems. As others have said, the elevators take some time.

I am pleased to write a review regarding the hospitality and home-like feel of Daniela’s flat in Harlem.  The flat is spacious, comfortable and warm during my cold and snowy visit.  The kitchen is well equipped, modern and clean.  The time and care that Daniela’s has invested in this property is apparent and appreciated.  The flat is in an historic area of Harlem, with great access to buses, subways, and quick Ubers.  I particularly enjoy the many restaurant and cafe choices.  This flat is my home away from home♥️
Great place right next to Chinatown and Little Italy.
nice place, we had room 8 & it had a great view
Great stay, cozy. private. I loved it.

Great location and the place is really clean and comfortable. Amir’s really thoughtful to his guest and responds quickly to our questions. We loved how the place had little touches of New York in it and his suggestions about places to eat was very helpful as well.

The description was actually very unfitting. The room’s pretty small with a king sized mattress placed. And look... I get it it’s NY but there’s not much room to maneuver around this one. Oh, random but I asked if he recommended any bars/restaurants and he responded by saying something amongst the lines that he’s a white guy and the bars he frequents won’t be my cup of tea. I was confused and I hope the nonblack people that poses this question gets the same response 💀 it was a bit extra-
I’m asking for drinks not race relations sir... anywho my stay was just two days as I came for a shoot during pride wknd — later that evening my friend had partied a little too much so I told him to spend the night, the host peeked through the room and sent a message that could’ve been communicated more effectively and in a better tone. NO GUESTS, the doors MUST ALWAYS be close, the AC has to be off when you leave, don’t lock the top lock, yadadee yadada. I think my dorm room had less protocols. I’m sure Ron is a nice guy but maybe hosting just isn’t HIS thing. Nevertheless it’s in a great area. I wasn’t going to let that ruin my trip, the city’s great and its really up to you and what you make of the situation 🍾 Good luck

Zhen place is wonderful . The room was amazing and nice touches. Zhen answered pretty fast when I had an issue and went out her way to fix any issues. The only con about this place is that the area sucks when it comes to ordering food or getting food. Everything closes pretty earlier. The room was clean. Sheets was clean. Bathroom was amazing. I recommend this place.

Divain’s property was amazing and everything was in order.  Our family of four fit perfectly in the space with lots of room to spread out.  The kids loved the individual TV’s in each room, and enjoyed the selection of books provided.  An awesome place for a NY getaway!
It was a perfect place for a couple of nights in the city. The rooftop deck was amazing!
The place was amazing in a wonderful area of Brooklyn. In the hot summer New York heat, the ACs were life savers. Communications with Ryan were easy breazy. Would recommend for sure!
Jayley’s place is minimal, cozy, and in a great location. Communication and check in were breezy. Highly recommended for minimal travelers!
Cozy place, a bit worn. Incredible location, perfect for somebody who likes an active city vacation. We really enjoyed our stay. Thank you Mia!

The place was really really dirty. It had a horrible smell through out the whole hotel. There was a dirty handprint on the wall and there was a bunch of red hair all over our bed sheets.
I know that there is also a disclaimer about taxes not included but I wasn’t expecting to pay $300 in fees after paying Airbnb in full.
Angelika's apartment was exactly as described, clean, cozy and in a good area. Perfect place to stay in NY.
Mike was a great host. Would recommend!

The apartment was generally satisfactory, but we faced a few discrepancies and issues during our stay. Even though the listing mentioned that the apartment can accommodate a maximum of three guests, there were four beds set up in one pass-through room, leading to four people staying in that space. Furthermore, the overall occupancy was seven people in the apartment, which felt a bit cramped. One of the beds was notably too short, making it uncomfortable for a good night's sleep. Additionally, we observed a few missing beers from the refrigerator. Despite these setbacks, we're grateful for the stay and hope the host takes our feedback into account for future guests.
Great place, good location
Lovely home and lovely space; a total gem in Brooklyn!
Je recommande a tout le monde. Très bon prix, accessible à tout et chouette quartier avec chouette voisinage !

Liza a été une super hôte. Nous avons eu du retard à l’arrivée de notre avion et elle a été super réactive pour nous aider à trouver des solutions pour les clés.
L’appartement est cosy et très agréable, super bien placé en plein Williamsburg. A quelques minutes du métro, vous avez tout ce qu’il vous faut autour (restaurants, bars, courses, shopping..). Le lit était particulièrement confortable et tout l’appartement est super bien équipé.
Nous reviendrons avec plaisir !
Clean unit, very communicative!

My stay with Elma and Mike was great! I was only in town for two nights, and their place was perfect It was very conveniently located near the MTA, clean, and quiet. It was a great home base for exploring during the day and relaxing at night. Elma sent clear, helpful instructions for using the MTA, and Mike gave me an excellent dinner recommendation the night I arrived. I would definitely stay with them again. Thanks, Elma and Mike!
Great quiet hotel.  Staff is incredibly friendly and helpful.  Wonderful location!

Chambre spacieuse avec nombreux rangements et accessoires de cuisine. Les espaces communs dont la salle de sport sont un plus.
Le personnel est très accueillant et agréable.

This is a lovely room for the price. The city noises weren’t too loud or disruptive most of our stay. At the end of the stay we had loud neighbors and realized how thin the walls are, but the host has ear plugs just for situations like this.

Es un departamento más grande de lo que imaginé, ubicado en un sector turístico como Dumbo, tranquilo, con una vista espectacular de Manhattan, a unos 10 minutos del metro, con restaurantes cercanos incluyendo 2 de las mejores pizzerías de NY a 2 pasos. La comunicación fue muy buena y amable siempre. El departamento limpio, ´sabanas y toallas limpias. Pasamos unas lindas vacaciones con mi familia. Gracias Nazila, Andrew y Mike.
Had a great stay at chito and Xaviers place it was very cozy . Perfect for my boyfriend and I to come back to after a long day of exploring nyc.

This is a great place to stay near Times Square. 9th avenue has several delis and restaurants just a few blocks away if you want something different than the hustle and bustle.
The apartment has a full set of cups and dishes, but if you are doing a long term stay, be prepared to purchase additional necessities to keep the apartment tidy. Communication with the host and POD staff is super easy, and both are quick and helpful. Would recommend!
Basma had a really nice space and was fast to respond. I would definitely stay here again

Bij aankomst regende het heel hard, maar Brynda zorgde voor een warm welkom door soep voor ons te koken. Zo fijn! Alsof je bij een goede vriendin thuis komt.
De dag daarna kookte ze weer heerlijk, het huis vulde zich met lekkere geuren en gezelligheid.

Prospect Park en openbaar vervoer zijn op loopafstand. De buurt is ook interessant: Little Haïti. Probeer eens een patties.
New York City is ontzettend groot, maar na een week voelde het echt alsof ik op weg naar mijn huis was i.p.v. gewoon maar een AirBnB.

Staying at Darya's place was a large part of why I just had one of the best trips I've ever been on. She is the kindest, most generous person, and goes above and beyond for her guests. Her apartment is great, and you have all the privacy you want/need. She made me tea and coffee and gave me so many great tips about restaurants and places to go in the city. She was extremely helpful and friendly, and helped make my trip so awesome and memorable.
the place was really nice and clean, there was a couple of entertainments like projector, monitor and books. so, you definitely will not miss here
Really good and comfortable place to be resting and have a good night, very clean and also nice and polite people in turn

Host molto preciso, puntuale e flessibile anche sugli orari di check-in e check-out. Alloggio complessivamente ben tenuto e con tutti i servizi. Unica pecca solo le 3 rampe di scale ripide che sono impegnative sopratutto all’arrivo e alla partenza
El alojamiento es muy bueno, tal cual se describe y tal cual las fotos que se muestran. El vecindario es muy tranquilo y seguro, en 5 mn llegas al subway y estas muy cerca de la ciudad.
Really cozy place. Everything was amazing
Good Hotel, the breakfast must improve to be an excelent hotel.

Great place to stay! There is a hotel fee, just a heads up. I paid $70CAD upon arrival for 2 nights. Also worth noting that the washrooms and showers are shared with everyone on the floor. Not private. Good value though! Would go back.

Die Unterkunft war wie Beschrieben sehr gut zu erreichen und in einer ruhigen Gegend alles war wirklich sauber und der Checkin hat super geklappt 👍 ich würde die Unterkunft sofort wieder nehmen Danke Angelo 👍👍👍

Sparkling clean, homey, and stylish. I rented this for my parents in their 60s. They were apprehensive about Air B n Bs but after staying at Sylvia’s apartment they’ve totally changed their minds, and hope they can stay in Sylvia’s place when they visit me in Brooklyn next year.
I had a great stay at this apartment, the place is very cozy. I loved the location!! Would definitely stay again!

Val and Mel were amazing. Val welcomed me and introduced me to the cat and apartment. We chatted for some time about Broadway musicals and Val told me what she’s been hearing about current musicals.
There were many amenities that I didn’t need this time, but might in the future.
When I had more questions and wanted to leave my luggage after checkout, Val and Mel were very flexible.
The location was fantastic..within blocks of the subway and easy to find.
I’d highly recommend staying with Val and Mel.
Travis is amazing! He is so helpful and responsive and really goes above and beyond to make sure you have what you need and that your stay is perfect. I cannot recommend him enough!!

Nice place in the heart of Carroll Gardens. Close to the Carroll Street F/G, and close to the BQE if you need to drive. Easy street parking, and everything you need for a nice stay. Would definitely stay again!

모든 직원이 다 친절하고 룸도 깨끗해서 편안하게 쉬다 왔습니다. 샴푸,컨디셔너 바디샴푸,바디로션..모든것이 다 갖춰져 있었습니다.
다음에 뉴역에 갈 기회가 생긴다면 또 이용하고 싶습니다.

I spent the week on the UWS working remotely and spending time with some friends who live close by. The apartment was in a great location with the subway, so many restaurants and stores nearby. I had no issues working and the wifi was great! Everything was clean and I appreciated the brand new sponge in the wrapper by the kitchen sink. There was a slight mixup with the keys upon check in but Daniel was quick to respond and was insistent on covering lunch for me while I waited for the keys.
Had a great time and would love to come stay again!

We loved this lovely place - conveniently located to restaurants and bodegas, but very quiet and peaceful - very open and spacious room - we easily walked to our son’s house a few blocks away and appreciated the friendliness of the neighborhood - we will definitely return - Alex and Athena were great - very responsive

Faigie's Airbnb apartment is in an excellent location and has a lot of amenities (toiletries, washer/dryer, kitchen (stove, oven, microwave, some dishes & pots, no d/w, no coffee pot), towels, TV, A/C) and is fairly quiet. The space is crowded with a lot of furniture: 3 beds and a not so small dining room table and many chairs and a couple of bureaus. There is a bug problem: cockroaches and they are in the kitchen (the apartment is one big room and the kitchen area is next to the beds). Cockroaches are also in the bathroom where there is a mildew problem and no easy access to ventilation (there is a window that would be difficult to get to) and shower stall is dark because it has no light (you have to leave the curtain open for some light).
nice host, friendly, and helpful. Would highly recommend.
Lovely hosts, great location, nice, clean flat. Happily recommend it to anyone and would be using the flat again. :)
In a largely latin, peaceful neighbourhood. Clean house and a satisfactory stay.
Gute Lage, die kostenlose Fähre nach Manhattan ist in ca. 15 Minuten zu Fuß erreichbar. Die Unterkunft erfüllte alle unsere Erwartungen. Parkplatzsituation etwas schwierig, aber es ist halt New York.
Was a great space to stay and Eric was great! He gave us an in depth tour and even gave us directions to the nearest sites. Would 100% recommend booking with Eric.

Alles war super! Wir haben uns wie Zuhause gefühlt. Alle notwendigen Informationen zum Aufenthalt und Check-in haben wir vorab erhalten. Die Lage war auch optimal, um Manhattan zu erkunden. Wir können die Unterkunft nur weiterempfehlen.
Great host and nice accommodations. Good place to stay.

The host responded practically immidately to any questions or concerns we had. Tony was a great host and the space was great. It's only a 5 minute walk to the subway and the apartment is very spacious

Pettrina's place met all my needs, clean, comfortable, quiet and close to the subway.  Pettrina and Monica were easy to communicate with, provided all the information I needed to feel comfortable coming and going on my schedule.

Everything was exactly as it looked , the area wasn’t as comfortable for me somebody tried to attack us not to far from the Airbnb & there wasn’t enough police around that area also the spot was clean I still was startled by the roach that was crawling on the mirror , didn’t not how to work the hot tub properly & didn’t know the jet’s didn’t work in the shower other than that everything was fine 👍
Niko's room is indeed in a most perfect location on Manhattan, and Niko is a great and responsive host. Very recommended!
Very clean great location will return
The apartment is close to everything but far from the croud. For me having  a private bathroom has a value. I left to the airport at 3:30 am and it was no problem.
Timur’s place was clean and comfortable. Very convenient location to subway stations, groceries, restaurants, bars and more.

This is the BEST Airbnb we been in Ms. Marie place is soo sparkling clean really make you feels like home...Her & her husband are such some sweethearts... She had juices milk bread tea coffee etc etc....My son really enjoyed staying there everything was just soo PERFECT!!
Thank you once again You are the BEST ; )

Camille was responsive to communications. Was able to check in early for a reasonable fee and well worth it after a long red eye flight. The home was a welcome site and felt great to recharge. Plenty of room and was always quiet. Supplied coffee was great and looked forward to brewing every morning.
Everything was clean but there was no air conditioning and I paid over 130 for the space . I wasn’t completely satisfied for What I paid for :(
Amazing place. Clean, comfortable, and cozy. Super check in instructions, very great location to train. Will book again when I come back to NYC

This apartment is located half a block from Central Park, one block from the subway, in a nice neighborhood. Unfortunately it needs some love because it’s pretty rundown. I had read that the washer-dryer machine didn’t work, but since I saw it there I assumed that it had been fixed. Big mistake. It started making an awful sound and then it died. I ended up with a full load of wet laundry all over the apartment. Andrei answered right away that neither the washer-dryer or the dishwasher worked but that they were both there as to not leave the empty space in the kitchen.
I was there for a week under hot weather, it has AC units in the rooms and the kitchen, although pretty old and not very powerful, but after a while at least it was pretty ok. The room in the middle has a bed with a broken frame and a very rundown mattress and it’s really low which makes it quite difficult for some people to get up from it. I had other options for that price that maybe would’ve been better
Awesome spot in a great location.

This is our second stay with Elise. We hope to stay here for every family visit that we make. The apartment is wonderful in every way. Elise is always helpful.
We could not recommend it more highly.
Catia has a very Che attraversa Steak and causi a parmense e mezza più Yet e parmense e
Maggie is an amazing host. the place was clean, beautiful and perfect to rest.
Quiet neighborhood, comfortable beds.

This was a great space. I loved the kitchen which is stocked with dishes along with pots and pans. Everything was clean. The bathroom was nice woth fresh clean towels. The bed was comfortable with closet space to hang your belongings. water was nice and hot. We were able to connect to wifi. There was also a parking space available! I would definitely book again!

What a gem! This apartment is a wonderfully quiet & safe place to stay in Chelsea! It is very clean & comfortable. The location really can not be beat. Walk out the door & you are at Penn Station in just a couple of minutes. A great grocery store is just around the corner (largest selection of hummus we have ever seen in one store). There are plenty of places to grab amazing food with just a short walk. Pizza Supreme & Murray's are a couple of places we are glad we did not miss. One of the best perks of the apartment building is the rooftop garden & it's amazing views! The owners​ were very accommodating, respond quickly & gave great suggestions! Hope we can stay there again in the future!

Thank you so much Stephen 🫶
we had a wonderful stay at the apartment. We felt so welcome! It was really clean and beautiful and was always smelling so good because of the Palo Santo he used. There were beautiful fresh flowers, a bottle of water for us and he also gifted us some cacao dates.
Stephen also has an own little travel guide with recommendations for the area he shared with us and we can also recommend having breakfast or lunch at the FiveLeaves!
Stephen is a very kind host and we‘d love to stay there again for our next New York trip!
When you talk about clean I give this place a A+ great place to stay
We had a great stay at this hotel! The staff were very friendly and it had all we needed. The location was great for sight seeing!

It was a pleasure staying with Laurence! He was kind, respectful and helpful. He gave us a tour around the neighborhood when we arrived and that was a tremendous help. Whenever we needed to grab food we were already familiar with our whereabouts and there were plenty of good options in walking distance. The neighborhood is quiet & safe, plus the rooftop view is amazing! We would most definitely recommend anyone to stay here.
thank you so much, Bianca. I had a great time in your apartment. Would love to return some day

Incroyable séjour à Brooklyn! L’appartement était parfait pour 5 adultes et un bébé. Bien situé et à un peu plus d’un km du magnifique Prospect Park. L’appartement était propre et il était parfait pour nos besoins.

The apartment is conveniently located close to the J/Z subway lines in an authentic Brooklyn Brownhouse. Francis is a great, very accommodating and responsive host. Communication before arrival was smooth and welcoming. We stayed at the 2br apartment on the second floor, which was very clean and offered two beds for four people. An additional sofa bed in the living room could be used as spare bed, but this room is more noisy and brighter during the night. The kitchen in the apartment is well equipped, although there was no dishwasher. Parking right in front of the apartment was not an issue and the neighborhood offered easy access to groceries.

Bonjour,
Le studio est exactement comme sur les photos et la salle de bain est bien (il n'y a pas de photo).
Le ménage n'est pas parfait, comme l'ont indiqués les précédents voyageurs, mais j'avais prévu des lingettes et du coup je l'ai nettoyé. Ceci est bien peu de chose quand on voit ce qu'il y a d'agréable dans cette location. Le service de gardiennage 24/24 est super, le wifi de 5$ par 24h fonctionne très bien et ce n'est pas gênant de devoir payer cette somme car ce studio est le meilleur rapport qualité prix au vu de sa situation géographique. Nous sommes à 15 minutes max à pieds de Times Square et à 10 minutes de l'Empire State Building...
Il y a de quoi se restaurer dans la rue et tout autour...
Nous avons passé un très bon séjour (8 nuits) chez Eliza et elle a été très réactive dans ses réponses pour préparer notre voyage. Si nous retournons à New York nous séjournerons de nouveau chez Eliza.

Moksha é uma excelente anfitriã, muito educada e atenciosa, não poupou esforços pra me ajudar com coisas que não eram nem da conta dela e estava sempre disponível.
O apartamento é bem confortável e acho que acomoda 3 pessoas tranquilamente.
Além disso é silencioso e muito bem aparelhado. A localização dá fácil acesso ao metrô/ônibus e embora, tecnicamente seja o LES, o feeling é mais para Chinatown.
great place and grest orice

Patrick it's such a nice person! Although I didn't have any problems, he would always ask if there were any, offering solutions on the spot
The place is underneath a train, so yeah it's a bit noisy all day, but it also means you have lots of stores/restaurants and transport available nearby, I'd say it's worth it!

I highly recommend staying here for many reasons. First of all, Moying’s hospitality was ultra welcoming and kind. As a solo female traveler, I want to mention how safe I felt. I even felt safe enough to go walk at night around the area. I loved how Chinatown and Little Italy are right at the doorstep for you to explore. If you’r staying here please try out the mango gelato at Ferrara Bakery & Cafe.
Great place plus great host, had many recommendations on where to eat and what to do. Communicates very quick. Location is good and amazing price. Needs to be a bit cleaner.

This room is exactly as described and had everything you need for a short stay. The bathroom is located right across the room and Valentina leaves out an assortment of breakfast items for you (including Nespresso). The space was clean and location can’t be beat. Her apartment is a 2 min walk from the subway and the neighborhood is quiet.
The bedroom was really clean and nice. Monisha helped us with our luggage after the check in. She is a good host

Rosaly is a great host, very friendly and easygoing! The room was super clean, the bed was even more comfortable than it looks, and the shower was delicious. Her place is close to two subway and a train stations, and has a lot of good stores nearby as well, such as a huge Whole Foods, which is very handy. And it is in a beautiful part of Harlem which is so full of history. I recommend to anyone staying in NYC!

Our family loved Becky and Andrew's place. It was spacious and stylish, and in a really interesting neighborhood that we enjoyed immensely. The apartment is quiet, and we availed ourself of the little patio on numerous occasions!

Communication was easy-breezy lemon squeezy, and they responded quickly to any questions we had. Awesome. Also, two blocks from a really great subway line.
Perfect Stay for a couple looking for a great deal for their NYC trip!

This is a really great find on NY! Alicia is a very welcoming host. She helped me navigate through the transportation in the city, answered questions I had, and conversed with me over tea in the mornings. She got me out of trouble by ordering a cab when I was late for my flight. I don't think you can get that sort of attention or experience in a hotel. I felt very much at home. The place itself is cozy and full of art with a beautiful view of the river. It's just a block away from the subway, so for an affordable price you can easily reach the rest of the city. Overall, I would definitely recommend. 10/10.
Loved the stay, very tranquil and relaxing including great service 10/10

Great spot for a quick stay in the city. The location is awesome, with the 6 being a block away and the park only a few more!
It was wonderful and I highly recommend!

Gorgeous space at an incredible value. Steve was great with communication, check-in was smooth and easy, the home is beautifully renovated and embodies Harlem and Black culture through and through.
I live in North Carolina now but I grew up just a few blocks away and felt right at home. I loved my stay and would definitely come back again when I’m visiting NYC.

I stayed in Antonio's apartment for almost 2 months. It was a very pleasant experience. Antonio's communication was super-quick and he was able to solve any question I had in a few minutes. He was so nice to provide me with early check-in & late check-out, as well as arranging the cleaning lady.
The apartment was outstanding and the location was perfect for me while I was doing business mainly in midtown.
Great spot! Fun location and hosts communicated well
Great place, spacious. AC worked great. Would stay here again in a heartbeat.

Nous avons passé une semaine chez Leli et tout s'est bien passé! Le logement est très bien situé car à 2min a pieds de la station de métro. Concernant les temps de trajets pour les attractions les plus "courantes", il faut compter à peu près 40min. Le fait d'être un peu "excentré" vous permet de voir aussi une autre ambiance, une vie de quartier, donc vraiment je recommande. Le lit est confortable, le logement très propre et bien équipé. Leli est très réactive et très serviable, cela est très appréciable! Merci Leli pour votre accueil!!

Outstanding visit.  If you are wondering if this is a place that you feel like you can enjoy the city life, yet will a laid back atmosphere, this is it.  I look forward to staying at this location anytime I'm back in NY.

Amir's home was perfect- beautifully furnished with every possible amenity one may need. As a host Amir was very kind and readily available to help make sure our stay was the best possible experience. The kitchen was fully stocked with all types of tableware and cooking pans, and he was even kind enough to leave some waters for us when we arrived. Highly recommend this host- thank you Amir!
This place was very clean and well organized. Very beautiful, even more that what you see in the pictures. One of the best places I have stayed at. Highly recommend.

Short stay in NYC to attend a graduation ceremony at Columbia University. Easy access to trains to downtown. Nice spacious street. Interior very well thought off. Good beds. Well equipped kitchen. Perfect for our purpose.

Nous avons passé un bon séjour chez Susan. Nous avons pu arriver facilement dans la nuit et on a pu laisser nos bagages pour notre dernière journée !
Facile d'accès en métro.
Susan a été très reactif à nos remarques.
Petit bémol, nous avons été surpris du bruit environnant et de la luminosité dans l'appartement le matin.
Thank you for yours business  ! Good ,clean Hotel and Very nice working personal .
Angela was incredibly flexible with my schedule and kindly let me drop my bags off early. Great communication throughout!

Tutto è stato perfetto, se tornerò a New York alloggerò sicuramente qua! Zona comodissima, stupenda. Se posso solo aggiungere un appunto, forse la caparra era un po' alta, però si merita lo stesso le 5 stelle!
Cordialmente,
Federico
The location of the place is great. Ashley is nice and helpful
Great location, and a very large bedroom with couch for relaxing.  Close to the park and a deli right across the street.  I hope to stay with Violette again.
Great place to stay. Very Clean and rooms are exactly as shown in pictures. Highly recommend!

We loved the size of the loft for our family trip to NY. The unit was well furnished and sparkling clean. We had everything we needed for our stay. The street parking was a huge bonus.
The hotel was a short walk to the subway station for a quick trip to the city. There are groceries and restaurants within few mins of walk.
The staff was very welcoming and helpful during our stay.
Great location, just a described!!! Highly recommended to anyone in the area looking a for a nice place to stay.
Great find and the host is very responsive! The home is decorated nice and only one flight of stairs! Will stay again!

Innerhalb unseres 2 Wöchigen USA Road Trip haben wir uns 4 aufregende Tage in New York verbracht. Es war toll. Wir waren 6 Personen (2 Erwachsenen und 4 Teenies) und haben und in der Wohnung sehr wohl gefühlt. Die Wohnung ist sehr sauber, modern und gut ausgestattet. Die Betten sind bequem. Sehr gute Anbindung an den öffentlichen Nahverkehr und viele Einkaufsmöglichkeiten für den täglichen Bedarf in der Nähe.
Die Kommunikation mit Joanna verlief immer schnell, freundlich. Sie hat auf alle Fragen prompt reagiert und immer Hilfe angeboten.
Vielen Dank für alles!

The house is clean, spacious, cozy, bright and very beautiful. The neighborhood is safe and full of shops, restaurants and near a large park.
Not far from the apartment there's the stop of the train and in 25-35 minutes you can reach Manhattan
Linda and Robert are two wonderful people. When I asked something they quickly help me better than I could wish for.
Some hours before my departure I had a problem , I hurt an ankle and I could not walk so we phoned asking if they could pick us up and Robert came quickly.
I advise you to stay in their home!!!

The place is organized clean and secured
Stick to the host policy . The apartment design is modern and is elegant. Everything

Proximité du métro, de quoi loger à 6 sans problème, appartement au 2è étage sans ascenseur.
Good place to stay a few days, it was as described in the advertisement
Clean place, good location, and the host was nice.
Great location! Will definitely stay here again!
A gem in Brooklyn. Clean and close to transit. Good communication with the host. Perfect for a large group. Pictures don’t do it justice. Would 100% stay again.

Belgin is a great host! She is very friendly, helpful and has a very nice apartment. The room is spacious and modern, the location is great too, excellent value for money. I thoroughly enjoyed my stay and would definitely recommend this room!
We had a great, comfortable stay! Mo and his team communicated well right from the start! I’d recommend this place to friends and family. Thank you!

I had a wonderful time with my family in Micheal's place.
we felt like home and the place is very convenient next to the shoping mall and Staten island Ferry that operates 24/7 and will take you to NYC in about 20 minutes. I will come back again to this lovely and spacious place.

Great stay at Mint House! Stayed for 4 nights over the New Year. Family of 4 (two teenagers 14/17) so we had the 2 bedroom apartment and sofa bed in the lounge which was perfect. Very spacious and equipped with everything you'd need. Staff were super helpful. Gym was well equipped too. Location was great. Subways easily accessible / Brooklyn Bridge, Wall Street, Battery Park all a few mins walk away.
Great communication & easy check in
Great place. Very clean
Everything was ok as described except it looks alot bigger in the pics and what it really is and it does not have a see thru window
The place is nice and clean except certain amenities unavailable such as towels, toilet rolls and refrigerator.

A lot smaller than images suggest. Located on a quiet street.
Hosts communicated promptly.
Smooth transaction.
Great place, will comeback
Beautiful home. Would stay here again.
Nice and clean affordable place to stay . And train is walkable distance for transportation.
Billy was great and the place, once inside was nice and clean. Parking was not easy to find. Billy was very responsive.
Great apartment located close to Central Park. Caitlin was really friendly and had plenty of recommendations for places to eat and things to do.
Pratique pour une nuit, mais attention, il est sous le métro donc très bruyant.

My stay at Sheri’s place was truly one of the best experiences I’ve ever had. The apartment is absolutely stunning, I completely fell in love with it !! Even if it’s a bit removed from the city center, you quickly get used to the location. I would 100% recommend staying here.
Thank you Sheri and Mariam for being such wonderful hosts!
The apartment is clean and comfortable, in a lively part of the neighborhood.   It was a perfect for our stay.  Check-in was easy, and Christopher went out of his way to accommodate us.

Perfect place for me and my 3 friends. Subway/bus stop around the corner, a city map given on arrival and very close to lots of shops and places to eat. We were given plenty of towels, extra bedding and NETFLIX which was great in the evenings! The communication was quick, would definitely recommend and stay again. Thanks :)

Ronald was very accommodating and very communicative. He walked me through the rules and the amenities as soon as I get there.  Good place for a short stay in Manhattan and great location to get anywhere using the subway.
Niko is a great guy and the accomodations were equally nice.  Everything went smoothly.  Great location.  Thanks Niko!

Très bonne communication et facilité d'accès. L'endroit est sécurisé. Le logement se situe sur la 8e avenue, donc très bien placé mais également bruyant. Les conditions sont un peu spartiates mais cela ne m'a pas dérangé car la description du logement l'annoncée, je savais donc à quoi m'attendre. La chambre était propre et le nécessaire était fourni pour dormir aussi calmement que possible. Bon petit déjeuner !

Amazing 10/10
Smells so good soon as you walk in .
Very great home feel
I love this place !
Very nice and cozy stay! Easy check in, very good communication from hosts, very close access to subway, get you anywhere in bk or city quite fast and convenient.

Great communication with Victoria, the location is superb and I felt very safe for a female solo traveller. The kitchen is not really available to use which I did not know before and overall the flat could have been a bit cleaner. If you are looking for affordable, safe and central location in NYC I would recommend!

Very clean and lovely apartment equipped with everything one needs. Bea was a great and very friendly host!
She was helpful from the beginning as the check-in was easy and flexible. Additionally, she provided us with useful information about the area. We could always reach out, if we had any questions. The apartment is also well located for public transportation as it is only a 5 minute walk to the metro station.
We'd love to come back and highly recommend it!

What an AWFUL experience. We arrived 30 minutes early and they could not accommodate us (understandable). We put our bags in the apartment and went on a walk to find lunch. On our way back, we were sexually harassed by a group of men just a few yards away from our Air BnB. This area is NOT safe to walk around, not even in the daytime. Especially if you are a group of women. There are frequent homeless people that walk up and down the street in front of the Air BnB. My friends and I felt very unsafe.
Upon arriving back, the water was off. We let the host know & he never responded. We had to pay $95 to take an Uber to the city to shower at a friend's family member's house. We reached out to the host after all of this to ask if we could pay for that night (even though we decided NOT to stay after we felt our safety was at risk) and get refunded for the remaining 4 nights and they refused to help in ANY way besides recommending we call the police. Do NOT stay here.

It was a pleasure to flow through this space during such a transitional chapter of my life. I stayed here for four months, and I’m deeply grateful for the safety, comfort, and peace it provided.
To those who come after me, know that there are two grocery stores within about a 5–7 minute walk, plenty of food options nearby, and paid laundry right outside your door. The neighborhood itself feels very grounded and approachable. The streets are quiet and peaceful, but within a block or two, you can easily find much more energy, movement, and busier areas.
The nearest train is about a 12–15 minute walk, and Astoria Park is about a 25 minute walk and absolutely stunning.
And perhaps most importantly... not a single bug during my entire stay.
